nightshade普通名可能指龙葵、颠茄等茄科植物，原文未限定物种，正文保守写茄科花朵，不生造夜影花或强猜一种。

ambiguities.term: stalk other Pokémon to lead them to food sources
ambiguities.resolution: 原句them指向被跟随的其他宝可梦，虽然与偷食语境略奇，仍保留尾随并引它们去食物处，不自行改成跟着它们为自己找食物。

ambiguities.term: is repaid by taking care of the fields
ambiguities.resolution: 原文语态含混；按敬奉、照料农田及双方互利的上下文，顺为村民敬奉它、它以照料田地回报，不颠倒成村民回报宝可梦以照料农田。
原文未定义具体季节，按后句潮湿环境并结合tropical温热含义，自然化为湿热时节；不擅写雨季或新增雨量设定。
源句在survive后多出孤立h，按明显排字杂字忽略；原文键逐字保留，仍译全部关于两天能量消散与自身恐惧供能的内容。

ambiguities.term: only to be vindicated once they are revealed
ambiguities.resolution: 被动句主语悬空；按持续墙内噪声困扰住户、发现宝可梦后证明噪音非虚构的语境，译那些人的说法得到证实，没有宣称宝可梦被证明无辜。
作者给毒蘑菇的俗称，以入土之邀保留埋葬/致命食物的文学双关；本轮创译，非官方植物或宝可梦专名。
本条缓存英名Unbuff、中文未知丁；原文明确fittingly for a fusion named POKENAME，体弱承接un-与buff强壮的英文梗。中文以英名透着不强壮的意思明示，不声称中文未知丁含同义、不改游戏融合名或遗留拉丁词。
英文Never odd or even本身为回文；中文优先保留非奇非偶及无尽眼睛变化的句意和对称措辞，不为强造中文回文而改义，也不遗留拉丁原句。
本条英名Uncruel、中文未知水母；原文fitting its name与less cruel承接un-与cruel的英文梗，以英名带着不残酷的意味解释，不声称中文名有相同构词，不改融合名或留拉丁词。
语境宝石挨击闪亮，right为light近形排字误；译为鲜红光，不译右方，不改变英文源键。

ambiguities.term: This leads to it biting things ... incapable of much thought
ambiguities.resolution: 前句明确POKENAME脑比后头脑大。it按相对更小后头的解剖语境解读，后头思考少而乱咬整吞；主审已读完整源并认可此读法，仍非作者确认，不将脑大小与智力关系推广到现实。前句相对大小未反转。
still不合硬度比较语境，按常见as solid as steel及近音拼写解释为钢铁般坚实；不改英文源键，不宣称作者确认，也不补硬度数值。
作者自称材料名译银钻，保留近乎完美晶体结构和最坚固材料之一，非现实矿物名或已核官方道具名，不额外指定银的成分比例。

ambiguities.source_issue: flays its ears在表达亲近、牵动面部表情的语境中用词异常，疑为展开/张耳动作笔误。
ambiguities.decision: 保守按展开耳朵顺译，保留因面部怪相受冷落、以泥墙自闭的因果，不按剥皮字面增写自残。

ambiguities.source_issue: density and sheet weight中sheet疑为sheer笔误。
ambiguities.decision: 按身体密度及巨大重量妨碍速度的语境译，不引入薄板面积克重或新物理数值。

ambiguities.source_issue: bite once then begin to teethe在全龄融合描述中用词宽泛。
ambiguities.decision: 按咬一口后磨牙的动作顺译，保留磨牙香气安抚、咬伤疼痛的对照，不限定幼龄或凭空写出牙。

ambiguities.source_issue: 末句the eggs of bird POKENAME再次用占位符，但当前215.10形态为狃拉×绿毛虫，不是鸟类。
ambiguities.decision: 首处保留POKENAME，末处按鸟类宝可梦的蛋保守释义，不宣称当前融合体为鸟，也不改英文原文精确键。占位符存在性仍正确。

ambiguities.source_issue: their hordes are filled with loose change中hordes疑为hoards。
ambiguities.decision: 按夜间恐吓村庄、零钱收藏语境译囤积财物，不解释为整群身体填满硬币。保留训练家报告语气，未改英文键。

ambiguities.source_issue: 原文将赤道附近举为long daylight hours的地区，地理概括不严谨。
ambiguities.decision: 保留作者所给夜间吸能、白昼较长地区虚弱的设定及赤道例子，不擅改纬度、日照时数或补科学解释。

ambiguities.source_issue: over 2000 degrees没有说明温标。
ambiguities.decision: 保留超过2000度，不擅加摄氏或华氏。

ambiguities.source_issue: 永不蒸发的沸腾液体又帮助产生蒸汽，原文物理机制不严谨。
ambiguities.decision: 保留作者奇幻设定，不擅改液体耗尽、添加循环解释或现实物性。

ambiguities.source_issue: spins on its head at ten miles per hour，旋转用线速度写法不精确。
ambiguities.decision: 保留每小时10英里的原文速度，不凭空改转每分钟或角速度。

ambiguities.source_issue: twice the temperature of boiled steel未给参照温标。
ambiguities.decision: 保留钢液沸腾温度两倍，区分沸腾与熔化，不擅添温标、数值或物性验证。

ambiguities.source_issue: 80 degrees未说明温标。
ambiguities.decision: 保留不超过80度，不擅加摄氏或华氏。

ambiguities.source_issue: if touched while sleeping省略睡眠主体。
ambiguities.decision: 主审复读后去掉趁它强指；末句保留睡着时接触宝石可实现愿望，不限定睡眠主体，不增可趁机触摸本体的设定。

ambiguities.source_issue: feeds mainly on geoids and rocks中的geoids疑为geodes晶洞石笔误，而非大地水准面术语。
ambiguities.decision: 按熔岩体内熔化矿石的进食语境暂译晶洞石和岩石，不引入天体形状或大地测量学设定。

ambiguities.source_issue: cold, active mountain regions中active未明确何种活动。
ambiguities.decision: 按山区地质活动活跃的语境译，并保留near附近；不补活火山、地热、成因。

ambiguities.source_issue: take care of their appearance中的their未明确指训练家还是POKENAME。
ambiguities.decision: 正文用悉心打理外表的训练家，不强加替本体梳毛、给自己打扮等动作；保留谢礼雪花与手工用途。

ambiguities.source_issue: deep protrusions in the sand与用作burrows的语境不完全吻合。
ambiguities.decision: 按海底滚行时角在沙中留下深沟痕保守译，供其他宝可梦作洞；不强加有顶盖沙丘或地质形成机制，不改英文源。

ambiguities.source_issue: when they are too hot中they可指路人或POKENAME。
ambiguities.decision: 结合夏日池塘玩耍语境中性译天热时朝路人喷水，不强指定路人过热、宝可梦过热或疾病机制。

ambiguities.source_issue: 海葵与POKENAME之间的it/its own food连用。
ambiguities.decision: 按海葵捕食、POKENAME获剩食的互利语境译；保留大海葵妨碍行动、吸盘固定的事实，不凭空添分餐规则。

ambiguities.source_issue: 过去卖出天价，所以后来赠石低值，因果机制未明。
ambiguities.decision: 只保留原文前后价格变化与因果措辞，不补供给泛滥、惩罚转卖者或真假宝石机制。

ambiguities.source_issue: until the day of their death中their指朋友或本体有形式歧义。
ambiguities.decision: 按直到此后才展翅离开的连贯语境，译朋友生命终结后本体离去；不添本体死亡或一生只飞一次设定。

ambiguities.source_issue: freezing black mist leaves burned frost含冰火并置的奇幻描写。
ambiguities.decision: 保留冰冷黑雾与烧灼霜痕，不用生物学冻伤替换环境霜痕，也不新增黑色冰晶或具体腐蚀机制。

ambiguities.source_issue: swallows it/regurgitates it中的it需由护蛋上下文识别。
ambiguities.decision: 译吞蛋避险、安全后吐回照料，不误吞靠近威胁；按安全/育护连贯语境判断，非作者确认。

ambiguities.source_issue: raises itself onto the back of its后缺名词，原句残缺。
ambiguities.decision: 保确定动作蓬耳、抬高身体显大，未猜补后腿、尾巴或具体支撑部位；毒液注完才松口条件保留。

ambiguities.source_issue: orchid scales中orchid可作兰花色名，也可能是形态比拟。
ambiguities.decision: 主审核Merriam-Webster orchid的浅紫色义，结合23.414爬虫鳞片语境，正文定点改淡紫色的鳞片。保磨粉补骨、邪恶组织驯养生产、毒牙驱退。非看图确认，不宣称作者明确形态。

ambiguities.source_issue: Once attacker is stunned ... it hastily flees中的it有形式指代歧义。
ambiguities.decision: 按使袭击者失去追赶能力后本体赶忙逃跑的防御语境，中文显名POKENAME逃，不误写麻痹的袭击者赶忙逃。

ambiguities.source_issue: parents leave ... once they reach maturity中they形式指向未明。
ambiguities.decision: 正文保成年后父母离去的原时间关系，不强补是父母还是后代成熟，不新增断奶年龄、进化条件或迁移地点。

原文吸干树桩使其变脆、离开找新居之后接ensuring territory secure and ready for next resting place，因果联系不清；保树桩变脆、寻找新居及安全领地/休息目的，不增树桩陷阱或加固机制。
its own body按POKENAME吸入自身孢子后受效处理，不泛化所有吸入者。成稿保精力阵阵涌现、动作活泼而无规律，不加持续时间或强化等级。
flames that emit from them的them可承接蘑菇，亦可能作者将POKENAME作复数代词；成稿保“散出的火焰”抑制寄生特性，不强定本体/蘑菇哪一部位产火，不补杀菌或消毒机制。

subsonic frequency将速度形容词用于频率；译低频吼声，保发声/舌头起伏动作，不补20Hz或音速以下频率等量纲。
as they produce a naturally sweet scent按花束/本体天然甜香承接，解释其避虫多林区，不添甜香来自虫群或具体毒素杀虫机制。

sources.use: Torchic Rice over Omelet采用已有料理中文名火稚鸡香滑蛋包饭，避免直译over产生摆盘误解。
Pinkan Island=平柑岛；区别Sunburst Island椪柑岛和Tangelo Island澎柑岛。
Punching Glove采用道具中文名拳击手套，不添加道具效果。
S.S. Anne=圣特安努号。
明确招式Psychic=精神强念；区别超能力属性及泛精神力。导出glossary新增categories分别提供moves/types词表，避免同名覆盖。
Fab Mail=奇迹邮件，采用百科第三世代邮件表通用译名，未添加信件内容。
Poké Doll=皮皮玩偶，沿用游戏物品名。
Pokémon Fan Club=宝可梦发烧友俱乐部，采用任天堂中文名。
Superb Remedy=厉害中药；保留原文鳞片提炼设定，未增官方配方或恢复数值。
honey linden在森林遗传资源报告中为多种蜜源椴树的用法，泛译不定种。
Diamond Dust天气任天堂译名冰晶，来源另述通名钻石尘；当前原文花粉称呼仅参考通名，不改物质或补天气效果。
Fancy Apple采用PokeAPI及Wiki一致中文特选苹果。
coesite=柯石英，仅核矿物名，未添加成因压力或温度到图鉴。
Lovely Mail在第二世代邮件列表通名可爱邮件；未增信纸图案。
Pink Juice采用表中通名粉色果汁。
Portraitmail采用第二世代邮件表肖像邮件。
clementine通用译名小柑橘。
Chili Sauce=辣酱。
cottage cheese=农家鲜奶酪。
ricotta=乳清奶酪。
quince英语释义页的简体/繁体翻译均为榅桲。
buttermilk与butter区分，正文只用酪乳，不添加制法。
Eusine当前任天堂名水京，亦与当前中文游戏资源9处用法一致；米那君为旧地区译名。
Yellow Nectar=金黄色花蜜。
目录中的Volcatrodon 374.574/374.576链接明示火神蛾与东/西海海兔兽组合，超出本地501基底候选范围。
当前Ensopod原文与两种Volcatrodon热液喷口生态同作者一致，未借其他作者生态覆写当前词条。
Enhydro Agate简体名称水胆玛瑙，仅核矿物名。
GIA中文尖晶石页面与英文spinel对应，颜色表含橙色。
haboob极端沙尘暴、尘墙的定义供中文释义；不加持续时间/成因到原文。
Piquant Pikachu Curry中文料理表为皮卡丘酥麻麻咖喱；未借菜单效果改写社区叶子设定。
Eon Mail=伊布邮件，Glitter Mail=闪亮邮件，按列表既有名。
Glitter Mail页面列台湾译名闪亮邮件；不宣称当前简中官方命名。
Nimbasa City对应雷文市，区别雷文镇。
Ecruteak Dance Theater=缘朱舞场。
Pester Ball无中文语言名表，沿用旧b与扩展b已使用的项目自译驱赶球；未增官方气体效果到作者正文。
Clamshell为beech mushroom常用名；料理语境不是一律硬译蛤壳。
真姬菇栽培条目列海鲜菇、白玉菇、蟹味菇俗称；中文正文沿用海鲜菇，不增加具体拉丁学名或药食属性。
Harlequin译滑稽演员，与Clown小丑分开。
Pinkan Island为平柑岛；发现旧包地图消息51误作常青道馆，定点修正。
卡诺里甜馅卷；本句cream filling奶油馅，不补具体乳酪种类。
糕点与糕点店而非糕点师；C10527保店之灵并记录pâtissier可能为作者想写的词但未确认。

decisions.source: POKENAME's two favorite things are honey and swimming. It gorges itself on the sweet substance to the point of covering its body, then it goes swimming to both play and clean up the mess it's made.
decisions.target: POKENAME最爱蜂蜜与游泳。蜜吃到满身，便下水玩，顺便洗干净。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最爱两件事：吃蜂蜜和游泳。它大吃特吃，常弄得满身蜂蜜，再下水游个痛快，顺便洗净这一身狼藉。

decisions.source: POKENAME wear skull helmets atop their heads to ensure that they do not receive concussions while they play games. As soon as they're done with their fun, the skulls come off their heads to allow fresh air to pass by their heads.
decisions.target: POKENAME戴头骨盔，防止玩游戏时脑震荡。一玩完就摘下，让头部透气。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头戴头骨做成的头盔，免得玩游戏时撞成脑震荡。玩够了，它们马上就把头盔摘下来，让脑袋透透气。

decisions.source: When this Pokémon hides from the predators in the ponds, the flower on its back floats on the water surface akin to a waterlily. At night, groups of POKENAME gather to sing together; their songs sound like a wind blowing over the reeds.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏池躲敌，背花像睡莲般浮水。夜里群聚唱歌，听着如风过芦苇。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦躲在池塘里避开捕食者时，背上的花会像睡莲一样浮在水面。夜里，POKENAME成群聚集，一同唱歌，歌声宛如风吹过芦苇。

decisions.source: POKENAME is adept in martial arts and it has powerful psychic powers as well. Its psychic powers are strong enough that it can see into the future, which allows it to predict the moves of its opponents.
decisions.target: POKENAME精通武术，精神力量也强，足以看未来，预知对手动作。
decisions.revised: POKENAME既精通武术，也拥有强大的超能力。它的超能力足以窥见未来，因此能预判对手的出招。

decisions.source: POKENAME sits on tree branches, camouflaging itself with its surroundings. The orbs on its body are made of iron and once they fall off, hunters will often collect them and use them as ammunition for their weapons.
decisions.target: POKENAME栖枝伪装。身上铁球一脱落，猎人常收去当武器弹药。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖在树枝上，借周围环境伪装自己。身上的球体由铁构成，脱落后，常被猎人收集起来，作为武器的弹药。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in large lakes, floating near the surface and soaking in the sunlight. When they need to leave the water they will do so by carrying gigantic lily pads with them to shade themselves from the sun and help keep them from drying out.
decisions.target: POKENAME住大湖，在水面附近晒太阳。离水时带巨大睡莲叶遮阳，帮助防干。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在大湖中，飘浮于水面附近，沐浴阳光。需要离水时，它们会带上巨大的睡莲叶遮阳，帮助身体保持湿润。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a remarkably lazy Pokémon; it acts like its body is heavy even though it's incredibly light. It would rather wait for its wings to collect dew than fly to a stream for a drink.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体极轻，却懒得装沉。宁等翼上积露，也不飞溪边喝水。
decisions.revised: POKENAME懒得出奇，明明身体极轻，行动却像沉重不堪。它宁愿等翅膀积起露水，也不肯飞到溪边喝一口。

decisions.source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is capable of flying up into trees to feed on fruit. However, it usually prefers to remain on the ground and fires blasts of high-pitched sound from its ears to make ripe fruit vibrate until it falls.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽大，仍能飞上树吃果。可多半宁愿留地，从耳放高音，震落熟果。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体型虽大，仍能飞上树吃果实。不过，它通常宁愿留在地上，从耳朵发出阵阵尖锐的高音，震得熟果不断颤动，直到掉落。

decisions.source: POKENAME pretend to be a lily pad and wait for Bug-type Pokémon to come their way. Once they are within range, they flick their tongue out to stick onto the Bug-type Pokémon and eat them.
decisions.target: POKENAME装睡莲叶，等虫属性宝可梦来。一到范围，就弹舌黏住吃掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME伪装成睡莲叶，等待虫属性宝可梦靠近。对方一进入范围，它们便迅速弹出舌头，黏住吞食。

decisions.source: POKENAME lay at the bottom of the ocean floor where they ambush prey with a jolt of electricity. If two POKENAME meet during the courtship season, they exchange bites on each other's fins to signal interest in one another.
decisions.target: POKENAME躺在海底，电击伏猎。求偶季两只相遇，会互咬鳍，表明好感。
decisions.revised: POKENAME伏在海底，以突然的电击伏击猎物。求偶季若有两只相遇，便会互咬鳍，向彼此表达好感。

decisions.source: POKENAME submerge themselves in rivers so that only their eyes, ears, and tails are above the water. Groups of them raise the ambient temperature of the water surrounding them and, when they are excited enough, can cause it to boil.
decisions.target: POKENAME浸河，只露眼、耳与尾。成群能升高周围水温，够兴奋，甚至煮沸。
decisions.revised: POKENAME浸在河里，只露出眼睛、耳朵和尾巴。它们成群聚集，能让周围的水温升高；兴奋到一定程度，甚至能把水煮沸。

decisions.source: POKENAME tunnel through the soil, keeping only their flower above the surface. They constantly emit a sickly sweet scent that draws other Pokémon to them, launching out of the soil to bite at them once they're close enough.
decisions.target: POKENAME钻土，只露花，持续散出甜腻香。宝可梦被引近，就跃出土，猛咬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在土中穿行，只把花露在地面，不断散发甜腻的香气，吸引其他宝可梦。等对方靠得够近，它便跃出土层，扑咬过去。

decisions.source: When POKENAME runs, it moves its wings in such a way as to cast flames behind it, leaving trails of fire in its wake. Using this, it surrounds a target with quick movements until the fire walls leave them with no chance of escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME跑动时，以翼向身后抛火，留下火道。迅速绕目标转，让火墙封死逃路。
decisions.revised: POKENAME奔跑时，会挥动翅膀向身后抛出火焰，留下一路火迹。它借此迅速绕着目标奔走，直到火墙彻底封死逃路。

decisions.source: POKENAME hides among any flower patches it finds, changing the color of its leaves and body to blend in. Any unsuspecting insects that fly overhead get caught by its extendable tongue lashing out and snagging them.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏花丛，叶身变色相融。昆虫无意飞过，长舌就猛甩抓住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME找到花丛就藏进去，改变叶片与身体的颜色，融入四周。毫无戒备的昆虫一旦从上方飞过，它便猛甩能够伸长的舌头，将其抓住。

decisions.source: POKENAME sways the silks on its tail to lull its prey into a trance. It then shoots a freezing water stream to encase its target in ice so it can drag it back to its lair.
decisions.target: POKENAME摇摆尾丝，让猎物入迷，再喷冰冻水流，将其封冰，拖回巢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME摇曳尾上的丝，使猎物陷入恍惚，再喷出冰冷的水流，将目标封在冰里，方便拖回巢穴。

decisions.source: An POKENAME's three orbs each play an important role in the flow of electricity throughout its body. The orb on its tail charges electricity, the orb on its head stores and distributes electricity, and the orb upon its club discharges electricity.
decisions.target: POKENAME三个光球各司其职：尾球充电，头球储电并分配，骨棒球负责放电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的三个球体，各自负责全身电力流转的重要环节：尾上的球充电，头上的球储存、分配电力，棍棒上的球则负责放电。

decisions.source: POKENAME exude a sweet scent from their flowers that can carry for long distances on the wind. Their sense of smell is particularly sensitive to the smell of these flowers and they use it to seek one another out in dense forests.
decisions.target: POKENAME花香能随风远传。嗅觉尤其敏感，能借同类花香，在密林找到彼此。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的花散发甜香，能随风飘出很远。它们的嗅觉对这种花香尤其敏锐，凭此便能在密林中找到彼此。

decisions.source: It usually has a calm nature, but when it fights it becomes aggressive. Although this Pokémon can fly, it is also a skilled swimmer. POKENAME uses the horn on its forehead to cut through the waves of the sea, and to hunt prey underwater.
decisions.target: 平时安静，开战却会凶狠。它会飞，也善泳，POKENAME用额角劈开海浪，在水下捕猎。
decisions.revised: 它平时性情沉静，一旦交战却会变得凶猛。虽然会飞，它也十分擅长游泳。POKENAME用额头上的角劈开海浪，并在水下捕猎。

decisions.source: The bright light that emanates from POKENAME's tail will compel Rattata within a mile of its location to head to the light's source. This works quite handily as a grand-scale method of pest control.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾光会吸引1英里内的小拉达前来，十分方便大规模除鼠。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾巴发出的亮光，会让周围一英里内的小拉达纷纷朝光源赶来，作为大规模除鼠的手段十分方便。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body contains a powerful generator that can produce vast quantities of electricity that are stored within the "X"-like part of its outer body. The "X" will glow a vibrant blue when it has reached the pinnacle of its electric charge.
decisions.target: POKENAME体内强发电机，产生大量电，存入体表“X”形部位。充至顶点，“X”便亮蓝发光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体内有强力发电机，产生的大量电力储存在体表的“X”形部位。电荷蓄积到顶点时，“X”就会泛起鲜亮的蓝光。

decisions.source: POKENAME is known as “The Tyrant of the Seas” due to its aggressiveness and brutality. The two golden fins on its body are sharp enough to slice through steel and allow it to maintain flight after it launches itself out of the water.
decisions.target: POKENAME凶猛残暴，号称“海洋暴君”。两片金鳍能切钢，跃水后，也帮助维持飞行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME凶猛残暴，因此号称“海洋暴君”。身上的两片金色鳍锋利得足以切开钢铁，还能让它跃出水面后，继续在空中飞行。

decisions.source: Spending most of their days in the safety of the nest, POKENAME cry out to their parents when they get hungry. If this Pokémon goes too long without eating, it will spit fireballs in a temper tantrum.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多安全地待巢里，饿了叫亲代。太久没吃，就发脾气，吐火球。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大部分时间都安全地待在巢里，肚子饿了就叫父母。若太久没吃东西，它便会大发脾气，吐出火球。

decisions.source: Herds of POKENAME gather together in fields to sing to one another. It is difficult to estimate how large these herds can get. Whenever researchers tried to count them, they found themselves lulled to sleep by their songs.
decisions.target: POKENAME群聚田间对唱，规模很难估。每次研究者想数，都被歌声哄睡。
decisions.revised: 成群的POKENAME聚在田野里，彼此对唱。它们的群体究竟能有多大，很难估计，因为每次研究者试着清点，都会被歌声哄得睡着。

decisions.source: Rival POKENAME bonk heads against each other in the wild, causing the pollen on their head to disperse in great batches. Areas where POKENAME live tend to be filled with a greater amount of plant-life due to this.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME对手互撞头，让大量头粉散开，因此住处往往植物更茂。
decisions.revised: 野外，相互竞争的POKENAME会用头碰撞，让头上的花粉成团散开。因此，它们栖居的地方，植物往往更加繁茂。

decisions.source: POKENAME are rarely seen on the ground, as they are constantly soaring through the sky on wind currents. On the rare occasion that they are on the ground, they can be seen half submerged in mud absorbing minerals.
decisions.target: POKENAME几乎总乘气流翱翔，地上少见。偶尔落地，就半浸泥里吸矿物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不停乘气流翱翔，很少落到地上。偶尔落地时，能见它半身浸在泥里，吸收矿物。

decisions.source: When POKENAME bites, it will clamp its jaw shut and lock the target into a vice-like grip. With the opponent trapped, it will fly up high with them in tow before releasing its hold and sending them plummeting back down.
decisions.target: POKENAME一咬，双颚如台钳锁牢目标。它带对手高飞，再松口，让其直坠下去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一旦咬住，就会合紧双颚，像台钳般牢牢锁住目标。待对手无法挣脱，它便带着对方飞上高空，再松口，让其直坠而下。

decisions.source: POKENAME hunt for prey by swooping down onto rivers and grabbing it with their beak. POKENAME start fires on the riverbank to cook food before they eat it, but will splash water onto the flames if it starts to spread too much.
decisions.target: POKENAME俯冲河流，用喙捉猎物。河岸生火烹食，若火蔓延太过，就泼水熄灭。
decisions.revised: POKENAME俯冲向河流，用喙抓取猎物。它们在河岸生火，烹熟食物再吃；若火势蔓延得太开，就会泼水遏制。

decisions.source: POKENAME flutter into the sky in large swarms on windy days, each of them searching for the strongest gusts of wind. They hold their fluffy arms out as they fly, clouds of seeds drifting away from the swarm in the breeze.
decisions.target: POKENAME风天大群升空，各找最强气流。飞时伸绒臂，成云种子随微风远散。
decisions.revised: 风大的日子里，POKENAME成群振翅升空，各自寻找最强的阵风。它们飞行时伸开蓬松的双臂，团团种子便随微风飘离群体。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves to gnaw on bones, especially since it relies on eating small shards of bone to give itself a boost of calcium. When it is not chewing on bones, it sprawls across a rock to sunbathe and nourish the leaf on its head.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱啃骨，尤其需吃小碎骨，补充钙。不啃时，就摊在石上晒太阳，滋养头叶。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱啃骨头，尤其需要吃下小碎骨，为身体补钙。不啃骨头时，它就摊在岩石上晒太阳，滋养头上的叶子。

decisions.source: POKENAME take great pride in their appearance and are at their happiest when they're being pampered by their trainer. They regularly preen at their feathers and fur with their beak, keeping themselves ready to take to the air at a moment's notice.
decisions.target: POKENAME极重视外貌，训练家呵护时最开心。它常用喙梳羽与毛，随时准备升空。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分看重自己的外表，最开心的就是受到训练家的悉心呵护。它们常用喙梳理羽毛和毛发，时刻准备着一有需要便飞上天空。

decisions.source: POKENAME hates it when its fur isn't constantly moist and is never seen far from a body of water. It spends most of the day floating on top of the water with its buoyant tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME最怕毛不湿润，从不远离水域。大半天都靠浮尾漂在水面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME讨厌毛发不够湿润，从不远离水域。一天中的大部分时间，它都靠浮力十足的尾巴，漂在水面上。

decisions.source: POKENAME taunts at prey with its tongue before spitting bubbles at them to obscure their vision. It then injects venom into them using the barb on its tail before ripping them apart with its large claws.
decisions.target: POKENAME伸舌挑衅猎物，再吐泡遮视线，尾刺注毒，最后用大爪撕裂。
decisions.revised: POKENAME先朝猎物伸舌挑衅，再吐出泡泡，遮住对方视线。随后，它用尾刺注入毒液，最后以巨爪将猎物撕碎。

decisions.source: When POKENAME dances, its thick plumage rubs together and builds up a static charge. The electricity is channeled into the pom-poms on the ends of its wings, which can release the charge all at once to shock foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME跳舞，厚羽相擦积静电，再导进翼端绒球，一口气放出，电击敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME跳舞时，浓密的羽毛相互摩擦，积蓄静电。电力会导入翼端的绒球，再一口气放出，电击敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME have been observed swimming together with linked fins, moving in rhythmic patterns. By rubbing the fluff on their fins together, they help each other build an electric charge. This charge helps keep them warm in the cold ocean.
decisions.target: POKENAME连鳍共游，动作有节奏。鳍绒互蹭，帮助彼此蓄电，抵御冷海寒意。
decisions.revised: 人们观察到，POKENAME会牵着彼此的鳍，一起有节奏地游动。它们摩擦鳍上的绒毛，帮助彼此蓄电，借此在寒冷的海洋里保暖。

decisions.source: POKENAME patrol around human towns and cities, hoovering up trash with their long nozzle. They never need to be emptied, as they break it all down into a foul-smelling toxic gas that they vent out of their head.
decisions.target: POKENAME巡城镇，用长吸嘴吸垃圾，无需清空。全分解成臭毒气，从头排掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在城镇周围巡游，用长吸嘴吸走垃圾。它们从不需要清空体内，因为所有垃圾都会分解成恶臭的毒气，从头部排出。

decisions.source: POKENAME were once terrors of the sea. Long ago, they would careen at high speeds into the sides of wooden ships, gouging holes through the hull to sink them. They would then dive into the wreckage and collect any treasure left behind.
decisions.target: POKENAME曾是海上恐怖，古时高速撞木船侧，凿穿船体沉船，再潜进残骸收宝。
decisions.revised: POKENAME曾是海上的恐怖存在。很久以前，它们高速撞向木船侧面，凿穿船身，将船击沉，再潜入残骸，收集留下的财宝。

decisions.source: POKENAME bob upright in the water, popping their head and hood above the surface and swaying back and forth to get a good view of what's happening on the shore. When threatened, they attack by swinging the buoy on their tail at their foe.
decisions.target: POKENAME直立浮水，让头与颈褶露出，来回摇摆，看清岸边。受威胁，就甩尾浮具打敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME直立着浮在水里，将头和颈褶探出水面，来回摇摆，好看清岸上的动静。受到威胁时，它们便甩动尾巴上的浮具，击向敌人。

decisions.source: As a pet, POKENAME is affectionate, but finicky. It enjoys being pet, but only for a certain amount of time; once it's done receiving affectionate, it flares fire on its back to let others know it no longer wishes to be touched.
decisions.target: POKENAME作宠物，亲热却挑剔。它爱被摸，可只肯一阵；够了，就背喷火，表示别再碰。
decisions.revised: 作为宠物，POKENAME亲热却挑剔。它喜欢被抚摸，却只肯接受一阵；觉得够了，就会让背上冒出火焰，告诉旁人自己不愿再被碰。

decisions.source: POKENAME make their homes within the tallest trees so they can use their tails to draw and capture lightning that they then store within their bodies. Each orb along its back will light up as it prepares to fire lightning from the tip of its tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME住最高的树，用尾招雷，捕来存体内。准备从尾尖发雷时，背上每颗球都亮起。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将家安在最高的树上，用尾巴引来、接住雷电，储存在体内。准备从尾尖放出雷电时，沿背排列的每颗球都会亮起。

decisions.source: POKENAME coats its wool with a sticky slime to prevent it from falling off its body. This, however, causes the wool to become an insulator for its electricity, so it has to be careful not to put on too much.
decisions.target: POKENAME用黏液涂毛，防止脱落。可也会让羊毛隔绝电流，因此不能抹太多。
decisions.revised: POKENAME给羊毛涂上黏液，防止脱落。可这也让羊毛隔绝电流，因此它得小心，不能涂得太多。

decisions.source: POKENAME's sharp, green feathers swell as it is exposed to water from any source. It will shed these feathers in battle and launch them at its foe with bursts of steam, but new feathers will regrow as it sleeps.
decisions.target: POKENAME锐利绿羽沾任何水都会膨胀。战中用蒸汽脱羽射敌，睡时又长回。
decisions.revised: POKENAME锋利的绿羽，无论沾上哪里的水，都会膨胀。战斗时，它会脱下这些羽毛，再用一股股蒸汽射向敌人；睡觉时，新羽毛便会长回来。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in ponds where they hide with only the tops of their heads sticking out, which look like lotus flowers. When many small bugs fly over a pond, POKENAME come out of the water to catch them with their long tongues and feed.
decisions.target: POKENAME住池里，只露头顶，看着像莲花。小虫大量飞过，它就出水，用长舌抓来吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在池塘里，藏在水下，只露出像莲花的头顶。大群小虫飞过池面时，它们便浮出水，用长舌抓来吃。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses the drill-tip tail it possesses to dig holes for it to rest in. Should it need to escape quickly, it creates a burst of electricity with its tail, dispersing all the dirt around it so it can flee more easily.
decisions.target: POKENAME用钻尾挖睡洞。需急逃，就用尾爆出电力，驱散周围所有泥土，方便脱身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用钻头状的尾尖挖洞，作为休息处。需要迅速逃离时，它便用尾巴爆发电力，驱散四周所有泥土，让自己更容易脱身。

decisions.source: POKENAME tends to swim in shallow waters, as its fins aren't strong enough to withstand the powerful currents of rivers. It defends itself from predators by striking them with the poisonous horn protruding from the top of its head.
decisions.target: POKENAME多游浅水，鳍不够强，难挡河中急流。用头顶毒角攻击，抵挡捕食者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常在浅水中游动，因为鳍不够强，承受不了河流的急流。捕食者来袭时，它会用头顶伸出的毒角攻击，自卫御敌。

decisions.source: An POKENAME's most prized possession is the stick it so strongly holds onto within its talons. Despite how it looks like a staff, this Pokémon typically uses it to strike their opponents upon the head.
decisions.target: POKENAME最珍爱的，是爪中紧握的棍。看似法杖，通常却拿来敲敌人头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最珍视的东西，就是利爪中紧握的那根木棍。它虽然看似法杖，却通常被用来敲打对手的头。

decisions.source: It mischievously gnaws at the anchor chains of docked ships to free the boats and have fun sending them out to sea. POKENAME is an expert swimmer, capable of moving at great speed thanks to the shape of its tail.
decisions.target: 它淘气啃断停船锚链，放船漂海取乐。POKENAME很会游，尾形让它速度极快。
decisions.revised: 它淘气地啃咬停泊船只的锚链，让船挣脱束缚、漂向大海，以此取乐。POKENAME泳技高超，尾巴的形状让它能游得飞快。

decisions.source: It emits alluring lights from its glassy orbs to draw others closer to the edge of its lake habitat, then drags them down to feed on their life force. POKENAME can also emit child-like cries from the hole on its head to lure humans closer.
decisions.target: POKENAME玻璃球发迷人光，诱到湖岸，再拖下，吸生命力。头孔也能学孩子哭，引人更近。
decisions.revised: POKENAME让玻璃般通透的球体发出迷人光芒，将生灵引到栖居的湖边，再拖下水，吸食生命力。它也能从头上的孔发出孩子般的哭声，诱人靠近。

decisions.source: While fearsome in dim lighting, POKENAME is deathly afraid of bright lights. Even a glimpse of sunlight will send it into a panic, boring holes with its horn to dig a hole or cave for it to hide away in.
decisions.target: POKENAME昏暗中吓人，却极怕强光。一瞥阳光就慌，用角钻孔或洞穴，藏进去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在昏暗处虽令人畏惧，自己却怕极了强光。哪怕只瞥见一丝阳光，它也会惊慌失措，用角钻出地洞或洞窟，躲藏起来。

decisions.source: POKENAME are considered a pest by farmers due to their habit of arriving in a field in the early morning and digging out a hole for themselves for the day. They poke their long neck out of their hole, soaking in the sun, before leaving at night.
decisions.target: POKENAME清晨到田里，挖洞待上一天，被农人视为害兽。长颈探出洞晒太阳，夜里才离开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME习惯清早来到田里，给自己挖个洞，待上一整天，因此被农民视为害兽。它们将长脖子探出洞外，沐浴阳光，直到夜里才离开。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon that love to make friends and love to bring gifts to others. However, if anyone steps upon the long, draping horn of an POKENAME then it will fly into a rage and flail it around like a powerful whip.
decisions.target: POKENAME友善，爱交友，也爱送礼。但谁踩到长垂的角，它就会暴怒，把角当强鞭甩动。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分友善，爱交朋友，也爱送礼。不过，谁若踩到它长长垂下的角，它就会勃然大怒，像挥动强有力的鞭子一样，将角四处甩动。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very peaceful creatures, yet no person ever dares to go near them due to how foul-smelling and gassy they are. Gloves must be worn at all times when around POKENAME since even a slight touch causes toxins to seep through the skin.
decisions.target: POKENAME极平和，却臭气冲天，没人敢近身。周围得一直戴手套，轻碰也会让毒透皮。
decisions.revised: POKENAME性情十分平和，可浑身恶臭，又不断冒气，谁也不敢靠近。在它们身旁必须一直戴着手套，因为哪怕轻轻碰一下，毒素也会渗进皮肤。

decisions.source: POKENAME have many sharp teeth that grow back if a tooth is damaged. The growth of a new tooth presses against their brains, which can give them a headache if they need to regrow lots of teeth at the same time.
decisions.target: POKENAME利牙很多，坏了会重长。新牙生长顶着脑，若同时换太多，就可能头痛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME长着许多利齿，牙若损坏，就会重新长出。新牙生长时会挤压大脑，若同时要再生的牙太多，就可能使它头痛。

decisions.source: Their curved blades have made POKENAME a popular Pokémon among pirates. During the night, they hunt down bug Pokémon by cutting off the branches that the bugs sleep on and carry them back to their nests in the mountains.
decisions.target: POKENAME弯刃很受海盗欢迎。夜里割下虫宝可梦睡的树枝，将猎物带回山巢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME弯曲的刀刃，让它深受海盗喜爱。夜里，它们会切下虫类宝可梦睡着的树枝，带着猎物回到山中的巢穴。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends most of its time digging in soft dirt for seeds and roots to chew on. The leaves shed from its tail can be ground up for medicinal powder, but the powder is extremely bitter to taste.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多在软土里挖种子树根嚼。尾上落叶可磨药粉，滋味却极苦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大部分时间都在软土里挖掘，寻找种子和根来啃。尾巴上脱落的叶片能磨成药粉，味道却极苦。

decisions.source: The seeds on POKENAME's back have a unique cheddar-like flavor to them, making them sought after by chefs. However, due to how agile and skittish these Pokémon are, these seeds are incredibly difficult to obtain.
decisions.target: POKENAME背种有独特切达奶酪味，厨师很想要。可它灵巧胆小，极难取得。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的种子，带有独特的切达奶酪风味，让厨师们趋之若鹜。可它们敏捷又胆小，这些种子极难取得。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to play in rich mud and dirt, which provides them with many nutrients to absorb as well. Exposure to evolutionary stones causes their leaves to change, with the changes being more noticeable the longer their exposure.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱在肥泥土玩，也吸养分。接触进化石，叶片便改变，越久越明显。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱在肥沃的泥土里玩耍，也能从中吸收许多养分。接触进化石会让叶片发生变化，接触越久，变化越明显。

decisions.source: If POKENAME is scared, it lets out an ear-piercing scream and fills its body with air, causing it to float away on the winds. It can rarely be found in grassy areas with moderate levels of elevation.
decisions.target: POKENAME害怕就刺耳尖叫，体内充气，随风飘走。罕见于中等海拔的草地。
decisions.revised: POKENAME害怕时，会发出刺耳的尖叫，向体内充气，随风飘走。偶尔能在中等海拔的草地发现它。

decisions.source: Though their wings are small, they can soar through the air with ease for long periods of time. Flocks of POKENAME will fly as fast as they can toward water and then skip across the surface using their own shells as a means of playing.
decisions.target: 双翼虽小，它们却能轻松长久翱翔。成群POKENAME会全速飞向水面，用甲壳打水漂玩。
decisions.revised: 它们翅膀虽小，却能轻松长时间翱翔。成群的POKENAME会全速飞向水面，用自己的甲壳打水漂，作为游戏。

decisions.source: While breathing in the spores of POKENAME gives great joy, they also cause the person breathing them in to become gravely unwell. POKENAME does try to nurse the sick person when this happens, but it being in the proximity only worsens the situation.
decisions.target: 吸入POKENAME孢子虽极快乐，也会重病。它会试着照顾，可待得近，只让情况更糟。
decisions.revised: 吸入POKENAME的孢子，会让人感到极大的快乐，却也会使人病得很重。每到这时，它虽然会试着照顾病人，可待在附近，只会让情况更加恶化。

decisions.source: POKENAME puff up their chest as large as they can before they attack, trying to intimidate their opponents into giving up. If the display fails, they will fly horn-first at their foes, trying to inflict their poison to win the fight.
decisions.target: POKENAME攻击前尽量挺大胸膛，试图吓对手认输。无效，就角朝前飞扑，以毒争胜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME进攻前，会尽可能鼓起胸膛，威吓对手认输。若不奏效，它们便把角朝前，飞扑向敌人，试图以毒取胜。

decisions.source: POKENAME's swimming skills aren't used for swimming in water; they're instead used to swim through magma in the mantle layer of the planet. It slices open the ground with its scythes whenever it wants to return to the surface.
decisions.target: POKENAME的泳技不用来游水，而在地幔岩浆中游。想回地面，就以镰刀切开土地。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的泳技用来穿行这颗星球地幔中的岩浆，而非在水里游泳。想返回地面时，它便用镰刀切开大地。

decisions.source: POKENAME fur is short and stiff, creating a streamlined shape that allows them to swim rapidly through the water. Their nine fins at the back of their body keep them stable as they assume a torpedo shape to swim through the water.
decisions.target: POKENAME毛短硬，身体流线，游得很快。后方九片鳍维持稳定，让它如鱼雷般穿水。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的毛短而硬，形成流线形的身体，让它能快速游动。它呈鱼雷般的姿态穿水而行时，后方的九片鳍能帮助保持稳定。

decisions.source: POKENAME will try and bite anything that moves, making it very easy to catch when fishing with live bait. When on the end of the line it will thrash about violently, but once it has been reeled in it becomes very docile.
decisions.target: POKENAME什么动都想咬，活饵很容易钓到。挂钩后猛烈挣扎，一收上来，却极温顺。
decisions.revised: POKENAME看见会动的东西就想咬，因此用活饵钓鱼，很容易将它钓上。挂在线上时，它会猛烈挣扎；一旦收上岸，却又变得十分温顺。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their sonars to determine which fruits are ripe enough to be consumed, which is why many of them are used to help farmers. They can sense ultrasonic waves with their feelers, so they never get lost in pitch-black caves.
decisions.target: POKENAME声呐能判断果熟，常帮农人。触角又能感超声，因此全黑洞里也不迷路。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能用声呐判断果实是否熟到可以吃，因此常被用来帮助农民。触角还能感知超声波，让它们在漆黑的洞窟里也不会迷路。

decisions.source: POKENAME feeds on poisonous mushrooms to boost the toxicity of the spines on its body. The size of the small green leaves on its head indicates its age; the larger they are, the more mature this Pokémon is.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃毒蘑菇，增强身刺毒性。头上小绿叶越大，就越成熟，能反映年龄。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以毒蘑菇为食，增强身上尖刺的毒性。头上的小绿叶能反映年龄，叶片越大，就表示它越成熟。

decisions.source: With a flap of its arms, it can summon hurricanes. With a whip of its tail, it can cause tidal waves. As a result of its terrible power, POKENAME prefers to dwell in the darkest depths of the ocean.
decisions.target: 扇臂能召飓风，甩尾能掀巨浪。力量太可怕，因此POKENAME偏爱最黑暗海底。
decisions.revised: 它一扇双臂，便能召来飓风；尾巴一甩，就能掀起巨浪。由于力量太过可怕，POKENAME更喜欢住在海洋最黑暗的深处。

decisions.source: The thick foliage on POKENAME's head and neck contains a strong electrical charge within each leaf. It lures trespassers traveling at night with the glow of its tail, bringing them closer so it can deliver a paralyzing jolt.
decisions.target: POKENAME头颈浓叶，每片都藏强电。夜里尾光引闯入者靠近，再施麻痹电击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头颈的枝叶十分浓密，每片叶子都蕴藏强电荷。它用尾巴的光吸引夜行的闯入者，待对方靠近，再施以使其麻痹的电击。

decisions.source: The patterns on POKENAME's stomach change colour depending on the pH of the water it is in, going from red in acidic water to blue in alkaline water, and green in neutral. The gene relating to this has been extracted and is used in research.
decisions.target: POKENAME腹纹随水的酸碱度变色：酸水红，碱水蓝，中性绿。相关基因已被提取，用于研究。
decisions.revised: POKENAME腹部的花纹，会随所处水域的酸碱度变色：酸性水中呈红色，碱性水中呈蓝色，中性水中则是绿色。相关基因已被提取，用于研究。

decisions.source: POKENAME is incredibly light; if it wishes to remain in place, it must dig its feet into the ground and grip the earth with its talons. Once it is ready to move on, POKENAME will unearth its feet and allow the wind to carry its body along.
decisions.target: POKENAME轻得很，想原地停留，就得把脚扎土，以利爪抓牢。准备走时，POKENAME拔脚出土，任风带走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME轻得惊人，想留在原地，就得将脚扎进土里，用利爪抓牢地面。准备出发时，它便把脚拔出来，任风带着身体前行。

decisions.source: POKENAME pose as trees so they may watch for any threats to their forest homes and strike as they see fit. They extend roots from their feet to absorb nutrients and water. They may use their roots to connect to and control nearby plants as well.
decisions.target: POKENAME装树，留意家园威胁，择机攻击。脚下生根吸水与养分，还可连上、操纵附近植物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME假扮树木，观察威胁森林家园的动静，择机出手。它们从脚底伸出根，吸收水分与养分，也可能借根连接、控制附近的植物。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body has a very thick layer of flesh, able to stop sharp rocks and teeth from piercing into them. A protective bubble coating is ingrained into their horns, allowing them to dig through rock without the risk of damaging their horns.
decisions.target: POKENAME肉层极厚，能挡住尖石与牙。角上还生有保护泡膜，让它钻岩，也不怕伤角。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体的肉层极厚，尖石与牙齿都无法刺穿。角上自带一层保护泡膜，让它们能挖穿岩石，而不用担心角受损。

decisions.source: The heads of POKENAME are competitive with one another, each wanting to be the first to catch a thrown ball, or be the first to strike in a fight. Their competitiveness leads POKENAME to be reckless and headstrong, making them a challenge to train.
decisions.target: POKENAME各个头都好胜，抢着先接投球，或抢先出手。争强让它莽撞固执，很难训练。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的几颗头彼此争强，个个都想第一个接住抛来的球，或第一个在战斗中出手。好胜心让它莽撞固执，训练起来颇为棘手。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a particularly lazy creature that loves to spend the day napping. Once it's full of sunlight, it uses the large leaf at the end of its tail to shade itself so it can keep sleeping for hours.
decisions.target: POKENAME特别懒，爱整天打盹。晒足阳光，就用尾端大叶遮身，继续睡上几小时。
decisions.revised: POKENAME懒得很，最爱整天打盹。晒够阳光，它就用尾端的大叶子给自己遮阴，继续睡上好几个小时。

decisions.source: During fall, POKENAME clash against each other by ramming their antlers into one another to fight over the best places to hibernate. Once the victor has been decided, the loser flies off to find a different place to fight over.
decisions.target: 秋天，POKENAME互撞鹿角，争最佳冬眠处。胜负一分，败者就飞走，另找地方争夺。
decisions.revised: 秋天，POKENAME互撞鹿角，争夺最佳的冬眠处。胜负一分，落败者就会飞走，另找一处地方继续争夺。

decisions.source: When these Pokémon are happy, they hop from foot to foot while flashing lights from their red crystals. The orbs on their tails are hot to the touch, to the point that rain will instantly evaporate on contact.
decisions.target: 它们开心就左右换脚跳，红晶体闪光。尾球烫到雨水一碰，立刻蒸发。
decisions.revised: 这些宝可梦高兴时，会两脚轮流跳动，让红色结晶闪闪发光。尾巴上的球体十分烫，雨水一碰到，就会瞬间蒸发。

decisions.source: POKENAME lounges among scattered seeds, picking at them and handing them to any passersby. It does this in the hope that others will help plant the seeds and help them spread, as it is too lazy to do so itself.
decisions.target: POKENAME懒躺种子堆，拣种子递给路人。盼别人代种、帮忙传播，因为自己太懒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME懒洋洋地躺在散落的种子间，拣起种子，递给路人。它盼着别人帮忙播种、传播，因为自己实在太懒。

decisions.source: The flowers on POKENAME's head and tail release pollen with a strong fragrance. While pleasant on cold days, on hot days POKENAME releases so much pollen that this becomes overwhelming, burning the ears and nose of anyone who inhales it.
decisions.target: POKENAME头尾花粉香浓，冷天宜人；热天却放得太多，强烈到吸入者耳鼻灼伤。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上和尾巴的花，会散出香气浓郁的花粉。冷天闻着宜人，热天却会放出太多，浓烈得灼痛吸入者的耳鼻。

decisions.source: It is said that POKENAME is able to charge head-first into power outlets, being able to disappear into the electrical current and quickly travel through cities. This puts them in the perfect situation to ambush rivals.
decisions.target: 据说POKENAME会迎头冲进插座，融入电流，迅速穿过城市，便于伏击对手。
decisions.revised: 据说，POKENAME能一头冲进电源插座，融入电流，迅速穿行城市。这让它们占尽先机，随时能伏击对手。

decisions.source: During battle, POKENAME rips off damaged body parts because its metallic shell is easy to damage. Once ripped off, it can regenerate these torn-off parts in mere seconds, allowing it to quickly get back into battle.
decisions.target: POKENAME金属壳易损，战时会扯掉坏部位。几秒就能再生，迅速回到战斗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的金属外壳很容易损坏，因此战斗中会主动扯掉受损的身体部位。只消几秒，这些部位便能再生，让它迅速重返战斗。

decisions.source: When in battle, the patterns on POKENAME's body will begin to glow and emit an intense heat. All water within 20 feet of this Pokémon will begin to steam up and evaporate while POKENAME is in combat.
decisions.target: POKENAME交战时，体纹发光，散出高热。周围20英尺内的水，都开始冒汽蒸发。
decisions.revised: 战斗中，POKENAME身上的花纹会开始发光，散出强烈热量。只要它仍在交战，周围20英尺内的所有水，都会冒汽、蒸发。

decisions.source: POKENAME are extremely proficient hunters, waiting in the mud for their prey. Once a Pokémon wanders too close, POKENAME will jump out of its hiding place, pinning down its prey and injecting it with a deadly venom.
decisions.target: POKENAME极擅捕猎，藏在泥里等待。宝可梦太近，就跃出压住，注入致命毒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是极其高明的猎手，藏在泥里等待猎物。哪只宝可梦走得太近，它便从藏身处跃出，按住猎物，注入致命毒液。

decisions.source: POKENAME pulls up its loose skin and stomps the ground as a gesture of dominance. It will attempt to use its jaws to tear apart anything that doesn't show it the proper respect after this display.
decisions.target: POKENAME拉起松皮，跺地宣示优势。谁看完还不尊敬它，就想用颚撕碎谁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME拉起宽松的皮肤，跺响地面，宣示自己的地位。展示过后，谁仍不肯给予应有的尊重，它就会试图用双颚将其撕碎。

decisions.source: POKENAME makes its home in a garbage can, subsisting on the trash thrown away by humans. When it pops out of its can, it is typically to drive others away, as it has a very grouchy personality.
decisions.target: POKENAME在垃圾桶安家，吃人类弃物。脾气极差，冒出桶，多半就是想赶人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在垃圾桶里安家，以人类丢弃的垃圾为食。它脾气很坏，每次从桶里冒出来，通常都是为了赶走旁人。

decisions.source: POKENAME feed on small fish Pokémon by diving at high speed into ponds to grab at their prey. Once they have their prey secured, they rapidly inflate the float at the end of their tail, rocketing back to the surface and to safety.
decisions.target: POKENAME高速潜池，抓小鱼宝可梦吃。抓稳便迅速鼓大尾端浮囊，猛冲回安全的水面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME高速潜入池塘，抓取小型鱼类宝可梦为食。猎物一抓稳，它们便迅速鼓起尾端的浮囊，火箭般冲回水面，脱离险境。

decisions.source: POKENAME feed on berries and minerals, which allow them to produce a rich honey inside their bodies. They are happy to share this honey with others, but those who try to take it by force are met with their steel stingers.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃树果与矿物，在体内产出浓蜜。它乐意分享，谁想硬抢，却会迎上钢刺。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以树果和矿物为食，在体内酿出浓郁的蜂蜜。它们乐于分享，但谁想强抢，就会遭到钢刺迎击。

decisions.source: Though POKENAME's horns are strong enough to dig through steel, they often get bad cuts and bruises on them due to having no protection. They often need to add a protective bubble coating around them while drilling into the ground.
decisions.target: POKENAME角虽能钻钢，没有防护，却常割擦伤。钻地时，往往需在角外，加保护泡膜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的角虽能挖穿钢铁，却因缺乏防护，常留下严重的割伤与瘀伤。钻入地下时，它们往往得在角周围加上一层保护泡膜。

decisions.source: Despite the fact that this Pokémon's body is made of metal, it is still able to fly for long periods of time without exhausting itself. Its crystalline feathers are said to each shine with the colors of rainbows.
decisions.target: 金属身体仍能长时间飞而不累。据说每根晶体羽毛，都泛着彩虹颜色。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦的身体虽由金属构成，却仍能长时间飞行而不觉疲倦。据说，每根结晶羽毛都会闪耀彩虹的颜色。

decisions.source: POKENAME tend to lie in mud most of the time to keep themselves hydrated. Upon their backs are maws that resemble fins, which they will open up while lying in mud so as to trap any prey that steps upon them.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多躺泥保湿。背上有形似鳍的巨口，躺着时张开，困住踩上来的猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大部分时间都躺在泥里，让身体保持湿润。背上长着形似鳍的巨口，它们躺着时便会张开，困住任何踩上去的猎物。

decisions.source: As POKENAME prances around, its many tails swish through the air in a light and elegantly flowing manner. Those who attempt to touch its tails will be blown away by a wave of fire it creates with a single swishing motion.
decisions.target: POKENAME蹦舞，多尾轻盈流畅地甩动。谁想碰尾，只消轻甩一下，火浪就将其轰飞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME轻快地蹦跳时，许多尾巴在空中摇曳，轻盈而优雅。谁想触碰，只消尾巴轻轻一甩，掀起的火浪便会将其轰飞。

decisions.source: Though its size may be huge, these giants are found near rivers and lakes where they guard sections and demand tolls to pass. Once the toll is paid they expand the foam around their neck to create a platform for others to climb on and ride across.
decisions.target: 这些巨兽守在河湖旁，收取过路费。付过后，便展开颈部泡沫，形成平台，载对方渡水。
decisions.revised: 这些巨兽体型庞大，守在河流、湖泊的各段水域，索取过路费。付费后，它们会扩张颈部的泡沫，形成平台，让对方爬上来，载着渡水。

decisions.source: POKENAME form their dens in beach sand right at the edge of where the tide comes in. They lie in wait until high tide, letting the ocean pull in their prey for them and using their psychic powers to draw in anything out of reach into their mouths.
decisions.target: POKENAME在海滩涨潮边界挖巢，静候潮来，让海水送上猎物。够不到的，再用超能力拉进嘴里。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在潮水涌至的海滩边缘挖巢，静候涨潮，任海水将猎物送来。够不到的，它们便用超能力直接拉进嘴里。

decisions.source: POKENAME slices into trees with its heated claws. It seems to feed on smoke produced by the burning wood and will blast fire out of its back to prevent any attack from behind while it consumes the tree.
decisions.target: POKENAME用热爪切树，似以燃木烟为食。吃树时，还会背喷火，防止后方来袭。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用炽热的爪子切入树木，似乎以木头燃烧产生的烟为食。享用树木时，它还会从背部喷火，防止任何来自后方的攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME store bubbles within their shell, using them to float and make themselves lighter in the water. They can expel the air rapidly when they retract inside their shell, sinking to the bottom to hide amongst the stones.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳里存泡，水中浮起、减轻重量。缩壳时可迅速排气，沉底藏在石间。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将泡泡储存在壳里，让自己在水中轻盈浮起。缩进壳时，它们能迅速排出空气，沉到水底，藏进石堆。

decisions.source: POKENAME emerge only at night from their burrows and are most active under the light of the full moon. The golden rings on their body give a faint glow, allowing them to see even in the pitch black.
decisions.target: POKENAME只在夜里出洞，满月下最活跃。金环泛着微光，即使漆黑也能看清。
decisions.revised: POKENAME只在夜里离开地洞，满月的光下最为活跃。身上的金色环泛起微光，让它们在一片漆黑中也能看清。

decisions.source: The dark membrane over POKENAME's eyes enables them to sense heat. When flying over the desert at night POKENAME will use this to locate prey, even if it has tried to hide by burying itself in the sand.
decisions.target: POKENAME眼上的暗膜能感知热。POKENAME夜飞沙漠，猎物哪怕埋进沙里，也会被发现。
decisions.revised: POKENAME眼上的深色薄膜，能帮助感知热量。夜里飞过沙漠时，它们便凭此寻找猎物，哪怕对方试着埋进沙里躲藏，也能找到。

decisions.source: POKENAME sways the sprout on its head back and forth in time with its dance. In the quiet of the night, some claim to hear the faint sound of a harp playing music, its source always a mystery.
decisions.target: POKENAME头芽随舞前后摇。静夜里，有人称听到淡淡竖琴声，来源始终是谜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME随着舞步，来回摇动头上的嫩芽。寂静的夜里，有人声称能听到微弱的竖琴乐声，来源却始终成谜。

decisions.source: POKENAME pretends to be a guide to those traveling through a forest, but instead leads them to become hopelessly lost within the woods. It does all this while feeding off the life force of those it is guiding.
decisions.target: POKENAME假装向导，却将穿林旅人引得彻底迷路，途中还不停吸其生命力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME假装为穿过森林的旅人引路，却将对方引得彻底迷失方向。一路上，它还不断吸食被引导者的生命力。

decisions.source: POKENAME hunt in small packs and can co-ordinate with one another across vast distances using the phases of the moon. They howl in unison with one another twice a day, once at midday and once at midnight.
decisions.target: POKENAME结小群捕猎，靠月相远距离协调。每天齐嚎两回，正午、午夜各一次。
decisions.revised: POKENAME结成小群狩猎，能借月相在相隔遥远时相互协调。它们每天齐声长嚎两次，正午一次，午夜一次。

decisions.source: Some people believe that POKENAME are born from the tiny bits of meteorite that can be found on top of Mt. Moon. When this Pokémon runs, the fire on its back leaves a trail of light behind, making it look like a shooting star.
decisions.target: 有人相信，POKENAME诞生于月见山顶的细小陨石。奔跑时，背上的火沿途留光，宛如流星。
decisions.revised: 有人相信，POKENAME诞生于月见山顶能找到的细小陨石碎片。它奔跑时，背上的火焰会拖出光迹，宛如一颗流星。

decisions.source: As soon as they hatch, POKENAME are swift predators capable of shooting jets of water up to fifteen meters away. Their bodies are soft and they have no scales for protection, as they use their old egg shells to help protect themselves.
decisions.target: POKENAME一孵出，就是敏捷猎手，水柱最远可射15米。身体柔软无鳞，便用旧蛋壳保护。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一孵化就是敏捷的猎手，水柱最远可射出15米。身体柔软，又没有鳞片防护，它们便用旧蛋壳保护自己。

decisions.source: POKENAME hook the spikes on their tails into the ground before raising themselves into the air to bask beneath sunlight. They predict the flight patterns of their prey, standing perfectly still with their claws open and grabbing them out of the air.
decisions.target: POKENAME把尾刺勾进地，撑身晒太阳。它预知猎物航线，静立张爪，直接从空中抓住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME先把尾巴的尖刺钩进地里，再抬起身体，沐浴阳光。它们预判猎物的飞行路线，张开爪子静立不动，再从空中一把抓住。

decisions.source: POKENAME have lightweight feathers that allow them to soar on a soft breeze on a warm sunny day. They can be seen migrating to and from certain regions when the season of fall comes, as they loathe getting wet or feeling cold.
decisions.target: POKENAME轻羽让它在暖晴天乘微风翱翔。它厌湿怕冷，秋至便往来某些地区迁徙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME羽毛轻盈，温暖的晴天里，乘着柔风便能翱翔。它们讨厌受潮、受冻，每到秋天，便能见到它们往来某些地区迁徙。

decisions.source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon that runs at the first sign of trouble. If cornered, it smacks an opponent with the fluff on its tail, spreading pollen to agitate the attacker's vision so POKENAME can escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽大却胆小，稍有麻烦就逃。绝境中以尾绒拍敌，撒粉刺激视线，争取逃走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体型虽大，却十分胆小，稍有风吹草动就逃。被逼得无路可退时，它便用尾上的绒毛拍击敌人，撒出花粉干扰视线，争取脱身的机会。

decisions.source: POKENAME's saliva is like tree resin, which they use to mark their territories and to tend to their own wounds. They cling to the sides of trees and glide toward their prey, which they fell using their pincers and venomous stingers.
decisions.target: POKENAME唾液如树脂，既标领地，也护理伤口。攀在树侧滑向猎物，用钳与毒刺打倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的唾液像树脂，既用来标记领地，也用来照料伤口。它们攀附树干，再滑翔向猎物，以钳子和毒刺将其击倒。

decisions.source: The bells on POKENAME's dorsal fins make a very faint ringing sound that's unable to be heard by the human ear. They often distract themselves by playing with these bells, causing them to accidentally run into coral.
decisions.target: POKENAME背鳍的铃，声微弱得人耳听不见。它们常玩铃分心，不小心就撞珊瑚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背鳍上的铃铛，响声轻微得人耳无法听见。它们常玩铃铛玩得分心，不小心撞上珊瑚。

decisions.source: It patrols the rivers where its family group lives from the sky, which it reaches thanks to its powerful wings. Although it is capable of striking from a distance with its water-based attacks, POKENAME prefers close-range combat.
decisions.target: POKENAME凭强翼升空，巡视家族生活的河流。虽能用水攻击远敌，却更爱近战。
decisions.revised: POKENAME凭强健的双翼飞上天空，巡视家族栖居的河流。虽然能以水攻击远处的敌人，它却更喜欢近身交战。

decisions.source: POKENAME rubs the wool on its tummy to gather electricity and fling it from its claws at others. Though it has a small mouth, its teeth are still quite sharp, so its bites cause quite a bit of damage.
decisions.target: POKENAME揉腹部羊毛积电，再从爪甩向别的生物。嘴虽小，牙仍锋利，咬伤很重。
decisions.revised: POKENAME摩擦肚子上的羊毛蓄电，再从爪子甩出电流，击向旁人。它的嘴虽然小，牙却很锋利，咬下仍能造成不轻的伤害。

decisions.source: It is capable of taking flight by angling its cannons downward and blasting streams of water to launch itself into the air. POKENAME is very proud of its feathered crest, the longer the feathers, the healthier the Pokémon.
decisions.target: 它把炮口朝下，喷出水流推身升空。POKENAME极以羽冠为傲，羽越长就越健康。
decisions.revised: 它能将炮口朝下，喷出道道水流，将自己推上天空。POKENAME十分为自己的羽冠骄傲，羽毛越长，就表示个体越健康。

decisions.source: The more POKENAME swings its arms, the more electricity it stores within its wool. During battles it will sometimes tear off a chunk of electrified wool and toss it, the clump exploding into lightning when it hits a target.
decisions.target: POKENAME挥臂越多，毛里电越多。战中有时扯一团电毛投出，击中便爆发雷电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME挥臂越多，羊毛中储存的电力也越多。战斗时，它有时会扯下一团带电的羊毛掷出，命中目标，毛团便会爆出雷电。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a greedy, opportunistic creature. It occasionally teams up with others of its kind to steal meals from other Pokémon, but the alliance will inevitably fall apart as each tries to hoard all the food for themselves.
decisions.target: POKENAME贪婪、善抓机会，有时同类联手抢食。可每只都想独吞，联盟终究破裂。
decisions.revised: POKENAME贪婪，善于伺机而动。有时，它与同类合作，抢夺其他宝可梦的饭食，但每只都想将全部食物据为己有，联盟终究会瓦解。

decisions.source: POKENAME change the color of their bodies to match the water around them, making them almost undetectable while swimming. They slowly sneak up on their prey before quickly grabbing them with their tongues, pulling them into their powerful jaws.
decisions.target: POKENAME变成周围水色，游泳几乎难察。缓缓潜近猎物，再迅速舌抓，拉进强颚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME改变身体颜色，融入周围的水色，游动时几乎无法被察觉。它们缓缓潜近猎物，再迅速伸舌抓住，拉进强健的双颚。

decisions.source: The fungus growing on the body of POKENAME is remarkably high in lignin. This gives it a very wooden texture. In order to fuel the growth of these fungi, POKENAME will seek out tree bark as its primary food source.
decisions.target: POKENAME体上真菌木质素极高，质感十分像木。为供菌生长，主要寻找树皮吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上生长的真菌，木质素含量极高，质感十分像木头。为了供养这些真菌，它主要寻找树皮作为食物。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends some of its time in the presence of vibrant flowers and plants in the wild. It takes seeds from its favorite flowers and plants them in the soil on its head to decorate itself with more colors.
decisions.target: POKENAME会在野外鲜花草木间待一阵，采最爱的花种，种进头土，给自己添色。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会在野外鲜艳的花草间待上一阵，从最喜爱的花中采种，种进头上的土壤，为自己增添更多色彩。

decisions.source: POKENAME gather twigs to craft small hats that shelter them from the snow. If they sense a storm approaching, they will set down their hats at the base of cliffs to act as nests for them to rest in.
decisions.target: POKENAME捡细枝做小帽，挡住雪。察觉风暴将来，就把帽子放在崖脚，当巢休息。
decisions.revised: POKENAME收集细枝，编成遮雪的小帽。察觉风暴将近时，它们就将帽子放在崖脚，当作巢穴，在里面休息。

decisions.source: POKENAME soak up water through their tiny feet and absorb sunlight through the vines on their head. When one of the vines is damaged, they produce a red sap that acts as a binding agent to help them heal.
decisions.target: POKENAME小脚吸水，头藤吸日光。藤若受损，会分泌红树汁，黏合伤处，帮助愈合。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用小脚吸水，借头上的藤蔓吸收阳光。藤蔓若受损，它们便分泌红色树液，作为黏合剂，帮助伤处愈合。

decisions.source: POKENAME sap is applied to wooden sculptures to create pieces of art that protects artwork from water damage and conducts electricity. Art exhibitions rely on this sap to illuminate spaces without wires interfering with the aesthetic of the displays.
decisions.target: POKENAME树汁涂木雕，既防水，也导电。艺术展靠它照明，免电线影响展品观感。
decisions.revised: 将POKENAME的树液涂在木雕上，既能保护作品免受水损，又能导电。艺术展览便靠它照明，免得电线妨碍展陈的美感。

decisions.source: The noxious smell of POKENAME's drool is enough to make the average creature sick to its stomach. Using its long tongue, it coats foes with the stinky saliva to make dealing with it in combat much more difficult.
decisions.target: POKENAME口涎恶臭，一般生物闻就反胃。长舌把臭涎涂敌人，令战斗更难应付。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的口水恶臭难当，足以让一般生物闻得反胃。它用长舌把臭唾液涂满敌人，让对方在战斗中更难应付自己。

decisions.source: The skin of this Pokémon consists of a slimy membrane that dries out when the weather is too hot. The only hard part of its body consists of a drill that it uses to dig tunnels to hide away in to keep itself cool.
decisions.target: 皮肤由黏膜构成，天太热便会干。唯一坚硬处是钻头，用来挖隧道，藏着保持凉爽。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦的皮肤由黏滑的薄膜构成，天气太热就会干掉。全身唯一坚硬的部分，是用来挖地道的钻头；它便躲进地道，保持凉爽。

decisions.source: POKENAME will hide itself from predators by holding onto tree branches and sticking out its tail to pretend to be a leaf. Much of its diet consists of tree sap that it extracts with its tongue.
decisions.target: POKENAME攀住树枝，伸尾装叶，躲避捕食者。平常主要吃，用舌吸出的树汁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME攀住树枝，伸出尾巴假扮叶片，躲避捕食者。它的食物中，有很大一部分是用舌头吸取的树液。

decisions.source: POKENAME seeks out locations that give the leaf on top of its head plenty of sunlight. After finding the ideal spot, it digs a hole in the ground with its claws and buries its lower body so that it can draw up water.
decisions.target: POKENAME寻找能让头叶充分日照的地方。一找到，就用爪挖地，埋住下半身，吸取水分。
decisions.revised: POKENAME寻找能让头上叶片充分照到阳光的地方。找到理想位置后，它就用爪子挖洞，埋住下半身，以便吸取水分。

decisions.source: POKENAME's way of hunting for prey is different based on their nature. While some POKENAME rely on the wind to float towards and catch prey as it passes, some will instead bury themselves in the dirt and eat whatever is living inside it.
decisions.target: POKENAME猎法，随性情而异。有些靠风，浮向路过猎物；有些却埋土，吃里面生活的东西。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的捕猎方式，随个体性情而异。有些借风飘向猎物，经过时便将其捕获；有些则埋进土里，吃掉其中生活的生灵。

decisions.source: POKENAME is usually found pecking at the grass in open fields, searching for seeds to eat. As it flies, it sheds feather-like leaves that are used by some to sweeten the taste of their tea.
decisions.target: POKENAME常在旷野啄草，找种子吃。飞时脱落羽状叶，有人用来给茶添甜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常在开阔原野的草间啄来啄去，寻找种子吃。飞行时，它会脱落羽毛般的叶片，有人用来给茶增添甜味。

decisions.source: POKENAME use the drill on their head to bury themselves into the ground, where they then open their mouths wide and wait for prey to be drawn by the sweet yet poisonous nectar on their tongues.
decisions.target: POKENAME用头钻埋进地，张大嘴，等猎物被舌上甜蜜却有毒的花蜜引来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用头上的钻头，将自己埋进地里，再张大嘴巴，等待猎物被舌上甘甜却有毒的花蜜吸引而来。

decisions.source: POKENAME gathers water in its shell, then forcefully ejects it out its rear to build speed. It then uses this speed as momentum to dig a nest underwater using the drill-like horns on its shell.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳里集水，从后部猛喷加速，再借动量，用壳上钻状角挖水下巢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将水积在壳里，再从后部猛力喷出，加快速度。随后，它借着这股速度带来的冲力，用壳上的钻头状角，挖出水下的巢穴。

decisions.source: The long frond on POKENAME's head floats on top of the water whilst they remain submerged beneath. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water.
decisions.target: POKENAME潜在水下，头顶长叶浮于水面。能接收上方振动，清楚掌握水上水下的情况。
decisions.revised: POKENAME潜在水下，头上的长叶则浮于水面。长叶能接收上方的振动，让它对水上、水下的动静都了如指掌。

decisions.source: When prey get close enough to a river, POKENAME quickly shoot out from the water. They then stab the prey, injecting it with poison before flying back in to wait for the effects to kick in.
decisions.target: 猎物靠河够近，POKENAME便迅速冲出水，刺入注毒，再飞回水里，等毒发作。
decisions.revised: 猎物一靠近河边，POKENAME就会迅速冲出水面，刺伤对方、注入毒液，再飞回水里，等待毒性发作。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a small number of spines coating their head to deter people from touching their body. The spines are coated with an aggravating toxin and are the only part of their head that stays sticking out of their shell when they withdraw.
decisions.target: POKENAME头上少许刺，阻止人触身。刺覆刺激性毒，缩壳时，头部也只有它们仍露在外。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上长着少量尖刺，防止别人触碰身体。刺上覆有刺激性毒素；缩进壳里时，头部也只有这些尖刺仍露在外面。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to live atop rocks jutting out from the ocean and fly directly along the surface of the water. They occasionally dip their heads into the water to capture prey and crush them against rocks.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱住海上突岩，贴水面飞。偶尔低头入水抓猎物，再往岩石砸碎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱住在突出海面的岩石上，贴着水面飞行。它们偶尔将头探进水里抓住猎物，再往岩石上砸碎。

decisions.source: The iron-tipped claws on POKENAME's feet give it a powerful grip capable of crushing stone. It is a relentless combatant, extending its legs to grapple far-away foes and toss or slam them around.
decisions.target: POKENAME脚上铁尖爪抓握强，足以碎石。作战不屈，伸腿抓远敌，抛来摔去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脚爪的尖端覆着铁，抓握力强得足以捏碎石头。它战斗起来不肯罢休，会伸长双腿抓住远处的敌人，将其抛起、摔打。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a thick fur coat that retains warmth during the winter. During the summer, they shed more than a quarter of their weight in fur, as the weather conditions are otherwise too hot for them.
decisions.target: POKENAME厚毛冬季保暖。夏季太热，会蜕下超过自身体重四分之一的毛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有一身厚毛，能在冬季保暖。可夏天若不换毛就会热得受不了，因此脱下的毛，重量超过自身体重的四分之一。

decisions.source: POKENAME hides under the sand at night with only part of its jaw exposed to the air. It releases a faint dark mist that causes a deep sleep in those who inhale it, leaving them helpless to avoid being bitten and dragged underground.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜藏沙下，只露一部分颚，释放淡暗雾。吸入便深睡，无力反抗被咬、拖入地底。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜里藏在沙下，只把部分下颚露出。它放出淡淡的黑雾，吸入者会沉沉睡去，无力躲避，任其咬住、拖入地底。

decisions.source: POKENAME love gemstones, as they will try to smash through the cave walls in the hopes of finding some. Their eyes are incredibly sensitive to light, so they very rarely leave the darkness of their cave.
decisions.target: POKENAME喜爱宝石，会砸开洞壁寻觅。眼睛极其畏光，很少离开黑暗洞穴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢宝石，会试着砸开洞壁，希望能找到一些。双眼对光极其敏感，因此它们很少离开黑暗的洞穴。

decisions.source: POKENAME operate in small packs to take down larger prey, but once the target is felled, all group cohesion is lost. Ravenous greed compels them to try and eat as much as they can for themselves, turning mealtime into a free-for-all.
decisions.target: POKENAME小群协猎大目标。可一打倒，就全无团结，贪食让它们各自抢吃，饭点成混战。
decisions.revised: POKENAME结成小群，合力击倒大型猎物，可目标一倒下，团结也就荡然无存。个个贪食，只顾尽可能多吃，开饭时便成了一场混战。

decisions.source: POKENAME hide along trees and wait for prey, which they can sense the movements of with their wisp-like horns. They will launch themselves toward their prey and cling on with their claws as they proceed to drain their prey's life essence.
decisions.target: POKENAME沿树藏身，以幽火般的角察觉猎物动静。随后弹出，用爪攀住，吸走生命精华。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏在树旁等待猎物，用幽火般的角感知动静。随后，它们朝猎物弹射过去，用爪子紧紧攀住，吸取对方的生命精华。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon and can hear for miles with the massive ear on its head. POKENAME likes to trick fishermen by diving underwater and using sonar on their fishing hooks to make them think a Pokémon has taken the bait.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜行，头上巨耳能听数英里。爱潜水用声呐扰鱼钩，骗渔人以为宝可梦上饵。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜间活动，头上的巨耳能听见数英里外的声音。它爱潜到水下，向鱼钩发出声呐波，骗钓鱼的人以为有宝可梦咬钩。

decisions.source: A wild POKENAME gets all of its energy from the sun. As it does not need to eat while basking in the sun, it resorts to grinding its own quick-growing teeth down by rubbing them up against one another. As a result, dental trauma is common.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME能量全取自太阳，晒着不需吃，却得互蹭，磨短长得快的牙，因此牙外伤很常见。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME的能量全来自太阳。晒太阳时不必进食，它便改用牙齿相互摩擦，磨短快速生长的牙，结果牙齿损伤十分常见。

decisions.source: When two POKENAME confront each other over a single mate, they begin to scream at each other, each attempting to be louder than the other. These fights tend to last for up to two hours, and by then, the mate they were fighting for will have left.
decisions.target: 两只POKENAME争同一个伴侣，就互相尖叫，比谁更响。最长吵两小时，那时争的对象，却早走了。
decisions.revised: 两只POKENAME争夺同一个伴侣时，会彼此尖叫，都想盖过对方。这番争斗通常能持续长达两小时，到那时，争夺的对象却早已离开。

decisions.source: POKENAME colonies sit amongst high tree branches and sing to one another to pass the day. They have a ruff around their lower body that keeps them safe if they fall, catching on the branches of the tree to give them a chance to climb back up.
decisions.target: POKENAME高枝群居，彼此唱歌度日。下身一圈褶边能在掉落时挂住树枝，给它爬回去的机会。
decisions.revised: POKENAME群落栖在高高的树枝间，彼此唱歌，消磨时光。身体下方的一圈褶边，能在跌落时挂住树枝，保护它们，留出爬回去的机会。

decisions.source: The flames all over its body become even more intense when it is enraged. The scalding water it uses in battle is so hot that POKENAME's attacks can strip the scales off of dragon-type Pokémon's bodies.
decisions.target: POKENAME暴怒，全身火更猛。战斗所用烫水，热得攻击能剥下，龙属性宝可梦的鳞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME暴怒时，全身的火焰会更猛烈。它在战斗中喷出的水滚烫无比，攻击的高热，甚至能剥落龙属性宝可梦身上的鳞片。

decisions.source: POKENAME gather together on starry nights to fly together and bask in the beauty of the stars above. Seeing them flying en masse is said to be a blessing that bestows fantastic luck on one fortunate enough to witness it.
decisions.target: POKENAME星夜群聚同飞，沐浴群星之美。据说有幸见到大群飞行，会获绝佳好运。
decisions.revised: 繁星满天的夜里，POKENAME聚在一起飞翔，欣赏头顶群星的美。传说，有幸目睹它们成群飞行的人，会受到祝福，获得绝佳好运。

decisions.source: POKENAME's fluffy fur can be removed in small chunks and consumed as a sweet treat. If it is allowed to soak up fresh water beforehand, the sweetness increases as POKENAME's fur turns the stored water into a sugary juice.
decisions.target: POKENAME蓬毛可摘小块，当甜食吃。若先吸足淡水，毛把存水变成糖汁，甜味更浓。
decisions.revised: POKENAME蓬松的毛能一小团一小团取下，当作甜食享用。若先让毛吸足淡水，它便会将存水化成甜汁，滋味更加甘甜。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in caves and tunnel networks that have very few sources of food. They will gnaw on bones to extract marrow from them, going so far as to carry bones with them to feed off when they get hungry.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在食物极少的洞穴、隧道网，啃骨抽取骨髓，甚至随身带骨，饿了就吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在食物稀少的洞窟与地道网中，靠啃骨获取骨髓。它们甚至会随身带着骨头，饿了就吃。

decisions.source: POKENAME use the hooks on their front paws to climb up sheer surfaces in search of a high vantage point. They wait patiently until they sense a favourable wind, then leap off and glide great distances in search of food.
decisions.target: POKENAME用前爪钩攀陡面，寻找高处。耐心等风势合适，再跃下，滑翔很远去觅食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用前爪上的钩攀上陡峭表面，寻找便于瞭望的高处。它们耐心等到风势合适，再纵身跃下，滑翔远行，寻找食物。

decisions.source: These Pokémon live within ponds, their metal bodies so heavy that they are often stuck at the bottom of them. The metal of their bodies is rather transparent, to the point you can sometimes see their internal organs.
decisions.target: 它们住池塘，金属身太重，常困底部。金属颇透明，有时连内脏也能看见。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦生活在池塘里，金属身体太重，常被困在塘底。身上的金属却相当透明，有时甚至能看见内脏。

decisions.source: POKENAME are so prideful of their looks that they use their meek psychic powers to keep themselves off the ground to avoid the dirt. They will cry loudly if anyone manages to get any form of filth upon their faces.
decisions.target: POKENAME极以容貌为傲，用微弱超能力悬空，免沾泥。谁若弄脏脸，它就大声哭闹。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分为自己的容貌骄傲，靠微弱的超能力悬离地面，避免沾上泥土。谁若让脏东西落到它脸上，它就会大声哭闹。

decisions.source: POKENAME coat their bodies in a watery gel that allows them to swim at speed, the gel letting them cut through water easily. When they feel threatened their gel can be withdrawn into their shell, keeping themselves safe from harm.
decisions.target: POKENAME裹着水样凝胶，轻易破水快游。受威胁时，便将凝胶收回壳里，护住自己。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上覆着水样凝胶，能轻松破开水流，快速游动。感到威胁时，它们会将凝胶收回壳里，保护自己免受伤害。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its claws to dig out a place for it to sleep in during the day. At night, this Pokémon uncovers itself and practices different fighting styles, spreading the seeds sitting in its feathers as it does so.
decisions.target: POKENAME用爪挖处所，白天睡觉。夜里出土，练习各种战法，也将羽间种子撒出去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用爪子挖出睡处，白天藏在里面休息。夜里，它钻出来练习各种战斗方式，同时散播羽毛间的种子。

decisions.source: POKENAME gather fallen logs and branches, incorporating the dead wood into their bodies. They appear to draw power from the wood they gather, firing blasts of energy that grow in strength based on the amount of material they've collected.
decisions.target: POKENAME收倒木与枝，将枯木融进身体。似乎从木取能，材料越多，能量攻击越强。
decisions.revised: POKENAME收集倒木与枝条，将枯木融进身体。它们似乎能从中汲取力量，收集的材料越多，射出的能量冲击也越强。

decisions.source: At night, when this Pokémon is alone, POKENAME will let out soft cries akin to the sound of a person in mourning at a funeral. During the early morning hours, POKENAME will sit in the rays of the sun to warm up before resting.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜里独处时，会轻声哀鸣，像葬礼上悲悼的人。清晨先坐在阳光里暖身，再休息。
decisions.revised: 夜里独处时，POKENAME会发出轻柔的哀鸣，仿佛葬礼上悲悼的人。清晨，它会先坐在阳光下暖身，再去休息。

decisions.source: POKENAME eat thrice their body weight in leaves so that they have enough energy to maintain the flowers on their head. They rarely have more than two flowers on their head at a time because of how many nutrients that go into each flower.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃体重3倍的叶，才有能量维持头花。每朵耗养分太多，所以同时很少超过两朵。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吃下体重3倍的叶子，获取足够能量，供养头上的花朵。每朵花都耗费大量养分，因此头上同时开着的，很少超过两朵。

decisions.source: POKENAME are able to change the weight of their keystone at will, using this ability to prank those who find them. A POKENAME's keystone may feel light as a feather a moment after being picked up, then weigh just over 100lbs in the next.
decisions.target: POKENAME能随意改变楔石重量，捉弄发现者。拿起后一瞬轻如羽，下一刻又重达100磅出头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能随意改变楔石的重量，捉弄发现自己的人。拿起后一刻，楔石可能轻如羽毛，下一刻却又变得超过100磅重。

decisions.source: POKENAME's skin is sensitive to sunlight and dries out quickly when out of water. To counter this, it raises its large tail to shade itself. The tip is very sharp, so when in the water, it uses it like a spear to hunt.
decisions.target: POKENAME皮肤怕日晒，离水就迅速干燥，因此抬起大尾遮阳。尾尖极利，水中会当矛捕猎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的皮肤对阳光敏感，离水后很快就会干燥，因此它会抬起大尾巴，给自己遮阳。尾尖十分锋利，在水里还能像长矛一样用来捕猎。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to chip off the pointed tips of its spines to use as projectiles in battle. It forces a foe to dodge the spines in order to draw them closer so it can rake at them with its razor-sharp claws.
decisions.target: POKENAME以精神力量削下背刺尖端，作弹丸射敌。逼对方闪躲，趁机引近，再用利爪狠抓。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用超能力削下尖刺的锐利顶端，作为战斗中的投射物。它逼敌人躲避尖刺，借此将对方引近，再用锋利的爪子猛抓。

decisions.source: POKENAME's tail-flame is said to be able to burn away the souls of those it bests in battle. It has been noted that when rivals battle in the wild, the victor's tail flame increases in size while the loser's decreases.
decisions.target: 据说，POKENAME尾火能烧掉战败者的灵魂。野外同类交战后，胜者尾火变大，败者则变小。
decisions.revised: 据说，POKENAME的尾焰能烧尽败在它手下的对手的灵魂。人们注意到，野外交战后，胜者的尾焰会变大，败者的则会缩小。

decisions.source: Trainers are advised to remain aware of POKENAME's mental well-being due to the Pokémon's tendency to hide their emotions when upset. While they're prone to rampaging when stressed, Trainers have found that acts of genuine affection calm them down.
decisions.target: POKENAME不快时爱藏情绪，训练家应留意心理状态。虽受压易暴走，真诚亲昵却能安抚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不开心时，常将情绪藏起来，因此训练家最好留意它的心理状况。压力大时虽容易暴走，但训练家发现，真诚的关爱能让它平静下来。

decisions.source: POKENAME are capable of bursts of speed when flying by abruptly erupting with flame. They can only maintain these speed bursts for a few minutes at a time, the flames taking a lot of energy to use.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞时突然喷火，就能爆发加速。可火太耗能，每次只能维持几分钟。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞行时突然爆发火焰，便能短时大幅加速。可火焰十分耗能，每次加速只能维持几分钟。

decisions.source: When in groups, POKENAME will compete with each other to see which one can produce the biggest flame. Many try as hard as they can, but most can only make enough fire to light a few sticks.
decisions.target: POKENAME成群，会比谁火最大。许多都拼尽力，可多数，也只够点燃几根小枝。
decisions.revised: 成群聚集时，POKENAME会比赛谁能放出最大的火焰。许多个体拼尽全力，但大多数也只能点燃几根木棍。

decisions.source: POKENAME's silk is not very good at making webs, so it prefers to make a burrow instead. the hair on its body keeps it body warm and allows for it to hunt during the winter months.
decisions.target: POKENAME的丝不太适合结网，因此更爱挖洞。体毛保暖，让它冬季也能狩猎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的丝不太适合结网，因此更喜欢挖地洞。身上的毛发保暖，让它在冬季也能狩猎。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their beaks to rapidly push dirt aside while they burrow into the ground. If they face any opposition, they will propel themselves backwards with psychic powers and start tunneling through dirt with their tails instead.
decisions.target: POKENAME掘地时用喙快速拨土。遇阻就以超能力向后推进，改用尾巴凿土。
decisions.revised: POKENAME钻入地下时，用喙迅速拨开泥土。若遇到阻碍，它们便借超能力向后退，改用尾巴掘土前行。

decisions.source: If POKENAME senses the fear of one lost in the forest, it floats its way towards them to be by their side. It comforts them with soft cries and gently leads them back out of the forest.
decisions.target: POKENAME察觉林中迷失者的恐惧，就飘去陪伴。轻鸣安慰，再温柔引导出林。
decisions.revised: 察觉有人迷失在森林、心生恐惧时，POKENAME便会飘向对方，留在身旁。它轻声鸣叫，安抚旅人，再温柔地引其走出森林。

decisions.source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it will rapidly change the color of the swirl on its belly to confuse the other people or Pokémon. However, this usually tires out POKENAME, making them fall asleep right on the spot.
decisions.target: POKENAME受威胁，迅速改变腹纹颜色，迷惑人或宝可梦。可常累得当场睡着。
decisions.revised: POKENAME感到威胁时，会迅速改变腹部漩涡纹的颜色，迷惑人或宝可梦。但这样常让它累坏，当场睡着。

decisions.source: POKENAME are devious Pokémon that can change the colors of their bodies to blend in. These tricksters love to prank others, from using their long tails to trip them to using their tongues to steal items.
decisions.target: POKENAME狡猾，会变色融入周围，爱恶作剧：长尾绊人，长舌偷东西，样样都来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME狡猾，能改变身体颜色，融入环境。它们最爱捉弄旁人，从用长尾绊人，到用舌头偷物，花样百出。

decisions.source: According to legend, POKENAME's fangs are powerful enough to tear through space itself, allowing it to travel between dimensions. No matter how much it consumes, its hunger is never satiated, keeping it perpetually on the hunt.
decisions.target: 传说POKENAME牙能撕开空间，跨维度旅行。无论吃多少都不饱，永远在捕猎。
decisions.revised: 传说，POKENAME的尖牙强得足以撕开空间，让它能穿行不同维度。无论吃下多少，它都填不饱肚子，只得永无休止地捕猎。

decisions.source: POKENAME has leafy ears that can pick up whispers from a long distance, making it difficult to sneak up on. It only sleeps two to three hours at night because it wants to vigilantly protect its nest.
decisions.target: POKENAME叶耳能听远处低语，很难偷近。为了警惕护巢，夜里只睡两三小时。
decisions.revised: POKENAME叶片般的耳朵，能听见远处的低语，让人难以悄悄靠近。为了警觉地守护巢穴，它夜里只睡两三个小时。

decisions.source: Although POKENAME will swing around its stingers to threaten others, it is too weak to do anything other than flail them around. Its stingers do contain and secrete a potent venom, should they ever manage to cut into one's flesh.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽挥刺威吓，却太弱，只能乱抡。可刺确有强毒，一旦真划入皮肉，就会分泌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽会挥动毒刺，威吓旁人，可实在太弱，只能乱抡。但毒刺确实蕴含强力毒液，若真能划入皮肉，便会将毒液分泌出来。

decisions.source: POKENAME slowly build up pressure in their joints, firing out a large bubble with a quick snap of their pincers. These bubbles cause the water around them to boil, as they're shot out with the same force of a gun.
decisions.target: POKENAME慢慢在关节蓄压，双钳快弹，射出大泡。发射力如枪，甚至让周围的水沸腾。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在关节里缓缓蓄压，再迅速弹合双钳，射出大泡泡。发射的力道堪比枪击，甚至能使周围的水沸腾。

decisions.source: POKENAME buries itself in the ground during the day to gnaw at plant roots, providing it with the nutrients it needs to grow. It only resurfaces at night, when it will wander in search of a healthy tree to feed on.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天埋地啃根，吸取生长养分。只有夜里才上来，游荡寻找健康树木取食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天埋在地里，啃食植物的根，获取生长所需的养分。它只在夜里返回地面，四处寻找健康的树木取食。

decisions.source: When POKENAME is tired, it can sleep the entire day under the sun to recharge its energy. In the rare moments it is awake, it tries to snatch anything that glitters—but since that activity quickly tires it out, it soon collapses back to sleep.
decisions.target: POKENAME累了，能整天睡在阳光下充能。罕见醒着，就想抓闪亮物，可很快又累倒，重新睡去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME疲倦时，能在阳光下睡上整天，补充能量。难得醒来，它便试着抓走任何闪亮的东西，可这很快又将它累坏，不久便倒头睡去。

decisions.source: Upon being milked, POKENAME's milk is as hot as magma and needs to be collected using specialized tools in order to avoid problems. In addition, these Pokémon are unruly and rambunctious, making it hard to catch and milk it in the first place.
decisions.target: POKENAME奶一挤出，便热如岩浆，须专用工具收集。它们又野、又闹，连抓住挤奶，本身都困难。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的奶刚挤出时，热得如同岩浆，必须用专门工具收集，免出意外。它们还桀骜不驯、精力过盛，光是抓住来挤奶，就已经十分困难。

decisions.source: POKENAME can briefly float in the air by tucking in its legs, but will quickly crash back down to the ground. POKENAME usually does this right on top of prey, pinning it to the ground, then lifting itself up again to bite with its powerful jaws.
decisions.target: POKENAME收腿能短暂浮起，却很快摔回地面。通常就砸在猎物身上，压住，再抬身用强颚咬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME收起双腿，就能短暂浮在空中，却很快又砸回地面。它通常会正好砸在猎物身上，将其压住，再抬起身体，用强健的双颚咬下。

decisions.source: Although a POKENAME will enshroud itself in spectral flames to intimidate others, it's only able to do so for at best an hour before it exhausts itself. It is usually seen near sites of forest fires and perceives nearly anything as a possible threat.
decisions.target: POKENAME裹幽焰威吓，最多一小时就筋疲力尽。常见于林火旧址，几乎什么都当潜在威胁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会裹上幽灵火焰威吓旁人，却至多只能维持一小时，就会筋疲力尽。它常见于林火发生地附近，几乎将一切都视为潜在威胁。

decisions.source: The thick petals of the flower growing on the bodies of POKENAME are tough enough that they can use them to roll on. They will emerge at night and roll from one sleeping spot to another, searching for fertile soil to settle for the day.
decisions.target: POKENAME身花的厚瓣坚韧，能当轮滚。夜里出来，从一个卧处滚到另一个，找沃土白天落脚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上花朵的厚实花瓣十分坚韧，能让它们借此滚动。它们夜里出来，从一个睡处滚到另一个，寻找肥沃土壤，作为白天的落脚处。

decisions.source: When POKENAME is bathed in sunlight, the orbs on its body begin to glow. If someone were to touch one of the glowing orbs, they could view either their past or future depending on which orb they touch.
decisions.target: POKENAME沐浴阳光，身上光球便亮起。碰不同的球，可看见自己的过去或未来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME沐浴阳光时，身上的球体便会发光。谁若碰到发光的球，就能看见自己的过去或未来，具体取决于触碰哪一颗。

decisions.source: The hue of POKENAME's body may slightly alter depending on the conditions of its habitat. For instance, higher salinity soil and water lead to yellow tints, while POKENAME in areas with lower salt content are slightly more blue.
decisions.target: POKENAME体色会随环境微变。如土水盐度高，就泛黄；盐少的地区，个体则略蓝。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的体色可能随栖息环境略微改变。比如，土壤和水的盐度较高，便会偏黄；低盐地区的个体，则会略带蓝色。

decisions.source: Seeking to avoid conflict, POKENAME attempts to stand still and hide itself amongst tall trees. The orbs around its neck put forth a strong herbal scent when it is stressed, often resulting in it giving away its position.
decisions.target: POKENAME想避争端，静立高树间藏身。可紧张时，颈球散浓草药香，常暴露位置。
decisions.revised: 为避免争斗，POKENAME试着站定不动，藏在高树之间。可一紧张，颈边的球体便会散出浓烈的草药香，往往暴露自己的位置。

decisions.source: POKENAME accumulates yellow spots if too much water seeps through and damages its rock body. By sitting in front of light rays all the time, it can dry off any water on it before it causes permanent damage.
decisions.target: 水渗太多、损坏石身，POKENAME就积黄斑。它总坐光前，及时晒干，免受永久损伤。
decisions.revised: 太多水渗入、损伤岩石身体时，POKENAME身上就会积起黄斑。它总坐在有光照的地方，及时晒干水分，免得造成永久损害。

decisions.source: The seed on its back is covered in a soft white fuzz that causes irritation to anyone who touches it. To prevent strong winds from blowing this coating away, POKENAME hides in its burrow during particularly windy days.
decisions.target: POKENAME背种覆软白绒，谁碰都受刺激。风特别大时，它躲洞，免得绒层被吹走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的种子覆着柔软的白绒，触碰者都会感到刺激。为免这层绒毛被强风吹散，风特别大时，它便躲进地洞。

decisions.source: POKENAME gorges on food as the weather turns cooler. Once it has consumed enough to last the season, it digs a large hole with its drill-shaped tail and buries itself in the dirt to hibernate until spring.
decisions.target: 天气转冷，POKENAME便大吃。吃够撑一季，就用钻尾挖大洞，埋土冬眠，直到春天。
decisions.revised: 天气转凉，POKENAME便开始大吃。吃下足够维持整季的食物后，它就用钻头状尾巴挖个大洞，将自己埋进土里冬眠，直到春天。

decisions.source: POKENAME changes the color of its body to mimic a small tree branch since it is also able to walk on walls. It uses this camouflage to be able to drop onto prey without them ever suspecting it.
decisions.target: POKENAME能爬墙，会变色像小树枝。借此伪装，落在猎物身上，也不被事先察觉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能在墙上行走，也会改变身体颜色，假扮细小的树枝。借着这层伪装，它能落在猎物身上，让对方毫无防备。

decisions.source: POKENAME change hue to blend in with their surroundings. However, they need to rub their scales for this to work. Most POKENAME make this work by clanging their scales to disorient the opponent before scurrying away and shifting colors.
decisions.target: POKENAME换色相融，可须先摩擦鳞片。多数先碰鳞，扰乱对手，再迅速跑开变色。
decisions.revised: POKENAME改变体色，融入周围环境，但必须先摩擦鳞片。多数个体会先将鳞片碰得铿锵作响，扰乱对手，再迅速跑开，变换颜色。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their sharp claws to dig through cliff faces in search of Moon Stones, relying on their tough, steely body to protect themselves from any rock falls. Miners commonly use them to help them in their operations.
decisions.target: POKENAME用利爪掘崖，寻找月之石，以坚钢身抵挡落石。矿工常借它帮忙作业。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用利爪挖掘崖壁，寻找月之石，靠坚硬如钢的身体抵挡落石。矿工常请它们帮忙作业。

decisions.source: POKENAME are almost always accompanied by a wreath of solid ice they use for offense and defense. The sharp tips of their feet allow them to stay steady atop ice and to skate effortlessly across ice as well.
decisions.target: POKENAME几乎总伴着一圈坚冰，用于攻防。尖脚让它站稳冰上，也能轻松滑行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME几乎总有一圈坚冰相伴，用来进攻、防御。锋利的脚尖让它们能在冰上站稳，也能轻松滑行。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its two long limbs to sweep up trash and to fend off competitors. There is a flower folded up inside the bag on its back, but it will not bloom until POKENAME nourishes itself with enough garbage.
decisions.target: POKENAME两根长肢扫垃圾、赶对手。背袋里折着花，吃够垃圾、养分足了，才会开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用两条长肢清扫垃圾，抵御竞争者。背上的袋子里有一朵收拢的花，只有吃下足够垃圾、获得充足养分，才会开放。

decisions.source: The edges of POKENAME's gears are extremely sharp. It fires the smaller gear from its body at distant prey, cutting them and allowing it to track them easier by following the scent of blood from the wound.
decisions.target: POKENAME齿轮锐边锋利，能将小齿轮射向远猎物，割伤后循血味，更容易追踪。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的齿轮边缘极其锋利。它将体内较小的齿轮射向远处猎物，割伤对方，便更容易循着伤口的血腥味追踪。

decisions.source: POKENAME usually spends its time in dark caves, so the plants on its back have adapted to thrive in little sunlight. It can carry Pokémon around, even being able to fly to another level of the cave.
decisions.target: POKENAME常住暗洞，背植已适应少光。也能载宝可梦飞，连洞穴另一层都能到。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常住在黑暗洞窟，背上的植物已适应微弱阳光，也能茂盛生长。它还能载着其他宝可梦移动，甚至飞往洞窟的另一层。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses sound waves to knock Persim Berries from trees before gathering them in its shell. The juice it makes is said to promote better hearing for short periods, offering a unique benefit for those who consume it.
decisions.target: POKENAME以声波震落柿仔果，收进壳。据说制成的果汁，能短暂改善饮者听力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用声波震落树上的柿仔果，再收进壳里。据说，它酿出的果汁能短时改善听力，为饮者带来独特的好处。

decisions.source: POKENAME likes to stretch out its legs to make itself look taller. It is easy to tell if a POKENAME is stronger by measuring how long its legs are, as the longer the legs, the stronger the Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱伸长腿，显得更高。量腿就容易判断POKENAME谁更强，因为腿越长，实力越高。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱伸长双腿，让自己显得更高。量一量腿长，就很容易比较个体的强弱，因为腿越长，实力就越强。

decisions.source: POKENAME's Thunder Fang attack is particularly strong due to its powerful jaws and refusal to let go after biting. While it holds on with its teeth, it swings its arms around to keep generating a shocking electric current into its target.
decisions.target: POKENAME颚强，咬住不放，雷电牙便格外强。牙咬牢时，双臂还不停挥，继续给目标送电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME双颚有力，咬住便不肯松口，因此雷电牙格外强劲。牙齿咬牢时，它还会挥舞双臂，不断向目标送入电流。

decisions.source: By igniting their hands, POKENAME can heat their claws to make carving into the ground less strenuous while creating their burrows. These Pokémon also have powerful legs that aid them in long-distance travel across the desert lands they call home.
decisions.target: POKENAME点燃双手，加热爪子，挖巢时凿地便省力许多。强腿也帮助它远行沙漠家园。
decisions.revised: POKENAME点燃双手，加热爪子，让挖洞安家时凿地更加省力。强健的双腿，也帮助它们在沙漠家园中长途远行。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses every part of its body to its advantage in a fight. It's said that when POKENAME's Trainer is in danger during a full moon, its desire to protect them becomes so powerful that its body undergoes a strange transformation.
decisions.target: POKENAME战斗善用全身。据说满月下训练家遇险，保护欲强到身体会发生奇异变形。
decisions.revised: POKENAME战斗时，善用身体的每个部分。据说，满月时若训练家遇险，它保护对方的愿望会强烈到让身体发生奇异变化。

decisions.source: One of POKENAME's favorite habits is to snatch something of its Trainer's and play tug-of-war with it. Due to its strong jaw strength, these sessions can last for a while before it'll give up the stolen object.
decisions.target: POKENAME很爱叼走训练家的东西，玩拔河。颚力太强，往往得拉扯好一阵，它才肯交还。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最喜欢叼走训练家的某件东西，再玩起拔河。它的颚力很强，往往要拉扯好一阵，它才肯放弃抢来的物件。

decisions.source: POKENAME carry a large chunk of black ice on their backs that does not melt, even in scorching hot conditions. POKENAME have large, bulky legs that struggle to move quickly, so they freeze a path and slide whenever the situation calls for it.
decisions.target: POKENAME背着大黑冰块，酷热也不融。粗重双腿难以快走，需要时便冻出路，滑着前进。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背着巨大的黑色冰块，即使酷热也不会融化。双腿粗重，难以迅速移动，因此需要时，它们会冻出一条路，滑行前进。

decisions.source: POKENAME take joy in cheering for the success of others, waving their arms and dancing with great enthusiasm. They have a tendency to splatter those nearby with mucus as they do so, inadvertently flinging their slime every time they shake their arms.
decisions.target: POKENAME为别人成功而高兴，兴奋挥臂跳舞。可每次甩手，黏液就不慎飞溅，洒向附近。
decisions.revised: POKENAME乐于为别人的成功喝彩，热情地挥臂、跳舞。可它们每次晃动双臂，都会无意中甩出黏液，常溅得附近生灵满身都是。

decisions.source: POKENAME acts as a guardian of trash dumps, and a protector of the trash-eating Pokémon. It will allow humans to make offerings of trash for its domain, but attempts to clean or scrounge from the area will not be tolerated.
decisions.target: POKENAME守卫垃圾场，保护吃垃圾的宝可梦。人类可献废物，清理或翻捡却绝不容忍。
decisions.revised: POKENAME守护垃圾场，也保护以垃圾为食的宝可梦。它允许人类献上垃圾，充实领地，却绝不容忍清理或在这里翻捡。

decisions.source: Although POKENAME has great strength, the spikes on POKENAME's back slow it down while swimming through water, and its tail gets in the way if it curls up into a ball to roll around on land. Because of this, it relies more on ambush than pursuit.
decisions.target: POKENAME力量大，可背刺拖慢泳速，陆上若蜷身滚动，尾巴又碍事，因此更依赖伏击，而非追赶。
