decisions.revised: POKENAME虽有强大的力量，背刺却会拖慢泳速；在陆地蜷成球滚动时，尾巴又会碍事。因此，它更依赖伏击，而非追捕。

decisions.source: POKENAME are commonly put to work on the shorelines of particularly rocky and difficult coasts. They wave their many tails to signal the dangers of the shore to ships, the gems at the tip of their tails lighting up bright enough to be seen for miles.
decisions.target: POKENAME常在岩多难行的海岸工作。它挥多尾向船示险，尾尖宝石亮到数英里外也看得见。
decisions.revised: 岩石密布、通行困难的海岸，常有POKENAME工作。它们挥动许多尾巴，向船只示警岸边的危险；尾尖的宝石明亮得数英里外都能看见。

decisions.source: POKENAME jets water from its shell to chase prey before ensnaring them with its tongue, which can be up to five times the length of its shell. The teeth on the shell shred the prey as POKENAME reels them in, allowing it to easily digest its food.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳喷水追猎，再以最长可达壳长五倍的舌缠住。卷回时，壳牙将猎物撕碎，方便消化。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从壳里喷水追赶猎物，再用最长可达壳长五倍的舌头缠住。将猎物卷回时，壳上的牙会将其撕碎，方便消化。

decisions.source: POKENAME do not see very well, but they have an excellent sense of smell. Their body is resistant to fire, so if their fluffy wool grows too thick, they simply burn it off by releasing fire through specific glands.
decisions.target: POKENAME视力差，嗅觉却出色。身体耐火，蓬毛太厚，就从特定腺体喷火，直接烧掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME视力不佳，嗅觉却十分出色。身体耐火，蓬松的毛若长得太厚，它们就从特定腺体放出火焰，直接烧掉。

decisions.source: Because of its curved-out body shape, POKENAME will often fly a bit too high for its comfort. To counter this, it hardens its body, giving them enough weight to come back down  and not float off into space.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体外弯，常飞得过高、不舒服。它就硬化身体，加重降下，免得飘进太空。
decisions.revised: POKENAME向外鼓出的体形，让它常飞得太高，感到不适。它便硬化身体，增加重量，降回低处，免得飘进太空。

decisions.source: POKENAME produces electricity to power a microwave with how often it pulls up its pants made of fleece. It is said that in one day of storing static, it has enough electricity to cook a pack of Instant Noodles.
decisions.target: POKENAME不断拉起羊毛裤，产电供微波炉。据说积一天静电，就够煮一包即食面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME频频往上提绒毛裤，产生电力，为微波炉供能。据说，只要储存一天静电，就足以煮熟一包即食面。

decisions.source: POKENAME is an exceptionally skilled flier, mastering the air currents it encounters and using warm winds to cover greater distances. From the cotton on its tail, it releases pollen during its journeys, spreading it to make new flowers bloom.
decisions.target: POKENAME精通飞行与气流，借暖风远行。旅途中从尾棉放花粉，传播到新花开放。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞行本领出众，能驾驭遇到的气流，借暖风飞得更远。旅途中，它们从尾上的棉絮放出花粉，传播到各处，让新的花朵绽放。

decisions.source: POKENAME's gem-encrusted claws and tail give it a defensive edge in battle. It produces a sharp noise by scraping its tail against the floor in its cave habitat, frightening those who come too close to its nest.
decisions.target: POKENAME镶宝石的爪、尾，让防御占优。洞里用尾刮地，锐声吓退靠巢太近的来者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的爪子和尾巴镶满宝石，让它在战斗中占据防御优势。它用尾巴刮擦洞窟地面，发出尖锐声音，吓退靠巢太近的来者。

decisions.source: Although cute-looking, POKENAME will puff up its chest and take on an intimidating glare to scare foes. It is very proud, so it will use its tail to slap away any gifts people may try to give it.
decisions.target: POKENAME外貌可爱，却会挺胸怒瞪，吓唬敌人。性格骄傲，谁想送礼，都用尾巴拍开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME看似可爱，却会鼓起胸膛，凶狠瞪视，吓退敌人。它十分高傲，谁想送礼，都会被它用尾巴拍开。

decisions.source: POKENAME have such an intense internal heat that they do not require their entire bodies to be covered in their feathers. When these Pokémon form groups, pairs of POKENAME will touch their horns together as a sign of trust.
decisions.target: POKENAME内热极强，全身不必都覆着羽毛。聚成群体时，成对碰角，是信任的表示。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体内热量强烈，因此不必让羽毛覆满全身。它们聚成群体时，会两两碰角，表示信任。

decisions.source: POKENAME dig burrows at the bottom of river beds, hiding the entrance amongst the pebbles and rocks that line the bottom. They use their shells to disguise themselves when entering and exiting their burrow, pretending to simply be stones.
decisions.target: POKENAME在河床底挖洞，入口藏在底部碎石间。出入时用壳伪装，装成普通石头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在河床底部挖洞，把入口藏进铺满底部的卵石与岩块间。进出洞时，它们借外壳伪装，假扮普通石头。

decisions.source: A POKENAME will fold its large limbs alongside its body as it swims through water. When it reaches land, or a floe of solid ice, it will launch from the water and use these limbs to continue its journey.
decisions.target: POKENAME游泳把大肢体折在身侧。抵达陆地或坚冰，就跃出水，用肢体继续旅程。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在水中游动时，会将巨大的肢体折在身侧。抵达陆地或坚实的浮冰时，它便跃出水面，用这些肢体继续前行。

decisions.source: POKENAME have an electrical organ atop their heads that serves to illuminate the paths ahead of them as they propel themselves through water. They can release stronger jets of water from their open palms to accelerate and ram others.
decisions.target: POKENAME头顶发电器官，照亮水中前路。张开手掌，能喷更强水柱，加速撞击别人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头顶有发电器官，在水中推进时，能照亮前路。它们张开手掌，还能喷出更强的水柱，加速冲撞旁人。

decisions.source: POKENAME battle one another in contests of strength, seeking to ram into one another and send the loser tumbling down the mountainside. They are incredibly slow Pokémon, and the impacts between them rarely result in any real harm.
decisions.target: POKENAME互相较力，想把对方撞得滚下山坡。它们动作极慢，相撞很少真正受伤。
decisions.revised: POKENAME相互较量力量，试图撞倒对方，让败者滚下山坡。不过，它们动作慢得惊人，碰撞很少真正造成伤害。

decisions.source: POKENAME has the power to fire projectiles of pure light from the holes in its palms. The horn on its head spins, glows and radiates brightly when it's preparing to launch a barrage of them at its opponent.
decisions.target: POKENAME能从掌孔发射纯光弹。准备向对手齐射时，头角会转动，发出明亮光辉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能从掌心的孔发射纯粹由光构成的弹丸。准备向对手接连齐射时，头上的角会旋转、发亮，散出明耀光芒。

decisions.source: Running around in the moonlight, POKENAME spread the seeds that grow between their feathers as they travel. Once morning breaks, these Pokémon will find a place to rest buried under the soil, with only their leafy feathers exposed.
decisions.target: POKENAME月下奔跑，沿路撒出羽间长的种子。天一亮，就埋土休息，只露叶状羽毛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在月光下奔跑，沿途撒下羽毛间生长的种子。天一亮，它们便找地方埋进土里休息，只露出叶片般的羽毛。

decisions.source: It appears in people's houses in the middle of the night, phasing through walls to chase them down. It's usually seen as frightening, but POKENAME actually aims to have a fun time with the humans it chases.
decisions.target: POKENAME半夜闯民宅，穿墙追人，常让人害怕。其实，它只是想与追逐的人好好玩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME半夜出现在人们家中，穿过墙壁追赶，通常让人心生恐惧。其实，它只是想和被追的人玩个痛快。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their long beaks both to drink pink nectar, which is what they favor most, and to stop themselves from rolling out of control. They sway themselves from side to side to help calm and focus their minds.
decisions.target: POKENAME长喙既喝最爱的粉花蜜，也能刹住失控滚动。左右摇身，帮助平静、专注。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用长喙饮下最爱的桃粉色花蜜，也用它防止自己滚得失去控制。它们左右摇摆身体，让心神平静、专注。

decisions.source: When the day becomes evening, POKENAME summons spirits to go on land and gather food for it. It covers each spirit in a toxic film-like substance so that the spirits can deter thieves from stealing their collected food.
decisions.target: 傍晚，POKENAME召灵魂上陆地采食，逐个裹一层有毒薄膜，防贼抢走收来的食物。
decisions.revised: 傍晚，POKENAME召唤灵体到陆地上，为自己采集食物。它会给每个灵体覆上一层有毒薄膜，使其能吓退想抢走食物的贼。

decisions.source: It is attracted to the sound of music and dancing, and will gather a pack of other POKENAME to go and invade any party it finds. They then engage in roughhousing, fights, and chaotic dancing, effectively ruining the party.
decisions.target: 它受歌舞吸引，会叫一帮POKENAME闯入派对，粗野嬉闹、打架、乱舞，彻底毁掉聚会。
decisions.revised: 它被音乐与舞蹈吸引，会召来一群POKENAME，闯进找到的任何聚会。接着，它们粗野打闹、打架、胡乱起舞，彻底毁掉派对。

decisions.source: POKENAME refuses to let a target escape once it has set its sights on them. It uses a specialized harpoon gun to ensure it can latch onto its quarry and reel them back in if they try to flee.
decisions.target: POKENAME一盯住目标，就绝不放走。特制鱼叉枪能钩住猎物，谁想逃，就再拖回来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一旦盯住目标，就绝不放走。特制的鱼叉枪能钩牢猎物，谁试图逃跑，它便将其重新拖回。

decisions.source: POKENAME's arms are huge enough to carry it around easily, so it's rarely seen actually standing on its own feet. It lumbers throughout dark forests, ready to strike down those who would disturb the woodland's peace.
decisions.target: POKENAME巨臂轻易撑身，很少真用脚站。笨重穿暗林，随时打倒破坏林地安宁者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的双臂巨大，足以轻松托着自己移动，因此很少真用双脚站立。它缓缓穿行黑暗森林，随时准备击倒破坏林地安宁的生灵。

decisions.source: POKENAME often keeps honey stuck to its horn so that it has something to snack on when it craves sweets. Trying to touch its horn while it has honey on it will result in it attacking with the massive stinger on its tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME常把蜜黏在角上，嘴馋就有零食。蜜还在角上，谁试着碰，它就用巨大尾刺攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常把蜂蜜黏在角上，想吃甜食时，就有零嘴可享。若角上还沾着蜜，谁想触碰，就会遭到巨大尾刺的攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME constantly sniff at the air to find food, their sense of smell being keen enough to find anything edible even if it's buried underground. They use their paws to dig toward their meals and their flames to cook it to perfection.
decisions.target: POKENAME不停嗅空气找食，灵鼻连埋地的可食物，也能找到。它用爪挖，再用火，烹到完美。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不断嗅闻空气，寻找食物。敏锐的嗅觉，让它连埋在地里的可食之物也能找到，再用爪子挖出来，以火焰烹到恰到好处。

decisions.source: When it's time to frighten a victim, POKENAME flares its fiery hands up to twice their normal size, emitting a cackling peak of laughter as it does so. It prefer to hide in old furnaces until it's ready to scare someone.
decisions.target: POKENAME准备吓人，就将火手涨至平常两倍，尖声怪笑。平时宁藏旧炉，等想吓谁才出来。
decisions.revised: 准备吓人时，POKENAME会将火焰双手涨到平常两倍大，同时发出高亢的怪笑。它平时喜欢藏在旧炉子里，等想吓谁时才出来。

decisions.source: POKENAME partake in elaborate dances with one another at high speeds. However, their wings are very fragile and during these dances the complexity means they are at risk of hitting each other. If this does happen, they tend to each other's injuries.
decisions.target: POKENAME高速跳复杂群舞。可翅膀脆弱，动作又复杂，容易相撞。真撞了，就互相照顾伤势。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会一起高速跳起繁复的舞蹈。可翅膀十分脆弱，复杂的动作又容易让彼此相撞。若真撞伤，它们就会互相照料。

decisions.source: The average Raticate's hiss is intimidating and ear-piercing, while this Pokémon's cry is neither of those. More often than not, this Pokémon will be forced to go first in a life-and-death situation for the pack.
decisions.target: 普通拉达嘶声吓人刺耳，它却两样都没有。族群遇生死关头，往往被迫打头阵。
decisions.revised: 普通拉达的嘶声刺耳又吓人，这种宝可梦的叫声却两者皆非。族群遇到生死关头，它往往会被迫打头阵。

decisions.source: POKENAME comes out during the warmer parts of the day. As the temperature cools, it uses the vines from its bulb to dig out holes for it to sleep in until the next day brings about more warmth for it to soak in.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天暖时才出来。气温一低，就用球茎藤蔓挖睡洞，直到次日更暖，再出来享受。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会在一天中较暖和的时候出来。气温转凉，它就用种子伸出的藤蔓挖洞，在里面睡到第二天，再享受新的暖意。

decisions.source: POKENAME are found in farmers' fields after a full moon. They delight in using their illusion powers to disguise themselves as crops and wait for people to come close. They then leap out to surprise their unfortunate target when they get too close.
decisions.target: 满月过后，农田能见到POKENAME。它乐于装成作物，等人靠近，再突然跳出，吓坏倒霉目标。
decisions.revised: 满月过后，农田里能发现POKENAME。它们乐于用幻象把自己伪装成作物，等人走近，再突然跃出，吓倒霉的目标一跳。

decisions.source: POKENAME resides at the ocean's abyss, where next to no light reaches. Should it surface and go on a rampage, it is said it can unleash light rays so hot as to cause the oceans to evaporate before the day's end.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在几乎无光的海渊。据说若浮出暴走，炽热光线能在当天结束前蒸发海洋。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在几乎无光可达的海渊。据说，若它浮出海面暴走，就能释放炽热光线，在当天结束前，将海洋蒸干。

decisions.source: The flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing, but it fails to have any grace in its dance moves to live up to the gorgeous sound. It often hides from others because it is ashamed of its terrible dance skills.
decisions.target: 振翼声像女子歌唱，舞姿却毫无优雅，配不上美声。它羞于舞技糟糕，常躲旁人。
decisions.revised: 它振翅的声音像女子歌唱，舞步却毫无优雅，配不上动听的歌声。它为自己糟糕的舞技羞愧，常躲着旁人。

decisions.source: POKENAME curls up in forests and resembles nothing more than a thick bush. It sleeps most of the day, but if it senses litter in its forest, it immediately goes on the attack and fires sharp leaves from its back at the defiler.
decisions.target: POKENAME蜷在林里，像厚灌丛，白天大多睡。可一察觉垃圾，就马上背射利叶，攻击亵渎者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME蜷在森林里，看起来不过是一丛浓密灌木。它白天大多在睡觉，可一察觉森林里有垃圾，就会立刻出击，从背上射出利叶，攻击糟蹋森林的家伙。

decisions.source: POKENAME blinks light with its tail to communicate with other Pokémon, changing the patterns it uses to best suit the species it's talking to. While it can't turn invisible, it can release a blinding flash of light to give enough time to dash away.
decisions.target: POKENAME闪尾灯沟通，依交谈物种调整最合适的规律。虽不会隐形，却能闪强光，争取时间跑掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME让尾巴闪光，与其他宝可梦交流，还会根据交谈的物种，调整最合适的闪光规律。它虽然不能隐形，却能放出刺眼强光，争取足够时间飞快逃离。

decisions.source: Most of the time POKENAME floats close to the ground, drifting on the breeze. If it gets near enough to a sleeping person to cause a bad dream, it will suddenly rise up into the air, and strong, high-altitude winds will blow it a great distance.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多近地随风飘。若靠近睡者到足以引恶梦，就忽然升空，随后被高空强风吹出很远。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大多贴近地面，随微风漂游。若靠得足够近，让睡着的人做起噩梦，它就会突然升空，被高处的强风吹往远方。

decisions.source: Though it displays a unique ability to detach its own head, it can only do so for less than an hour before it must be returned to its body. It typically only detaches its head to reach foods that are far away and/or high up.
decisions.target: 它能拆下头，却只能离身不到一小时，就得接回。通常只为够远处或高处的食物，才拆。
decisions.revised: 它有一项独特本领，能将自己的头取下来，但离身不到一小时，就必须装回身体。它通常只是为了够到远处或高处的食物，才会这样做。

decisions.source: The inner section of POKENAME's blade is normally empty, but it can fill that gap with light energy to make its blade whole again. It always lies flat on its side so that it's more likely to be picked up and can drain the light from whoever holds it.
decisions.target: POKENAME的刃内部平常空着，能注入光能，重新补全。它总侧身平躺，好更容易被捡起，吸走持有者的光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的剑刃内部平常中空，却能注入光能，重新补全。它总侧身平躺，让自己更容易被捡起，好吸走持有者的光。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their hardened chrysalises both to protect themselves and as weapons. The shells of their chrysalises are especially thick at the tops of their skulls, leading them to prefer ramming head-first as an attack.
decisions.target: POKENAME的硬蛹壳既能防身，也能作武器。头顶尤其厚，因此更爱迎头冲撞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME硬化的蛹壳，既能防身，也能作武器。头顶处的壳尤其厚，因此它们更喜欢头朝前，发起冲撞。

decisions.source: POKENAME clings to the trunks of giant trees, gorging on the sap it digs up from beneath the bark. As it feasts, its leaves emit a pleasantly sweet aroma that soothes and calms the creatures nearby.
decisions.target: POKENAME攀巨树干，从皮下挖汁，大吃不休。用餐时，叶片甜香安抚四周生灵。
decisions.revised: POKENAME攀在巨树的树干上，挖开树皮，饱食底下的树液。进食时，叶片会散发宜人的甜香，安抚附近的生灵，使其平静。

decisions.source: POKENAME searches for food on beaches, devouring anything that washes up or that it can find by digging. If its claws become too worn down, they will drop off so that new ones can replace them.
decisions.target: POKENAME在海滩找食，冲来的、挖到的，都吃。爪过度磨损，会掉下，长新的替换。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在海滩觅食，无论冲上海岸，还是挖出来的东西，都大口吞下。爪子若磨损太严重，就会脱落，由新爪取代。

decisions.source: By creeping and hiding in tall grass, POKENAME close the distance between themselves and their prey without being detected. Once in position, they kick up blinding sand to confuse their prey before landing a lethal blow.
decisions.target: POKENAME爬近、藏高草，悄悄接近猎物。位置一到，就扬沙迷眼，再给致命一击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME潜行、藏身于高草间，不被察觉地接近猎物。一到合适位置，它们便扬起遮眼的沙，扰乱对方，再给予致命一击。

decisions.source: POKENAME waits at the bottom of creeks for prey to get close before biting at them with its sharp front tooth. It drags its catch in with ease, using its strength to hold onto the prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME在溪底等猎物靠近，用锐利门牙咬。力气大，轻松拖来并牢牢抓住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在溪底等待猎物靠近，再用锐利的门牙咬住。它力气很大，能牢牢抓住猎物，轻松拖到身边。

decisions.source: POKENAME is usually found doing its swaying dances near some type of body of water. As it dances, its psychic powers cause small waves to ripple across the water's surface in tune with its movements.
decisions.target: POKENAME通常在水边摇摆跳舞。精神力量让水面小波随动作有节奏荡开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常在各种水域旁摇摆起舞。跳舞时，超能力会让细小的涟漪随动作节拍，在水面荡开。

decisions.source: POKENAME keeps itself buried in the soil, letting its large leaves draw in sunlight and sense the weather around it. On windy days it pops up from the ground to take a ride along the breeze.
decisions.target: POKENAME埋在土里，以大叶吸日光、感知天气。有风就钻出地面，乘风走一程。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将自己埋在土里，让大叶片吸收阳光，感知周围天气。有风的日子，它就钻出地面，乘着微风走上一程。

decisions.source: POKENAME turn to face into the breeze and greatly enjoy the feel of the wind on their leaves. They love to play with electric fans and will sit in front of them for hours on end.
decisions.target: POKENAME迎微风转身，很享受叶上风感。它爱玩电风扇，能在前面坐数小时。
decisions.revised: POKENAME转身迎着微风，十分享受风拂叶片的感觉。它们最爱玩电风扇，能在前面一坐就是好几个小时。

decisions.source: POKENAME flowers blossom when they are sufficiently warm, releasing a sweet fragrance into the air when it does. POKENAME seek out sunny locations to lounge in, relying on their sensitive whiskers to warn them of impending rain.
decisions.target: POKENAME花暖够便开，甜香入空气。它找晴处休息，靠敏感胡须警告雨将至。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的花，只要足够温暖就会绽放，散出甜香。它们寻找阳光明媚的地方躺卧，靠敏感的胡须，察知即将到来的雨。

decisions.source: When threatened, POKENAME shakes off several bits of pollen-like fluff into the air around it. It then releases powerful electric jolts from its body that jump from clump to clump, creating a chain-lightning effect.
decisions.target: POKENAME受威胁，抖下几团花粉般的绒，再放强电，团间跳跃形成连锁雷电。
decisions.revised: 受到威胁时，POKENAME向周围抖落几团花粉般的绒毛，再放出强力电流。电光在绒团间跳跃，形成连锁闪电般的效果。

decisions.source: POKENAME's mushrooms are coated with a thick layer of cotton-like spores. The spores can burst and spread outward both as a defense mechanism and as a way to stimulate fungal growth in the area.
decisions.target: POKENAME蘑菇覆厚厚的棉状孢子，既可迸散自卫，也能促进当地真菌生长。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的蘑菇覆着一层厚厚的棉絮状孢子。孢子能迸散出去，既用于自卫，也能促进附近真菌生长。

decisions.source: POKENAME make their homes amongst the roots of trees, creating intricate burrow networks within forests. They use their sharp teeth to feast on roots and tubers in safety underground, nourishing the plant growing from their head.
decisions.target: POKENAME在森林树根间造复杂地洞，地下安全吃根与块茎，滋养头顶植物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在森林树根之间安家，挖出繁复的地道网。它们在安全的地下，用利齿饱食根与块茎，滋养头上生长的植物。

decisions.source: POKENAME hates having to move around in its iron shell and will spend all day trying to chew through it. While keeping its teeth from growing too long, it doesn't seem to accomplish much else.
decisions.target: POKENAME讨厌带铁壳移动，整天想啃穿。除了防牙长过头，似乎没别的成果。
decisions.revised: POKENAME讨厌带着铁壳四处移动，整天试着将壳啃穿。除了磨短牙齿，免得长得太过，它似乎没取得什么其他成果。

decisions.source: POKENAME is naturally agitated and frequently chomps on its tail to hold back its rage. When it hangs from branches using its tail, it sometimes forgets and bites it anyway, falling and becoming even more enraged.
decisions.target: POKENAME天性躁，常咬尾压怒。可用尾挂树时，有时忘了照咬，摔下反更生气。
decisions.revised: POKENAME天生烦躁，常啃咬尾巴，压住怒气。可用尾巴挂在树枝上时，它有时也会忘记，照样咬下，结果摔落，反而更加恼怒。

decisions.source: It jabs at opponents with the thick spikes at the ends of its fists. When its vines ensnare an opponent, it will not stop lashing at them until they can be dragged in and consumed.
decisions.target: 用拳端粗刺戳敌。藤一缠住对手，就抽打不停，直到能拖进来吃掉。
decisions.revised: 它用拳端的粗刺戳向敌人。藤蔓一旦缠住对手，它就会鞭打不休，直到能将其拖进来吞食。

decisions.source: POKENAME's crescent-shaped wings glow faintly in the night. When the moon is full, should POKENAME be hovering silently over a field of flowers, all the plants will have wilted by the time the sun rises.
decisions.target: POKENAME新月翼夜里微亮。满月时若静悬花田，日出前，所有植物都会凋萎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME月牙形的翅膀，夜里泛着微光。满月之夜，若它静静悬在花田上方，到日出时，所有植物都会凋萎。

decisions.source: Hiding out in dumpsters and trash cans, POKENAME camouflage themselves and wait for trash to be thrown out. Using their long tongues, these Pokémon can snatch food from afar, pulling it straight into their mouths.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏在垃圾箱桶里，伪装等垃圾丢来。长舌从远处抓食，直接拉入口。
decisions.revised: POKENAME躲在大垃圾箱或垃圾桶里，伪装自己，等着人们丢弃垃圾。长舌能从远处抓住食物，直接拉进嘴里。

decisions.source: POKENAME travel across the world, keeping to themselves due to their deep hatred of social interaction. They have quite a fascination with bug Pokémon, always holding out their forearms so they can land on them.
decisions.target: POKENAME极厌社交，独自走遍世界，却很迷虫宝可梦，总伸前臂让它们停落。
decisions.revised: POKENAME游历世界，却因极其厌恶社交而独来独往。它们很迷恋虫类宝可梦，总伸出前臂，让对方停在上面。

decisions.source: After heavy snowfall, the conical mushroom on POKENAME's head is often the only part of its body that remains visible. It feeds the mushroom by digging up and eating fallen leaves from beneath the snow.
decisions.target: 大雪后，常只看见POKENAME头顶的锥形蘑菇。它挖吃雪下落叶，为蘑菇供养。
decisions.revised: 大雪过后，POKENAME常只剩头顶的锥形蘑菇露在外面。它挖出雪下的落叶吃，供养这朵蘑菇。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to sing, so much so that the flame at the end of their tail glows bright when they get the opportunity. Their lack of experience is only surpassed by the strength of their passion.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱唱歌，一有机会，尾火就亮起。经验虽不足，满腔热情却更胜一筹。
decisions.revised: POKENAME非常爱唱歌，一有机会，尾端的火焰就会明亮起来。比它缺乏经验更引人注目的，只有那份热情。

decisions.source: One should never attempt to touch the stone on POKENAME's head, as doing so will send it into an immediate rage. It will coat itself in raging flame before charging into anything and everything nearby until it calms down.
decisions.target: 别碰POKENAME头上的石头，一碰就立刻暴怒。会披上烈焰，冲撞周围一切，直到平静。
decisions.revised: 千万别试着碰POKENAME头上的石头，否则它会立刻勃然大怒。它披上熊熊烈焰，冲撞附近的一切，直到平静下来才肯停。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their tentacle-like tails to pull left-behind toys down into the water. When they go back into their caves, they play with these toys for short periods of time before letting them float back to the surface.
decisions.target: POKENAME用触须状尾，将遗落玩具拉进水。回洞后，先玩一小阵，再让玩具浮回水面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用触手般的尾巴，将遗落的玩具拉进水里。回到洞窟，它们会拿来玩上一小会儿，再任玩具浮回水面。

decisions.source: It regularly plays pranks on fishermen. If the fisherman uses a rod, POKENAME will dive underwater and attach their hook to detritus; if the fisherman uses a net, POKENAME will float over to them and slap them with its long tongue.
decisions.target: POKENAME常捉弄渔人。用竿，它就潜水，把钩挂上杂物；用网，它就飘过去，用长舌抽打。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常捉弄钓鱼的人。对方用鱼竿，它就潜入水下，把鱼钩挂在杂物上；对方用网，它便飘过去，用长舌抽打。

decisions.source: The blades on POKENAME's arms are so sharp that they can cut through even the toughest metal. The edge of the blade is only 0.05 mm thick and possesses extreme durability. No one in history has ever observed them breaking.
decisions.target: POKENAME臂刃锋利，最硬金属也能切。刃口仅0.05毫米，却极耐用，史上从没人见过折断。
decisions.revised: POKENAME手臂上的刀刃锋利无比，连最坚硬的金属也能切开。刃口仅厚0.05毫米，却极其耐用，有史以来从未有人见过它折断。

decisions.source: During nights of a full moon, POKENAME will gather to spin a large web and dance around it. The web is made of a smooth silk that glows in moonlight, making it a rare and sought-after material for clothing.
decisions.target: 满月之夜，POKENAME聚集织大网，绕网跳舞。丝线光滑，月下发光，是稀有抢手的衣料。
decisions.revised: 满月之夜，POKENAME聚在一起，织出大网，绕网跳舞。蛛网由光滑的丝织成，月光下会发亮，是稀有而抢手的制衣材料。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a cheerful and energetic Pokémon that loves the dark. It is known to play excitedly with the glowing orbs on its head, leaping and tumbling around the moment they flicker to life when it's sufficiently dark.
decisions.target: POKENAME开朗活泼，喜欢黑暗。暗到头上光球亮起，就兴奋地跳跃翻滚，追着光球玩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME开朗活泼，喜欢黑暗。暗到头上的球体开始闪亮时，它就会兴奋地跃动、翻滚，摆弄这些发光球。

decisions.source: POKENAME stare up at the sun all day, and will grow hotter as the sun glows brighter. On overcast days, the fire they spit out will be at its weakest, and they will try to fly away rather than fight.
decisions.target: POKENAME整天抬头望日，太阳越亮，身体越热。阴天喷火最弱，会宁可飞走，也不战斗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME整天仰望太阳，阳光越明亮，身体就越热。阴天里，它们喷出的火最弱，便宁愿飞走，也不肯战斗。

decisions.source: Honing in on their extraordinary energy-based attack, POKENAME will focus their energy into one powerful beam and launch it at their opponent. This energy output is so potent that sparks will fly off its body when charging its attack.
decisions.target: POKENAME专注能量攻击，聚成一道强光束射敌。输出太强，蓄力时身上会迸出火花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME专注于非凡的能量攻击，将能量集中为一道强力射束，击向对手。输出的能量如此强大，连蓄力时，身体都会迸出火花。

decisions.source: POKENAME has a hoarder mentality, collecting large amounts of junk and storing it away in stashes. It's quite greedy and paranoid about its collections, preferring to burn them to ash rather than share them or have them taken away.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱囤杂物，分处藏好。贪婪又怕收藏出事，宁愿烧成灰，也不分享、不让夺走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱囤积，收来大量杂物，分处藏好。它对收藏既贪婪又多疑，宁可烧成灰，也不愿分享，更不愿被夺走。

decisions.source: POKENAME slowly wave their two flowers to mimic the motion of being moved by the wind. They leave a trail of pollen as they move, the dusty substance causing irritation to the eyes of those unfortunate enough to be nearby.
decisions.target: POKENAME缓摆两花，模仿随风摇动。移动留花粉踪迹，尘粉会刺激附近倒霉者的眼。
decisions.revised: POKENAME缓缓摇动两朵花，模仿风吹花动的样子。移动时，它们留下一路花粉，这些粉尘会刺激不幸待在附近者的眼睛。

decisions.source: POKENAME practice their martial arts with one another under the light of the moon, whirring around in a flurry of punches and kicks. They rely heavily on their wings during fights, using the manoeuvrability they afford them to their advantage.
decisions.target: POKENAME月下互练武术，拳脚纷飞。战斗很依赖翅膀，借其带来的灵活性，取得优势。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在月光下互相练习武术，身影飞转，拳脚纷飞。交战时，它们十分依赖翅膀，借翅膀带来的灵活性，取得优势。

decisions.source: Its lethargic lifestyle means it rarely gets up and moves around for any reason. It takes so long to do so that by the time it is on its feet, it has forgotten the reason it wanted to move in the first place.
decisions.target: 它懒得很，极少起身活动。就算想动，起身也太慢，等终于站好，早忘了为什么要走。
decisions.revised: 它过着懒散的日子，几乎找不出什么理由起身活动。即便想动，起身也慢得很，等终于站稳，早忘了最初为什么想动。

decisions.source: If rival POKENAME meet in the wild, they will try to intimidate the other by flaring their fires up to see who burns hotter. If neither backs down from the display, they charge their heavy bodies into each other and begin fighting for dominance.
decisions.target: 野外对手相遇，POKENAME先扬火，比谁更热，威吓彼此。若谁都不退，就用重身冲撞，争个主导。
decisions.revised: 野外，互为对手的POKENAME相遇，会先扬起火焰，比谁烧得更热，威吓彼此。若谁都不肯退让，它们便用沉重的身体相撞，争夺支配地位。

decisions.source: POKENAME's beak has a potent venomous bite and a large territorial streak, so it should be given a wide berth in the wild. It uses the feathers on the end of its tail to groom the glossy mane of feathers on its head.
decisions.target: POKENAME喙咬含强毒，领地意识也强，野外最好远离。它用尾端羽毛，梳理头上光亮的羽鬃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的喙带有强毒，领地意识又极强，在野外最好绕远些。它用尾端的羽毛，梳理头上光亮的羽鬃。

decisions.source: With their lower bodies in the visage of a flowing cape, these Pokémon crawl along forest floors and up the sides of trees in search of large leaves to feed upon. When asleep, their white antennae flick about like wisps of smoke.
decisions.target: 它们下身像流动披风，沿林地与树侧爬行，找大叶吃。睡觉时，白触角如烟丝飘摆。
decisions.revised: 这些宝可梦的下半身宛如飘动的披风，沿林地和树干爬行，寻找大片叶子吃。睡着时，白色触角会像缕缕烟丝一样摆动。

decisions.source: POKENAME hate being wet, and always carry a leaf with them to shelter from the rain. If they keep their body dry, they can pull off balls of cotton, set them on fire using their flaming tail, then toss them at foes as projectiles.
decisions.target: POKENAME讨厌沾湿，总带片叶子挡雨。身体干燥时，就能扯下棉球，以尾焰点燃，再投向敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME讨厌沾湿，总带着一片叶子遮雨。身体保持干燥，它便能扯下棉球，用尾焰点燃，再投向敌人。

decisions.source: This Pokémon's sad cries can be heard during the fall season when the last flowers are slowly withering. As the spring comes and flowers begin to bloom again, flocks of POKENAME gather together to dance, celebrating the start of a new cycle.
decisions.target: 秋日最后的花凋谢，便能听见这种宝可梦悲鸣。春花重开，POKENAME成群共舞，庆祝新轮回。
decisions.revised: 秋天，最后的花渐渐凋零时，能听见这种宝可梦悲伤的叫声。春日花朵重开，POKENAME便成群共舞，庆祝新的循环开始。

decisions.source: POKENAME are common landfill occupants because they feed on waste; they can even feed on liquid waste in lieu of water. They can spit fire, which also serves as a sign of their health; if POKENAME spits out any black smoke, it is likely ill.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃废物，是垃圾场常见住民，连废液都能代水。喷火也表健康；若喷黑烟，多半病了。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以废物为食，是垃圾填埋场的常见住民，甚至能用废液代替水。喷火也是健康的标志；若喷出黑烟，它多半是病了。

decisions.source: POKENAME's fur is always locked into the position they were last in before impurities grew over and hardened on them. There is an organ in its body that is able to produce light; however, it has been dormant for a long time now.
decisions.target: POKENAME的毛，永远定在杂质长出、硬化前最后的姿态。体内虽有发光器官，却已休眠很久。
decisions.revised: 杂质覆上POKENAME的毛并硬化，使毛永远停在先前的姿态。它体内有个能发光的器官，却已经休眠很久。

decisions.source: POKENAME is an agile climber, scaling trees to reach tree hollows. It uses the noxious fumes produced by burning spores at the end of its tail to drive away any Pokémon that approach it as it feeds on the wood within the tree.
decisions.target: POKENAME攀树灵巧，能爬进树洞吃里面的木。它燃烧尾端孢子，以毒烟驱赶靠近的宝可梦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME攀爬灵巧，爬上树，钻进树洞。它吃洞里的木头时，会燃烧尾端孢子，放出有害烟气，驱赶任何靠近的宝可梦。

decisions.source: Though it is a predatory Pokémon, POKENAME has poor eyesight and relies on its sense of smell to hunt. It utilizes the bright light it emits from its body to camouflage as a cluster of stars at night and dives into water to catch fish Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽是猎食者，视力却差，靠嗅觉狩猎。夜里以全身强光伪装成一簇星，再潜水捕鱼宝可梦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽是捕食者，视力却不佳，靠嗅觉狩猎。夜里，它用身体发出的强光，假扮一簇星星，再一头扎进水里，捕食鱼类宝可梦。

decisions.source: POKENAME stores excess heat in the blue orbs on its body. When it is on the backfoot in a battle, it releases all of its stored heat, the orbs erupting in a blaze of gorgeous blue flames.
decisions.target: POKENAME把多余热量存进蓝珠。战斗落下风，就全数释放，珠体迸出华丽蓝焰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将多余热量储存在身上的蓝色球体中。战斗陷入下风，它便尽数释放，让球体迸出绚丽的蓝焰。

decisions.source: POKENAME search for reservoirs of mineral water to quickly absorb the nutrients they need to nourish their body. Once they finish drinking the mineral water, they fall asleep in a sunny patch of grass to soak up the sun's rays.
decisions.target: POKENAME寻找矿泉水，快速吸取滋养身体所需的养分。喝完，便睡在向阳草地，晒太阳。
decisions.revised: POKENAME寻找储有矿泉水的地方，迅速吸取滋养身体所需的养分。喝完后，它们便在向阳的草地睡下，沐浴阳光。

decisions.source: Though POKENAME is well-suited to digging tunnels and absorbing nutrients from tree roots, it is too proud of its bright petals to dirty them with soil. Instead, it clings to tree branches, hoping to disguise itself as a flowering bud.
decisions.target: POKENAME擅打洞、吸树根养分，却太以鲜瓣为傲，不肯沾土。它改攀树枝，盼伪装成花苞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽很适合挖洞、吸取树根的养分，却十分为鲜艳的花瓣骄傲，舍不得沾土。它改为攀住树枝，盼着伪装成一枚花苞。

decisions.source: The pollen orbs of POKENAME's body can be ignited in order to give it better self-defense. On occasion, they will also catch on fire when a supportive POKENAME gets too energetic in cheering on its allies.
decisions.target: POKENAME体内花粉球，可点燃自卫。偶尔，热心给同伴加油，兴奋过头，也会着火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的花粉球，可以点燃，增强自卫能力。有时，它替伙伴加油太过起劲，这些球也会着火。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a very powerful Pokémon that uses both fire and electricity to fight its foes. When it's losing a fight, it makes the tips of its tails touch, producing an explosion of fire and a huge electric discharge.
decisions.target: POKENAME十分强大，以火与电迎敌。落下风，就让尾尖相碰，引发烈火爆炸与巨大放电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分强大，用火与电迎击敌人。战斗落入下风时，它便让尾尖相碰，引发烈焰爆炸，同时放出庞大的电流。

decisions.source: POKENAME secretly uses its power over cold to freeze those traveling through its domain. It then thaws them out with the flames from its body to make it seem as if it saved them from certain doom.
decisions.target: POKENAME偷偷用寒力，冻住过路者，再用身火解冻，装成自己把人从绝境救出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME偷偷用寒冷的力量，冻住穿过领地的生灵，再用身上的火焰解冻，装成将对方从绝境救出的恩人。

decisions.source: By latching their teeth into tree branches, POKENAME use their mouths to swing from tree to tree. These Pokémon primarily live in swamps, being just as agile in the water as they are in the trees.
decisions.target: POKENAME用牙攀枝，靠嘴在树间荡。它们主要住沼泽，在水里，也如树上般敏捷。
decisions.revised: POKENAME咬住树枝，靠嘴巴在树间荡行。它们主要栖息在沼泽，在水中与树上同样敏捷。

decisions.source: Shoals of POKENAME live in the deep ocean, their lights reminiscent of constellations in the night sky. They can adjust the flashing of their lights to communicate with one another across the darkness of their abyssal home.
decisions.target: POKENAME群住在深海，灯像夜空星座。它们调节闪烁，在黑暗家园中远距沟通。
decisions.revised: POKENAME成群生活在深海，光芒宛如夜空的星座。它们调节光的闪烁，在深渊家园的黑暗中，彼此交流。

decisions.source: Filled with restless energy, POKENAME regularly battle one another in the ponds they call home. They seek to triumph over their rivals and become the ruler of their peers. They will pummel their opponents with their clenched fists or quick tongue.
decisions.target: POKENAME精力难抑，常在家乡池塘互斗，想胜过对手，统领同伴。它用紧拳或快舌猛打。
decisions.revised: POKENAME精力躁动，常在栖居的池塘里互相交战，想击败对手，统领同伴。它们用紧握的拳头或迅捷的舌头，猛击敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME can move their multiple leaf-like tails independently of each other, adjusting them to be able to catch as much light as possible. When strong winds pick up, they spread them out wide and float on the breeze, making excited yips as they do.
decisions.target: POKENAME多条叶尾能独立活动，调整到尽可能多受光。大风来就全展开，兴奋尖叫着乘风漂。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能独立活动每条叶片般的尾巴，调整位置，尽量多接收光照。强风一来，它们便将尾巴大大展开，兴奋地尖叫着，随风漂游。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is fairly light, and it may be blown away mid-hop by a strong enough gust of wind. It uses its extendable arms to grab onto the nearest surface in order to keep from being carried away completely.
decisions.target: POKENAME身轻，跳到一半也可能被强风带走。它伸长手臂抓最近表面，免得完全漂开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体轻，跳到半空，也可能被强风吹走。它们便伸长手臂，抓住最近的表面，免得彻底被带走。

decisions.source: Even though POKENAME are considered pest by most people, they can actually be quite helpful as they like to eat things covered in mold. Because of this however, POKENAME fur is often covered in large amounts of bacteria.
decisions.target: 多数人视POKENAME为害兽，可爱吃霉物，也能帮忙。不过因此，毛常覆大量细菌。
decisions.revised: 虽然多数人将POKENAME视为害兽，它们爱吃发霉的东西，其实也能帮上不少忙。不过，也正因如此，毛上常布满大量细菌。

decisions.source: POKENAME can commonly be found at cheese factories, as the bacteria on their bodies aid in the fermentation process. However, they have a tendency to sneak into the storage areas and eat all the cheese they can.
decisions.target: 奶酪厂常见POKENAME，体表细菌助发酵。可它也爱偷进仓库，尽量把奶酪吃光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常见于奶酪工厂，身上的细菌有助于发酵。但它们也常偷偷溜进仓库，能吃多少奶酪，就吃多少。

decisions.source: Its petals spin in a rotating motion to help it swim gracefully up strong streams. The horn on POKENAME's forehead is its only method of defense, so it chooses to flee most battles until it evolves.
decisions.target: POKENAME旋花瓣，优雅逆急流游。额角是唯一防御，因此进化前多半逃避战斗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME借旋转的花瓣，优雅地逆着急流游动。额头上的角是唯一的防御手段，因此进化之前，它多半选择避战逃离。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their long ribbons to scoop up clumps of mud that they use to cushion the blow of incoming attacks. While their opponent is caught in the mud, they rapidly flick forward to deliver a sharp smack with the broad side of their fins.
decisions.target: POKENAME用长缎带兜泥，缓冲来袭攻击。对手困在泥里时，就迅速前弹，以宽阔鳍面重重拍击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用长缎带兜起泥团，缓冲来袭的攻击。对手困在泥里时，它们便迅速向前弹出，用宽阔的鳍面，狠狠拍击。

decisions.source: POKENAME is generally quite shy and tends to hide when it sees others approaching. It is drawn to brightly-colored flowers, and can be coaxed out of hiding by presenting it with some as a peace offering.
decisions.target: POKENAME通常害羞，见别人靠近就藏。受鲜艳花朵吸引，献花示好，便能哄出来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常很害羞，看见旁人靠近就躲起来。它偏爱鲜艳的花，拿花示好，便能哄它离开藏身处。

decisions.source: The colorful cotton around POKENAME's body does not change color when POKENAME uses camouflage, which unfortunately still leaves it vulnerable and easy to spot. If it's snatched up by a flying Pokémon, it lashes out with its powerful tongue.
decisions.target: POKENAME伪装时，身周彩棉却不变，仍然显眼脆弱。被飞行宝可梦抓起，就用强舌反击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME伪装时，身体周围的彩色棉絮却不会变色，仍然显眼、容易受袭。若被会飞的宝可梦抓起，它们便用强健的舌头猛烈反击。

decisions.source: It is easier for POKENAME to grab objects with their tongue instead of their claws. POKENAME communicate with each other by changing their colors as well as waving twigs they set alight. They have to be careful not to burn their tongues.
decisions.target: POKENAME用舌拿东西，比用爪容易。以变色和挥舞点燃的细枝交流，须小心别烧到舌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用舌头取物，比用爪子容易。它们靠变换颜色和挥动点燃的细枝交流，得小心别烧到自己的舌头。

decisions.source: POKENAME has the cheerful disposition of a naive child. It easily gets clingy towards others, grabbing onto them to keep close. Because of the massive grip strength its claws have, it's difficult to pry it away once it gets attached.
decisions.target: POKENAME如天真孩子般开朗，易黏人，抓住别人想贴近。爪握力太强，一黏住就难掰开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME像天真的孩子一样开朗，很容易黏上旁人，伸爪抓住，想贴得更近。爪子的握力惊人，一旦抓牢，就很难让它松开。

decisions.source: Although POKENAME's skin is made of metal, it is buoyant enough to float. If it sees a ship sinking while flying over the sea, POKENAME may dive down and use its powerful tail to push the vessel closer to shore, enabling the passengers to escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME皮肤虽金属，浮力却够。海上飞行若见沉船，可能俯冲，用强尾推近岸，帮助乘客逃走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的皮肤虽由金属构成，浮力却足以让它漂起来。飞过海面时，若发现正在下沉的船，它可能俯冲下去，用强尾将船推近岸边，让乘客逃生。

decisions.source: POKENAME has a strong resemblance to an Aerodactyl skeleton, with a thin black membrane stretched between its bones. It will pretend to be inert during the day, and then fly off at night in search of prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME酷似化石翼龙骨架，骨间张着薄黑膜。白天静伏伪装，夜里飞出觅食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME酷似化石翼龙的骨架，骨骼间绷着一层黑色薄膜。它白天假装毫无动静，夜里才飞出去寻找猎物。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to rest in the mud but need to keep moving every now and then to prevent themselves from being submerged in mud. If they remain in one spot for too long, they may get stuck until someone helps them.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱躺泥里，却需不时移动，免得沉进去。同处待太久，可能困住，得等谁来帮忙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱在泥里休息，却得不时移动，免得陷下去。若在同一处待太久，它们可能被困住，只能等人帮忙。

decisions.source: POKENAME makes sure to stay as far away from predators as possible by flying high up in the air or burrowing deep into the ground. When they are spotted, they flap their wings to create large gusts of wind and escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME或飞到高空，或深钻地下，尽可能远离天敌。一被发现，就扇翅掀起大风逃走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞上高空，或深钻地下，尽量远离捕食者。一旦被发现，它们便拍翅掀起强风，趁机逃走。

decisions.source: The tips of POKENAME's ribbons are able to glow, growing bright enough to illuminate the darker parts of the ocean depths. Coming close to the light causes a creature's negative emotions to fade away, replaced by a numb contentment.
decisions.target: POKENAME缎带尖端能亮得照清深海暗处。靠近光，负面情绪便渐消，换成麻木的满足。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的缎带尖端能发光，亮得足以照清深海暗处。生灵靠近这光，负面情绪便会消退，取而代之的，是一种麻木的满足感。

decisions.source: The blue lights emitted from within these Pokémon have a hypnotically soothing effect on those who watch them. Many POKENAME have been seen using their feelers to hang from branches and will shine their lights on those who draw near.
decisions.target: 体内蓝光能催眠般安抚观看者。人们常见POKENAME用触须吊在枝上，向靠近者照光。
decisions.revised: 这些宝可梦体内的蓝光，对观看者有催眠般的安抚效果。人们常见POKENAME用触须挂在树枝上，将光照向走近的生灵。

decisions.source: POKENAME shakes the pollen from its orbs loose in order to make up for its lack of sight. It can sense when its pollen has landed on a living being, chasing after them in order to latch onto them and drink some of their blood.
decisions.target: POKENAME抖落球状部位的花粉，补足失明的不便。它能察觉花粉落上活物，追去攀住，吸些血。
decisions.revised: POKENAME抖落球体上的花粉，弥补看不见的不便。它能感知花粉落在活物身上，便追上去攀住，吸取一点血。

decisions.source: POKENAME doesn't move much, as it wants to keep its protective shell from falling apart. If it does fall off, it will hunt for a Caterpie nest to use the larvae's sticky silk to stick its shell back together.
decisions.target: POKENAME不太动，想防止护身壳散架。壳若脱落，就寻找绿毛虫巢，用幼虫黏丝粘回去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不怎么移动，想让护身的壳不至散架。壳若掉落，它就寻找绿毛虫的巢，用幼虫的黏丝，将壳重新粘牢。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives in colder climates as its beautiful feathers give off large amounts of heat.  It is a difficult Pokémon to please as it will spew harsh flames at any potential mate it doesn't like.
decisions.target: POKENAME美羽放热多，便住寒地。很难讨好，不喜欢的求偶者，都会被猛烈喷火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME美丽的羽毛散出大量热量，因此住在寒冷地区。它十分难以讨好，对任何不喜欢的求偶者，都会喷出猛烈火焰。

decisions.source: One should be very careful not to anger POKENAME. Its spiked pom-poms make for deadly punches, but can also be lobbed from afar, where they will burst apart in a shower of lightning and spiked projectiles.
decisions.target: 千万别惹怒POKENAME，带刺绒球能打致命拳。也能远掷，爆成闪电与刺弹的雨。
decisions.revised: 千万小心，别惹怒POKENAME。带刺的绒球能打出致命重拳，也能远远投出，随后炸开，撒下闪电与尖刺弹丸。

decisions.source: POKENAME is often shunned because people consider it filthy and fear it might spread disease. In reality, its presence is very beneficial to metropolitan areas, since it feeds on trash and therefore helps keep the alleys clean.
decisions.target: POKENAME常被嫌脏，怕它传病，遭人排斥。其实吃垃圾、清巷道，对都市大有好处。
decisions.revised: 人们嫌POKENAME脏，又怕它传播疾病，常将它排斥在外。其实，它以垃圾为食，帮助巷道保持洁净，对大都市很有益处。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their powerful legs to kick off surrounding rocks to propel themselves through the water. Using their fins to control their direction, groups of these Pokémon will attack a single target to take it down.
decisions.target: POKENAME用强腿蹬岩，在水里前冲，以鳍控方向。群体围攻单一目标，将其打倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用强健的双腿蹬向周围岩石，推动自己在水中前行。它们以鳍控制方向，成群围攻同一个目标，将其击倒。

decisions.source: When angered, POKENAME's body temperature rises so much that it can heat the very waters it swims through while hunting. It competes with others of its kind by biting the anchors of ships to determine who has the strongest jaws.
decisions.target: POKENAME发怒，体温升得连捕猎游过的水都能加热。同类以咬船锚比试，看谁颚最强。
decisions.revised: POKENAME发怒时，体温剧增，连捕猎途中游过的水都能被加热。它们与同类比赛咬船锚，看看谁的颚力最强。

decisions.source: POKENAME will often lure innocent people into its forests, watching as they slowly get lost in the dark woods. It will often shift the position of the trees, making it almost impossible for its victims to escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME常引无辜者入林，看着逐渐迷路。再挪树位置，让受害者几乎逃不出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常将无辜的人引入自己的森林，看着对方逐渐迷失在黑暗林中。它还常挪动树木的位置，让受害者几乎不可能逃出去。

decisions.source: The three large puffs on POKENAME's body are full of sap, as each puff has tiny holes that expand and contract to keep POKENAME airborne. The sap ensures that their bodies stay moisturized, as POKENAME cannot fly when their puffs dry up.
decisions.target: POKENAME三大绒团满是树汁，小孔张缩，帮助浮空。树汁维持水分，绒团干了，就不能飞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的三大绒团装满树液，绒团上的小孔舒缩，让它保持浮空。树液维持身体湿润，绒团一干，它便飞不起来。

decisions.source: POKENAME smears the smelly drool from its mouth within the walls of homes to signal others to come make their homes there. Because the stench is so foul, it's easy to identify a home in the midst of a POKENAME infestation.
decisions.target: POKENAME在住宅墙内涂臭口涎，招新住客来安家。味太难闻，哪家遭侵入，很容易辨认。
decisions.revised: POKENAME把嘴里的臭口水涂在住宅墙内，招来更多住客安家。闻到恶臭，就很容易分辨哪家正遭POKENAME侵扰。

decisions.source: POKENAME drool a poisonous sap that clings to fur and scales. This sap is incredibly difficult to remove, even with water or friction. Many Pokémon have gotten ill trying to remove this sap with their tongues.
decisions.target: POKENAME滴毒汁，黏毛与鳞，水洗、摩擦都极难除。许多宝可梦想舔掉，反而生病。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会流出有毒树液，黏在毛发和鳞片上，哪怕水洗、摩擦，也极难清除。许多宝可梦想用舌头舔掉，反而生了病。

decisions.source: POKENAME needs a good amount of water daily in order to keep its body from drying out and becoming brittle. With some effort, it can grow and shoot spines from the shell on its back as a method of self-defense.
decisions.target: POKENAME每天需要不少水，免得身体干燥、变脆。费些力气，也能从背壳长刺、射出自卫。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每天都需要足够多的水，免得身体干燥、变脆。只要花些力气，它就能从背壳长出尖刺，射出自卫。

decisions.source: POKENAME has an almost manic compulsion to dig many holes in the sand at the beach it inhabits. If anything tries to dissuade it from this habit, it repels them with the blue flames on its tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME几乎狂热地执着于在海滩挖许多洞。谁想阻止，就被尾上蓝火驱退。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有近乎狂热的挖洞冲动，总想在栖息的海滩上挖出许多洞。谁想劝阻这种习惯，它就会用尾上的蓝焰驱退对方。

decisions.source: On a clear day, POKENAME can be found floating on the surface of a still body of water. Using its flat body, it camouflages itself as a reflection of the sky on the water's surface. During the summer months POKENAME is often found floating in pools.
decisions.target: 晴天，POKENAME会浮在平静的水面，以扁平的身体装作天空的倒影。夏季常能在水池里看见它。
decisions.revised: 晴天，能见到POKENAME漂在平静的水面，借扁平的身体，假扮天空的倒影。夏季，水池里也常有它的身影。

decisions.source: As soon as the drool from POKENAME's mouth drips onto its body, it reacts with the heat emanating from its mane and becomes a noxious gas. The drool in its liquid form is very valuable, however, as it can bring dying flowers back to life.
decisions.target: POKENAME口涎一滴到身体，就与鬃上热量反应，化有害气体。可液态时很珍贵，能救回垂死的花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的口水一滴到身体，便会与鬃毛散出的热量反应，化为有害气体。不过，液态的口水十分珍贵，能让濒死的花恢复生机。

decisions.source: According to legend, POKENAME was awakened by the mining excavations of an ancient civilization that disturbed its millennial slumber. When it flies in the sky, the temperature rises to such an extent that it is even difficult to keep the eyes open.
decisions.target: 传说，古文明采矿，惊扰了千年沉睡的POKENAME。它一飞上天，气温升得连眼睛都难睁开。
decisions.revised: 传说，古文明开矿挖掘，打断了POKENAME千年的沉眠，将它唤醒。它飞上天空时，气温会升得连睁眼都很困难。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a powerful martial artist, though it prefers to avoid excess battling. When it doesn't want to fight, it ignites the petals on its wrists, spreading a pollen-filled smoke that weakens the fighting spirit of those that inhale it.
decisions.target: POKENAME武艺强，却更愿避免多战。不想打，就点燃腕瓣，散满花粉的烟，削弱吸入者战意。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是武术高手，却不愿过多争斗。不想交战时，它便点燃腕上的花瓣，散出充满花粉的烟，削弱吸入者的斗志。

decisions.source: POKENAME fight with forceful gales loosed by their strong wings and with slashing attacks that utilize their razor-sharp tusks. They are strong enough to pick up large foes with their talons and lift them into the air before throwing them downward.
decisions.target: POKENAME用强翼掀烈风，并用刀锋般的长牙斩击。力大到能抓起大对手，升空再往下抛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用强翼掀起猛烈狂风，再以锋利如刀的长牙斩击。它们力气很大，能用利爪抓起大型敌人，带上空中，再往下抛。

decisions.source: POKENAME's tail emits a bright flash of light as an instinctive self-defense maneuver whenever it is jostled too much. Due to POKENAME's tendency to play with its own tail when bored, it often ends up blinding itself with this light.
decisions.target: POKENAME被晃得太厉害，尾巴本能强闪自卫。可无聊爱玩自己尾巴，常反晃花自己的眼。
decisions.revised: 被晃动得太厉害时，POKENAME的尾巴会本能地放出强闪光，自卫御敌。可它无聊时爱玩自己的尾巴，结果常被闪光晃花了自己的眼。

decisions.source: When the sun is at its highest and casts the most warmth, POKENAME dances its most vibrantly. It uses its flowery tail to lift itself up and make it more visible, so that more outsiders can bare witness to its joyous moves.
decisions.target: 太阳最高、最暖时，POKENAME舞得最有活力。花尾撑高身体，让更多外来者看见快乐舞姿。
decisions.revised: 太阳升得最高、最暖和的时候，POKENAME舞得也最有活力。它用花尾撑高身体，让自己更加显眼，好让更多来者看见欢乐的舞姿。

decisions.source: POKENAME will hide out in flower fields, using the false flowers on their chests to attract pollinators in order to eat them. When faced with a larger threat, they will rapidly shake the leaves on their bodies, creating a loud rustling sound.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏花田，以胸前假花引传粉者来吃。遇更大威胁，就急摇身叶，发出响亮沙沙声。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏在花田，用胸前的假花引来传粉者，供自己捕食。遇到较大的威胁，它们就迅速摇动身上的叶片，发出响亮的沙沙声。

decisions.source: When diving, POKENAME keeps its ears above the water to listen for danger. If it hears the sound of an aerial hunter swooping down, it leaps out of the water and knocks the attacker out with the heavy ball on its tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME潜水时，把耳朵留水上听危险。一听空中猎手俯冲，就跃水，以重尾球击昏对方。
decisions.revised: POKENAME潜水时，让耳朵保持在水面上，听察危险。听到空中猎手俯冲的声音，它便跃出水面，用沉重的尾球将攻击者击昏。

decisions.source: Every night on a full moon, POKENAME gathers with others to belt out songs. Its cute appearance makes it a popular pet, and it often waves its arms to ask its Trainer to pick it up, showing its love of being held.
decisions.target: 满月之夜，POKENAME与同类聚唱。外表可爱，是热门宠物，常挥臂要训练家抱，很爱被搂着。
decisions.revised: 每逢满月之夜，POKENAME便与同类聚集，放声高歌。可爱的外表让它成为热门宠物，它也常挥动双臂，央求训练家抱起自己，显得格外爱被搂着。

decisions.source: The weight of POKENAME's shell limits its ability to float along with the wind but gives it better defense against predators. It enjoys when heavy storms arrive as they have a chance of possessing winds strong enough to blow it away.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳重，不便随风漂，却更能防敌。它喜欢大风暴，因为可能风强到足以吹走自己。
decisions.revised: POKENAME壳重，限制了随风漂浮的本领，却也更能防御捕食者。它喜欢猛烈风暴来临，因为风势可能够强，将自己吹起来带走。

decisions.source: POKENAME's feet are covered with soft cotton spores, cushioning its powerful kicks and allowing it to balance its power against a weaker opponent. When facing a powerful foe, it blasts the seeds at them and charges with its foot talons exposed.
decisions.target: POKENAME脚覆软棉孢子，缓冲强踢，方便控制对弱者的力道。遇强敌则射种，露足爪冲锋。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脚上覆着柔软的棉絮状孢子，能缓冲强力踢击，方便面对弱敌时控制力道。遇到强敌，它便射出种子，露出脚爪冲锋。

decisions.source: These Pokémon live in large groups, resting within large caverns where they can use their drill-like horns to hang from the ceilings. They can technically move on their own, but they rely on the winds to truly move far.
decisions.target: 它们大群住巨洞，用钻状角挂在洞顶休息。虽能自行移动，真要远行，还得靠风。
decisions.revised: 它们成大群生活，在巨大的洞窟中休息，用钻头般的角挂在洞顶。它们虽能自行移动，真正远行却仍得依靠风。

decisions.source: POKENAME tusks are hollow and can deliver a nasty venom when they puncture skin. POKENAME will roll into a tight curl and aim to scratch their foes with the tip of their tusks as they roll by to inflict this poison on them.
decisions.target: POKENAME长牙中空，刺破皮肤便能注强毒。它蜷紧滚过，试图以牙尖擦伤敌人，使其中毒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的长牙中空，刺破皮肤，便能注入烈性毒液。它们紧紧蜷起，滚过敌人身边，试图用牙尖划伤对方，使其中毒。

decisions.source: Although POKENAME lives in lakes, it can bounce its body onto the shore to graze on plants. It returns to the water as soon as it begins to dry out, and seems to use the mushrooms on its head to sense this.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽住湖里，也能弹上岸啃植物。一开始干燥，就立刻回水，似乎以头菇感知水分。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽住在湖里，也能弹跳上岸，啃食植物。身体一开始变干，它就立刻回水，似乎是靠头上的蘑菇感知。

decisions.source: Households in villages near POKENAME populations are advised to dim their lights at night. POKENAME are drawn to bright lights and crawl up windows if they see lights left on inside, leaving a trail of slime all over the windows as they do.
decisions.target: POKENAME族群附近的村民，夜里应调暗灯。它趋强光，见屋内亮着，就爬窗，留下满窗黏液。
decisions.revised: POKENAME群落附近村庄的住户，夜里最好把灯调暗。它们受强光吸引，见屋内灯亮，就会爬上窗户，沿途留下满窗黏液。

decisions.source: POKENAME is very loyal, but also very gluttonous. When it sees something edible, it likes to forget its duties and chase after its food. It is so focused that it is not uncommon for it to get lost.
decisions.target: POKENAME忠诚却贪吃。看见能吃的，就会把职责忘光，一心追食，专注得经常迷路。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分忠诚，却也很贪吃。看见能吃的东西，它便爱忘掉职责，一心追着食物跑，专注得经常迷路。

decisions.source: Male POKENAME fight each other in battles of dominance using their large horns. They fight for the right of passage to crawl onto land and evolve. The combatant who is afflicted with poison first is considered the loser.
decisions.target: 雄性POKENAME以大角互斗，争夺高下，也争取登岸进化的资格。谁先中毒，就算输。
decisions.revised: 雄性POKENAME用大角互斗，争夺支配地位，也争取爬上陆地进化的资格。最先中毒的那一方，就算落败。

decisions.source: POKENAME is usually spotted hanging around websites based on the subjects of floral upkeep. It's quite helpful in guiding users towards sites that will give them even more details on how to properly care for their gardens.
decisions.target: POKENAME常逗留花卉养护网站，帮用户找到资料更详尽的站点，好好照料花园。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常流连于花卉养护网站。它会热心引导使用者，找到资料更加详尽的站点，学习如何妥善照料花园。

decisions.source: POKENAME always lets out a little trumpeting noise before it charges in an attempt to bite something. It has yet to grasp that this only serves to alert its target and give it a head start in fleeing.
decisions.target: POKENAME冲上去咬之前，总先轻轻嘟鸣。它还没明白，这只会提醒目标，抢先逃走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME想冲上去咬什么之前，总会先发出一声号角般的短鸣。它至今没明白，这只是在提醒目标，给对方抢先逃走的机会。

decisions.source: Flocks of POKENAME are common during the springtime, as they can be seen picking small flowers to take back to their nest. They have no need to eat as the flower on their head provides energy through photosynthesis.
decisions.target: POKENAME群春季常见，会摘小花带回巢。头花能光合作用供能，因此不需吃东西。
decisions.revised: 春天，成群的POKENAME十分常见，会摘下小花，带回巢里。头上的花靠光合作用供能，因此它们无需进食。

decisions.source: POKENAME's tail has a habit of biting, but it's coated in so much fluff that its attacks are rendered harmless. When POKENAME shakes its coat, thousands of cotton spores float away, leaving it bald for a while.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾巴爱咬，绒太厚，攻击却无害。一抖毛，数千棉孢子漂走，便会暂时秃着。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的尾巴习惯咬东西，却被厚厚的绒毛包住，攻击也就没了伤害。它一抖毛，数千棉絮状孢子便飘散出去，让自己暂时光秃秃的。

decisions.source: POKENAME use the leaves on their back to help them steer as they glide along the air. They scatter leaves as they flap their wings, collecting them with gusts of wind and directing them back to their nests.
decisions.target: POKENAME滑翔时，用背叶调整方向。拍翅散落的叶片，会被它借风收拢，送回巢里。
decisions.revised: POKENAME滑翔时，用背上的叶片帮助掌舵。振翅散落的叶子，则会被它用阵风收拢，引回巢中。

decisions.source: POKENAME like to spend most of their time in the mud found in wet marshlands. They only get out of the water during heavy rainfall, where they eat the reeds and other plant life found in the marshland.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多待在湿沼的泥里，只有大雨才离水，吃沼泽中的芦苇和其他植物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大部分时间都待在湿沼的泥里。唯有大雨时，它们才会离水，啃食沼泽里的芦苇和其他植物。

decisions.source: Pointed quills are hidden beneath POKENAME's curl of fur over its head. It can extend these to prick foes in self-defense, but due to its gentle nature this is an absolute last resort of a technique.
decisions.target: POKENAME头顶卷毛下藏利刺，能伸出扎敌自卫。可天性温和，只有绝无他法才用。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头顶的卷毛下藏着尖刺，能伸出刺伤敌人，自卫御敌。但它天性温和，唯有别无选择，才会动用这一招。

decisions.source: The extra arms of a POKENAME emit explosive bursts of fire with every strike. They can uses their explosive bursts to propel themselves through the air in search of prey or to escape if they get too hurt.
decisions.target: POKENAME额外手臂，每击都爆出火。借爆燃能推动空中游猎，受伤太重也能逃走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME额外的手臂，每次出击都会迸出爆炸般的火焰。它们能借这股爆发力在空中推进，寻找猎物，或在伤得太重时逃离。

decisions.source: POKENAME has earned the nickname "Dragon Tamer" due to the calming properties of its ribbons being particularly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. Even the most aggressive of the species stops in its tracks with just a touch.
decisions.target: POKENAME缎带安抚龙属性特别有效，得名“驯龙者”。连最凶个体，也会一碰就止步。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的缎带，对龙属性宝可梦有格外强的安抚效果，因此得名“驯龙者”。哪怕最凶暴的个体，只消轻轻碰到，也会止住脚步。

decisions.source: POKENAME have distinct and complex mating dances. They shed their feathers every year: during this time, they cannot fly. Interestingly, it is during this period of molting that POKENAME try to woo other of their kind with their dancing.
decisions.target: POKENAME求偶舞独特复杂。每年蜕羽期间不能飞，偏偏就在这时，用舞追求同类。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有独特而复杂的求偶舞。每年换羽时，它们都无法飞行；有趣的是，偏偏就在这个时期，它们会以舞蹈追求同类。

decisions.source: POKENAME is very self-conscious due to its appearance and nature as a being made of garbage. It takes quite a bit of gentle coaxing to convince it to warm up and let itself enjoy being near others.
decisions.target: POKENAME很在意自己的外表与垃圾构成。得温柔耐心地哄，才肯亲近，享受陪伴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分在意自己的外貌，以及由垃圾构成的身份。得花不少心思温柔地哄，它才愿意放下戒备，享受与旁人亲近。

decisions.source: POKENAME colonies are often found in areas that experience heavy logging, and can be seen lingering around cut tree stumps. They are protective of their home, banging their fists against their belly to try and scare people away.
decisions.target: POKENAME群体常在大规模伐林处，徘徊砍倒树桩旁。为护家，双拳敲肚，想吓走人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME群落常见于遭到大量砍伐的地区，徘徊在留下的树桩旁。它们极力保护家园，用双拳捶打肚子，试图吓走人们。

decisions.source: POKENAME can spin fast enough to churn the ground, allowing them to partially bury themselves. While buried, they can extend roots to control nearby plants. They can release freezing air all around them to impede any foes nearby.
decisions.target: POKENAME快旋翻土，半埋身体，再伸根控附近植物。也能向周围放冻气，阻碍近敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME旋转得足够快，就能翻动土壤，将自己部分埋起。埋在土里时，它们会伸根操纵附近植物，也能向四周释放寒气，阻碍靠近的敌人。

decisions.source: Beneath the large mane of fur on POKENAME's back lies a small plant bulb. The bulb is fragile, so the heavy fur coat is there to protect it from outside harm as well as keep it warm.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上的大鬃毛下，藏着一颗小种子。种子脆弱，厚毛既挡外伤，也能保暖。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上浓密的鬃毛下，藏着一颗小种子。种子很脆弱，厚毛既能抵御外来伤害，也能替它保暖。

decisions.source: POKENAME have the ability to change the colors and textures of their bodies and are able to mimic the appearance of any kind of tree at will. They often use this to play around with hikers, appearing for brief moments before quickly camouflaging.
decisions.target: POKENAME能改体色与质地，随意模仿任何树。它常借此逗登山者，只现身片刻，又快速藏起。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能改变身体的颜色和质感，随意模仿任何树木的外观。它们常借此捉弄登山者，现身短短片刻，便又迅速伪装起来。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be seen soaring over the skies of Johto in the summer, their vibrant petals visible even from the ground. Their flowers give off a unique scent based on the time of year, with the most floral smell coming during warmer months.
decisions.target: 夏季，POKENAME翱翔城都，鲜亮花瓣，连地面也看得见。花香随时节而异，温暖月份，花味最浓。
decisions.revised: 夏天，POKENAME飞过城都的天空，连地面也能看见鲜艳的花瓣。花朵的香味随时节而变，温暖月份里，花香最浓。

decisions.source: POKENAME's anchor is actually an elongated tooth that it uses to impale its prey like a harpoon. It will sometimes have to break the tooth off if it gets jammed in the ground, waiting for two weeks for it to grow back.
decisions.target: POKENAME的锚，其实是长牙，用来如鱼叉般刺猎物。若卡进地里，有时须折掉，等两周，才长回。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的锚，其实是一颗伸长的牙，用起来像鱼叉，能刺穿猎物。若卡进地里，它有时不得不将牙折断，再等两周，重新长回。

decisions.source: The wings growing from its head are strong enough to let it fly, though only for short periods. When their plumage turns snowy white, it means POKENAME has recently molted, and it will take weeks for its feathers to regrow stronger than before.
decisions.target: 头上双翼，足够让它短暂飞行。POKENAME羽变雪白，表示刚蜕羽，须几周，才长得比从前更强。
decisions.revised: 它头上长出的翅膀，强得足以带它短暂飞行。POKENAME的羽毛变成雪白，就表示刚换过羽，还需几周，才能长得比从前更强韧。

decisions.source: POKENAME's innate, keen awareness of their surroundings makes them popular in races even though they are picky about who may ride them. Their flames flare up when they feel threatened and they will rear up to stomp away threats using their hooves.
decisions.target: POKENAME天生敏锐，赛跑很受欢迎，虽挑剔骑手。受威胁就火焰暴涨，抬前腿，以蹄踩退危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME天生对周围极其敏锐，虽挑剔骑乘者，却仍在竞速中广受欢迎。感到威胁时，它们火焰升腾，扬起前腿，用蹄子将威胁踏退。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME will lay claim to an entire pond and stack up rocks to form a "throne" that they can lay upon to survey their new domain. The longer the curled hair upon a POKENAME's head, the more prideful and haughty it is.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME占下整座池塘，堆石成“王座”，躺上巡视新领地。头顶卷毛越长，就越骄傲高慢。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME会占据整片池塘，堆起岩石，做成能躺卧的“王座”，俯瞰新领地。头上的卷毛越长，它就越骄傲高慢。

decisions.source: POKENAME withdraw themselves inside of their puffy homes as they drift on the wind, only extending their limbs out when they land. Studies are still being conducted to try and determine just how long they are and how they fit in their fluff.
decisions.target: POKENAME乘风时缩进绒屋，落地才伸肢。研究者仍想弄明白，它到底多长，又如何塞进绒里。
decisions.revised: POKENAME乘风漂游时，缩在蓬松的家中，只有落地才伸出肢体。研究仍在进行，人们想弄清它们到底有多长，又如何装进这团绒毛。

decisions.source: When POKENAME sways, the sprouts around its skirt open and close their cotyledons. It can move each sprout independently with psychic power to make them wave hello or ensnare a foe. There are a lot more sprouts hidden in wait under the skirt.
decisions.target: POKENAME摇摆，裙边幼芽便开合子叶。每芽能独立念控，挥手打招呼或缠敌，裙下还藏更多。
decisions.revised: POKENAME摇摆时，裙边的幼芽便会开合子叶。它能用超能力独立操纵每棵幼芽，让它们挥动打招呼，或缠住敌人；裙下还藏着更多，蓄势待发。

decisions.source: POKENAME are hard to rouse to take action, preferring to brood over their nests for days on end instead. When they are finally forced to act they use their vicious claws and fight aggressively, trying to end the fight as fast as possible.
decisions.target: POKENAME难被唤起行动，宁可一连数日守着巢。终于被迫出手，就用凶爪猛战，想尽快结束。
decisions.revised: POKENAME很难被催动，宁愿一连数天守在巢上。等终于被迫出手，它便挥动凶狠的利爪，猛烈战斗，力求尽快结束。

decisions.source: POKENAME acts as a wandering protector, traveling the regions and standing up for those who cannot stand up for themselves. It creates a ring of fire around itself and its foe before going on the attack with elbow-blades made of pure flame.
decisions.target: POKENAME游历各地区，守护无力反抗者。先在自己与敌人周围造火环，再以纯火肘刃进攻。
decisions.revised: POKENAME像游历诸地的守护者，为无力反抗的生灵挺身而出。它用一道火环，将自己与敌人围在里面，再以纯火焰构成的肘刃进攻。

decisions.source: Its body is covered in a thin film of poisonous slime, much of which comes from its blunt horn. To fight, it uses its broad tail to launch itself at a foe and drives its blunt horn into them with a Tackle.
decisions.target: 体外覆着薄层毒黏液，大多来自钝角。战时用宽尾弹向敌人，以撞击将钝角顶入。
decisions.revised: 它身上覆着一层薄薄的毒黏液，大多来自钝角。战斗时，它用宽大的尾巴将自己弹向敌人，再使出撞击，把钝角顶入对方身体。

decisions.source: POKENAME attach themselves to branches with their tails, waiting for their prey. They will use their tongues to snatch up their food and pull it into their large mouths. Even prey larger than them is not safe, their leaves easily slicing them up.
decisions.target: POKENAME以尾挂枝等猎物，长舌抓食，拉进大口。比自身大的猎物也不安全，利叶轻松切开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用尾巴挂住树枝，等待猎物，再以舌头抓住食物，拉进大嘴。即使比它更大的猎物也不安全，叶片能轻易将其切碎。

decisions.source: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to stick deep into stone walls and keep its own heavy body suspended with little effort. Rivals have been seen tearing chunks of their opponent's shell off to add to themselves as a mark of victory.
decisions.target: POKENAME爪强，轻松深入石墙，吊住沉重自身。曾见敌手撕下对方壳块，贴在身上，标记胜利。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的爪子强而有力，能深深扣进石壁，轻松悬住沉重的身体。人们曾见交战的对手撕下彼此的壳块，加在自己身上，作为胜利的标记。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves to fly, but usually just glides rather than flapping its wings. If it lands on the ground, it may lie there for days before it can be motivated enough to slowly climb back up to a high cliff to jump off.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱飞，却通常只滑翔，不拍翼。落地后，可能躺上几天，才肯慢慢爬回高崖，再次跃下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱飞，却通常只是滑翔，不怎么振翅。落地后，它可能躺上数天，才肯提起劲，慢慢爬回高崖，再次跃下。

decisions.source: If POKENAME finds itself alone, it tries to channel the illusion of other POKENAME or Carvanha to give it the courage to hunt. Ships are advised to avoid any areas where they see flames flickering on the surface, a sure sign of their habitat.
decisions.target: POKENAME落单，会造同类或利牙鱼幻象，壮胆捕猎。水面有闪火，是栖地明证，船只最好绕行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME落单时，会试着唤出同类或利牙鱼的幻象，给自己壮胆狩猎。水面闪着火光，是它们栖居的确凿迹象，船只最好避开这些区域。

decisions.source: POKENAME lies in wait beneath the ground, able to sense the vibrations in the dirt above it. It attacks prey from underneath, opening a hole in the ground for the target to fall in before all three go into a gnashing feeding frenzy.
decisions.target: POKENAME伏地底，感受上方土中震动，从下方开洞，让猎物跌进来，随后三者一同疯狂啃食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME伏在地下，能感知上方泥土中的震动。它从下方打开地洞，让猎物跌入，随后三个头便一同疯狂啃食。

decisions.source: As POKENAME zips through the air, it cools the air and creates snow drifts that linger for a short while after. It likes to fly over tropical areas and give the inhabitants a short respite from the hot temperatures.
decisions.target: POKENAME疾飞时冷却空气，留下短暂积雪。它喜欢飞过热带，让居民暂时摆脱酷热。
decisions.revised: POKENAME疾飞时，会冷却空气，留下短时间不散的积雪。它爱飞过热带地区，让当地生灵暂时摆脱酷热。

decisions.source: When POKENAME trains by throwing punches in the air, it scatters pollen in all directions, helping nearby flowers bloom more quickly. Before a battle, it spins the leaf on its head in a threatening display to intimidate its opponents.
decisions.target: POKENAME挥空拳训练，会向四周撒粉，让附近花更快开。战前，它旋转头叶，威吓对手。
decisions.revised: POKENAME朝空中挥拳训练时，花粉会散向四周，帮助附近的花更快开放。战斗前，它还会旋转头上的叶片，做出威吓姿态。

decisions.source: POKENAME have trouble sleeping, often suffering from bouts of insomnia due to their constant need to be on the move. They grow increasingly irritable as they grow more tired, becoming prone to getting into fights when they're exhausted.
decisions.target: POKENAME总想不停活动，难以入睡，时常失眠。越累越易怒，疲惫不堪时尤其爱打架。
decisions.revised: POKENAME总得不停活动，因此很难入睡，时常失眠。越疲倦，它们就越易怒，筋疲力尽时尤其容易打起架来。

decisions.source: POKENAME rubs its wand on its fur to gather a static charge, then aims it at its opponent and fires an electric bolt. The wand is apparently edible, with a spicy onion-like taste, but few have tried it.
decisions.target: POKENAME拿魔杖蹭毛积静电，再瞄敌射电。杖似乎能吃，带辛辣葱味，却没几人尝过。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将魔杖在毛上摩擦，积蓄静电，再瞄准对手，射出一道电光。魔杖似乎能吃，带有辛辣的葱味，却没几人尝试过。

decisions.source: POKENAME take great joy in sneaking in to join flocks of Pidgeot, trying to camouflage themselves amongst them. When their deception is uncovered, they will give a chirping laugh and fly away to find a new flock to join.
decisions.target: POKENAME很爱偷混大比鸟群，试着伪装其中。被识破就啁啾笑，飞走再找新群加入。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最爱偷偷混进大比鸟群，试着伪装成其中一员。骗局若被识破，它们就会发出啾鸣般的笑声，飞去寻找新的群体加入。

decisions.source: POKENAME produce a highly soluble pigment from the fur on their tails. They use this pigment to paint landscapes on rocks and stones around the ponds they live in. Their artwork is ephemeral, washing away whenever the rains come.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾毛产易溶颜料，在家乡池边石头上画风景。作品短暂，每逢下雨就洗掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾毛能产生极易溶解的颜料，它们用来在栖居池塘旁的岩石上画风景。作品转瞬即逝，每逢雨来，就会被冲洗干净。

decisions.source: POKENAME's puffy body causes it to sneeze very often due to the cotton tickling its nose. These sneezes are accompanied by a burst of psychic power, so Trainers are advised to keep POKENAME's fluff trimmed to prevent accidents.
decisions.target: POKENAME棉絮挠鼻，常打喷嚏，还伴精神力量爆发。训练家被建议修短绒毛，防意外。
decisions.revised: POKENAME蓬松身体的棉絮，常挠得鼻子发痒，使它频频打喷嚏。喷嚏还伴着超能力爆发，因此训练家最好把绒毛修短，免出意外。

decisions.source: POKENAME hide within bushes during the day, only their leaves poking out to allow them to photosynthesise. At night, they scurry out in search of plant roots to chew on for the nutrients they can't get from sunlight.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天藏灌木，只露叶片光合。夜里才跑出啃植物根，补阳光给不了的养分。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天藏在灌木里，只露出叶片，进行光合作用。夜里，它们才跑出去啃食植物的根，补充阳光无法提供的养分。

decisions.source: The hand-like portion of POKENAME's tail is extremely savory and used in a variety of fried dishes. It is considered a rare delicacy due to POKENAME's avoidance of humans and the speed at which they run away.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾部手状部分鲜美，入多种煎炸料理。可它避人、逃得快，因此是稀有佳肴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾巴上手掌般的部分，滋味极其鲜美，用于各种煎炸菜肴。但它避着人，逃跑又快，因此被视为稀有佳肴。

decisions.source: POKENAME tries to keep itself hidden from people since they often mistake it for a real burger and try to eat it. Many people have ended up in the hospital due to getting a mouthful of its poisonous film.
decisions.target: POKENAME想躲人，因为常被误当真汉堡，想拿来吃。许多人满嘴毒膜，最后进了医院。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尽量躲着人，因为人们常把它认成真正的汉堡，想拿来吃。许多人就因咬了一嘴毒膜，最后进了医院。

decisions.source: POKENAME are covered with steel plates that deflect beaks and talons. They are difficult to knock down because of their sturdy plates, but on the rare occasion they do get knocked down, they violently explode before reaching the ground.
decisions.target: POKENAME覆着钢片，挡喙、利爪，很难打落。可罕见被打下时，还没到地面就猛烈爆炸。
decisions.revised: POKENAME覆着钢铁甲片，能挡开尖喙与利爪。甲片结实，它们很难被击落；可若真被打下，触地前就会猛烈爆炸。

decisions.source: POKENAME build up pressure within their thickly plated body and use this pressure to shoot out seeds from cannons from their back. These projectiles can be fired up to a hundred meters away, though they are not especially accurate.
decisions.target: POKENAME在厚甲身体内积压，借压力从背炮射出种子。最远可射一百米，却不太准。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在厚甲身体内积蓄压力，借此从背上的炮射出种子。最远能射到100米外，准头却不怎么样。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a fondness for performing tragic ballads, their songs inspiring a sense of melancholy in the listener. They are commonly found in the wake of disaster where they perform in an effort to offer solace to those listening.
decisions.target: POKENAME喜欢唱哀婉歌谣，使听者忧伤。灾难过后常能见到它，努力以歌安慰听众。
decisions.revised: POKENAME偏爱演唱悲怆的歌谣，让听者心生忧伤。灾难过后，常能见它们到场演唱，努力给听众些许慰藉。

decisions.source: The scent that wafts from POKENAME's leaf is perceived differently by whoever smells it. No matter the specifics of the scent, the aroma is always one that will have a calming effect on the one breathing it in.
decisions.target: POKENAME叶片飘出的香气，每个人闻来都不同。无论具体什么味，吸入者总会平静。
decisions.revised: POKENAME叶片的香气，闻者各有不同的感受。不论具体是什么味道，总能让吸入者平静下来。

decisions.source: The candle flames on POKENAME's body may come in a variety of different colors. It seems there was once a group that tried to interpret the color and even the shape of the flames to predict the future.
decisions.target: POKENAME身上的烛火颜色多变。似乎曾有团体，试着解读火色甚至形状，预测未来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的烛火，可能呈现各种不同颜色。似乎曾有一个团体，试着解读火焰的颜色，甚至形状，以预测未来。

decisions.source: The pattern on POKENAME's shell changes constantly as it moves and swirls around itself. This mighty Pokémon has the power to absorb black holes and turn them into cosmic dust, which it then releases from its shell.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳纹随着移动、旋转不断改变。它能吸收黑洞，转成宇宙尘，再从壳里释放。
decisions.revised: 随着移动和盘旋，POKENAME壳上的图案不断变化。这种强大的宝可梦能吸收黑洞，化为宇宙尘埃，再从壳里释放出去。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in temperate climates and create burrows in the sand for their nests. These Pokémon will use the natural flora in the area, as well as the growths on their heads, to camouflage and protect their homes.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在温带，沙中挖洞筑巢。它们借当地草木与头上生长物，伪装保护家园。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在温带，在沙中挖洞筑巢。它们借当地的草木，以及头上的生长物，伪装并保护家园。

decisions.source: POKENAME can swim through soft sand, using their horn to break any hard surface that impedes their travels. Wild POKENAME store heat within their bodies during the summer, which they use to keep warm through the autumn and winter seasons.
decisions.target: POKENAME能游过软沙，以角破开挡路的硬面。野生POKENAME夏季在体内储热，用来度过秋冬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能在软沙中游动，用角破开阻路的坚硬表面。野生个体会在夏天把热量储存在体内，用来在秋冬保暖。

decisions.source: Some of the garbage comprising POKENAME's body drips and falls off of it as it soars across the region. It needs to regularly stop and feast on trash dumps in order to regain some of its lost mass.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞过地区，身上垃圾会滴落、掉下。得常停在垃圾场大吃，补回损失的体重。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞过各地时，构成身体的垃圾会滴落、掉下。它得时常停在垃圾场大吃，补回流失的体重。

decisions.source: POKENAME have jaws powerful enough to tear a hole in a ship's hull and use their strong legs on land or underwater to launch themselves at high speeds. Their strength fades the longer they go without water exposure.
decisions.target: POKENAME强颚能撕穿船体，强腿无论陆上水下，都能高速弹出。离水越久，力气越弱。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的双颚能咬穿船身，强健的双腿，无论在陆地还是水下，都能让它高速弹出。越久没接触水，它的力量就越衰弱。

decisions.source: POKENAME has a strong urge to bite those who swim past it, though its bite is rather weak. It tries to growl and be intimidating, but even a light retaliatory tap will send it swimming away, crying in terror.
decisions.target: POKENAME极想咬游过的生物，咬力却弱。想低吼吓人，可轻轻还一下，就哭喊着游逃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME很想咬游过的生灵，咬力却很弱。它低吼着想逞威风，可对方哪怕只轻轻回击，也会吓得它哭着游走。

decisions.source: POKENAME disguises itself as a cozy cabin for lost travelers and Pokémon to rest in. Once those who enter try to leave, however, it will seal all of its doorways and windows shut and consume its guests whole.
decisions.target: POKENAME装舒适小屋，让迷路旅人与宝可梦休息。客人想走，就封死门窗，整个吞掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME假扮舒适的小屋，供迷路的旅人和宝可梦休息。可住客一想离开，它就会封死所有门窗，将客人整个吞下。

decisions.source: POKENAME will curl into a spiny ball if it is about to be stepped on. In battle, it will utilize its sharp spikes with a Rollout attack to great effect in order to cause its foes to flinch. It then finishes its foe off with its sharp claws.
decisions.target: POKENAME即将被踩时会蜷成刺球。战斗中配合利刺使出滚动，效果出众，使敌人畏缩，再用利爪击败。
decisions.revised: 快被踩到时，POKENAME会蜷成刺球。战斗中，它以利刺配合滚动进攻，效果出众，使敌人畏缩，再用利爪解决对手。

decisions.source: POKENAME live at the bottom of lakes and ponds, weaving a web of conductive strands, which they touch with their curls to shock prey that gets caught in it. They only rise to the surface during heavy rain and watch the sky for lightning.
decisions.target: POKENAME在湖池底织导电丝网，以卷毛碰网，电击落网猎物。只有大雨才浮上水面，望天等雷。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在湖泊、池塘底部，织出导电的丝网，再用卷毛触碰，电击落网的猎物。唯有大雨时，它们才浮上水面，望向天空，留意闪电。

decisions.source: POKENAME are light enough to glide on strong winds with every leap and bounce they make. They are known for adapting to any environment, no matter how harsh, so even if they are carried away by the wind, they will be able to thrive.
decisions.target: POKENAME轻盈，每次弹跳都能乘强风滑。不管环境多恶劣都能适应，因此被风带走，也能茁壮。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分轻盈，每次弹跳，都能乘强风滑翔。它们出了名地善于适应环境，无论多恶劣都不怕，因此即使被风吹走，也能茁壮生存。

decisions.source: POKENAME's powerful bite is augmented by a weak poison. While this can be used to subdue prey, it is also capable of scavenging food such as Berries or even garbage. Its ability to survive almost anywhere has made it a particularly prolific fusion.
decisions.target: POKENAME强咬配弱毒，能制住猎物，也能拾食树果、垃圾。几乎哪里都能活，让它繁衍格外旺盛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME强力的咬击，还带着轻微毒性，能制服猎物。它们也能拾食树果，甚至垃圾。几乎哪里都能活下去，让这种融合体格外繁盛。

decisions.source: The two halves of POKENAME each have their own brains. Both are able to shift the color of their fur to blend into the environment, but since they have trouble seeing each other, they more often than not change into conflicting patterns by accident.
decisions.target: POKENAME前后半身各有脑，都能换毛色融入环境。可难看见彼此，常不慎换成不相衬的图案。
decisions.revised: POKENAME两半身体各有大脑，都能改变毛色，融入环境。可双方难以看见彼此，常无意间变成互不相衬的花纹。

decisions.source: With the flames emitted from its wand, POKENAME marks the trees it plans to cut down to build its dam, so it doesn't forget them later. It has a particularly brave nature and will fight even the strongest foes to defend its home.
decisions.target: POKENAME用杖火标出计划砍来筑坝的树，免得日后忘记。特别勇敢，护家时连最强敌也敢战。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用魔杖的火焰，标记计划砍来筑坝的树，免得日后忘记。它性情格外勇敢，为守护家园，连最强的敌人也敢迎战。

decisions.source: POKENAME gather together at night once a year to dance joyfully to each other's songs. Their gathering spot is said to be a place between life and death, and that whoever interrupts these Pokémon's dancing gets swept away to the afterlife.
decisions.target: POKENAME每年一夜聚集，随彼此歌声欢舞。据说聚处位于生死之间，谁打断舞，就被卷往来世。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每年会在夜里聚会一次，随彼此的歌声欢舞。据说，聚会地点介于生死之间，谁打断舞蹈，就会被卷往亡者的世界。

decisions.source: The horns and fangs of a POKENAME have become like metal grinders that can churn large waste into little pieces for it to eat. Although some humans fear them a bit, they are often utilized in landfills to break apart larger pieces of trash.
decisions.target: POKENAME的角与牙，如金属粉碎机，将大废物磨碎吃。人虽有些怕，填埋场却常用它拆大垃圾。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的角和牙，已变得如金属粉碎机，能将大块废物绞碎进食。虽有人有些害怕，它们却常被用于垃圾填埋场，拆解大件垃圾。

decisions.source: It is a common pest at hydroelectric dams, as it will bite into anything flowing with electricity and leech that energy for itself. It is difficult to safely remove a POKENAME, as the slightest stimulus could cause it to fly into an explosive rage.
decisions.target: POKENAME常在水电坝作害兽，咬一切通电物吸能。稍受刺激，就可能狂暴爆发，难以安全移走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是水电大坝的常见害兽，会咬住任何通电的东西，吸走能量。想安全移走它很难，因为稍受刺激，就可能惹它暴怒。

decisions.source: POKENAME will bash through sand dunes using their bludgeon-like tails. They do this in search of sources of water within the deserts they live in. Due to their inelegant means of searching, the water they find is quickly buried when they move on.
decisions.target: POKENAME用棍棒般的尾砸穿沙丘，寻找沙漠水源。找法太粗暴，等它离开，水很快又被沙埋住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用棍棒般的尾巴砸开沙丘，寻找沙漠里的水源。可找法粗笨，它一离开，找到的水很快又被沙埋住。

decisions.source: POKENAME takes on the shape of what appears to be an ancient temple of some kind. It will collect any valuables it finds while roaming along beaches by incorporating them into its body, and may sometimes offer these trinkets to those it bonds with.
decisions.target: POKENAME的模样，像某种古庙。沿滩漫游时，把找到的贵重物融入身体，有时也送给亲近对象。
decisions.revised: POKENAME看起来像某种古老庙宇。沿海滩漫游时，它会将找到的贵重物品融入身体；与它亲近者，偶尔可能收到这些小宝物。

decisions.source: The flame on POKENAME's tail has a mind of its own, which will try to burn the main body to get it moving. Despite being in a lot of pain, the main body isn't that interested in combat.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾焰自有意识，会烧本体，催它活动。本体虽然痛，却依然对战斗没多大兴趣。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的尾焰有独立的意志，会试着烧灼本体，催它动起来。本体虽然疼痛不已，却依旧对战斗没多大兴趣。

decisions.source: This Pokémon's thick fur allows it to survive even in the coldest environments. If it senses a danger nearby, POKENAME hides by covering its face with its big ears, making itself look like a big pile of snow.
decisions.target: 浓密毛发让它承受最酷寒的环境。察觉危险，POKENAME便用大耳遮脸，装成一大堆雪。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦毛发浓密，连最寒冷的环境也能生存。察觉附近有危险，POKENAME便用大耳朵遮住脸，藏成一大堆雪的样子。

decisions.source: POKENAME has an intense urge to bite anything near it as a way to relieve its aggressive urges. Anything that tries to escape gets caught by vines from its flower, and dragged closer so it can chomp down on them.
decisions.target: POKENAME强烈想咬近处一切，缓解攻击冲动。什么试逃，花中藤便抓住、拖近，供它咬下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有强烈的冲动，想咬附近的一切，缓解自己的攻击欲。任何想逃的目标，都会被花中伸出的藤蔓抓住、拖近，供它啃咬。

decisions.source: A stealthy and nimble Pokémon capable of hiding in tight and narrow spaces. In addition, POKENAME has the ability to alter its colors to blend in with the environment. As a result, they are difficult to find and capture.
decisions.target: POKENAME隐秘敏捷，能藏进细窄空间，还能变换颜色融入环境，因此很难发现和收服。
decisions.revised: POKENAME善于潜行，身手敏捷，能藏进狭小空间，还能改变体色，融入环境。因此，它很难被发现和捕捉。

decisions.source: POKENAME grow a thick woollen shell to hide their soft body within, sheltering themselves from harm when they feel endangered. Though it offers little physical protection, their wool is electrically charged and shocks those who try to bite into it.
decisions.target: POKENAME长厚毛壳，遇险把柔软身体藏进去。物理防护虽少，毛却带电，谁想咬就电谁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME长出厚厚的羊毛外壳，感到危险，便将柔软的身体藏进去。物理防护虽有限，羊毛却带电，谁试着咬上去，就会挨电。

decisions.source: POKENAME wishes to mimic trees, but contains far too much pent-up energy to remain still for long. When it tries to stand motionless, visible strain can be seen in its eyes before it gives up and runs around wildly.
decisions.target: POKENAME想装树，可精力太多，站不久。试静止时，眼里能看出挣扎，最后放弃，狂跑起来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME想模仿树木，可精力积蓄太多，根本站不久。它试着静止时，眼里会流露明显的挣扎，最后还是放弃，四处狂奔。

decisions.source: POKENAME utters a croaking cry while it dances, meant to draw in others of its kind to join in the performance. The dance and cacophony of cries together can summon heavy rain to water the tropical plants of its home.
decisions.target: POKENAME边跳边蛙鸣，召同类加入表演。舞与众声一起，能唤大雨，浇灌家乡热带植物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME边跳舞边呱呱叫，吸引同类加入表演。舞蹈与杂乱的叫声，能一同唤来大雨，浇灌家园的热带植物。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be seen floating through the sky half-asleep while their tail keeps them suspended. By giving them a Rawst Berry, they can heal themselves of the sunburns they inevitably get while flying for long periods in the sun.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠尾悬浮，半睡半醒地漂过天空。长久晒着飞，难免晒伤，喂莓莓果就能治好。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠尾巴悬浮，半睡半醒地漂过天空。长时间在阳光下飞行，难免晒伤；给它一颗莓莓果，它就能治好这些伤。

decisions.source: POKENAME bury themselves just below the surface to avoid getting blown away by a gust of wind. If another Pokémon comes to uproot them from their spot, they explode and release a burst of seeds into the nearby area.
decisions.target: POKENAME浅埋地表，免被风吹走。其他宝可梦想拔走它，就爆炸，向周围喷出一阵种子。
decisions.revised: POKENAME浅浅埋在地里，避免被阵风吹走。其他宝可梦前来将它从原处拔起时，它们就会爆炸，向附近喷出一阵种子。

decisions.source: The flame on POKENAME's back flickers in and out of existence at random. It's a bit problematic if it flares up while it's inside a computer, as it causes the computer's core to rapidly heat up.
decisions.target: POKENAME背火随机出现、消失。若在电脑里突然燃起，就会使核心迅速升温，颇为麻烦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的火焰，会随机出现、消失。若在电脑内部时突然燃起，就有点麻烦了，因为会使电脑核心迅速升温。

decisions.source: POKENAME roost at the tops of trees, sleeping with their tail feathers raised and wings splayed out around them. The leafy texture of their feathers helps to disguise them amongst the trees as they sleep, making them hard to spot.
decisions.target: POKENAME栖树顶，睡时尾羽竖起，双翼向四周展开。叶状羽毛让它融入树间，很难发现。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖在树顶，睡觉时竖起尾羽，把双翼铺展在四周。羽毛的叶片质感，能让它们睡着时融入树间，难以发现。

decisions.source: POKENAME has the ability to turn invisible, but if it hears a noise that is too loud, it loses concentration and becomes visible again. The toxin contained in its horns can be synthesized to create medicines used in cardiovascular therapies.
decisions.target: POKENAME能隐身，可听见太响声音，就分心现形。角里的毒可合成药，用于心血管治疗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能够隐身，但听到太响的声音，就会分心，再次现形。角里的毒素，能用于合成心血管治疗药物。

decisions.source: The fungus on POKENAME's back is capable of changing the color of its pigments. Rather than using this to blend in, it uses this to stand out, as a warning to other Pokémon that its spores are toxic.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上真菌能改色素，却不为隐藏，反而刻意显眼，警告其他宝可梦孢子有毒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的真菌，能改变色素的颜色。它不用来融入环境，反而故意让自己醒目，警告其他宝可梦：孢子有毒。

decisions.source: POKENAME gnaw at the plants in their environment to create sticks that they can carry with them. They don't use the sticks for fighting, instead waving them about in competition with others to see who has the largest stick.
decisions.target: POKENAME啃周围植物，做随身木棍。不拿来打架，而是与同类挥舞比试，看谁的棍最大。
decisions.revised: POKENAME啃咬周围的植物，做成随身带着的棍子。这些棍子不用来战斗，而是挥舞着相互比试，看谁的最大。

decisions.source: It is a graceful dancer, performing on the surface of lakes. POKENAME is an incredibly shy Pokémon and will dive into the water the moment it senses humans with the sensitive antennae that adorn the side of its head.
decisions.target: 它是优雅舞者，在湖面表演。POKENAME极害羞，头侧敏感触角一察觉人类，就立刻潜水。
decisions.revised: 它是优雅的舞者，会在湖面表演。POKENAME十分害羞，头侧敏感的触角一察觉人类，就立刻潜入水中。

decisions.source: POKENAME are usually found in glaciers, where they eat away at the glacial ice. This is their only source of food. If they cannot find any ice, they will freeze the nearest available water and eat the ice they create.
decisions.target: POKENAME通常在冰川啃冰，那是唯一食物。找不到冰，就冻住最近的水，吃自己造的冰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常住在冰川，啃食冰层。这是它们唯一的食物来源；找不到冰，就把能找到的最近水源冻住，再吃掉自己造的冰。
