decisions.source: POKENAME spends the day clinging to the upper branches of trees, absorbing what sunlight it can through its wings. It becomes active at night, spreading a pollen from its wings that slows down prey that tries to flee from it.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天攀在高枝，用双翼尽量吸日光。夜里活跃，翼上撒花粉，拖慢想逃的猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天攀住高高的树枝，尽量用翅膀吸收阳光。到了夜里，它才活跃起来，从翅膀散出花粉，拖慢试图逃离的猎物。

decisions.source: POKENAME expertly navigates the ocean in search of prey to devour, using moonlight to guide its way. Lanturn are able to use their lights to fool POKENAME into thinking it's seeing moonlight, leading it away from its would-be prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME借月光辨路，熟练游海捕猎。电灯怪会以灯伪装月光，骗它离开原本的猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME借月光引路，熟练地游遍海洋，寻找猎物。电灯怪能用发出的光，骗它以为是月光，将它引离本要捕食的目标。

decisions.source: POKENAME are nocturnal, sleeping by hanging from cave ceilings during the day and soaring through the skies at night, when their dark coloration makes them extremely difficult to see. They can break the sound barrier by diving from high altitudes.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜行，白日倒挂洞顶睡，夜里翱翔，暗色身极难察觉。高空俯冲时，能突破音障。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜间活动，白天倒挂在洞顶睡觉，夜里翱翔天空，深暗的体色让它极难被看见。从高空俯冲时，它们能突破音障。

decisions.source: Even though it was meant to be like a pest that's hard to get rid of, many Trainers have adopted POKENAME as an ideal house pet. Its soft tail and tiny ears warm the hearts of many, so they don't realize their food gets stolen at night.
decisions.target: POKENAME本该是难除害兽，却被许多训练家当理想家宠。软尾小耳惹人疼，连夜里食物被偷也没发现。
decisions.revised: POKENAME本应是难以摆脱的害兽，却被许多训练家当成理想家宠收养。柔软的尾巴、小小的耳朵，让人满心喜爱，连食物在夜里被偷，也没察觉。

decisions.source: POKENAME are prone to falling over and lying on the ground, wanting someone's attention. It will lie on the ground for hours, waiting for a person to help pick it up. Once it finds the person it wants for a Trainer, the tip of its tail will ignite.
decisions.target: POKENAME常跌倒躺在地上，想引人关注。会躺上几小时，等人扶起。一找到想要的训练家，尾尖就会点燃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常跌倒躺在地上，盼着受到关注。它会一躺数小时，等人帮忙扶起。找到想认作训练家的人，尾尖就会燃起火焰。

decisions.source: The fist on its tail is used to smash stones into chunks small enough for it to eat. When it chews on the rocks, sparks can sometimes be seen as it crunches on the stones.
decisions.target: 尾上的拳头把石块敲小，方便吞食。嚼碎岩石时，有时还能迸出火星。
decisions.revised: 它用尾上的拳头，把石头砸成适合吃的小块。啃咬、嚼碎岩石时，有时还能看到火花迸出。

decisions.source: A glow appears at the tip of POKENAME's tail at the start of combat. The longer the battle continues, the further down its tail the glow moves, and should it reach its body, POKENAME will explode.
decisions.target: 战斗开始，POKENAME尾尖发光。打得越久，光越沿尾下移；一到身体，它就会爆炸。
decisions.revised: 战斗开始，POKENAME的尾尖会发光。交战越久，光便沿着尾巴，越靠近身体；一旦到达，它就会爆炸。

decisions.source: POKENAME are patient creatures that wait until their opponent is staggered before striking. By tripping their opponent with vines and spraying water from their mouths, they can achieve victory over their peers in a few minutes.
decisions.target: POKENAME有耐心，等敌人踉跄，才出击。用藤绊倒、嘴喷水，几分钟便能战胜同伴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分耐心，等对手失去平衡，才会出击。它们用藤蔓绊倒对方，再从嘴里喷水，几分钟内就能战胜同伴。

decisions.source: Though normally it keeps its shell coated in flame for self-defense, POKENAME can easily retract the fires to allow others to ride on its back. Land-based POKENAME are often seen carrying young children to school.
decisions.target: POKENAME平常覆火护壳，却能轻易收回，让人骑背。陆栖个体，常载小孩子上学。
decisions.revised: POKENAME平时让火焰覆在壳上自卫，却也能轻松收回，让别人骑在背上。人们常见陆栖的个体，载着小孩去上学。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its long neck to grab berries off trees and stores them in its bell. As the berries break down, it releases a sweet scent that attracts prey, which it then coils in a web.
decisions.target: POKENAME用长颈摘树果，存进铃铛中。果子分解后，甜香引来猎物，再用网裹住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用长脖子摘取树上的树果，存进铃铛。随着果实分解，它会放出甜香，引来猎物，再用蛛网裹住。

decisions.source: When its Trainer is feeling down, POKENAME will shock them with a small jolt of electricity to get them energized. However, it can't control its electricity that well, often discharging more energy than is necessary.
decisions.target: 训练家低落，POKENAME就轻轻电一下，想帮忙提神。可控电不太好，常放得过多。
decisions.revised: 训练家心情低落时，POKENAME会轻轻电一下对方，想让其振作。但它控制电力的本领不够好，常放出多于所需的能量。

decisions.source: POKENAME are most often found at dusk, although they are still difficult to find due to their shyness and tendency to get overwhelmed. When the moon is full, they can jump thrice as high as normal.
decisions.target: POKENAME黄昏最常见，却因害羞、容易慌乱，仍难寻找。满月时，能跳到平时3倍高。
decisions.revised: 黄昏最容易遇见POKENAME，但它害羞，又容易不知所措，依旧很难寻找。满月时，它们能跳到平常三倍的高度。

decisions.source: POKENAME make their nests along river banks, raising their young amongst the reeds. When they swim out to hunt, they rely on their broad hood and buoyant tail to keep themselves at the water's surface.
decisions.target: POKENAME在河岸筑巢，于芦苇间育幼。游出去狩猎，靠宽颈褶与浮尾留在水面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME沿河岸筑巢，在芦苇间养育幼崽。游出去捕猎时，它们靠宽阔的颈褶和浮力十足的尾巴，保持在水面。

decisions.source: POKENAME sinks to the bottom of water quickly thanks to the high density of its spiked body. It uses its spiky, heavy tail to crack open the shells of Shellder and other hard-shelled aquatic denizens.
decisions.target: POKENAME多刺身体密度高，很快沉底。重刺尾能敲开大舌贝等硬壳水生猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME多刺的身体密度很高，因此很快就会沉到水底。它用沉重、多刺的尾巴，敲开大舌贝等硬壳水生生灵的壳。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in and amongst water lilies, using their leaves as platforms on which to play with one another on. Flowers bloom on their bodies, the colour of the petals depending on the plants they eat.
decisions.target: POKENAME住睡莲丛，用叶片当平台一起玩。身上也开花，花色取决于所吃植物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在睡莲之间，拿叶片当平台，彼此玩耍。它们身上也会开花，花瓣的颜色，取决于所吃的植物。

decisions.source: POKENAME forages around lakes and rivers to find water-based fungi to snack on. Its tail is extendable and packs a powerful punch, letting it deter things that would try to attack it while it feeds.
decisions.target: POKENAME沿河湖找水生真菌吃。长尾可伸缩，打击极强，觅食时能赶走袭击者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME沿湖泊与河流觅食，寻找水生真菌吃。它的尾巴能伸长，出击有力，能在进食时抵御想来攻击的生灵。

decisions.source: POKENAME have small flowers on their backs that require lots of resources to develop. They can accelerate the process of growth by resting in direct sunlight, increasing the rate at which sugar is produced and metabolized.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上小花耗费大量资源。直晒太阳能加快糖的制造、代谢，促进生长。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的小花，需要大量资源才能长大。在直射的阳光下休息，能加快糖的产生与代谢，促进发育。

decisions.source: If POKENAME senses the scent of a ripe berry, it can't help but run off to eat it. From its rigid tail, it can fire powerful electric shocks at anyone foolish enough to underestimate it.
decisions.target: POKENAME一闻熟树果香，就忍不住跑去吃。坚硬尾巴能放强电，可别轻易小看。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一闻到成熟树果的香气，就忍不住跑去吃。它能用坚硬的尾巴，向那些蠢到小看它的家伙，放出强力电击。

decisions.source: POKENAME burrows underground using its drill tail to wait out droughts and cold weather. When the first rains start to fall, they emerge from their burrows and will sing loudly to one another across great distances.
decisions.target: POKENAME用钻尾潜地下，熬过干旱、寒冷。第一场雨一落，便出洞，彼此隔远高歌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用钻头尾巴潜入地下，等待干旱和寒冷过去。第一场雨开始落下，它们便钻出地洞，相隔很远也会放声对唱。

decisions.source: Living deep in the forest since ancient times, POKENAME have the ability to change the color and patterns along their face at will. They take on the appearance of bigger Pokémon to scare away predators.
decisions.target: POKENAME自古住在深林，随心改脸色与花纹。扮成更大的宝可梦，吓退捕食者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME自古就生活在森林深处，能随意改变脸部的颜色和花纹。它们假扮更大的宝可梦，吓退捕食者。

decisions.source: With teeth that are constantly growing, POKENAME will gnaw at trees to wear their teeth down. The falling trees will sometimes land on top of them, POKENAME curling up into a ball to endure the collapsing trunk.
decisions.target: POKENAME牙不停长，便啃树磨短。有时倒树压向自己，就蜷成球，承受倒下树干。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的牙不断生长，便靠啃树磨短。有时，倒下的树会砸向自己，它们就蜷成球，承受压下的树干。

decisions.source: Although its fighting techniques are not yet fully developed, it would be a mistake to underestimate POKENAME. Its stone jaws are capable of causing trouble for anyone who is careless enough to let their guard down.
decisions.target: POKENAME战技虽未完全成熟，却不可小看。石颚足以让粗心松懈的人吃苦头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的战斗技巧虽尚未成熟，小看它却会犯下大错。石头般的双颚，足以让粗心大意、放松警惕的家伙吃苦头。

decisions.source: The two heads of POKENAME rhythmically nod in unison to support their companions and cheer them on. While one head tries to act cool and calm, the other head makes no effort to hide its excitement.
decisions.target: POKENAME两头同步点节拍，支持、鼓励伙伴。一个装酷冷静，另一个却不掩兴奋。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的两颗头，有节奏地一齐点动，为伙伴加油鼓劲。一颗头故作潇洒镇定，另一颗却毫不掩饰兴奋。

decisions.source: As POKENAME roams through wastelands, a foul smelling wind swirls around it, picking up dust and small pieces of trash. When it is agitated, these are propelled through the air with enough force to injure foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME走过荒地，臭风绕身卷起土与小垃圾。烦躁时，便猛射出去，足以伤敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME游荡荒地时，臭风绕身打旋，卷起尘土和小块垃圾。烦躁时，这些碎物会被猛地抛出，力道足以伤敌。

decisions.source: POKENAME scratches its talons against tree trunks in order to keep them sharp. The bark of its body is said to possess healing properties when powdered, but POKENAME is very resistant to attempts to acquire its bark.
decisions.target: POKENAME用树干磨脚爪，保持锋利。据说树皮磨粉有疗效，可它极力抗拒采皮。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在树干上磨爪，保持锋利。据说，它身上的树皮磨成粉，有疗愈作用，可它极力抗拒任何采皮的企图。

decisions.source: POKENAME tunnel through loose soil and dirt, consuming vast amounts of nutrients as they do. The soil they consume allows them to grow petals that give off an earthy smell that is prized by fragrance companies.
decisions.target: POKENAME钻松土，摄大量养分。吃的土，让它长出泥土香花瓣，香料公司很珍视。
decisions.revised: POKENAME钻过松软土层，沿途摄取大量养分。吃下的土帮助它们长出花瓣，散发泥土香，备受香氛厂商青睐。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives in caves near marshy ponds and is able to have even footing on the mud. It uses sonar to pick out ripe fruit outside the cave and shakes trees to get fruit to fall.
decisions.target: POKENAME住沼池旁洞穴，泥里也站得稳。用声呐找洞外熟果，再摇树让果掉下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在沼泽池塘旁的洞窟，在泥里也能站得平稳。它用声呐找出洞外的熟果，再摇动树木，让果实掉落。

decisions.source: A baby Pokémon freshly hatched from its egg, POKENAME has not yet shed its egg fully and uses the remaining shell to protect its body. Its hind legs are far more well-developed than the rest of its body and are used for escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME刚孵化，还没完全脱壳，用剩余蛋壳护身。后腿比身体其余部位发育好得多，用来逃跑。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是刚孵化的幼年宝可梦，还没完全脱去蛋壳，会用余下的壳护身。后腿远比身体其他部分发育得好，专用来逃跑。

decisions.source: With a barking roar, POKENAME will command trees to chase after those who ruin forests. When a tree becomes old and needs to be rid of so new nature can grow, it blasts intense fire in a precise manner so only that tree burns away.
decisions.target: POKENAME一声吠吼，就命树追破坏森林者。老树该清除、让新生命长时，便精准喷火，只烧那一棵。
decisions.revised: POKENAME发出犬吠般的吼声，命令树木追赶破坏森林的家伙。老树需要清除、让新生命生长时，它便精准喷火，只烧去那一棵。

decisions.source: POKENAME enjoys playing in the sand on beaches and gets excited when a child wants to build with it, causing the flame of its tail to burn brighter. If an adult tries to take the child away from it, POKENAME will aggressively throw sand at them.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱玩沙，孩子愿意一起筑东西，就兴奋得尾火更亮。成人若想带走孩子，它会凶狠扬沙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱在海滩玩沙。有孩子想跟它一起堆沙，它便兴奋得尾焰更亮。若成人想将孩子带走，它就会凶猛地朝对方扬沙。

decisions.source: Although POKENAME is a strong swimmer, it spends most of its time sitting on the shore. Even when it enters the water, it mostly just drifts with the current, to the frustration of anyone riding on its back as a passenger.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽很善游，却大半时间坐在岸上。即使入水，也多半随流漂着，急坏背上的乘客。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然泳技出众，大部分时间却坐在岸上。即使入水，也多半只是随波逐流，让骑在背上的乘客颇为懊恼。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives and snoozes among the craggy cliffs of mountainsides. Its tough skin and deep slumber mean that even if it turns in its sleep and rolls all the way down a mountainside, it won't be jostled from its nap.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在山坡崎岖岩崖间睡觉。皮硬、睡得深，哪怕翻身一路滚下山，也不会被颠醒。
decisions.revised: 山坡的崎岖岩崖，是POKENAME生活、打盹的地方。它皮肤坚韧，又睡得沉，哪怕睡梦中翻身，一路滚下山坡，也不会被颠醒。

decisions.source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon to keep in small apartments, their presence adding a lush feel to the interior whilst their ability to produce fire helps to keep heating bills low. Student rented flats are an especially common home for them.
decisions.target: POKENAME深受小公寓住户喜爱，既添绿意，又能生火，省暖气费。学生合租房里，尤其常见。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是小公寓里受欢迎的伙伴，既为室内添绿意，又能生火，节省取暖开支。学生租住的公寓里，尤其常见它们。

decisions.source: Instead of eating bugs, POKENAME relies on eating flower nectar and dew, which is more difficult to come by given the increased size and body weight. It requires at least 1 pound of nectar and dew every day to fill POKENAME's stomach.
decisions.target: POKENAME不吃虫，改靠花蜜与露水。可体形体重增加，觅食更难，每天至少需1磅，才能填饱。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不吃虫，改靠花蜜和露水为食。可体型、体重增大，让觅食更加不易，每天至少需要合计1磅花蜜与露水，才能填饱肚子。

decisions.source: POKENAME fight dirty, both literally and figuratively. In combat, this Pokémon will use its feathery arms to whip up sand and dirt to blind its opponents. While the foe is disoriented, POKENAME rushes forward and deals harsh blows with its kicks.
decisions.target: POKENAME打架很“脏”，字面与手段，都是如此。它用羽臂扬沙土迷眼，再趁敌迷乱，冲前狠踢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME打架很“脏”，说的是手段，也说的是泥沙。它用覆羽的双臂扬起沙土，迷住对手的眼，再趁敌人失去方向，冲上去猛踢。

decisions.source: POKENAME can lift itself off the ground for only a few minutes at a time with its small wings. When it flies, it spreads spores from its mushroom cap that provide a short-lived euphoric sensation in those who inhale them.
decisions.target: POKENAME的小翼每次只能让它离地几分钟。飞时从蘑菇帽散孢子，吸入者会短暂欣快。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的小翅膀，每次只能让它离地几分钟。飞行时，菌盖会散出孢子，让吸入者短暂地陶醉不已。

decisions.source: Should POKENAME see in the future that something bad is going to happen, its fur will become incredibly hot. Its fur can get hot enough to cause fires in dry foliage, making it a harbinger of danger when its heat increases.
decisions.target: POKENAME预见坏事将至，毛就变得极热，足以点燃干叶。因此，毛发变热也成了危险先兆。
decisions.revised: POKENAME若预见有坏事将要发生，毛发便会变得极热，足以点燃干燥叶片。因此，它升高的热量，也成了危险的先兆。

decisions.source: POKENAME can dance majestically in flight thanks to its broad wings, releasing a sweet floral fragrance all around as it moves. It is particularly active during the hottest hours of the day, as the presence of the sun strengthens its moves.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠宽翼在空中优美起舞，沿途散甜花香。一天最热时尤其活跃，阳光增强动作。
decisions.revised: POKENAME凭宽翼，在空中优美起舞，散出阵阵甜美花香。一天最热的时候，它格外活跃，因为阳光能增强它的招式。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their sharp teeth to gnaw through coral, feeding on the animals hiding within the rocky growths of the reef. They gnaw burrows into the reef to have a quick escape route when threatened, never straying far from their holes.
decisions.target: POKENAME锐齿啃穿珊瑚，吃礁石状结构里藏的动物。也在礁里啃洞作逃路，始终不远离。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用锐齿啃穿珊瑚，吃藏在坚硬礁体里的动物。它们还会啃出礁洞，方便遇险时快速逃离，也从不离洞太远。

decisions.source: POKENAME gain small glimpses into the future that allow them to see the results of their pranks. If they find that the person they are about to prank has a bad reaction, then they find a different target for their pranks.
decisions.target: POKENAME能瞥见一小段未来，提前看到恶作剧结果。若预见对方反应不好，就换个目标。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能瞥见一小段未来，预先知道恶作剧的结果。若发现准备捉弄的人反应不妙，它就会换个目标。

decisions.source: POKENAME has a powerful sense of smell, which allows it to detect other Pokémon nearby, or even if any were in the area recently. Unfortunately, it cannot make great use of this ability as it doesn't move very quickly.
decisions.target: POKENAME嗅觉强，能发现附近宝可梦，连近期来过也闻得出。可动作太慢，很难好好运用。
decisions.revised: POKENAME嗅觉强，能发现附近的宝可梦，甚至察知最近有没有宝可梦来过。可惜它移动缓慢，没法充分用好这项本领。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to fight, though they always have to rest for a long time after just one battle. They love to hoard food for themselves to gorge upon after they wake up, even if it means stealing that food from others.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱打架，却每战一场就得长休。喜欢囤食物，醒来大吃，哪怕需要从别人那里偷。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱打架，可每打一场，都得休息很久。它们喜欢囤积食物，留待睡醒大吃，哪怕得从别人那里偷，也在所不惜。

decisions.source: The heads of POKENAME have wildly differing personalities. While the left head is outgoing and social, the right head prefers to be alone. This leads to them being very moody due to the many arguments with themselves that they go through.
decisions.target: POKENAME双头性格天差地别。左头外向合群，右头宁可独处，常为此自我争论，心情多变。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的两颗头性格迥异，左头外向合群，右头却喜欢独处。它们常自己与自己争吵，弄得心情十分多变。

decisions.source: The venom that oozes from POKENAME's tail can be boiled down into a syrup that is extremely spicy. Though it's no longer toxic after this process, it's often used in salsa, adding a fiery kick to the dish.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾上渗毒，可熬成极辣糖浆。煮过便无毒，常用在莎莎酱里，为菜肴添上火辣劲。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾巴渗出的毒液，能熬成极辣的糖浆。经过这道工序，便已不再有毒，常被加进莎莎酱，为菜肴增添火辣风味。

decisions.source: POKENAME claws are sharp enough to tear through stone, their swipes leaving nasty scratches on their foes. They're able to use their claws to climb almost any surface, though they are not always able to get themselves back down again.
decisions.target: POKENAME爪利到能撕石，挥击留下深伤。几乎什么表面都能攀，却不总能自行爬回地面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的爪子锋利得足以撕开岩石，挥击会给敌人留下严重抓伤。它们几乎什么表面都能攀爬，却未必总能自己爬下来。

decisions.source: Appearing within the blink of an eye, POKENAME dive down from the sky to pin down their prey with the blades in their pincers. They use the blade on their heads to cut through any resistance or deal the finishing blow.
decisions.target: POKENAME眨眼间从天而降，用钳中刀刃钉住猎物，再以头刃斩破抵抗，或给予最后一击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME眨眼间便从天空俯冲而至，用钳中的刀刃钉住猎物。头上的刀刃，则用来斩破抵抗，或给予最后一击。

decisions.source: Their soft, grass-like wings help them to blend in with the tree canopies they nest upon. Their many eyes emit shrill noises when they flash in various patterns, and serve as means for them to communicate with their kind.
decisions.target: 柔草般翅膀能融入筑巢树冠。许多眼以不同图案闪光，也发尖音，和同类交流。
decisions.revised: 它们柔软如草的翅膀，能融入筑巢的树冠。许多眼睛以不同规律闪光，同时发出尖锐声音，借此与同类交流。

decisions.source: POKENAME's teeth are very small, so they use illusions to mask their presence and lull their prey into a false sense of security to get up close. By the time the prey sees through the facade, it is too late.
decisions.target: POKENAME的牙很小，便用幻象藏身，让猎物放松戒备，方便靠近。等猎物识破，就已经太迟。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的牙很小，便用幻象掩盖自己的存在，让猎物误以为安全，方便靠近。等猎物识破伪装，就已经太迟。

decisions.source: The dark-furred body of a POKENAME is covered in a dense, hard shell made of solid ice. It combines its psychic powers with its ability to produce a fast-cooling mist to protect its Trainer by freezing their foes solid.
decisions.target: POKENAME暗毛身体裹着致密硬冰壳。超能力配合快速降温的雾，冻实敌人，保护训练家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME深色毛发的身体，覆着致密坚硬的实冰外壳。它将超能力与迅速降温的雾结合，将敌人冻成坚冰，保护训练家。

decisions.source: POKENAME can control minute aspects of its environment that affect the mood and concentration of those around it. With just a flowing twist of its head, the atmospheric pressure alters; with a gentle flick of its tail, the wind shifts direction.
decisions.target: POKENAME能控制环境细节，影响附近心情与专注。流畅转头，气压就变；轻甩尾，风便转向。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能控制环境的细微变化，影响周围生灵的心情与专注。头流畅地一转，气压便改变；尾巴轻轻一甩，风就换了方向。

decisions.source: POKENAME root themselves along damp shores of dirt or shores of dark mud. They produce a noxious honey-like liquid within their rather hollow upper bodies. To defend themselves, they will flail their upper bodies and send this liquid flying about.
decisions.target: POKENAME在湿土岸或黑泥岸扎根。较空的上身造毒蜜状液，防御时，甩动上身，洒向四周。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在潮湿的土岸或黑泥岸扎根，较为中空的上身里，会产生有害的蜂蜜状液体。自卫时，它们甩动上身，将液体洒向四周。

decisions.source: The multiple mushrooms growing from the backs of POKENAME ooze a sickly sweet liquid that cause POKENAME to seek out others of their own species. When they find each other, they groom their partner, becoming coated in fresh spores as they do.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上多菇渗甜腻液，驱使自己寻找同类。找到后互相梳理，身上也沾满新孢子。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的多朵蘑菇，渗出甜腻液体，驱使它们寻找同类。找到后，它们便互相梳理，身上也因此沾满新孢子。

decisions.source: POKENAME rapidly beat their wings together to scatter their poisonous scales around them, causing nausea and headaches in anyone who comes into contact. These Pokémon mix these scales with the sand in their burrows as an added layer of defense.
decisions.target: POKENAME快速振翅，散播毒鳞，接触会引起恶心、头痛。它们也把毒鳞混进巢沙，增添防护。
decisions.revised: POKENAME快速振翅，向周围散出有毒鳞粉，接触者会恶心、头痛。它们还将鳞粉混进巢穴的沙里，增添一层防御。

decisions.source: POKENAME are left off-balance by their large heads, so they prefer to hide deep within caves. Their heads are said to hold a wealth of knowledge, which they share with anyone who manages to find them.
decisions.target: POKENAME头大得失衡，宁藏深洞。据说头中知识丰富，谁设法找到，它就乐于分享。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脑袋大，难以保持平衡，因此更愿意藏在洞窟深处。据说，脑袋里藏着丰富的知识，它们会分享给任何设法找到自己的生灵。

decisions.source: Though normally it keeps its shell coated in flame for self-defense, POKENAME can easily retract the fires to allow others to ride on its back. Water-based POKENAME are most often seen carrying people across small lakes.
decisions.target: POKENAME平常覆火护壳，却能轻易收回，让人骑背。水栖个体，则最常载人渡小湖。
decisions.revised: POKENAME平时让火焰覆在壳上自卫，却也能轻松收回，让别人骑在背上。人们最常见水栖的个体，载人渡过小湖。

decisions.source: POKENAME haunts the shores of lakes and rivers with a gang of its own kind, delighting in playing pranks on those it finds near the water. It often wrestles for fun, so it is not unusual to see it with a black eye on its face.
decisions.target: POKENAME与同类小帮派，盘踞湖河岸，爱捉弄水边对象。也常为好玩摔跤，脸上眼圈淤青，并不少见。
decisions.revised: POKENAME和一群同类出没于湖岸、河边，最爱捉弄靠水的生灵。它也常摔跤取乐，因此眼眶带着淤青，并不稀奇。

decisions.source: POKENAME glide silently through the night, rattling their mushroom caps to scatter their spores over their prey. Once their prey is taken out, they extend their arms to carry them away into the darkness of the night.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜里无声滑翔，摇响蘑菇帽，把孢子撒向猎物。制住后，便伸臂带入暗夜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜里无声滑翔，摇响菌盖，将孢子撒在猎物身上。制住猎物后，它们便伸出手臂，将其带进夜色深处。

decisions.source: POKENAME produce a scent from the giant flower on their back that induces feelings of generalised positivity and friendliness in those that smell it. They are peaceful Pokémon and tend to enjoy the company of others.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上的巨花散香，让闻者乐观友善。它性情平和，喜欢有其他生物作伴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的巨花散发香气，让闻者整体心境积极、待人友善。它们性情平和，通常喜欢有其他生灵作伴。

decisions.source: POKENAME have hazy visions of the future that they rely on to avoid serious injury. When they are forced to fight another Pokémon, they observe their opponent to find the right moment and launch a counterattack.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠模糊的未来景象避免重伤。不得不战斗时，细看对手，等准时机反击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能看见朦胧的未来景象，借此避免重伤。被迫与其他宝可梦交战时，它们会观察对手，等到恰当时机，再发起反击。

decisions.source: Swarms of POKENAME are found along coastal cliffs where they illuminate the clifftops at night. Their collective light is bright enough that sailors are able to use them in place of lighthouses to avoid beaching their ships.
decisions.target: POKENAME群见于海崖，夜里照亮崖顶。汇聚的光，足以让水手代作灯塔，避免搁浅。
decisions.revised: 沿岸悬崖常聚着POKENAME，夜里将崖顶照亮。汇聚的光足够明亮，水手能把它们当作灯塔，避免船只搁浅。

decisions.source: The beachball-sized orb on the end of POKENAME's tail keeps it afloat in the water. When scuttling across the beach, POKENAME picks the float up in its claw to stop it from dragging in the sand.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾端的球大如沙滩球，供水中浮起。海滩爬行时，会用钳抱起，免得拖沙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾端的球体有沙滩球大，能让它在水里浮起来。在海滩爬行时，它会用钳子提起浮具，免得拖在沙上。

decisions.source: POKENAME rely on their tongue to grab berries from tree branches. By rubbing the glands on their cheeks, a Trainer can force them to open their mouth, which is perfect when they need to take bitter medicine.
decisions.target: POKENAME用舌卷树上树果。训练家揉脸颊腺体，就能使它张嘴，喂苦药时很有用。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠舌头抓取枝上的树果。训练家揉一揉它脸颊的腺体，就能使其张嘴；需要服苦药时，这很方便。

decisions.source: POKENAME blows large bubbles from its wide mouth to communicate with others of its kind. Rivals in the wild will bite down on the other's hair curl and tug it roughly as a show of dominance.
decisions.target: POKENAME从大嘴吹巨泡，与同类沟通。野生对手会咬住彼此卷毛，猛扯以示支配。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用宽大的嘴吹出大泡泡，与同类交流。野外的对手会咬住彼此的卷毛，粗暴拉扯，展示支配地位。

decisions.source: POKENAME's light body is easily carried by even light gusts of wind. It spins its body while airborne, dispensing pollen from its leaves that makes any flowers touched by it smell just a little bit sweeter.
decisions.target: POKENAME身轻，微风也能托起。腾空时旋身，叶片撒花粉，让沾到的花再香甜一点。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体轻，一阵微风就能带起。它们在空中旋转，从叶片散出花粉，让沾到的花，香气略微更甜美一些。

decisions.source: The unnerving visage of this Pokémon strikes fear in the hearts of those who gaze upon it. Anyone who dares to look at the crack on its back is left on the brink of death.
decisions.target: 它令人不安的面容，使凝望者恐惧。谁胆敢看背上裂缝，就会濒临死亡。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦令人不安的面容，使凝望者心生恐惧。谁敢看它背上的裂缝，就会濒临死亡。

decisions.source: POKENAME gnaw their way through the walls of dairies in search of fresh milk. They use their high body heat to curdle the milk into cheese to steal away, much to the dismay of the dairy farmers.
decisions.target: POKENAME啃穿奶场墙壁，寻找鲜奶，再靠高体温凝成奶酪偷走，让奶农苦恼不已。
decisions.revised: POKENAME啃穿奶场的墙，寻找鲜奶。它们用高体温让奶凝成奶酪，再偷走，令奶农苦恼不已。

decisions.source: It has a possessive streak when it seeks a tree to perch on. If Kakuna and similar Pokémon hang threads on its tree, it will use the beating of its wings to blow them all to the forest floor so it alone can remain.
decisions.target: 它选树栖身，占有欲很强。铁壳蛹等若在树上挂丝，就拍翅把它们全吹落林地，只留自己。
decisions.revised: 它挑选栖息的树时，占有欲很强。铁壳蛹等宝可梦若在这棵树上挂起丝，它便振翅，将它们统统吹落林地，只让自己留下。

decisions.source: POKENAME rubs its body against tree bark in order to help scrape and snap off plates of its body that have grown excessively. The fallen pieces biodegrade quickly and provide more nutrients for soil and plant life.
decisions.target: POKENAME蹭树皮，刮断长过头的甲片。碎片很快生物分解，给土壤、植物更多养分。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在树皮上摩擦身体，刮掉、折落长得过头的甲片。碎片会迅速生物降解，为土壤与植物补充养分。

decisions.source: POKENAME's plate-covered hide is as solid and sturdy as stone. By tucking in its four arms, it can roll around at high speeds, kicking up vast amounts of dirt or sand as it does so.
decisions.target: POKENAME覆满甲片的外皮坚实如石。收起四臂后，便能高速滚动，扬起大量泥沙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME裹满甲片的外皮，坚硬结实得像石头。四臂一收，它就能高速滚动，沿途扬起大量泥土或沙子。

decisions.source: POKENAME are able to sense the emotions of anyone who holds their tails. These Pokémon often insist that their Trainers hold their tails at all times so they can constantly keep an eye on their emotions.
decisions.target: POKENAME能感知握着尾巴者的情绪。常坚持训练家时时牵尾，好一直留意心情。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能感知握住自己尾巴者的情绪。它们常要求训练家始终牵着尾巴，好随时留意对方的心情。

decisions.source: POKENAME's agility has become greatly hindered by its thick, heavy metal exterior. To make up for this, it uses its psychic powers to hold foes in place so it can crush them with its hammerlike tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME厚重金属外壳大碍敏捷。为弥补，先以精神力量定敌，再用锤状尾碾压。
decisions.revised: 厚重的金属外壳，大大妨碍了POKENAME的敏捷。为弥补这点，它用超能力把敌人定在原地，再用锤状尾巴砸碎。

decisions.source: Their stout hind legs can hold up their heavy bodies clad in burning vines and burning small trees. The trees and vines on their backs may always be burning but they will never turn to ash, no matter how hot their flames get when enraged.
decisions.target: 粗后腿能撑起披着燃烧树藤的重躯。背上树藤即使一直烧，怒时火再热，也绝不会成灰。
decisions.revised: 粗壮的后腿，撑起它们披着燃烧藤蔓和小树的沉重身体。背上的树与藤虽然始终燃烧，哪怕暴怒时火焰再热，也绝不会化成灰。

decisions.source: The membranes on POKENAME's eyes let them see well in the dark, making them especially suited for fighting at night. The flames on their bodies are jet black so as not to give away their location.
decisions.target: POKENAME眼膜让它暗中也看得清，尤其善于夜战。体表火焰漆黑，免得暴露位置。
decisions.revised: POKENAME眼上的薄膜，让它在黑暗里也能看清，格外适合夜战。身上的火焰漆黑一片，免得暴露位置。

decisions.source: POKENAME mouths are formed of multiple segments, enabling them to open their mouths far wider than might be expected for a Pokémon their size. They have a venomous bite that they use to deter their foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME的嘴由多节构成，能张得远比这体形看起来更大。毒咬用来驱赶敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的嘴由多节构成，张开后，大得远超体型给人的预期。它的咬击带毒，能用来驱退敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME dances around with twirling, flipping and hopping motions, each rotation giving it more electrical energy to work with.  Once it finishes a dance sequence, it releases the pent-up energy in a huge burst around it.
decisions.target: POKENAME旋转、翻腾、跳跃，每转一次，就多蓄些电。一套跳完，能量向周围猛烈爆发。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以旋转、翻腾、蹦跳的动作起舞，每转一圈，就多积蓄些电能。一套舞跳完，它便向四周猛烈释放积存的能量。

decisions.source: POKENAME is often found swimming at the surface of tropical rivers, the plant on its back exuding a sweet scent to attract bird and bug Pokémon for a meal. When it dives, the plant clamps its jaws shut as overconsumption of water makes it sluggish.
decisions.target: POKENAME常游热带河面，背植散甜香，诱鸟与虫宝可梦吃。潜水时植物合颚，吸水太多会令它迟缓。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常游在热带河流的表面，背上植物散出甜香，诱来鸟类和虫类宝可梦，供自己捕食。潜水时，植物会合紧双颚，因为吸水太多，会让动作迟缓。

decisions.source: This Pokémon lives and hunts in arctic waters, though it is capable of staying on land for periods of time. The ice along its body protects it while also giving it a deadly horn that allows it to quickly impale any of its prey.
decisions.target: 这种宝可梦住、猎极地水域，也能暂时上陆。冰层护身，又形成致命角，让它迅速刺穿猎物。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦在北极水域生活、捕猎，也能在陆地待上一段时间。身上的冰层既能保护它，也形成致命尖角，让它能迅速刺穿猎物。

decisions.source: POKENAME floats around forests at night, offering lost children the chance to partake in some of the sweet candy from its body. Those who accept are believed to be cursed, and will become POKENAME when they pass on.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜游森林，请迷路孩子吃身上甜糖。据说接受者会受诅咒，去世后变成POKENAME。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜里飘游森林，邀请迷路的孩子吃身上的甜糖。据说，接受者会遭到诅咒，去世后变成POKENAME。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves to dig holes in sandy beaches. When it finds a shell, rock, or piece of trash that it likes, it will add the treasure to its fluffy collar of fur, wagging its tail with pride.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱在沙滩挖洞。遇上喜欢的贝壳、石头、垃圾，就添进蓬松毛领，自豪摇尾。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱在沙滩挖洞。找到喜欢的贝壳、石头或垃圾，它就会将宝贝添进蓬松的毛领，自豪地摇起尾巴。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very solitary Pokémon. They dig holes in the desert to fish in shifting sands. The skull they wear on their head is essentially used to protect them from the burning sun of the desert.
decisions.target: POKENAME极独居，在沙漠挖洞，垂钓流沙中的猎物。头骨主要用来挡住沙漠烈日。
decisions.revised: POKENAME习惯独自生活，会在沙漠挖洞，垂钓流沙中的猎物。头上戴的头骨，主要用来遮挡沙漠的灼人烈日。

decisions.source: It wanders in search of meteorites fallen from the sky, feeding on them to grow stronger in the hope of evolving as soon as possible. During the day it rests in its den, conserving energy so it can spend the night gazing at the stars.
decisions.target: 它寻找天降陨石，吃下变强，盼着尽快进化。白天在巢里休息，保存精力，好整夜凝望星辰。
decisions.revised: 它寻找天降陨石，吃下变强，盼着尽快进化。白天在巢里休息，保存精力，好整夜凝望星辰。

decisions.source: POKENAME will sleep beside any source of water with the tips of their tails dipped in the water so they may passively absorb it. They can safely absorb any type of water, though oddly their petals always exude a sea breeze scent.
decisions.target: POKENAME睡在水旁，尾尖浸水，被动吸收。任何水都能安全吸，可奇怪的是，花瓣总散海风味。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在水源旁睡觉，尾尖浸在水里，被动吸收水分。它们能安全吸收任何种类的水，可奇怪的是，花瓣总散出海风般的气味。

decisions.source: Cocky and boisterous, POKENAME is often seen picking fights with larger Water-types by smacking them with its club. If it is disarmed of its weapon in the ensuing battle, it doesn't hesitate to bite down with its sharp teeth instead.
decisions.target: POKENAME自负、吵闹，常用棒拍大水属性，挑起争斗。战中若武器被夺，就毫不犹豫，改用利牙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME自负又吵闹，常用棍棒拍打大个头的水属性宝可梦，挑起争斗。随后的战斗里，武器若被缴走，它就毫不犹豫地改用尖牙咬下。

decisions.source: POKENAME stick together in large groups at all times. For example, they huddle together for warmth during the cold season, and they all get together in the early hours of the morning to eventually fly with one another during the warm season.
decisions.target: POKENAME时刻大群相伴。寒冷季节会挤在一起取暖；温暖季节则清早集合，随后一同飞行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME时刻与大群同类待在一起。寒冷季节，它们挤在一起取暖；温暖季节，则清早集合，随后一同飞行。

decisions.source: POKENAME are not skilled swimmers, and are often tossed about by the currents of the rivers they reside in. The curled fins on top of their heads help establish a pecking order among schools, with the most impressive fins earning royal treatment.
decisions.target: POKENAME不善游，常被家乡河流卷来甩去。头顶卷鳍决定群体等级，最华美者享王室待遇。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不擅长游泳，常被栖居河流的水势卷得东倒西歪。头顶的卷曲鱼鳍，能确立群体中的等级；鳍最出众者，会受到王者般的礼遇。

decisions.source: Its large tusks are made of dense, rigid vines that regrow in less than a week if ever broken. It charges down invaders of its territory and uses its strong legs to create tremors that knock free the fruit within trees.
decisions.target: 巨牙由密硬藤蔓构成，断了不到一周便再生。会追撞入侵者，强腿震地，摇落树果。
decisions.revised: 它巨大的长牙，由密实、坚硬的藤蔓构成，若折断，不到一周便能再生。它会冲撞入侵领地的生灵，也能靠强腿震地，震落树上的果实。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their quills to carry mud to and from the dams they construct in streams. Their quills help to trap moisture, keeping the mud damp and easily shapable so they can reinforce the structures without fear of them drying out prematurely.
decisions.target: POKENAME用背刺来回运泥，修筑溪坝。刺能留住水分，让泥湿润易塑，加固时不怕太早干掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用身上的刺来回运泥，修筑溪流中的堤坝。刺能留住水分，让泥保持湿润、容易塑形，加固时就不怕泥过早干掉。

decisions.source: POKENAME sing only one day every 1,000 years, their songs reaching the ears of those that are miles away. Their skirts shimmer like space itself and their golden locks are reminiscent of the sun itself, causing many to portray them as cosmic singers.
decisions.target: POKENAME每1,000年只唱一天，声传数英里。裙闪如宇宙，金发似太阳，因此常被描绘为宇宙歌者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每1000年只唱一天，歌声传到数英里外。裙摆闪烁如宇宙，金发仿佛太阳，因此许多人将它们描绘为宇宙歌者。

decisions.source: Whenever POKENAME are in a nest with a broody parent, they wrap their wings around the parent to keep them warm. When POKENAME inevitably become too big for the nest, they remain close to their nest to expand it with twigs and branches.
decisions.target: POKENAME与抱窝亲代同巢，会用翼环住保暖。终究长得容不下时，仍待在近旁，用枝条扩巢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME与正在抱窝的亲代同巢时，会用翅膀环住对方，替其保暖。等它们终究长得太大、巢已容不下，仍会留在附近，用细枝和树枝扩建。

decisions.source: POKENAME soar through the skies, keeping an eye out for similarly sized bird Pokémon. They will try to bully out any Pokémon that are in the same skies as them, swiping at them with their tail and pecking at them.
decisions.target: POKENAME翱翔时留意体形相近的鸟宝可梦，试图霸凌、赶走同空飞行者，用尾巴扫，用喙啄。
decisions.revised: POKENAME翱翔天空，留意体形相近的鸟类宝可梦。它们用尾巴扫打、用喙啄击，试图驱逐同一片天空中的其他宝可梦。

decisions.source: The pair of orbs that dangle from the hood of a POKENAME glow with a faintly purple-pink color when they use their psychic powers. Their black fur is surprisingly cool to the touch, no matter the environment they may be within.
decisions.target: POKENAME用超能力时，兜帽垂着的双球泛出淡紫粉光。无论环境如何，黑毛摸着都出奇凉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用超能力时，兜帽上垂下的两个球体，会泛起淡淡的紫粉色光芒。无论身处什么环境，黑毛的触感都出奇地凉。

decisions.source: POKENAME camouflage themselves within a Trainer's bag as a Technical Machine so that they can be carried for long distances. When they are inevitably spotted by the Trainer, they scuttle out of the bag to find a safe place to hide.
decisions.target: POKENAME在训练家包里，假扮招式学习器，搭便车远行。终被发现，便爬出包，另找安全处躲。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在训练家的背包里，假扮招式学习器，好被带着远行。它们终究会被训练家发现；那时，便会爬出背包，再找个安全地方躲起来。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a very resentful Pokémon. It can't stand the thought of anyone dancing better than it, and it flies into a rage when that happens. It disrupts other Pokémon Contest competitors' performances by giving them small electric shocks.
decisions.target: POKENAME嫉妒心强，见谁舞得更好就暴怒。常小电击其他宝可梦华丽大赛选手，扰乱表演。
decisions.revised: POKENAME怨气很重，受不了别人舞得比自己好，一旦真有，就会勃然大怒。它会给华丽大赛的其他选手轻微电击，扰乱表演。

decisions.source: POKENAME's strong jaws let it bite through solid stone as if it were soft soil. It is a highly dangerous predator, able to cut through an entire mountain range in minutes to hunt down prey it has caught the scent of.
decisions.target: POKENAME强颚咬坚石，如咬软土，危险无比。嗅到猎物，几分钟就能凿穿整条山脉，追猎而去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME强健的双颚，咬穿坚石如同软土，是极其危险的捕食者。嗅到猎物后，它能在几分钟内凿穿整条山脉，追捕而去。

decisions.source: POKENAME's cannon refracts the light energy it has collected, creating a rainbow of colored light when it fires. Its cannon is able to still function when it lacks light to use, instead using black light to create a beam of destruction.
decisions.target: POKENAME的炮折射收集的光能，开火时映出彩虹。缺光仍能运作，改用黑光，发射毁灭光束。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的炮会折射收集来的光能，开火时映出彩虹般的色光。即使无光可用，炮也能运作，改以黑光射出毁灭光束。

decisions.source: POKENAME can grow so large that they stand nearly as tall as a two-story house, so long as they are able to feed on plenty of mineral-rich rock. They are easy to anger, but their steel bodies make it difficult to truly disturb them enough.
decisions.target: 只要吃够富矿物的岩石，POKENAME能长到近两层楼高。它易怒，钢铁身体却让人很难真正搅扰到它。
decisions.revised: 只要有足够富含矿物的岩石吃，POKENAME就能长到近两层楼高。它们很容易生气，钢铁身躯却让人难以真正撼动它们。

decisions.source: When POKENAME kicks its legs fast enough its feet can catch fire. When their feet are on fire they are capable of causing third degree burns if they come in contact with another Pokémon for just 1 second.
decisions.target: POKENAME踢腿够快，脚就会起火。此时只需接触其他宝可梦1秒，就能造成三度灼伤。
decisions.revised: POKENAME踢腿足够快时，脚就会燃起火焰。此时，哪怕只接触其他宝可梦1秒，也能造成三度烧伤。

decisions.source: POKENAME's sword and shield are made of hard stone. The wings on either side are just as sharp as the blade and can cut foes who manage to evade the blade's tip as it flies past.
decisions.target: POKENAME的剑盾由硬石构成。两侧翅膀同样锋利，飞掠时，能割伤躲过剑尖的敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的剑与盾，由坚硬的石头构成。两侧翅膀和剑刃一样锋利，飞掠时，即便敌人躲过剑尖，也能被翼锋割伤。

decisions.source: It is said that the belt POKENAME wears helps to contain its rotund belly so only its dense muscles are seen. If it is not sleeping, it is either gorging itself with food or indulging itself with battles.
decisions.target: 据说POKENAME腰带束住圆肚，只露致密肌肉。不睡觉，它就在大吃，或尽情享受战斗。
decisions.revised: 据说，POKENAME的腰带能束住圆鼓鼓的肚子，让人只看见结实的肌肉。醒着时，它不是在大吃，就是在痛快战斗。

decisions.source: The energy welling within POKENAME's body is so immense, the weather experiences minor changes depending on their mood. Even Dragon Tamers report having trouble training these Pokémon due to the vast amount of energy they have.
decisions.target: POKENAME体内力量庞大得让天气随心情略变。连驯龙师，都说能量太多，很难训练。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体内能量庞大，天气都会随其心情略微改变。即使驯龙师也表示，这些宝可梦能量太多，训练起来十分棘手。

decisions.source: When a POKENAME spots suitable prey, it will use the single scythe on its tail to attack. When threatened, this Pokémon will attempt to scare off enemies using the patterns on its wings to avoid a battle.
decisions.target: POKENAME找到合适猎物，就用尾上单镰攻击。遇险时，则试着用翼纹吓敌，避免战斗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME发现合适的猎物，就会用尾上的那把镰刀进攻。受到威胁时，它则试着以翅膀上的花纹吓退敌人，避免交战。

decisions.source: When poking around for seeds to eat, POKENAME always makes sure to save a few to carry with it. It carefully places the seeds in the perfect soil conditions so that the new plants will bloom exceptionally well.
decisions.target: POKENAME找种子吃，总留几颗带着。它细心选恰好土壤种下，让新植物开得格外好。
decisions.revised: POKENAME找种子吃时，总会留几颗随身带着。它们精心选择土壤条件最合适的地方播种，让新植物开得格外好。

decisions.source: POKENAME ignites its wings in flames as a show of strength and dominance over others. Rivals clashing against each other will flare their fire up particularly fiercely, in some cases tripling the apparent visual size of their wingspan.
decisions.target: POKENAME点燃双翼，向别人示威。对手相争，火尤猛烈，有时，让翼展看起来足足三倍。
decisions.revised: POKENAME点燃双翼，向旁人展示力量与支配地位。对手交锋时，火势格外猛烈，有时能让翼展看起来达到平常三倍。

decisions.source: The flames on POKENAME's back flicker even while it lazes around. Its rest is often disturbed by wildfires it has started, but it is too lazy to flee from the flames until the smoke becomes very thick.
decisions.target: POKENAME懒躺，背火也闪。常被自己引发的野火扰休息，却懒得逃，直到烟极浓才动。
decisions.revised: POKENAME懒散躺着时，背上的火也仍在闪烁。它常被自己引发的野火打扰休息，却懒得逃离，直到烟雾极浓，才肯动。

decisions.source: Despite its fiery appearance, POKENAME reside deep in the ocean. It spends its time around geothermic vents, absorbing the heat from them before swimming to the surface and leaping out, emitting a burst of flame as it does.
decisions.target: POKENAME看似火热，却住深海。它在地热喷口吸热，再游上水面、跃出，同时爆发火焰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME看似烈焰缭绕，却住在深海。它待在地热喷口旁，吸取热量，再游上水面，纵身跃出，同时喷出一阵火焰。

decisions.source: When attacked, POKENAME will fire a net of webbing from the top of its head, hopefully immobilizing its opponent. It will even use its web like a parachute to allow it to safely jump down from tall trees.
decisions.target: 遇袭时，POKENAME从头顶射网，盼能制住对手。还会把网当降落伞，从高树安全跳下。
decisions.revised: 遭到攻击时，POKENAME会从头顶射出蛛网，希望能困住对手。它甚至会把网当作降落伞，让自己能从高树安全跃下。

decisions.source: POKENAME is known to be one of the most unique Krookodile fusions. Its tail shines bright when it's dark, and it can see farther than the human eye, though it is still quite the clumsy Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME是极独特的流氓鳄融合体。暗处尾巴明亮，视力远胜人眼，却仍相当笨拙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME被认为是最独特的流氓鳄融合体之一。黑暗中，尾巴发出亮光；它看得比人眼更远，却仍十分笨拙。

decisions.source: POKENAME buries itself in dirt to disguise itself as a young tree. It resides near other trees, both to further sell its mimicry and to ensure that the dirt is rooted and won't wash away in rain.
decisions.target: POKENAME把自己埋土，装小树。住在真树旁，既装得更像，树根也稳土，免得雨水冲走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将自己埋在土里，伪装成幼树。住在其他树旁，既能让模仿更加逼真，也能确保根系固定土壤，不被雨水冲走。

decisions.source: POKENAME are subject to the caprice of the weather and can be whisked away at a moment's notice. Sometimes they transform into bird Pokémon to control their flight, but they cannot maintain that form for long.
decisions.target: POKENAME受天气摆布，转眼就被卷走。有时变鸟宝可梦掌控飞行，可维持不了太久。
decisions.revised: POKENAME任天气摆布，转眼就可能被卷走。有时，它们会变成鸟类宝可梦，控制自己的飞行，却无法长久保持这种形态。

decisions.source: POKENAME inflates itself to float over grasslands and urban areas in search of food to steal. With a healthy diet of Qualot Berries, its coat grows into a soft material that is loved for light scarves and pillowcases.
decisions.target: POKENAME鼓身，漂草原市区找食物偷。健康吃比巴果，毛就软，适合做轻围巾与枕套。
decisions.revised: POKENAME鼓起身体，漂过草原和市区，寻找能偷的食物。以比巴果保持健康饮食，毛就会长得柔软，很受制作轻围巾与枕套的人喜爱。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a sturdy shell that smells like roasted nuts. They hang from trees where they eat leaves off of branches. They communicate with each other by swinging their tails to help one another defend themselves against predators.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳坚硬，闻着像烤坚果。它挂在树上吃枝叶，摆尾交流，帮助彼此抵御天敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的壳结实，闻起来像烤坚果。它们挂在树上，啃食枝头的叶子，并靠摆尾交流，帮助彼此抵御捕食者。

decisions.source: While howling at the moon, POKENAME does so through all of the tubes on its body simultaneously, each producing a different noise. During this time, its shell becomes as hard as diamond, reverting once the howling is done.
decisions.target: POKENAME对月长嚎，全身管道同时出声，每根都不同。这时壳硬如钻石，嚎完才恢复。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对月长嚎时，全身所有管道会同时出声，各有不同。这时，壳会硬得如同钻石，直到长嚎结束才恢复。

decisions.source: It is rumored that POKENAME's electric strikes are so powerful they can scorch forest trees in moments. Its wide wings allow it to soar through stormy skies, recharging its body by absorbing lightning with its twin tails.
decisions.target: 传闻POKENAME电击强得能瞬间焦毁林木。宽翼让它飞过风暴天空，双尾吸雷补能。
decisions.revised: 传闻，POKENAME的电击强得能在片刻间烧焦林木。宽翼让它飞过风暴天空，再以双尾吸收雷电，补充能量。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden in the mud, with only the fin on its head visible. Through that fin, it can sense the emotions of others, and will only reveal itself if it senses positive feelings.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多藏在泥里，只露头鳍。通过鳍感知情绪，只有察觉正面感受，才会现身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大部分时间藏在泥里，只露出头上的鳍。它通过鳍感知旁人的情绪，唯有察觉积极的感受，才肯现身。

decisions.source: POKENAME soars over the ocean in search of storm clouds from which it can absorb electrical energy. Once fully charged, it can fly for an entire week without needing to land, streaking through the sky at incredible speeds.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞越海洋，寻找雷云吸电。充足电后，可整周不落地，以惊人速度掠过天空。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞过海洋，寻找能吸取电力的雷云。充满电后，它能整整一周不落地，以惊人的速度划过天空。

decisions.source: POKENAME scares schools of fish by casting illusions to make itself appear to be a much larger, fearsome Pokémon. As the school scatters, POKENAME takes advantage of the confusion to pick off a few stragglers for its meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME以幻觉装成大得多的可怕宝可梦，吓散鱼群，再趁混乱捉几只落单者吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用幻象，让自己显得大得多、可怕得多，吓散鱼群。随后，它趁着混乱，挑几只落单的抓来，作为一餐。

decisions.source: The sharp horn on its head can drill through even the thickest shells to deliver poison. After swimming close enough to strike its prey, POKENAME will back off and patiently wait for it to succumb to the toxin.
decisions.target: 头上尖角能钻穿最厚甲壳，送入毒。POKENAME游近猎物刺击，再退后，耐心等其毒倒。
decisions.revised: 头上的尖角能钻穿最厚的甲壳，注入毒液。POKENAME游近猎物，出手刺击，再退开，耐心等待猎物被毒素制服。

decisions.source: While POKENAME possesses the ability to manipulate water around it, it detests getting wet. It will part the waters of lakes, rivers and the like in order to keep the liquid as far away from it as possible.
decisions.target: POKENAME能控周围水，却讨厌湿身。它会分开湖河等水域，让液体尽可能远离自己。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽能操纵周围的水，却厌恶沾湿。它会分开湖泊、河流等水域，让液体尽可能远离自己。

decisions.source: POKENAME has the power to manipulate the flow of time around it. Should those it cares for come to harm, it will rewind time to go back and alter the course of events and avoid the danger entirely.
decisions.target: POKENAME能操纵周围时间流。珍爱者受伤，就会倒转时间，改变经过，完全避开危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有力量操纵周围的时间流。珍爱的生灵若受到伤害，它便倒转时间，改变事情的经过，彻底避开危险。

decisions.source: POKENAME rapidly flap their tiny wings whenever they're excited, making a high-pitched cry as they do. If they become too enthusiastic about whatever has them worked up, they start to spit fire from their gaping mouth.
decisions.target: POKENAME兴奋时，小翅膀急速扑动，发出尖鸣。若高兴得过了头，大嘴还会开始喷火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一兴奋，就会飞快扑动小翅膀，发出尖锐叫声。若热情过了头，张开的大嘴还会开始喷火。

decisions.source: POKENAME's kind personality leads it to cheer for both sides of a battle equally when it spectates. After watching a battle unfold, it flies over and spreads a static pollen that helps soothe the combatants' tired muscles.
decisions.target: POKENAME心善，观战两边都公平加油。战后飞来，撒带静电花粉，舒缓双方疲惫肌肉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME心地善良，观战时会同样热情地替双方加油。战斗结束，它就飞过去，撒下带静电的花粉，舒缓双方疲惫的肌肉。

decisions.source: POKENAME are untrusting of all others and will charge at anyone they see within their forest domains. Their legs pack enough power that they soften hard ground when they rampage, allowing new life to more easily take root.
decisions.target: POKENAME谁都不信，谁进林领地，就冲谁。强腿暴走会松硬土，让新生命更容易扎根。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不信任任何其他生灵，见谁进入森林领地，就会冲撞。强健双腿暴走时，能将硬土踩松，让新生命更容易扎根。

decisions.source: It hangs from tree branches using its tail, even when it rests. It is skilled at using its gliding membrane to ride on even the weakest breezes and can swiftly navigate through the forest as it hunts.
decisions.target: 它以尾挂树枝，休息也一样。滑翔膜善借最微弱的风，狩猎时能迅速穿林。
decisions.revised: 它用尾巴挂在树枝上，连休息时也一样。善用滑翔膜，哪怕最弱的微风也能搭乘，狩猎时便能迅速穿行森林。

decisions.source: Only the flower of POKENAME is visible as it roots around through leaf litter for food. They are often trailed by swarms of Bug-Type Pokémon, the swarms drawn to POKENAME by the musty scent of their nectar.
decisions.target: POKENAME在落叶里翻食，只露花。花蜜霉潮的气味，常招来虫属性宝可梦大群跟随。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在落叶层里拱找食物，只有花朵露在外面。花蜜潮霉的气味，会引来大群虫属性宝可梦，跟在身后。

decisions.source: POKENAME are known to never have problems with overheating, but due to some of their software being heavily outdated, POKENAME tend to freeze up. It's been said that a full software update would take around 30 years to complete.
decisions.target: POKENAME从不过热，可部分软件极其陈旧，常会死机。据说，一次完整更新大约要30年。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从来没有过热问题，可部分软件严重过时，常会死机。据说，要完成一次全面的软件更新，大约需要30年。

decisions.source: POKENAME are almost always found with a twig in their beaks, which they slowly feed on. They will fight by igniting these twigs and waving them around, or they may toss aside their twigs and spit out fireballs.
decisions.target: POKENAME几乎总叼着小枝，慢慢啃。战斗时会点燃枝条挥舞，也可能丢开，改吐火球。
decisions.revised: POKENAME几乎总叼着一根细枝，慢慢啃食。战斗时，它们会点燃枝条挥舞，或丢开细枝，改为吐出火球。

decisions.source: POKENAME can run at a top speed of 60 km/h, and its punches are stronger than those of the best boxers. Humans have learned to not anger this mighty Pokémon. The tail does not hold much strength and is simply a decoy.
decisions.target: POKENAME时速最高60公里，拳力胜过最好的拳击手。人类已懂得别惹它。尾巴却不强，只是诱饵。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最高时速60千米，拳力胜过顶尖拳击手。人类已经明白，别去惹怒这只强大的宝可梦。尾巴力量不大，只是诱饵。

decisions.source: When POKENAME falls into a deep slumber, it gains the ability to listen to other sleeping Pokémon's dreams. If their dreams are actually nightmares, it'll feast upon them, allowing the suffering Pokémon to have a better night's sleep.
decisions.target: POKENAME进入深眠，便能听见其他熟睡宝可梦的梦。若是噩梦，它就吃掉，让受苦者睡得更好。
decisions.revised: POKENAME进入深眠后，便能聆听其他熟睡宝可梦的梦境。若听到的是噩梦，它就会将其吃掉，让受苦的宝可梦睡得更安稳。

decisions.source: POKENAME are the perfect mode of transportation when needing to travel during harsh storms since they can control lightning. However, due to how rare these Pokémon are and how low travel distance times are, affording to travel on one is a luxury.
decisions.target: POKENAME能控雷，是恶劣风暴中赶路的理想坐骑。可它稀有，路程又快，能负担乘坐，实属奢侈。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能控制雷电，是猛烈风暴中出行的理想坐骑。但它们稀少，旅途耗时又短，能坐它出行，实属奢侈。

decisions.source: The leaf on POKENAME's head and the leaf on its tail smell different. Nobody can agree what each smells like, however. One person may say one smells sweet and the other bitter, then the next person says they smell earthy and spicy.
decisions.target: POKENAME头叶与尾叶，气味不同，可没人说得一致。一个说甜与苦，下一个却说，像泥土与辛香。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上与尾巴的叶子，气味各不相同，可没人能说得一致。一个人说，这片甜、那片苦，下一个却说，闻着像泥土和辛香。

decisions.source: In the Johto region, people are known to collect POKENAME's slightly shed skin and dry it so it can be crumbled into a powder. Smoking this causes the user to see vivid dreams, with some saying that they can see the future.
decisions.target: 城都人会收集POKENAME脱落的皮，晒干碾粉，吸食后能看见鲜明梦境，有人声称见到了未来。
decisions.revised: 城都一带，人们会收集POKENAME零星蜕下的皮，干燥后碾成粉，再拿来当烟吸食。这会让吸食者看见鲜活的梦境，有人声称，甚至能看见未来。

decisions.source: When POKENAME is in the water, its wool sticks close to its body and becomes an insulating layer. When it leaves the water, its tail absorbs electricity, and causes its wool to stand on end, making it appear more than twice its size.
decisions.target: POKENAME入水，羊毛贴身，形成绝缘层。出水后，尾巴吸电，毛便根根炸起，看着比原本两倍还大。
decisions.revised: POKENAME入水时，羊毛紧贴身体，形成绝缘层。离水后，尾巴吸收电力，让羊毛根根竖起，看起来比原本两倍还大。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives in damp caverns. It dives into pools of water in search of prey, and sucks the blood out of anything it finds. The blood it draws from its prey is infused with the oil in its wings making them surprisingly buoyant.
decisions.target: POKENAME住湿洞，潜池找猎物，逮到什么就吸血。吸来的血与翼中油脂混合，带来惊人的浮力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在潮湿洞窟，潜入水池寻找猎物，找到什么就吸取其血。吸来的血混上翼内油脂，带来惊人的浮力。

decisions.source: By heating the air within its cotton-like shell, POKENAME can float in the wind to travel great distances. It seeks out barren areas, spreading seeds that it has picked up in its travels along with its slime, which helps promote plant growth.
decisions.target: POKENAME加热棉壳内空气，便能乘风远行。它找荒地，撒旅途收的种子与黏液，促进植物生长。
decisions.revised: POKENAME加热棉絮般外壳内的空气，便能随风远行。它们寻找荒地，将旅途收来的种子，连同黏液散出，帮助植物生长。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a cuddly and gentle giant despite its strength and size, but its tail is a bit rambunctious. It must be careful not to hold those it hugs too long, or the tail may try to bite them while in its embrace.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽高大强壮，却温柔爱抱，尾巴有点闹。抱人得注意别太久，免得尾巴趁拥抱咬对方。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽高大强壮，却是温柔又好抱的巨兽，尾巴倒有些闹腾。它得当心，别把对方抱得太久，免得尾巴在拥抱中咬到对方。

decisions.source: POKENAME possesses a swift swimming speed, being able to swim against the current of fast streams and rivers. However, when it is resting, it will utilize tiny hooks within its fins to latch onto a floating log and drift lazily down the waterway.
decisions.target: POKENAME游得快，能逆着湍急河溪前进。休息时却用鳍上小钩挂住浮木，懒洋洋地顺流漂下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME游得快，能逆着湍急河溪前进。休息时却用鳍上小钩挂住浮木，懒洋洋地顺流漂下。

decisions.source: The hotter its flame sac becomes, the more its tail will curl and the more embers will scatter with every flap of its wings. It will shoot out its tongue to ensnare its target and incinerate them with a torrent of fire.
decisions.target: 火囊越热，尾巴卷得越紧，每次振翼，火星也更多。它射舌缠住目标，再以火流烧成灰。
decisions.revised: 火囊越热，尾巴卷得越紧，每次振翅撒出的余烬也越多。它伸舌缠住目标，再以滚滚火流，将其烧成灰。

decisions.source: Large, metal feathers stuck in the ground are a common indicator of this Pokémon's territory. Their talons are sharp enough to pierce rock and their wings are strong enough to allow them to carry a Rhyhorn high into the air.
decisions.target: 地上插着大金属羽，常表示它的领地。脚爪利到能穿石，强翼足以带独角犀牛高飞。
decisions.revised: 地上插着的巨大金属羽，常是这种宝可梦领地的标记。它们的脚爪锋利得能穿岩，翅膀也够强，能将独角犀牛带上高空。

decisions.source: POKENAME's dense body and strong claws make it difficult to remove once it latches onto a creature to feed. Fortunately, its small size means it drains very little static electricity in order to sate its hunger, leaping off once it is full.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体密实、爪强，一攀上生灵取食，就难拉开。幸好个小，只吸少量静电就饱，随后跳走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体密实，爪子强健，一攀住生灵取食，就很难拉开。幸好个头小，吸少量静电就能填饱肚子，吃饱便会跳开。

decisions.source: POKENAME have long jaws that are strong enough to punch holes through walls of rock, which allows them to easily feed on minerals and ores. Their eyes can contract to change the range of their sight, which allows them to easily track foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME长颚强得能在岩壁穿洞，轻易吃到矿石。眼睛可收缩，改变视野范围，方便追踪敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的长颚强得能在岩壁凿出洞，轻松吃到矿物与矿石。眼睛能通过收缩，改变视野范围，方便追踪敌人。

decisions.source: Legends say that a great hero garbed in green has saved a faraway kingdom with the help of his powerful Pokémon. Even when it's dangerous to travel alone, one can always be assured of their safety with POKENAME in their party.
decisions.target: 传说绿衣英雄曾借强大宝可梦，拯救远方王国。即使独行危险，队中有POKENAME，也总能安心。
decisions.revised: 传说，一位绿衣英雄在自己强大宝可梦的帮助下，拯救了远方王国。即使独行有危险，只要POKENAME在队伍里，也总能确信安全。

decisions.source: POKENAME carry shards of ice on their backs that never seem to melt. They are also known for creating long, slippery paths made out of ice that they rely on to slide through the world, as their stocky limbs are heavy and stiff.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上冰片似乎永不融化。短粗肢体沉重僵硬，便造出长长的滑冰道，靠滑行四处走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背着似乎永不融化的冰片。四肢短粗、沉重又僵硬，它们便造出长长的滑溜冰路，靠滑行四处移动。

decisions.source: Its tough tusks are used to rummage through vegetation. It grabs its own loose leaves with its trunk and eats them, recycling nutrients while keeping its form unburdened so it can curl up at a moment's notice to roll over foes.
decisions.target: 硬牙翻找植被，象鼻则抓住自己的松叶吃，回收养分、保持轻便，随时蜷起碾过敌人。
decisions.revised: 它用坚韧的长牙翻找植被，再用象鼻抓住自身松脱的叶子吃，回收养分，让身体不受拖累，好随时蜷起，滚过敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a dominant predator of deep ocean trenches, using its light to surprise prey before devouring them in only a few bites. It is rare to see POKENAME near the ocean surface, but when one is found it is usually disoriented and defensive.
decisions.target: POKENAME是深海沟的优势猎手，以光突袭，再几口吞猎物。海面少见，若出现，多半迷向又戒备。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是深海沟中的捕猎霸主，用光突袭猎物，再几口吞食。海面附近极少见它；若发现，通常正迷失方向，满心戒备。

decisions.source: POKENAME gnaw down the spines of cacti in order to form the stems and bodies into dens for them to sleep within. If someone invades the den, the whole herd will combine their powers to regrow the spines and drive the intruder out.
decisions.target: POKENAME啃掉仙人掌刺，把茎与躯体作成睡巢。若遭入侵，整群便合力催生尖刺，赶走闯入者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME啃掉仙人掌的刺，把茎干改成睡觉的巢。若有谁闯入，整群便会合力催生尖刺，赶走入侵者。

decisions.source: POKENAME sucks the life energy out of others with its lips, so when it decides it wants to kiss someone, it hunts them down all night long, giving up only at dawn. If it realizes its makeup has been ruined, it runs away and disappears into the walls.
decisions.target: POKENAME用嘴唇吸取生命能量，想吻谁，就整夜追猎，到黎明才罢休。若发现妆花了，就会逃走，穿墙消失。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用嘴唇吸取生命能量，一旦想吻谁，就会整夜追猎，直到黎明才放弃。若发现妆花了，它便跑开，消失在墙里。

decisions.source: The shell upon its back is made of soil mixed with various metal minerals, and it hardens whenever it consumes water. Its jaw is so strong that it can bite through train track rails as if they were twigs; it will eat raw ores and refined metals.
decisions.target: 它背壳由土与多种金属矿物混成，饮水就硬。颚强到咬铁轨如咬小枝，原矿与精炼金属都吃。
decisions.revised: 它背上的壳，由土壤与多种金属矿物混成，每次饮水都会硬化。双颚强得咬断铁轨如同细枝，原矿和精炼金属都吃。

decisions.source: POKENAME flares up the fire around its neck to keep others at bay, as it has a rather standoffish personality. The only exception to this rule is its Trainer, for whom it happily retracts the burning ring of flame.
decisions.target: POKENAME性子疏离，扬起颈火，不让别人靠近。唯独训练家例外，它会开心地收回火环。
decisions.revised: POKENAME性子颇为冷淡，会扬起颈边火焰，不让旁人靠近。唯一例外是训练家，见到对方，它就会高高兴兴地收回火环。

decisions.source: POKENAME lurk near the surface of the water, using the plant growths on their back to disguise themselves amongst the reeds. It is advised to assume that there is always a POKENAME present, regardless of if you can see one.
decisions.target: POKENAME伏在水面附近，用背上植物，装成芦苇。无论是否看见，最好都当它始终在场。
decisions.revised: POKENAME潜伏在水面附近，用背上的植物，融入芦苇。无论看不看得见，最好都假定它一直就在附近。

decisions.source: When a POKENAME clamps down with its jaws, it will refuse to let go under any circumstances. It has a tendency to go after Fire-type Pokémon since their fire-based attacks help regulate POKENAME's cold-blooded body.
decisions.target: POKENAME颚一夹，无论如何都不肯松。它常追火属性，因为火招能给冷血的身体调温。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一旦咬住，无论如何都不肯松开。它是变温的宝可梦，常追逐火属性宝可梦，因为对方的火焰攻击能帮助调节体温。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body over-produces its poisons and silk, to the point it overflows from various points of its body. This, combined with its potent stench, makes it very difficult for it to socialize with others, making it lonesome.
decisions.target: POKENAME产毒、产丝过多，从身体各处溢出。加上恶臭，极难与别的生物交往，十分寂寞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体制造过多毒液和丝，从各处溢出。加上强烈恶臭，它很难与其他生灵交往，因此十分孤单。

decisions.source: The fur of an POKENAME is always warm to the touch, though it is also always crackling with static electricity. Still, many Trainers choose to endure this static for the sake of experiencing their soft, warm fur for themselves.
decisions.target: POKENAME毛始终暖暖，却也总有静电噼啪。许多训练家仍肯忍，只为亲手摸柔软暖毛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的毛摸起来始终温暖，却也总在噼啪放静电。许多训练家仍愿忍受静电，只为亲手感受柔软的暖毛。

decisions.source: If it sees someone trampling on a plant, POKENAME will chase after them until it manages to bite them. Although it looks menacing, it would rather spend its days tending to the flowers growing on its head than fighting.
decisions.target: POKENAME看见踩植物的人，就追到咬中为止。虽模样凶，更愿整天照料头花，而非战斗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME看见谁践踏植物，就会追个不停，直到咬中。模样虽吓人，它其实更愿整天照料头上的花，而非争斗。

decisions.source: POKENAME rely on their bulbous green fur to disguise them amongst bushes and shrubs while they sleep. If they're disturbed, they lash out with a Flamethrower at whoever roused them before finding a new place to hide away.
decisions.target: POKENAME睡时靠球状绿毛融入灌木。受扰就向唤醒者使出喷射火焰，再找新地方藏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME睡觉时，靠球团般的绿毛，融入灌木丛。受打扰，它就向惊醒自己的对象使出喷射火焰，再找新的藏身处。

decisions.source: When startled, POKENAME will camouflage itself and run away, leaving a trail of cotton seeds in the process. If this activity happens in a barren field, it may jumpstart a new ecosystem due to the new presence of plants.
decisions.target: POKENAME受惊就伪装逃走，沿途留棉种。若发生在荒田，新植物可能启动一套新生态。
decisions.revised: POKENAME受惊便会伪装、逃走，沿途留下棉种。若这发生在荒地，新出现的植物，可能让一套新生态由此兴起。

decisions.source: POKENAME hang from branches where plenty of sunlight shines. Their growth can get stunted if they do not receive enough sunlight, so some may opt to fall from the branches if it means reaching a sunny patch of grass.
decisions.target: POKENAME挂在日照足的枝上。光不够会发育不良，有些为到晴草地，宁可从枝头掉下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME挂在日照充足的树枝上。缺少阳光，生长就会受阻；为到达向阳的草地，有些个体可能选择从枝头落下。

decisions.source: POKENAME tightly packs balls of mud and scatters them all around its home. That way, when it feels threatened, it's always within easy reach of a mud-ball it can grab, set alight with fire breath, and throw.
decisions.target: POKENAME把泥球压紧，撒在家园各处。遇威胁，随时都能顺手抓起，借火息点燃，再扔出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME把泥团压成紧实的球，散布在家中各处。受到威胁，它随手就能抓到泥球，用火息点燃，再投掷出去。

decisions.source: POKENAME can change the color of their bodies to mimic that of a sunflower, standing still in fields of them to blend in. Once pollinators begin to wander too close, POKENAME use their sticky tongues to swiftly snatch them up.
decisions.target: POKENAME变成向日葵般的颜色，静站花田相融。传粉者一靠太近，就被黏舌迅速叼走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME变换体色，模仿向日葵，站定在花田里，融入其中。传粉者一靠得太近，它们便迅速伸出黏舌，抓住对方。

decisions.source: Using their powerful jaws, POKENAME eat every part of nuts, shells included, and break into trees to drink the sap within. The hues of their flesh change to match their surroundings the longer they live in a single area.
decisions.target: POKENAME强颚连坚果壳都吃，还咬开树，喝汁。久居同一地区，体色会逐渐与周围一致。
decisions.revised: POKENAME双颚强健，坚果连壳都吃，也会咬开树木，饮下树液。在同一地区住得越久，体色就越会渐渐贴近周围环境。

decisions.source: On nights when the moon is shining, POKENAME can be found digging through gardens in search of large root vegetables. If they find a tuber they prefer, they will swap it out, replanting their existing club in the soil.
decisions.target: 月夜，POKENAME翻花园，寻找大根菜。找到中意块茎，就换新的，把原来的棒重新栽进土。
decisions.revised: 有月光的夜里，POKENAME翻找花园，寻找块头大的根茎蔬菜。若找到中意的块茎，它就换作新的棍棒，把原来的那根重新种进土里。

decisions.source: The dance of an POKENAME is slow, yet methodical. Its subtle movements coerce orbs of ghostly energy to swirl around it as it dances. The spirit orbs then ignite with fire as they are hurled to attack its foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME舞慢而有条理，细微动作引幽灵能量球绕身。掷向敌人时，灵球便燃烧起来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME舞步缓慢，却很有章法。细微的动作引动幽灵能量球，绕着身体盘旋；投向敌人时，这些灵球便会燃起火焰。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends the night stuffing the bags it carries on its head with garbage to stay dirty and smelly. If someone tries to wash it clean, it bursts into tears and immediately searches for new filth to roll in.
decisions.target: POKENAME整夜往头上袋子塞垃圾，保持脏臭。谁想洗净，就哭出来，立刻另找污物打滚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME整夜往头上带着的袋子塞垃圾，保持脏臭。若有人试着洗净它，它就会大哭，立刻另找污物打滚。

decisions.source: If a human with a guilty conscience touches the sap dripping from a POKENAME, they will stick to its body and become trapped. The only way for them to be released from its clutches is by confessing their guilt.
decisions.target: 心中有愧的人碰POKENAME滴下的树汁，就会粘在身上受困。只有坦承过错，才能挣脱。
decisions.revised: 心中有愧的人，碰到POKENAME滴下的树液，便会黏在它身上，无法脱身。只有坦承自己的过错，才能获释。

decisions.source: Fields inhabited by POKENAME can often be smelled before they are seen. The heated nectar dripping from its mouth gives off a noxious odor resembling rotting sweets. This sticky substance is hot enough to leave burns on exposed skin.
decisions.target: POKENAME住的田野，常先闻臭、后看见。嘴滴热花蜜，像腐烂糖果，黏又烫，足以灼伤裸皮。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖居的田地，常在看见之前，就先闻到臭味。嘴里滴下的热花蜜，气味像腐败的甜食，黏稠又烫，足以灼伤裸露的皮肤。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in harmony with the mushrooms on their abdomen, as the mushrooms coat their electric webs with sticky spores that make it difficult for prey to escape. In return for this added stickiness, POKENAME share nutrients with the mushrooms.
decisions.target: POKENAME与腹菇和谐共处。蘑菇以黏孢子涂电网，让猎物难逃；作为回报，它分享养分。
decisions.revised: POKENAME与腹部的蘑菇和谐共生。蘑菇用黏孢子覆住带电蛛网，让猎物难逃；作为回报，POKENAME会与蘑菇分享养分。

decisions.source: POKENAME are incredibly combative should two of them meet in the wild. They strike at each other with the spades on their tails or by chucking heated sand at the other until one is forced to yield and retreat.
decisions.target: 两只野生POKENAME相遇，就极好斗。以尾铲敲击，或向对方抛热沙，直到一方屈服退走。
decisions.revised: 两只POKENAME若在野外相遇，就会斗得格外凶。它们用尾上的铲子敲打，或向对方抛掷热沙，直到一方被迫屈服、退走。

decisions.source: When POKENAME leaves its den at night to search for food, it scatters a silvery powder so it can always find its way home. It uses the venomous spine on its tail to defend itself from predators it encounters.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜里出巢觅食，沿途撒银粉，确保能找到归路。遇捕食者，就用尾上毒刺防身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜里出巢觅食，会沿途撒下银色粉末，确保总能找到归路。遇上捕食者，它就用尾上的毒刺防身。

decisions.source: POKENAME's tears act as a natural flame accelerant, which they have learned to use in crafty ways with their own flames. If their flame attacks ever seem to be ineffective, POKENAME will resort to swinging their bone club instead.
decisions.target: POKENAME的泪是天然助燃液，它学会巧妙配合自身火焰。若火攻不奏效，POKENAME便改挥骨棒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的眼泪是天然助燃剂，它学会将其与自身火焰巧妙配合。如果火焰攻击似乎不奏效，它便改为挥动骨棒。

decisions.source: Despite being a buoyant floatation aid, the gigantic ball at the end of the tails of POKENAME are extremely bulky and cumbersome. POKENAME carry the ball on their back in an effort to avoid getting caught on roots and vines.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾端的巨球虽有浮力，却笨重累赘。它会背到背上，免得卡在树根与藤蔓间。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾端的巨球虽能帮助浮水，却格外笨重累赘。它们背着球，免得卡在树根与藤蔓间。

decisions.source: Since the islands POKENAME live on are tiny and contain few trees, they must fly to and gather berries on islands far away. While they need all the berries they gather for themselves, they won't hesitate to share some with others who starve.
decisions.target: POKENAME所住岛小，树也少，须飞到远岛采果。虽然收获全是自己所需，却仍毫不犹豫，分给饥者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖居的小岛很小，树木稀少，因此得飞到远方岛屿，采集树果。虽然收来的果实全是自己所需，它们仍会毫不犹豫地分给挨饿的生灵。

decisions.source: The pleasant scent of POKENAME's flowers is calming to the spirits of both Pokémon and people. When in battle, it gives off an even stronger version of this scent to lower its opponents' guards, and then strikes mercilessly with its poisonous thorns.
decisions.target: POKENAME花香让人类与宝可梦安心。战斗时，却放更浓香，使敌人放松警惕，再用毒刺无情打击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME宜人的花香，能安抚人类与宝可梦的心灵。战斗时，它放出更浓的香气，使对手放松警惕，再用毒刺无情攻击。

decisions.source: On the bellies of these Pokémon, there is a black pattern that resembles a tiny Spinarak. POKENAME try to use this to appear smaller, but due to the flashy colors on their other body parts, this technique has proven to be mostly ineffective.
decisions.target: POKENAME腹部黑纹像只小圆丝蛛。它想借此显得更小，可其他部位颜色太鲜艳，这招大多无效。
decisions.revised: POKENAME腹部的黑色花纹，像一只小圆丝蛛。它们想借此显得更小，但其他部位的颜色太鲜艳，这项技巧大多没有效果。

decisions.source: POKENAME flies around land that it considers its territory to seek out prey. Once this Pokémon spots a target, it will dive from the sky before outstretching its taloned claws and dropkicking the foe. With its fresh catch, it returns to its nest.
decisions.target: POKENAME在自认的领地上空寻找猎物。看准目标就俯冲，伸出利爪，双脚飞踢，带着新收获回巢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞过自认属于自己的领地，寻找猎物。发现目标后，它便从高空俯冲，伸出利爪，以双脚飞踢敌人，再带着新猎获回巢。

decisions.source: POKENAME's antennae contain small amounts of electricity, able to briefly stun those hit by them. It can cause these antennae to flash on and off with a bright light, which it uses for communication or to signal others of its species for help.
decisions.target: POKENAME触角有少量电，能短暂电晕碰中的对象。它使触角明亮闪烁，用来沟通，或向同类求助。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的触角含有少量电力，击中目标，能使其短暂麻痹。它们还能让触角明亮地闪烁，用于交流，或向同类发出求助信号。

decisions.source: POKENAME emerge from lakes on the night of the full moon, gathering on the shore and linking hands with one another. They dance in a spiral pattern, each POKENAME taking a turn to start from the outside and dance to the centre of the spiral.
decisions.target: POKENAME满月夜从湖中出来，岸边聚集牵手，跳螺旋舞。每只轮流从最外侧开始，一路舞到中央。
decisions.revised: 满月之夜，POKENAME从湖中出来，在岸上聚集，彼此牵手，跳起螺旋状的舞。每只轮流从外侧起舞，一直跳到螺旋中心。

decisions.source: When it believes its group is in danger, POKENAME won't hesitate to hurl itself at its enemies, attempting to pierce them with the poisonous horn on its forehead. Its wings are so strong that they allow it to reach incredible speeds when diving.
decisions.target: POKENAME认定群体遇险，就毫不犹豫扑敌，试着用额上毒角刺穿。双翼极强，俯冲能达惊人速度。
decisions.revised: POKENAME若认为群体遇险，就会毫不犹豫地扑向敌人，试图用额上的毒角刺穿对方。双翼强健，让它俯冲时能达到惊人速度。

decisions.source: An electrical charge runs through the tail of POKENAME, which allows them to turn their tail tip into an anode and use their body as a cathode. This alternating charge allows them to turn water around them into gas bubbles, letting them move swiftly.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾中电流让尾尖作阳极，身体作阴极。这交替电荷把周围水变成气泡，让它快速移动。
decisions.revised: 电荷流过POKENAME的尾巴，让尾尖成为阳极，身体成为阴极。这种交替变化的电荷，能将周围的水化成气泡，帮助它迅速移动。

decisions.source: It uses big leaves or drifting wood to surf, a feat possible thanks to its light weight. POKENAME's ears and tails are like sails, helping them keep their balance when surfing, but often making them stumble on the ground when it's windy.
decisions.target: POKENAME体轻，能用大叶或浮木冲浪。耳与尾像帆，助水上平衡，可有风的陆地上，也常让它绊倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体轻，能拿大片叶子或浮木冲浪。耳朵和尾巴像帆，帮助保持平衡，可在刮风的陆地上，也常使它踉跄。

decisions.source: POKENAME lures other wild Pokémon toward it by releasing a distinctive aroma from the flower at the tip of its tail. Because it's very lazy, it uses its psychic powers to pick fruit from trees so it doesn't have to climb.
decisions.target: POKENAME用尾尖花朵的独特香气，引来野生宝可梦。它太懒，宁用精神力量摘树上果子，省得爬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从尾尖的花朵放出独特香气，引来野生宝可梦。它十分懒惰，便用超能力摘取树上的水果，省得攀爬。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be seen moving through desert wadis at night, prowling through the dried-out remains of the riverways as though in search of water. They disappear at the start of the rainy season and are not seen again until the water stops flowing.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜里游走沙漠干河谷，巡过枯水道，仿佛找水。雨季开始就消失，直到水不再流才重现。
decisions.revised: 夜里，POKENAME游走于沙漠干河谷，巡过枯干的旧河道，仿佛在找水。雨季一开始，它们就消失，直到河水停止流动，才会再现。

decisions.source: It is innately driven to dance the moment it hears music playing. It will even pull others in with it and expect them to dance with it; using its ribbon-like organs, it can even compel opponents to dance rather than to fight.
decisions.target: 音乐一响，它就本能地起舞，甚至拉人同跳。缎带状器官也能迫使对手跳舞，不再战斗。
decisions.revised: 它一听见音乐，就本能地起舞，还会把旁人拉进来，盼对方一起跳。缎带状的器官，甚至能迫使敌人放下战斗，转而跳舞。

decisions.source: POKENAME are suited to being trained by Ace Trainers thanks to their propensity to follow direction from those who are stronger. If they lose a fight, they grow sullen, encouraging their Trainer to rematch the Pokémon they lost to so they can win.
decisions.target: POKENAME倾向听从强者指挥，适合精英训练家培育。输了会闷闷不乐，催训练家再战，直到能赢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME倾向听从强者指挥，因此很适合精英训练家培养。输了，它们会闷闷不乐，催训练家与打败自己的那只宝可梦重赛，争取赢回来。

decisions.source: POKENAME prefer to wait for prey rather than hunt prey down; they lie in wait by clinging to the sides of trees. When potential prey draws near, they drop onto them with their bulky bodies and quickly slash at them with Leaf Blade attacks.
decisions.target: POKENAME宁愿守候，不愿追猎，便攀在树侧埋伏。猎物一近，就用笨重身体压下，迅速以叶刃劈砍。
decisions.revised: POKENAME宁愿守候猎物，也不想追猎，便攀在树干侧面埋伏。潜在猎物靠近，它们就用笨重的身体压下，迅速以叶刃劈砍。

decisions.source: POKENAME creates its smoke by feeding off of images of coals inside of computer systems. However, if it can't discern the image format of the picture of coal, it will refuse to eat the image even if it hasn't eaten in days.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃电脑系统里的煤炭图片，产生烟。但若认不出图片格式，哪怕几天没吃，也拒绝进食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠吃电脑系统里的煤炭图片，制造烟雾。但若认不出那张煤炭图的格式，哪怕数日未进食，它也不肯吃。

decisions.source: It is often seen looking up to the sky and staring for long times, as if there is something it senses. There are very few legends that claim this Pokémon is aware of something beyond our own solar system and that it is always monitoring for it.
decisions.target: 它常久久仰望天空，像感知到什么。极少数传说声称，它知道太阳系外的某种存在，始终在监视。
decisions.revised: 它常久久仰望天空，仿佛感知到了什么。极少数传说声称，这种宝可梦知晓太阳系外的某种存在，始终在留意。

decisions.source: This Pokémon flies in search of stronger foes. Not even a fierce thunderstorm will bar its path. When it releases all of its electricity, the orb on its tail can glow bright enough to be seen miles away.
decisions.target: 它飞行寻找更强敌人，猛烈雷雨也挡不住。全放电时，尾球亮到数英里外可见。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦飞行四方，寻找更强的敌人，猛烈的雷雨也挡不住前路。放出全部电力时，尾上的球能亮到数英里外都看得见。

decisions.source: POKENAME hides in the bushes, waiting for someone to pass by so it can jump out and scare them. However, if it can't find a large enough bush, it will comically try to hide behind small trees and shrubs.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏灌木，等人经过，跳出来吓。若找不到够大的，就滑稽地试躲小树与矮灌木后。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏在灌木里，等人经过，便跃出来吓唬。但找不到够大的灌木时，它就会滑稽地试着躲在小树、矮灌木后。

decisions.source: The flower on POKENAME's head is naturally white, but it prefers to paint it—usually with the yellow paint from its tail. It can often be seen painting other flowers, as it only seems to like the color yellow.
decisions.target: POKENAME头花本白，却爱涂色，通常用尾上黄颜料。常见它也涂别的花，似乎只喜欢黄色。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上的花本来是白色，它却喜欢涂色，通常用尾上的黄色颜料。人们常见它给其他花涂色，因为它似乎只爱黄色。

decisions.source: POKENAME are commonly found floating along the water's surface during warmer months. They swim together against the current in an effort to remain in place, creating the illusion of a field of flowers in the rivers they call home.
decisions.target: 温暖月份，POKENAME常沿水面漂。它们一同逆流游，努力留原地，让家乡河流看着像花田。
decisions.revised: 温暖的月份，POKENAME常漂在水面。它们一起逆流游动，努力停在原位，让栖居的河流，看上去仿佛一片花田。

decisions.source: POKENAME lets the fur on its back grow out to copious levels so it can act as a place of storage. It stows away stolen morsels in the fur, so it always has a snack it can shake loose later.
decisions.target: POKENAME任背毛长得极茂密，当成储藏处，藏入偷来的小食。往后随时抖一抖，就有零食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME任背毛长得极其茂密，当作储藏处。它把偷来的小食藏进去，往后只消抖一抖，随时都有零嘴。

decisions.source: POKENAME's blue tongue secretes a poisonous saliva. This fluid is so potent that a single drop is strong enough to hospitalize a fully grown adult. If POKENAME has to fight at range, it will launch fiery attacks at its opponents.
decisions.target: POKENAME蓝舌分泌毒唾液，强到一滴就能让成年人住院。若须远攻，则向对手发射火焰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的蓝舌会分泌有毒唾液，毒性强得一滴就能让成年人住院。需要远距离交战时，它便用火焰攻击对手。

decisions.source: POKENAME get all of their needed nutrients from eating minerals and can even eat soil as well. The colors of their bodies can change to conceal themselves, though the shades of their hues seem to be influenced by their diets.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃矿物就能取得全部养分，连土也可吃。身体变色藏身，色调似乎受饮食影响。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吃矿物，就能取得所需的全部养分，甚至也能吃土。它们能变换体色藏身，具体色调却似乎受饮食影响。

decisions.source: POKENAME utilize their ability to change the pigments of their own bodies to match their surroundings and remain hidden as they rest. Because they rest for over half of a day, they are often accidentally stepped on and tripped over.
decisions.target: POKENAME改变身体色素，融入环境休息。每天休息超过半天，因此常被人不慎踩中、绊到。
decisions.revised: POKENAME改变身上色素，融入周围环境休息。休息时间超过半天，因此它们常被无意踩中，也常绊倒来者。

decisions.source: Berry juice sourced from POKENAME was once said to grant those who drink it eternal life. Though debunked in current times, frenzied hunts for the species in the past have led to it being scarcely seen in the wild nowadays.
decisions.target: POKENAME的树果汁，曾被说能使人永生。如今虽已证伪，过去疯狂猎捕，却让野外极少见。
decisions.revised: 曾有人说，POKENAME产的树果汁，能让饮者永生。如今说法虽已证伪，过去的疯狂猎捕，却让它们在野外难得一见。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very long-lived Pokémon with the figure of a shadowy Pokémon biting upon their tails. They constantly forget that these shadowy Pokémon even exist, which seems to infuriate them and make them bite even harder.
decisions.target: POKENAME长寿，尾上咬着暗影宝可梦。它总忘了对方存在，似乎因此惹恼对方，咬得更重。
decisions.revised: POKENAME寿命长，尾巴被一团宝可梦般的黑影咬着。它们总忘记黑影的存在，似乎因此惹恼对方，使其咬得更用力。

decisions.source: The horns on POKENAME's head drip with a poison highly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. While not normally overtly aggressive, the presence of Dragon types sends it into an angry rage, aiming to poison them almost on sight.
decisions.target: POKENAME头角滴毒，对龙属性极有效。平常不算太凶，遇龙却暴怒，几乎一看见就要毒倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上的角滴着毒液，对龙属性宝可梦极其有效。平时不算特别凶暴，可一有龙属性在场，它便暴怒，几乎一见到就想使对方中毒。

decisions.source: POKENAME are a long-lived species that favor nesting within deep caverns rich in minerals and ores. Their bodies are harder than tungsten and remarkably heavy, yet they can move quite well, which indicates they are quite strong as well.
decisions.target: POKENAME长寿，偏爱矿物丰富的深洞。身体硬过钨，也极重，却活动自如，显示力量也很大。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是长寿的物种，偏爱在富含矿物、矿石的深洞筑巢。身体比钨更硬，也重得惊人，却仍能自如移动，说明力气同样很大。

decisions.source: The pearl that POKENAME produces when it's created is so valuable that it is worth more than quintuple the price of the most expensive ore. Nobody has dared to obtain its pearl due to the space-distorting abilities of POKENAME.
decisions.target: POKENAME诞生时产生的珍珠，价值超过最贵矿石的五倍。因它能扭曲空间，无人敢去拿。
decisions.revised: POKENAME诞生时产出的珍珠，价值超过最昂贵矿石的五倍。因它能扭曲空间，还从未有人敢去取这颗珍珠。

decisions.source: POKENAME spend the day sleeping in a very shallow burrow, fanning their tail leaves out above the surface so they can photosynthesise as they rest. At night, they emerge and wander in search of food and a new resting burrow.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天睡在浅洞，尾叶在地表摊开，睡着也能光合。夜里出土，找食物与新洞休息。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天睡在极浅的地洞，尾叶在地面上摊开，休息时也能光合。夜里，它们出洞游荡，寻找食物与新的睡处。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME are drawn to polluted lakes and ponds, seemingly trying to clean them by feasting upon the waste floating in them. Unfortunately, their own bodies are so toxic they often add a different form of pollution to the water.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME受污染池湖吸引，似想吞浮垃圾清水。可身体太毒，往往又添另一种污染。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME被受污染的湖泊、池塘吸引，吞吃漂浮的废物，似乎想将水清理干净。可身体毒性太强，它们往往又给水添上另一种污染。

decisions.source: POKENAME inhabits heavily polluted lakes, cleaning them by feeding on the refuse and garbage. As it consumes the pollution, its graceful body takes on additional aspects of the detritus, in turn causing people to be repulsed by the habitat savior.
decisions.target: POKENAME住重污染湖，吞废物清水。可优雅身体越吃越像垃圾，反让人厌弃这栖地救星。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在重度污染的湖泊，靠吃废物、垃圾清理水域。可越吸收污染，优雅的身体越带上杂物的特征，让人们反而厌弃这位栖地救星。

decisions.source: POKENAME will use the healing power of its leaves to cure the sickness of anyone who puts a hand into its mouth. Be careful though, as it may drop the axe on its head and take their hand off instead.
decisions.target: POKENAME用叶中疗愈力量，医治将手伸嘴的人。可要小心，头上斧可能落下，反将手斩掉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用叶片的疗愈力量，给把手伸进嘴中的人治病。可得小心，头上的斧头可能落下，反而将手斩掉。

decisions.source: Under the light of the full moon, POKENAME sap is applied to decorative wooden sculptures as a special lacquer to make the works of art glow. Monthly art exhibitions showcase the powerful glow of POKENAME sap to raise money for reforestation.
decisions.target: 满月下，POKENAME树汁当特殊漆，涂木雕使其发光。每月艺术展展示强光，筹款植树造林。
decisions.revised: 满月下，人们将POKENAME的树液当作特殊漆，涂在装饰木雕上，使作品发光。每月的艺术展展示树液的强光，为恢复森林筹款。

decisions.source: POKENAME's hearing is strong enough that it can sense the faint drip of honey and sap moving beneath tree bark. This lets it seek out the freshest sources for it to dig up using the horn on its head.
decisions.target: POKENAME连树皮下，蜜与树汁流动的微响也听到。能找到最新鲜的来源，再以头角刨取。
decisions.revised: POKENAME听觉敏锐，连树皮下蜜与树液流动的细响，也能察觉。它能据此找到最新鲜的来源，再用头上的角挖取。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a diet consisting solely of coal, which they grind down and burn inside themselves to generate an immense amount of energy. POKENAME can use the soot released from within to obscure the sky, giving them an advantage in battle.
decisions.target: POKENAME只吃煤，在体内磨碎燃烧，产生巨大能量。POKENAME能用排出的煤灰遮天，取得战斗优势。
decisions.revised: POKENAME只以煤为食，在体内磨碎、燃烧，产生巨大能量。排出的烟尘能遮住天空，为它们争取战斗优势。

decisions.source: POKENAME scare away Pokémon that eat rocks by slamming a bone club against their thick skull helmet. They always carry this club wherever they go and hug this bone when they sleep to ensure it does not get lost.
decisions.target: POKENAME拿骨棒敲厚头盔，吓退吃岩石的宝可梦。走到哪都带着，睡觉也抱住，免得弄丢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用骨棒敲击自己厚厚的头骨盔，吓退吃岩石的宝可梦。走到哪里，它都带着这根棒，睡觉也抱住，确保不丢。

decisions.source: POKENAME sleeps for 18 hours a day, but when it is awake, all efforts focuse on finding food for its huge appetite. Due to the abundant psychic powers supercharging its metabolism, this Pokémon can eat as much food as it wants and never gain weight.
decisions.target: POKENAME每天睡18小时，醒来便全力找吃的，满足巨胃。强大超能力催动代谢，让它吃再多也不会胖。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每天睡18小时，醒来就全力找食，满足旺盛的食欲。丰沛的超能力大大加快代谢，让它想吃多少就吃多少，体重也不会增加。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in shallow ponds, diving as deep as they can if they feel like they're in danger. If their escape fails, they become agitated, fluttering their fins and flopping out of the water in an effort to get from one pond to another.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在浅池，遇险便尽量深潜。若逃不掉，就烦躁地扑鳍，跃出水面，想从这一池，扑到另一池。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在浅池，觉得有危险，就尽量往深处潜。若逃离失败，它们便烦躁地扇动鳍，扑腾出水，想换到另一个池塘。

decisions.source: Although it would be assumed this fusion would bring the genetic framework of POKENAME closer to that of Mew's, it has achieved the opposite effect. This Pokémon is considered dangerous and it is encouraged that a report be made if one is spotted.
decisions.target: 原以为融合会让POKENAME基因构造，更近梦幻，结果却适得其反。它被视为危险，若发现，最好通报。
decisions.revised: 人们可能以为，这种融合让POKENAME的基因构造更接近梦幻，实际却恰好相反。它被视为危险，若发现它，最好通报。

decisions.source: POKENAME propels itself at speed using the thrust generated by the flames it can blast from the vents at the back of its shell. It only emerges when it needs to feed, as it lives in constant fear of the predators lurking in its territory.
decisions.target: POKENAME从壳后喷口猛喷火，借推力高速前进。它始终害怕领地中潜伏的猎手，只有觅食才出来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从壳后排气孔喷出火焰，借推力高速前进。它始终害怕领地内潜伏的捕食者，只有需要进食，才肯出来。

decisions.source: POKENAME's wings are too small for it to fly faster than most of its prey, so it uses its wings to generate Air Slashes that it reinforces with electricity from its cheek pouches. These attacks are powerful enough to cut down even large trees.
decisions.target: POKENAME翼太小，飞不过多数猎物，便用翼造空气斩，再加颊囊电力。这攻击强得，连大树也能砍倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME翅膀太小，飞得不如大多数猎物快，便用翅膀掀出空气斩，再以颊囊电力加强。攻击强得连大树也能斩倒。
