decisions.source: Herds of this Pokémon can be spotted by lakes, feasting on grass and berries or floating in water for recreation. Its wool loses its waterproof properties over time, so it must be routinely trimmed, lest mold start to grow in its woolen coat.
decisions.target: 它们常在湖边成群，吃草树果，或浮水取乐。毛渐失防水性，须定期剪，不然毛衣里会发霉。
decisions.revised: 湖边常能看见成群的这种宝可梦，吃草、吃树果，或浮在水中取乐。羊毛会渐渐失去防水性，必须定期修剪，否则毛层会发霉。

decisions.source: When threatened, POKENAME will often use its ability to curl its upper body up into a ball that is impervious to attack from all sides, even if knocked off its feet. It will remain like this until whatever was attacking it gives up and leaves.
decisions.target: POKENAME受威胁，常将上身蜷成球，四面都攻不透，掀倒也一样。它始终保持，直到攻击者放弃、离开。
decisions.revised: 受到威胁时，POKENAME常将上身蜷成四面攻不透的球，哪怕被掀倒，也不影响防护。它会一直这样，直到攻击者放弃、离开。

decisions.source: When it feels threatened, POKENAME manifests a likeness of ears and six tails on its body using its internal energy. This is a warning to others, and failure to adhere to it will cause it to release more of its stored-up firepower on them.
decisions.target: POKENAME受威胁，以体内能量显出耳朵与六尾形貌，警告旁人。若不听，就释放更多储存火力攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME感到威胁，就用体内能量，在身上显出耳朵和六条尾巴的形象，警告旁人。不理会警告者，就会遭到更多积蓄火力的攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME constantly chews through trees and wood with its two front teeth, then digests them with the enzymes that cover its body. Its shell is a byproduct of the wood it digests, and large colonies of this Pokémon can be found damming up rivers.
decisions.target: POKENAME不断以双门牙啃穿树木，再用覆体酶消化。壳是消化木头的副产物，大群聚在河中筑坝。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不断用两颗门牙啃穿树木，再以覆在身体上的酶消化。壳是消化木头产生的副产物，人们常见大群个体拦河筑坝。

decisions.source: This Pokémon will let none, save for the very few it ever chooses, ride upon its back. It is able to walk upon the air itself, its majestic mane of flames casting an awe-inspiring visage as it trots through and beyond clouds.
decisions.target: 除亲自选中的极少数外，谁也不能骑背。它能踏空行走，穿过云层时，威严火鬃令人敬畏。
decisions.revised: 它只允许亲自选中的极少数骑在背上。它能踏空轻跑，穿行云中云外时，壮丽的火焰鬃毛，形成令人敬畏的景象。

decisions.source: POKENAME's claws are clad in many layers of solid ice to further reinforce them, allowing them to easily cut through solid rock in search of minerals to eat. It maintains the ice on its body with a freezing gas it produces within its gut.
decisions.target: POKENAME爪上裹多层硬冰，更加坚固，轻易切开硬岩，寻找矿物吃。腹内产生的冻气，维持身体冰层。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的爪子裹着多层坚冰，更加坚固，能轻松切开岩石，寻找矿物吃。腹内产生的寒冷气体，维持着身上的冰层。

decisions.source: POKENAME is said to have evolved after they discovered a large patch of garbage floating in the middle of the ocean. It has begun taking in the trash as part of its body, much to the delight of itself and the disgust of its Trainer.
decisions.target: 据说POKENAME找到海中大垃圾带后才进化，开始将垃圾融入身体。自己高兴，训练家却恶心不已。
decisions.revised: 据说，POKENAME是在大洋中央，发现大片漂浮垃圾后进化的。它开始将垃圾融入身体，自己乐在其中，训练家却嫌恶不已。

decisions.source: Very sneaky and sly, POKENAME remains immobile and pretends to be a normal tree until it is time to hunt. It waits for unsuspecting prey to turn their back, before its roots launch it at blindingly-fast speeds to chomp down on its next meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME狡猾隐秘，平时不动，装普通树。等猎物没戒心地背过身，根便将它极速弹出，咬住下一餐。
decisions.revised: POKENAME狡猾隐秘，一动不动地假扮普通树，直到狩猎时刻。等无戒备的猎物背过身，根部便将它飞快弹射出去，一口咬住下一餐。

decisions.source: POKENAME rests in the shallows of rivers, sleeping for days at a time. When it wakes up, it often finds a thin layer of mud has formed over it. It uses its long tongue to lick the mud off, but this often exhausts it, causing it to fall back asleep.
decisions.target: POKENAME在河流浅水休息，一睡几天。醒来常发现身上覆了薄泥，便用长舌舔净，可这又常累得它重新睡去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在河流浅水休息，一睡几天。醒来常发现身上覆了薄泥，便用长舌舔净，可这又常累得它重新睡去。

decisions.source: POKENAME drift around at sea, as their fins are small and are easily washed away by currents. The fin on their head is often mistaken for a crown, and they spit out ink when in danger.
decisions.target: POKENAME的鳍小，常被海流冲着漂遍海上。头鳍容易被误当王冠，遇险则会吐墨。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的鳍小，容易被海流卷走，因此漂游海上。头上的鳍常被认作王冠，遇险时，它们会喷出墨汁。

decisions.source: POKENAME lazes around all day, not seeming to care about whatever is currently going on around it. Though it is lazy, it is also known to be an excellent climber, often seen climbing massive trees just to gather fruits and berries.
decisions.target: POKENAME整天懒躺，似乎毫不关心周遭。虽懒，却是攀爬高手，常为采水果与树果，爬上巨树。
decisions.revised: POKENAME整天懒散地躺着，似乎毫不在意周围发生的事。虽懒，却也是攀爬高手，常爬上巨树，只为采集水果和树果。

decisions.source: POKENAME sing a serene melody as they fly, small pieces of their cotton-like plumage gently fluttering below them. They can fly quickly across long distances and have been known to carry others, even if they have not yet been tamed.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞时，唱平静旋律，小片棉羽轻轻落下。它们能长途快飞，甚至尚未驯服，也曾载人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞行时，唱着安宁的旋律，棉絮般的羽毛小片，在下方轻轻飘落。它们能长途快飞，甚至尚未驯服时，也曾载过其他生灵。

decisions.source: The honey that POKENAME produce has no consistent flavor and varies depending on the individual POKENAME that are part of the nest. While this does make their honey difficult to sell, some small markets do offer them as a "mystery flavor" product.
decisions.target: POKENAME蜂蜜的味道不固定，随巢里个体而异。虽难卖，有些小市场，却当作“神秘口味”出售。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的蜂蜜味道不固定，会随巢里有哪些成员而变。虽说因此难卖，有些小市场仍将它当作“神秘口味”产品出售。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to drink nectar from flowers, so they're usually covered in pollen. In an emergency, POKENAME can shake off the pollen in its fur and use the cloud as a surface to cast its illusions.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱喝花蜜，通常沾满花粉。紧急时，它抖掉毛中花粉，借花粉云施展幻象。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱喝花蜜，通常沾满花粉。紧急时，它会抖落毛中的花粉，以这团花粉云为表面，投映幻象。

decisions.source: POKENAME are fond of berries and can be found hiding within orchards, waiting for nightfall to steal the fruit away. They use their psychic powers to alter the genes of their food, transforming the berries into different species before eating them.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱树果，藏在果园，等天黑偷走。吃前，它用精神力量改基因，让果子变成不同种类。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜爱树果，藏在果园里，等天黑便偷走。它们用超能力改变食物的基因，让树果变成不同种类，再吃下。

decisions.source: The leaves on POKENAME's body help it camouflage amongst the jungle leaves while hunting for prey. If it has an abundance of energy in its body, its leaves will glow with a vibrant green light.
decisions.target: POKENAME猎食时，用身叶混在丛林叶间，伪装自己。体内能量多，叶就会发鲜绿光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME捕猎时，靠身上的叶片，融入丛林枝叶，伪装自己。体内能量充裕，叶子就会发出鲜亮的绿光。

decisions.source: The intensity of POKENAME's flames is directly tied to the level of harmony between its heads. When all three get along and agree on a course of action, the fire becomes a white-hot inferno.
decisions.target: POKENAME火势，直接取决于三头和谐程度。相处好、行动一致，就会化作白热烈火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME火焰的强度，与各头之间的和谐程度直接相关。三个头相处融洽、行动一致时，烈焰就会炽热到发白。

decisions.source: When angered, this Pokémon will start furiously shooting off the red-hot spikes along its shell and spewing scalding water from its mouth. Steam can often be seen rising from all over its body when it finally tires out.
decisions.target: 生气，它便疯狂发射壳上灼红尖刺，嘴里喷烫水。终于累坏，全身却常还升着蒸汽。
decisions.revised: 生气时，这种宝可梦会疯狂发射壳上烧得通红的尖刺，同时从嘴里喷出滚烫热水。等它终于筋疲力尽，常能看见全身腾起蒸汽。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their tough claws to tunnel through cave walls and to weave their silk webbing into webs. They will lurk upon the ceilings of caves and drop, with their sharp quills aimed down, upon prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME用坚爪凿穿洞壁，也用来织网。它潜伏洞顶，瞄准猎物，让锐刺朝下坠落。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用坚爪钻透洞壁，也用来将丝线织成网。它们潜伏在洞顶，发现猎物，便让锐刺朝下，朝对方坠落。

decisions.source: POKENAME weave simple webs that they use to capture air bubbles, taking these air bubbles with them underwater so that they can breathe. They are slow-moving in the water, their shell making their movements cumbersome.
decisions.target: POKENAME织简单的网兜住气泡，带到水下呼吸。壳使行动笨重，在水里移动缓慢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME织简单的网兜住气泡，带到水下呼吸。壳使行动笨重，在水里移动缓慢。

decisions.source: POKENAME treads along the sea floor, picking at small fish and clams to consume. Its large claw is coated with a sticky webbing that ensures once it grabs something, there will be no escaping its grip.
decisions.target: POKENAME沿海底走，捡小鱼与蛤蜊吃。大钳涂着黏网，一抓到就绝无脱逃的可能。
decisions.revised: POKENAME沿海底走动，挑取小鱼和蛤蜊吃。大钳上覆着黏丝网，一旦抓住什么，就绝无挣脱可能。

decisions.source: Although many kinds of Pokémon dwell in the forests that POKENAME resides in, it generally goes out of its way to avoid any kind of confrontation while gathering nectar, likely due to its inability to properly control its electric powers.
decisions.target: POKENAME所住森林虽有许多宝可梦，采蜜时却总刻意避开冲突，可能因为还控不好电力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖居的森林，虽有许多其他宝可梦，它们采蜜时，却通常会刻意避开任何冲突，多半因为控制不好自身电力。

decisions.source: A POKENAME can only ride on its tail for a small period of time before getting tired due to its weak psychic powers. This usually results in POKENAME resting in the sun in order to restore energy.
decisions.target: POKENAME精神力量弱，骑着尾巴行动不久就累，通常只好晒太阳休息，恢复能量。
decisions.revised: POKENAME超能力弱，只能骑着尾巴行动一小会儿，就会疲倦。这通常让它转去阳光下休息，恢复能量。

decisions.source: POKENAME make popular messengers due to their ability to sense the best routes on their travels. It is advised not to ask them to deliver anything too shiny, as they may get distracted and try to keep the objects for themselves.
decisions.target: POKENAME能感知最佳路线，是热门信使。最好别请它送太亮的东西，免得分心，想占为己有。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能感知旅途中的最佳路线，是受欢迎的信使。但最好别托它送太闪亮的东西，它可能分心，想据为己有。

decisions.source: The bubbling green goo on POKENAME's body becomes intensely hot while it is gazing into the future. It does this to protect itself during its visions, ensuring that no one can get too close during these moments of intense focus.
decisions.target: POKENAME预见未来时，身上冒泡的绿胶变得极热，以此自保。高度专注期间，谁也靠不太近。
decisions.revised: POKENAME窥见未来时，身上冒泡的绿色黏液，会变得极热。它借此自保，确保高度专注时，谁也无法靠得太近。

decisions.source: POKENAME herds roam across grassy meadows together, the bulk of the herd feeding whilst a handful of POKENAME patrol for danger. The guard POKENAME communicate with one another through flashes of their tail lights, banding together against threats.
decisions.target: POKENAME群在草地漫游，多数吃草，少数巡危险。守卫用尾灯闪光沟通，合力应敌。
decisions.revised: 成群的POKENAME一同漫游草甸，大部分成员进食，少数则巡查危险。守卫用尾灯闪光彼此联络，合力抵御威胁。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon with the ability to carry very heavy objects with its talons. It builds hardy nests that are strong enough to bear both its weight and that of its offspring.
decisions.target: POKENAME很强壮，利爪能搬极重的东西。巢也结实，足够承受自己与后代的重量。
decisions.revised: POKENAME很强壮，利爪能搬极重的东西。它搭建的巢也结实，足够承受自己与后代的重量。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their broad petals to glide from place to place, catching updrafts and spinning gently in the wind. They use their feathered tail to guide and stabilise themselves when they want to travel large distances.
decisions.target: POKENAME用宽花瓣乘上升气流滑翔，在风中轻旋。远行时，羽尾负责引导和稳定。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠宽大花瓣，借上升气流滑翔各处，在风中轻轻旋转。长途旅行时，它们用长羽的尾巴指引方向、稳定身体。

decisions.source: POKENAME clips small clumps of its wool to store within its claws. This way, when it opens them next in battle, its foe will be caught off-guard by the sudden bolts of lightning released from the highly charged wool within.
decisions.target: POKENAME剪小毛团存进钳中。下一次战中张钳，高度带电的毛突然放雷，打敌人措手不及。
decisions.revised: POKENAME剪下小团羊毛，藏进钳子里。下次在战斗中张钳，高度带电的羊毛，便会突然放出雷电，打敌人一个措手不及。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves to dance atop lily pads, leaning down to scoop up water with its hat. Once filled to the brim, it'll swim onto land, letting bird Pokémon perch on the sides to take a drink while it dances.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱站睡莲叶跳舞，俯身用帽舀水。装满就游上岸，边舞边让鸟宝可梦停在帽沿喝。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱在睡莲叶上跳舞，俯身用帽子舀水。装满后，它便游上岸，边跳舞，边让鸟类宝可梦停在帽沿喝水。

decisions.source: If it comes across parched areas within the forests where it lives, it instantly makes it rain by vibrating the antenna on its head. POKENAME is fond of Bluk Berries; sometimes it even walks for days on end in search of bushes that bear that variety.
decisions.target: POKENAME在家乡森林遇干地，立刻振头触角降雨。它很爱墨莓果，有时连走数天，找结这种果的灌木。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在栖居森林里遇到干燥地区，就立刻振动头上的触角，唤来雨水。它很爱墨莓果，有时连走数天，只为找结这种果的灌木。

decisions.source: POKENAME aggressively hop back and forth while waving their leaves to try and scare intruders off of their territory. Unfortunately, the motion of their leaves in the wind causes their light bodies to lift off of the ground and blow away.
decisions.target: POKENAME来回猛跳、挥叶，想吓退领地入侵者。可叶片在风中摆动，反把轻身体托起，吹走了。
decisions.revised: POKENAME来回猛跳，挥舞叶片，试图吓退领地入侵者。然而，叶片随风摆动，反把轻盈的身体托离地面，吹了出去。

decisions.source: When hungry, POKENAME floats over to the nearest flower patch by riding the breeze. After gorging itself on the flowers, it is grounded until it digests, as the binge-eating makes it too heavy to float.
decisions.target: POKENAME饿了就乘风去最近花丛。吃得过饱便沉重，得待地上消化，才能再浮起。
decisions.revised: POKENAME饿了，便乘微风漂向最近的花丛。大吃花朵后，身体重得无法浮起，只能待在地上，直到消化后，再次升空。

decisions.source: When POKENAME leaps out of the rivers it calls home, it flings out one of the pollen orbs on its tail towards the river-line. The pollen aids in plant growth, so rivers with POKENAME in it tend to be bordered by plenty of robust, colorful flowers.
decisions.target: POKENAME跃出家乡河流，便把一颗尾上花粉球抛岸边。花粉促生长，因此所在河岸常开满健壮彩花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME跃出栖居的河流时，会将尾上的一颗花粉球抛向岸边。花粉有助植物生长，因此这些河畔，常遍布繁盛鲜艳的花。

decisions.source: POKENAME is an extremely lazy creature that sleeps at least 16 hours a day. To avoid fighting other Pokémon, it tends to rest hidden in small abandoned burrows dug by other Pokémon before its arrival.
decisions.target: POKENAME极懒，每天至少睡16小时。为避战，常住其他宝可梦挖好、已经废弃的小洞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME极其懒惰，每天至少睡16小时。为避免交战，它常藏进其他宝可梦早先挖好、如今废弃的小洞里休息。

decisions.source: POKENAME is happy to ferry passengers along the water, but it is rather scatterbrained. It will often need to be reminded repeatedly of where it is supposed to go so that it doesn't wander off.
decisions.target: POKENAME乐意载人过水，却十分健忘，常得一再提醒目的地，免得游着游着跑偏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME乐于在水上载客，却相当迷糊。常得一遍遍提醒目的地，免得它游着游着跑偏。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends most of its time standing in water, with only its petals, neck, and head above the surface. Other Pokémon gather around it, but it is unknown if they are listening to its cries or are simply drawn in by its flower's fragrance.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多站在水里，只露花瓣、颈和头。其他宝可梦聚来，不知是在听叫声，还是单纯被花香吸引。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大部分时间站在水里，只露出花瓣、脖子和头。其他宝可梦聚在周围，尚不清楚是来听叫声，还是单被花香吸引。

decisions.source: The smaller head contains an organ which produces noxious fumes which POKENAME uses to fend off foes. The larger head has to hold its breath while doing so, as it can't stand the smell any more than its foes can.
decisions.target: 小头的器官产生毒烟，让POKENAME驱敌。大头此时得憋气，因为和敌人一样，也受不了臭味。
decisions.revised: 小头里有个产生有害烟气的器官，POKENAME借此驱敌。大头此时得屏住呼吸，因为它和敌人一样，也受不了那气味。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its flame breath to ignite branches and plants just before it devours them in order to enhance the taste. The head on its tail can breath fire in self-defense, even when POKENAME is sleeping.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃枝叶前，先用吐息点燃，增添风味。即使睡着，尾上的头也能喷火自卫。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吞食枝条与植物前，会先用火焰吐息点燃，增添风味。即使POKENAME睡着，尾上的头也能喷火自卫。

decisions.source: The head on the tail of POKENAME is used as a decoy when threatened. This head can be dropped, upon which it will thrash around. A new head will be regrown in a matter of days.
decisions.target: POKENAME遇威胁，用尾巴上的头作诱饵，还能脱落，落下后乱甩。新头几天便长回。
decisions.revised: POKENAME受威胁时，会用尾上的头作诱饵。这颗头可以脱落，落下后还会猛烈扭动，几天内便会再生出新头。

decisions.source: Due to the unique texture, POKENAME makes a soft crackling noise with every flap of its wings. Sentret are known to enjoy gnawing on these crunchy scales when they shed and fall to the forest floors.
decisions.target: POKENAME翅膀质地独特，每拍一下就轻轻噼啪响。尾立爱啃脱落林地的脆鳞片。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的翅膀质地独特，每次拍动，都会发出轻轻的噼啪声。尾立很爱啃食这些脱落到林地上的脆鳞片。

decisions.source: The shape of POKENAME's head protects it from flying Pokémon that would otherwise predate on it but restricts their field of view. They are very clumsy when walking on land and prefer to spend their time in muddy water, looking up at the sky.
decisions.target: POKENAME头形能挡住想捕食的飞行宝可梦，却也挡自己视线。陆上走得笨拙，宁可泡泥水，仰望天空。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的头形，能防御本会捕食它的飞行宝可梦，却也限制视野。它在陆地走得笨拙，更愿待在泥水里，仰望天空。

decisions.source: POKENAME's sturdy hide nullifies most strikes to the point that it hardly notices if it's being attacked. It uses the pointed tip of its tail to stab into fruit or drill into tree trunks to find things to eat.
decisions.target: POKENAME坚皮能化解大多数打击，几乎察觉不到挨打。尾尖能刺进果子，或钻树干找吃的。
decisions.revised: POKENAME坚实的外皮，能化解大多数打击，让它几乎感觉不到自己正被攻击。它用尾尖刺入果实，或钻进树干，寻找吃的。

decisions.source: Although they are all part of the same body, the three heads of POKENAME each have their own personality, making it challenging for Trainers to please them all. The largest is the most aggressive, while the smallest is the most playful.
decisions.target: POKENAME三颗头虽同属一身，性格却各异，训练家很难全讨好。最大的最凶，最小的最爱玩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的三颗头虽同属一个身体，性格却各不相同，训练家很难全部讨好。最大的头最凶暴，最小的则最爱玩。

decisions.source: Some history books speculate that the circus act of jumping through rings of fire was inspired by a POKENAME. When this Pokémon leaps out of the water, it leaves a ring of fire behind where it exited the water, though the fire quickly goes out.
decisions.target: 有些史书推测，马戏中的跳火圈源自POKENAME。它跃出水面时，会在离水处留下火环，不过很快熄灭。
decisions.revised: 有些史书推测，马戏中的跳火圈表演，受到了POKENAME启发。它跃出水面时，会在离水处留下火环，不过火很快就会熄灭。

decisions.source: POKENAME needs to be covered in mud for its skin not to dry out, but because of that, its fur is always dirty. It uses the electricity produced by its back claws to communicate with other POKENAME.
decisions.target: POKENAME需覆泥，皮肤才不干，因此皮毛总是脏的。用背爪产生的电，与同类传讯。
decisions.revised: POKENAME必须裹着泥，皮肤才不至干燥，因此毛总是脏的。它用后爪产生的电力，与其他同类交流。

decisions.source: POKENAME are averse to water exposure, instead preferring to roll around and lie in fresh mud to stay hydrated. They seem to be aware of impending storms, as they will head for clearings and look to the sky with mouths agape to drink up the rain.
decisions.target: POKENAME不愿沾水，宁可在新泥里滚动躺卧，保持水分。似乎知道风暴将至，会去空地，仰天张口喝雨。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不愿沾水，宁可在新鲜泥土里滚动、躺卧，保持水分。它似乎察知风暴将近，会去空地，仰天张口，喝下雨水。

decisions.source: A playful prankster of a nature spirit, the tendrils of POKENAME's leafy wreath reach out to take keys and other tiny trinkets from unsuspecting travelers, so it can revel in making them chase after it to retrieve the stolen items.
decisions.target: POKENAME是顽皮的自然精灵。叶环触须伸出，拿走旅人钥匙与小饰物，乐看对方追来讨还。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是顽皮爱闹的自然精灵。叶环的触须会拿走毫无防备旅人的钥匙和小饰物，再以看着对方追来讨还为乐。

decisions.source: The round stones growing on POKENAME's head leak a light blue poison that can be boiled down into a delicious sauce for pasta dishes. The poison is gone once cooked, leaving behind a savory flavor.
decisions.target: POKENAME头上的圆石漏出淡蓝毒，能熬成美味意面酱。煮熟毒就消失，只留鲜美。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上生长的圆石，渗出淡蓝色毒液，能熬成美味的意面酱。煮熟后毒性消失，只留下鲜美滋味。

decisions.source: POKENAME's appearance is akin to a rather large beach ball. It is quite light despite its size, so it spends its time letting humans play with it at the beach, bouncing it through the air.
decisions.target: POKENAME像颗大沙滩球，体大却很轻。它常让海滩游客玩，把自己抛到空中弹跳。
decisions.revised: POKENAME像一颗颇大的沙滩球，虽体型大，却很轻。它常让人们在海滩把玩，将自己弹向空中。

decisions.source: The gears on its back power the chainsaw in front of it. Once it has sawn apart a tree, POKENAME will devour the wood chippings it creates, digesting them into fuel for its own internal mechanisms.
decisions.target: 背齿轮驱动前方链锯。锯开树后，POKENAME会吃下木屑，消化成内部机构的燃料。
decisions.revised: 背上的齿轮，驱动着它前方的链锯。锯开一棵树后，POKENAME会吞食产生的木屑，消化成内部机构的燃料。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their feelers to read the auras of others and to channel their own auras, though they are always training to be better at the latter. They have the ability to soothe others graced by the touch of their feelers.
decisions.target: POKENAME以触须读取他者波导，也传导自身波导，不断训练后者。触须温柔一碰，就能安抚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用触须读取他者的波导，也传导自己的波导，后者还在不断练习。触须一碰，就能安抚受到触碰的生灵。

decisions.source: POKENAME tails are prehensile and are used to grab onto anything edible that is within reach. They are insatiable Pokémon and will gorge themselves on any food available, fighting one another to be the first to get to a meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME的尾巴能抓握，够得着的可食物都会抓。它贪吃无厌，见食就大嚼，还互斗抢先吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的尾巴能抓握，够得到的可食之物，都会抓来。它们食欲无穷，见食物就大吃，还会彼此争斗，抢先开饭。

decisions.source: A curled-up leaf acts as a shell for POKENAME to retreat into should the need arise. As well as protection, it can also provide POKENAME warmth overnight after growing hot from absorbing the sun's rays.
decisions.target: 卷叶是POKENAME的壳，需要就缩进去。不仅护身，白天吸日光存热，还能整夜供暖。
decisions.revised: 一片卷叶就是POKENAME的壳，需要时，它便缩进去。叶壳除了护身，也会吸收阳光、积存热量，在夜里为它保暖。

decisions.source: POKENAME have been known to create entire illusory forests and cause travelers to become lost. Their illusions tend to become see-through during daylight hours - so if you feel like you're wandering in circles, settle in and wait for dawn.
decisions.target: POKENAME能造整座幻象森林，让旅人迷路。白天幻象往往透明；若总在绕圈，就停下等天亮。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会造出整座幻象森林，使旅人迷路。白天，幻象往往变得透明；若你觉得总在绕圈，就安顿下来，等天亮。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in the dampest marshes, with all but the tops of their heads and their leafy tails submerged in mud during the day. At night, when the moon is shining and their leaves can feed on the moonlight, they arise and wander about with glee.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在最湿沼泽，白天只有头顶与叶尾露泥。夜里月亮照耀，叶片能吸月光，便开心出土游荡。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在最潮湿的沼泽，白天全身浸在泥中，只露头顶和叶片般的尾巴。夜里月亮照耀，叶片能以月光为食，它们便欢快地出来游荡。

decisions.source: POKENAME can create a vibrant rainbow trail behind it as it flies. Those who view the colorful sight find a feeling of tranquility come over them, which lingers for quite a while after POKENAME has flown away.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞行时，身后能拖出绚丽彩虹。见者心生宁静，等它飞远很久，感觉仍在。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞行时，身后能留下绚丽的彩虹光迹。看见美景者会心生宁静，即使它飞走，这份感受仍会停留很久。

decisions.source: POKENAME is highly sought after by theater companies due to its natural elegance in the art of dance. To meet expectations, it trains throughout the night, which sometimes causes it to fall asleep during the day.
decisions.target: POKENAME天生舞姿优雅，剧团争相求取。为不负期待，整夜苦练，有时白天便睡着。
decisions.revised: POKENAME天生擅长优雅起舞，令剧团争相邀请。为不负期待，它彻夜训练，有时却因此在白天睡着。

decisions.source: POKENAME fills bags full of garbage and junk to hand out as gifts to passersby. It gets frustrated when its kindness is refused, oftentimes leading to it attempting to beat the refusing party with said bags.
decisions.target: POKENAME把垃圾与杂物装满袋，送给路人。好意被拒就恼火，常拿袋子打拒收者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME把垃圾、杂物装满袋子，送给路人作礼物。好意被拒，它就恼火，常试着用袋子殴打拒收者。

decisions.source: Highly territorial, POKENAME uses its sheer brute strength to drive away ships that venture too close to its coastal den. When it slams its massive tail against the ground, it can shake the earth with enough force to trigger violent quakes.
decisions.target: POKENAME领地意识极强，靠蛮力赶走太近岸洞的船。巨尾一砸地，震动足以引发猛烈地震。
decisions.revised: POKENAME领地意识极强，靠蛮力赶走过于接近海岸巢穴的船只。巨尾猛砸地面时，震动足以引发猛烈地震。

decisions.source: Perhaps due to their inherent weakness from the moment they are born, POKENAME will only ever let children ride upon their backs. Their trust must still be earned first, lest their black flames harm their rider.
decisions.target: 或许天生体弱，POKENAME始终只肯背孩子。还得先赢得信任，否则黑火会伤骑者。
decisions.revised: 或许因为生来体弱，POKENAME只肯让孩子骑在背上。不过，仍须先赢得信任，免得黑焰伤及骑乘者。

decisions.source: POKENAME hides in the canopies of unique and endangered trees, waiting to attack any that would harm its home. It carries seeds in the hole of its chest, and will give one to any passerby who it senses cares about nature.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏独特濒危树的林冠，等待攻击伤家者。胸孔存种子，谁被感知爱自然，就送一颗。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏在独特、濒危树木的树冠中，对危及家园的生灵伺机出手。胸口的洞里藏着种子，若感到经过者关爱自然，它就会送上一颗。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves to pull others into a hug and offer the honey-like nectar it drools out. The offer may be well-intentioned, but the pungent aroma of POKENAME's flower will linger on the person hugged for quite some time after.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱抱旁人，送口滴的蜜状花蜜。或许出于好意，可花臭会留被抱者身上，久久不散。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱将旁人拉进拥抱，献上口中流出的蜂蜜状花蜜。也许出于好意，可花朵刺鼻的香气，会在被抱者身上停留很久。

decisions.source: POKENAME blows a number of bubbles when it feels like it is in danger. Upon popping, the bubbles release a small burst of ultrasonic waves that can be highly disorienting to anything nearby at the time.
decisions.target: POKENAME感到危险就吹许多泡。破时放小股超声波，附近生物常被弄得极迷乱。
decisions.revised: POKENAME觉得有危险时，会吹出一些泡泡。破裂时，泡泡会释放一小股超声波，能使附近生灵晕头转向。

decisions.source: While flying, it uses its poison-coated horn to ward off other wild Pokémon that try to get in its way. Berry trees are its favored nesting spots, chosen because their branches provide both safety and a steady supply of fruit for its young.
decisions.target: 飞行时，以裹毒角赶挡路的野生宝可梦。偏爱树果树筑巢，树枝既安全，也给幼崽稳定果粮。
decisions.revised: 飞行时，它用裹着毒液的角，赶走试图挡路的野生宝可梦。它偏爱在树果树筑巢，因为枝头安全，又能给幼崽稳定供果。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME are highly adept in aerial combat and their sheer tenacity has let them dominate the skies. Their bushido-like discipline has earned them the respect of many who have come in contact with them.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME极擅空战，顽强到统御天空。武士道般的自律，让许多接触者尊敬。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME极擅空战，顽强不屈，得以称霸天空。武士道般的自律，让许多与它们接触的生灵，都心生尊敬。

decisions.source: POKENAME siphons light energy when it crushes the light source with its powerful pincers. Flying causes it to burn through its energy, so it prefers to flap its wings as little as possible to preserve as much light as it can.
decisions.target: POKENAME用强钳捏碎光源，同时抽走光能。飞行消耗能量，所以它尽量少扇翅，保存更多光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用强钳捏碎光源，同时吸走光能。飞行会大量耗能，因此它尽可能少拍翼，保存更多光能。

decisions.source: POKENAME often get into fights over nesting area in the wild. After a spirited round of combat, it's customary for the winner to pluck a few feathers from the loser to use as part of the nest it later builds.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME常为巢区争斗。激战后，胜者通常从败者身上拔几根羽毛，添进之后筑的巢。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME常为筑巢地争斗。激战过后，胜者惯常从败者身上拔几根羽毛，加入之后搭建的巢。

decisions.source: Despite its size and weight, POKENAME is an expert climber, able to crawl up the jungle trees with its small claws or stick to wet river cliffs with its finger pads. That way, this stealthy predator sneaks up to its prey, catching it with its tongue.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽大又重，却很会攀爬，用小爪爬丛林树，用指垫贴住潮湿河崖，悄悄接近猎物，再用舌捕住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然又大又重，却是攀爬高手，能用小爪爬上丛林树，或以指垫贴住潮湿河崖。它便这样悄悄接近猎物，再伸舌抓住。

decisions.source: The fluid that seeps from their mouths is a viscous poison that can become acidic as they grow nearer to their evolution. POKENAME tend to live in flocks of six and care for each other greatly.
decisions.target: 口中渗出的稠毒液，临近进化时可能带上酸性。POKENAME常六只一群，彼此关爱。
decisions.revised: 它们口中渗出稠毒液，临近进化时，毒液可能转为酸性。POKENAME通常六只一群，彼此十分关爱。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME dash across the lands at extreme speeds, the many orbs along its body aglow and casting it as a streak of red and yellow to the eyes of most. When it barks, embers spill from its mouth and sparks of lightning fly from its orbs.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME以极高速奔驰，身上众多亮球，看着像一道红黄流光。吠叫时嘴吐余烬，光球迸雷电火花。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME以极高速奔驰，身上的众多球体发亮，在多数生灵眼中，宛如一道红黄流光。吠叫时，嘴里洒出余烬，光球迸出雷电火花。

decisions.source: This Pokémon is a slow swimmer that is most often found in shallow reefs. Due to its large eyes, it is very good at noticing incoming threats. However, due to the rest of its body being so small, it's terrible at avoiding those threats.
decisions.target: 这种宝可梦游得慢，常见于浅礁。大眼很会发现来袭威胁，其余身体却太小，躲避的本领很差。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦游得缓慢，最常见于浅礁。大眼让它十分善于发现来袭威胁，身体其他部分却太小，躲避本领就糟得很。

decisions.source: Driven by gears, the blade on POKENAME's head can spin like a circular saw. In addition to slamming it into foes in combat, POKENAME can use its spiky wheel to anchor itself in place, while using its head to cut down trees or saw through solid rock.
decisions.target: 齿轮驱动POKENAME头刃，如圆锯般旋转。战时能撞向敌人，也能用刺轮稳固身体，再用头砍树、锯穿坚岩。
decisions.revised: 齿轮驱动POKENAME头上的刀刃，让它能像圆锯般旋转。除战斗中撞击敌人，它还会用刺轮固定自身，同时以头部砍树、锯穿坚岩。

decisions.source: When in battle, POKENAME will lazily bash its stomach with its fists, which oddly makes a low, flute-like sound. This tune slowly drives its opponent to sleep, giving it the chance to land a heavy blow before its foe wakes up.
decisions.target: 战斗中，POKENAME懒懒用拳敲肚，竟发出低沉笛声。曲调渐渐催眠对手，让它趁醒前，打出重击。
decisions.revised: 战斗中，POKENAME懒懒地用拳头捶肚子，竟发出低沉、如笛的声音。曲调让对手慢慢睡去，它便能趁敌人醒来前，打出重击。

decisions.source: POKENAME run down opponents before bashing them with a combination of their long snouts and the spikes on their heads. When they get serious, they pull up their spare skin to protect their bodies while they clamp their jaws down on foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME追上对手，用长鼻吻与头刺，合力冲撞。认真时，它拉起多余皮肤，护身，再用双颚夹敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME追上对手，再用长吻与头上的尖刺，合力猛撞。认真起来，它会拉起多余皮肤护身，同时以双颚夹住敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be seen roaming across the forest floor during the early morning, feeding on leaves that are coated in the morning dew. Their arms are stubby and ill-suited to battle, meaning they rely on swipes with their tail to fight.
decisions.target: 清晨能见到POKENAME在林地漫游，吃沾着晨露的叶片。手臂短，不适合战斗，因此靠甩尾迎战。
decisions.revised: 清晨，能见到POKENAME漫游林地，啃食沾着晨露的叶子。手臂短粗，不适合作战，因此它们靠挥尾扫击迎敌。

decisions.source: The bright light that POKENAME can emit from their antennae can shine through even the deepest parts of the ocean, making it valuable in sea-based rescue missions. However, the light is so bright it can cause eye damage without proper protection.
decisions.target: POKENAME触角的强光，连最深海处也照得透，海上搜救很有用。可若无适当保护，亮度会伤眼。
decisions.revised: POKENAME触角的强光，甚至能照入海洋最深处，在海上搜救中十分宝贵。但光太亮，缺少适当防护，也能造成眼部损伤。

decisions.source: The horns on POKENAME's back allow it to attract and absorb lightning bolts falling from the sky. Some people have begun asking for its help during thunderstorms to protect satellite dishes and other metal objects on the roofs of their homes.
decisions.target: POKENAME背角能吸引、吸收天降雷电。有些人雷雨时请它帮忙，保护屋顶卫星天线和金属物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的角，能吸引、吸收天降的雷电。有些人开始在雷雨时请它帮忙，保护屋顶的卫星天线与其他金属物品。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in very large communities,  dancing in the sun together. They use the flower on their head to absorb sunlight, converting it into nutrients. They are very social Pokémon, often helping out Trainers or inviting them to join their dances.
decisions.target: POKENAME巨大群居，阳光下一同起舞。头花吸日光转养分。它爱社交，常帮训练家，或邀人共舞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在规模庞大的群落，阳光下一同起舞，靠头上的花吸收日光，转为养分。它们很合群，常帮助训练家，或邀请训练家一起跳舞。

decisions.source: POKENAME blows the bits of pollen that grow at the end of its ribbons at others during allergy seasons. This is not a malevolent act, as inhaling this special pollen has proven to combat allergies for up to a week after inhalation.
decisions.target: 过敏季，POKENAME朝人吹缎带末端长的花粉。这并非恶意，已证实吸入后，最多能抗过敏一周。
decisions.revised: 过敏季节，POKENAME将缎带末端生长的花粉，吹向旁人。这并非恶意，已证实吸入后，抗过敏的效果最长可持续一周。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives in large schools with its companions and becomes particularly active when the tide rises under the light of the full moon. It makes its luminous rings shine in the sea to communicate over great distances with others of its kind.
decisions.target: POKENAME与同伴大群生活，满月下涨潮时格外活跃。它让圆环在海中闪耀，与远方同类交流。
decisions.revised: POKENAME与同伴成大群生活，逢满月下的涨潮，尤为活跃。它让发光环圈在海中闪耀，与远处的同类交流。

decisions.source: The dust from POKENAME's wings is extremely irritating, causing intense itching that can last for weeks. If you leave a house's lights on during the night, they will be attracted to the light and try to chew through the walls.
decisions.target: POKENAME翅粉刺激极强，能引起持续数周的剧痒。屋里夜间开灯，就会被引来，试图啃穿墙壁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的翅粉刺激性极强，能引起持续数周的剧痒。夜间让屋灯亮着，就会引来它们，试图啃穿墙壁。

decisions.source: The head on POKENAME's tongue has its own mind and is actually the only one between the two that is capable of experiencing the sensation of taste. The mouth on POKENAME's main head is used only for communication and little else.
decisions.target: POKENAME舌头上的头有自己的意识，也是两者中唯一有味觉的。主头的嘴，几乎只用来交流。
decisions.revised: POKENAME舌头上的头，有自己的意识，也是两颗头中唯一有味觉的。主头的嘴，除交流外，没多少其他用途。

decisions.source: POKENAME is very clingy towards its Trainer, holding onto the fabric of its person's legs. If POKENAME loses sight of its Trainer for too long, it will let out loud cries and sit, waiting for them to return and pick it up.
decisions.target: POKENAME十分黏训练家，抓着腿边衣料不放。太久看不见，就高声鸣叫，坐着等对方回来抱起。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分黏训练家，会抓紧腿边的衣料。太久看不见训练家，它就大声叫喊，坐下等对方回来，抱起自己。

decisions.source: POKENAME has five brains, one inside its head and the other four in the shoulders of its arms. None of them are particularly large, so it doesn't attempt any strategies more complex than lowering its horn and charging straight at foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME有五脑，一颗在头，四颗在臂肩。都不很大，因此不玩复杂战术，只压低角，径直冲敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有五个大脑，一个在头部，另外四个在手臂肩部。都不算大，因此它不会尝试比低下角、直冲敌人更复杂的战术。

decisions.source: POKENAME generally does not come out of its stone unless it detects the presence of fallen trees nearby. It then emerges fully, gnawing the wood until it is perfectly shaped to fit into a dam, then retreats back from whence it came.
decisions.target: POKENAME通常不出石头，除非察觉附近倒树。才会完全现身，把木啃得恰能入坝，再退回原处。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常不从自己的石头里出来，除非感到附近有倒树。它才会完全现身，将木头啃到恰好适于筑坝，再退回原处。

decisions.source: POKENAME lurk in marshes and swamps, hiding themselves within the murky waters. When they see a traveller pass by, they use the golden glint of the coin on their forehead to draw them close, then leap out to attempt to drown them.
decisions.target: POKENAME潜在湿地沼泽的浑水里。旅人经过，就以额上硬币金光引近，再跃出，想将对方淹死。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏在湿地、沼泽的浑水中。看见旅人经过，它便用额上硬币的金光，吸引对方靠近，再跃出来，试图将其淹死。

decisions.source: POKENAME are nocturnal and have been seen racing around at high speed in the depths of the night, their head leaves trailing in the breeze. They spend the day buried up to their neck, sleeping in the ground to passively absorb nutrients.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜行，深夜常能看到它急速奔跑，头叶随风飘。白天埋到颈，睡在地里，慢慢吸取养分。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜间活动，深夜能见它们高速奔跑，头叶随风飘动。白天，它们将自己埋到脖子，在地里睡觉，被动吸收养分。

decisions.source: POKENAME jiggles its body to rub its pom-poms together and create showers of sparks as displays of support to its allies. The act leaves a residual magnetic charge for a time, so metal objects are pulled towards it during these dances.
decisions.target: POKENAME摇身摩擦绒球，迸出火花雨，支持伙伴。动作留下暂时磁性，舞中金属物便会被吸来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME摇晃身体，让绒球相互摩擦，迸出火花，为伙伴助威。动作会暂留磁性，因此舞蹈时，金属物品会被吸向它。

decisions.source: The stench of a POKENAME penetrates through walls and lingers for days. Some farmers cultivate them, however, as the honey they drool, a purified form of the liquid waste that makes up much of a POKENAME's body, is exquisitely sweet and delicious.
decisions.target: POKENAME恶臭穿墙，几天不散。可仍有农人养着，口蜜是身体大量液废的纯化形态，甜美异常。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的恶臭能穿墙，数日不散。它身体很大一部分是液体废物，纯化后变成口中流出的蜂蜜，甜美异常，因此仍有农人饲养。

decisions.source: Slime constantly oozes from pores on POKENAME's body, stopping both its skin and the fungus growing on it from drying out. Whenever a mushroom becomes large enough to break off, POKENAME will carry it with its tail to scatter spores from it.
decisions.target: POKENAME体孔不断渗黏液，让皮肤、真菌都不干燥。蘑菇大到断落，就以尾巴带着，继续散孢子。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体表的小孔不断渗出黏液，防止皮肤和真菌干燥。蘑菇长大到脱落时，它就会用尾巴带着，散播孢子。

decisions.source: POKENAME plays with small children on beaches by allowing them to manipulate its sand into whatever shape they wish. Once they've given it a form, it does a funny dance to amuse them before shifting back and starting the game over.
decisions.target: POKENAME让幼童随心塑沙，陪他们在海滩玩。形体一成，就跳滑稽舞逗乐，再变回去，重新开始。
decisions.revised: POKENAME陪小孩子在海滩玩，让他们随意塑造身上的沙。形体一成，它便跳滑稽的舞，逗孩子们开心，再变回原形，重新开始。

decisions.source: Due to POKENAME's low internal temperature, the poison in its tail has frozen into slush. This process has also resulted in denaturing these toxins, making this slush tasty and safe to eat, making it a popular treat in the summer season.
decisions.target: POKENAME体温低，让尾毒冻成冰沙。过程也使毒素变性，让冰沙安全美味，成为夏季人气点心。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体内温度低，尾上的毒液冻成冰沙。毒素也因此变性，使冰沙安全、美味，成了夏日的人气点心。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very easy for fishermen to catch because they swim very close to the surface of the water to stay warm. If their bodies get too cold, their fins stop working, rendering them unable to swim.
decisions.target: POKENAME为保暖，贴着水面游，渔人很容易钓到。若身体过冷，鳍就失灵，再也游不动。
decisions.revised: POKENAME为保暖，游得很靠近水面，渔人很容易捕到。身体若冷过头，鳍就会失去作用，使它无法游动。

decisions.source: It sleeps on the seabed, a thick layer of fat insulating it against the cold. POKENAME always wakes up hungry, and only comes up to the surface if it can't find food in the ocean depths.
decisions.target: 它睡在海床，厚脂肪隔绝寒冷。POKENAME醒来总饿，唯有深海找不到食物，才会上浮。
decisions.revised: 它睡在海床上，厚厚的脂肪层帮它抵御寒冷。POKENAME醒来总是很饿，唯有深海找不到食物，才会上浮到水面。

decisions.source: POKENAME gallops with such speed that it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning crackling through the air. Only those it trusts the most are able to touch it without being zapped by its electrified fur.
decisions.target: POKENAME奔驰快得像电光划空。只有最信任的对象，碰到它，才不被带电的毛电击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME奔驰得极快，仿佛一道噼啪作响的闪电划空而过。只有它最信任的对象，才能碰触它，而不被带电的毛发电到。

decisions.source: As POKENAME grows nearer to needing to shed its skin, it grows more agitated and hyperactive. Once it manages to wriggle out of its old skin, it becomes much more calm, at least for a short while.
decisions.target: POKENAME越近蜕皮，就越烦躁、过分好动。终于扭出旧皮，便平静得多，至少暂时如此。
decisions.revised: POKENAME越临近蜕皮，就越烦躁、过分好动。终于扭出旧皮，便平静得多，至少暂时如此。

decisions.source: POKENAME has a fiery temperament, constantly seeking out combat rivals to test its strength against. When in the midst of a heated fight, its aura flares up and causes the flames on its body to change color.
decisions.target: POKENAME性子火热，不断找战斗对手，测试实力。激战中，波导高涨，使身上火焰变色。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脾气火爆，不断寻找对手，较量实力。激烈交战时，它的波导会升腾，使身上的火焰变色。

decisions.source: POKENAME are known to bury eggs in the ground near volcanoes, as geothermal heat keeps their eggs warm. This practice is thought to have originated from a time when the volcanic peaks were still covered in snow.
decisions.target: POKENAME会在火山旁埋蛋，靠地热保温。据说，这习惯起于火山峰仍覆着雪的年代。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会把蛋埋在火山附近，靠地热保温。这一习惯被认为，源于火山峰顶仍覆着雪的年代。

decisions.source: POKENAME enjoy taking care of eggs that are abandoned in caves, keeping them warm in their rocky den. It is said that giving them shiny stones fills them with so much glee that they evolve shortly thereafter.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱照顾洞里遗弃的蛋，在石巢保暖。据说送它亮石头，会开心得很快进化。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱照顾洞窟里遭遗弃的蛋，在岩石巢穴中保暖。据说，送给它们闪亮的石头，会高兴得不久就进化。

decisions.source: Despite the apparent bulk of their bodies, POKENAME are very light due to being mostly fluff. They can float long enough after a jump for the wind to catch them and propel them forwards on their travels.
decisions.target: POKENAME看似臃肿，其实大多是绒毛，很轻。跳后能浮够久，让风接住，带它继续旅行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体型看似庞大，其实大多是绒毛，因此十分轻。跃起后，它们能浮得足够久，让风接住，推动它们继续前行。

decisions.source: As POKENAME zips through the air at high speeds, it leaves a trail of static electricity from its wool behind. If multiple POKENAME fly together, their trails may intersect and cause a dazzling array of sparks to erupt.
decisions.target: POKENAME高速飞，羊毛在身后留下静电轨迹。多只同行，轨迹相交，便迸出璀璨火花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME高速飞行，羊毛在身后留下一道静电轨迹。多只同行时，轨迹可能相交，引发一大片耀眼火花。

decisions.source: POKENAME can often be seen using its trunk to play with the ball on its tail. Sometimes it will fling the ball forcefully, forgetting that it is attached to its tail, and causing it to tumble over.
decisions.target: 常能见POKENAME用鼻子玩尾球。有时用力抛出，却忘了球连着尾巴，反把自己带倒。
decisions.revised: 常能看见POKENAME用象鼻拨弄尾上的球。有时它用力抛出，却忘了球还连着尾巴，结果将自己带得翻倒。

decisions.source: POKENAME are sensitive to changes in the weather and are used by some rural communities as a way of preparing for storms. When POKENAME gather out in a field it's a warning that a thunderstorm is imminent.
decisions.target: POKENAME对天气变化敏感，有些乡村靠它准备风暴。若聚在田里，便警告雷雨将至。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对天气变化敏感，有些乡村便借助它们，提前准备风暴。它们聚到田间，就预示雷雨将至。

decisions.source: POKENAME's eye glows faintly in the dark, often leading to homeowners being spooked by its discovery. Staring into its eye too long causes one to feel a tingling sensation along their skin akin to static electricity.
decisions.target: POKENAME眼睛暗中微亮，屋主发现常吓一跳。盯得太久，皮肤会有静电般的麻刺感。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的眼睛在黑暗中泛起微光，屋主发现时，常会吓一跳。凝视太久，观看者的皮肤便有静电般的麻刺感。

decisions.source: POKENAME removes and offers tiny plates from its own body as gifts to those it is fond of. They grow back quickly, and the self-removal is painless, so there's no harm in accepting the present.
decisions.target: POKENAME摘下自身小甲片，送给喜欢的来者。很快长回，摘时也不痛，因此收礼无妨。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会摘下自身的小甲片，送给喜欢的生灵。甲片很快长回，由它自己摘取时也完全不痛，因此收下礼物无妨。

decisions.source: In order to achieve flight, POKENAME expands its body by intaking air and heating it with its internal fire. When this Pokémon wants to come down from the air, it releases a fiery breath and descends.
decisions.target: POKENAME吸入空气，用内火加热，使身体膨胀飞起。想落下时，就吐出火息，缓缓降下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吸入空气，用体内火焰加热，使身体鼓胀飞起。想落下时，它便吐出火焰，降下来。

decisions.source: To gain an advantage in combat, POKENAME will blend into its surroundings by shifting the colors of its feathers. When it is ready to strike, POKENAME will use its muscular legs to lunge at the opponent before striking.
decisions.target: POKENAME为占战斗优势，会改羽色融入环境。准备出击，就靠强腿扑近对手，再攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME为占据战斗优势，会改变羽毛颜色，融入周围环境。准备出手时，它用肌肉发达的双腿，扑近对手，再发起攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses the sword-like fangs to hack away at its prey and enemies. When it can't overcome someone with its fangs, it'll slash with its horn as a last attempt to defeat the enemy.
decisions.target: POKENAME用剑状牙齿劈砍猎物与敌人。牙齿无法取胜时，就用角劈斩，作最后一搏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用剑一般的尖牙，劈砍猎物与敌人。牙齿若无法取胜，它就会以角斩击，作最后一搏。

decisions.source: POKENAME's vision is less effective in the light. It spreads shadows around itself to darken the area to a pitch-black state, limiting the visibility of others while its own vision gets better in the darkness.
decisions.target: POKENAME光下视力较差，便散影，让四周漆黑。他者看不清，自己却在黑暗看得更好。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在亮处视力较差，便向周围散出阴影，使环境漆黑一片。旁人视线受阻，自己却在黑暗中看得更好。

decisions.source: Though POKENAME's water cannon can only fire in single shots rather than a constant stream, these blasts of water are viciously powerful. A single shot of water from it can pierce straight through an entire mountainside.
decisions.target: POKENAME水炮只能单发，不能持续喷水，威力却凶猛。一发就能径直贯穿整片山壁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的水炮只能单发，无法形成连续水流，威力却极其凶猛。一发水流，就能径直贯穿整片山壁。

decisions.source: The bulb on its back takes in sunlight to increase its internal temperature. When confronted by predators in the wild, or during a fierce battle, POKENAME releases the heated spores by whipping them around with its wings.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上的花苞吸日光，提升体温。野外遇天敌或激战时，便挥翼扬出热孢子。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的花苞吸收阳光，提升内部温度。野外遇到捕食者，或陷入激战时，它便挥动翅膀，扬出热孢子。

decisions.source: POKENAME can channel electrical attacks through the pom-pom-like sprout growing out of its head. During thunderstorms, it absorbs lightning strikes, channeling the energy through its body and adding a surge of power to its attacks.
decisions.target: POKENAME头顶绒球般的芽，能引导电攻击。雷暴时吸雷，电力通体，令攻击再增威力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能从头顶绒球般的嫩芽，传导电击。雷暴中，它吸收落雷，让能量流遍全身，令攻击再添一股威力。

decisions.source: POKENAME watches over forests in secret, following those who desecrate its land until they fall asleep. As they slumber, it infests their dreams with horrific nightmares of living trees as punishment for their crimes against its home.
decisions.target: POKENAME暗护森林，跟踪亵渎者，直到睡着，再以活树恐怖噩梦侵扰，惩罚毁家罪行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME暗中守护森林，跟随糟蹋领地的生灵，直到对方睡着。它再用活树的恐怖噩梦，侵扰其梦境，惩罚破坏家园的行为。

decisions.source: POKENAME releases a syrupy fragrance from its body to entice prey into a false sense of safety. The moment they drift too near, the jaws disguised as blossoms snap shut, engulfing them whole in a merciless bite.
decisions.target: POKENAME体散糖浆香，诱猎物放松戒备。太近，花形伪颚就猛合，无情一咬，整个吞下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME散发糖浆般的香气，使猎物误以为安全。对方一飘得太近，伪装成花朵的双颚便猛然合拢，无情一口，将其整个吞下。

decisions.source: POKENAME can dispense incredibly toxic and noxious fumes from all three of the flowers on its body. It may cover itself with a toxic fog before lashing out with thorn-covered vines while it remains hidden within.
decisions.target: POKENAME身上三朵花，全能放极毒恶烟。会先以毒雾藏身，再挥带刺藤蔓，出手袭击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的三朵花，都能放出剧毒、有害的烟气。它也可能先用毒雾裹住自己，藏在其中，再挥动带刺藤蔓袭击。

decisions.source: POKENAME is extremely heavy and can only swim thanks to its incredibly powerful legs. It's feared by sailors due to stories of it grabbing boats with its grasping limbs and dragging them to the ocean floor.
decisions.target: POKENAME极沉，全靠强大的双腿才能游泳。水手怕它，故事说，它会抓住船，拖往海底。
decisions.revised: POKENAME极其沉重，全靠强大的双腿，才能游泳。水手畏惧它，因为故事中，它会用能抓握的肢体捉住船，拖往海底。

decisions.source: POKENAME excels at ranged and close combat fighting. Using the stick from its tail, POKENAME can light flames and launch them at opponents. Up close, this Pokémon utilizes its claws for slashing and powerful legs for kicking.
decisions.target: POKENAME远近战都擅长。POKENAME能用尾里的棍点火，射向敌人；近身则以爪劈斩，强腿踢击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME擅长远近战，能用尾里的棍棒点起火焰，射向对手。近身时，它则挥爪劈斩，以强腿踢击。

decisions.source: Its tongue is covered with sea foam that allows it to filter impurities from the water. POKENAME feeds on algae to strengthen the shell that protects it from attacks by other Pokémon living in the ocean.
decisions.target: 它舌上的海沫，能过滤水中杂质。POKENAME吃藻类，强化护壳，抵御海中其他宝可梦。
decisions.revised: 它舌头上的海沫，能过滤水中的杂质。POKENAME以藻类为食，强化外壳，抵御海里其他宝可梦的攻击。

decisions.source: If POKENAME's main blade dulls out in a battle, it will use its tiny knife to stab its foe. This small blade is also used to stab and cling onto anyone who tries to grab its hilt until they've been drained of all their life force.
decisions.target: POKENAME主刃若在战斗中变钝，就改用小刀刺敌。谁想抓它的剑柄，也会被小刃刺住，直到生命力被吸干。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的主刃若在战斗中变钝，它就改用小刀刺敌。谁试图抓住剑柄，也会被小刃刺住、攀牢，直到生命力被吸尽。

decisions.source: POKENAME can inflate its hollow tail with gas, which allows it to leap to great heights. Its voice has a distinct melodic quality that lulls listeners to peaceful sleep when it sings. It will use this chance to steal food from its victims.
decisions.target: POKENAME能向中空的尾巴充气，跃上高处。优美的歌声会让听者安稳入睡，它就趁机偷走食物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能向中空的尾巴充气，跃上高处。嗓音有独特的旋律感，唱歌时，能使听者安然入睡，它就趁机偷走受害者的食物。

decisions.source: POKENAME's fists each have a trio of stingers lining the knuckles that ooze a steady stream of venom. POKENAME aim jabs at their opponent to inflict them with their toxin, waiting for their venom to disable their foe in a battle of endurance.
decisions.target: POKENAME双拳各有三根刺针，排在指节，毒液不断渗出。POKENAME以刺拳上毒，再打耐力战，等毒制服敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME双拳的指节上，各排列三根毒针，不断渗出毒液。它们以刺拳使对方中毒，再打耐力战，等待毒液制服敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME swims deep within the lava found on volcanic islands. It dislikes intrusions on its territory, and it has been said that if others invade its home, it will sink the island beneath the ocean in a rage before seeking a new home.
decisions.target: POKENAME在火山岛的熔岩深处游泳，讨厌领地被侵。传闻谁闯家园，它会怒沉整岛，再去找新家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在火山岛的熔岩深处游泳，厌恶领地被侵。传闻，若有谁闯入家园，它就会暴怒，使整座岛沉入海中，再去寻找新家。

decisions.source: POKENAME stores up power inside the blue orbs on its back. If a section of the forest is damaged by logging or fire, POKENAME will remove one and bury it in the ground, enabling plants in that area to grow back much more quickly.
decisions.target: POKENAME在背部蓝珠中储力。森林若遭砍伐或火灾，它就取下一颗埋地，让当地植物更快长回。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在背上的蓝色球体里储存力量。若有森林遭砍伐或火灾损坏，它便取下一颗，埋进地里，让那里的植物更快长回。

decisions.source: POKENAME's teleportation ability makes it highly elusive, disappearing in the blink of an eye the moment it senses it has been spotted. It does this not out of fear, but because it is amused by those who pursue it after it vanishes.
decisions.target: POKENAME一觉被看见，便眨眼瞬移，极难寻踪。不是害怕，只是觉得消失后，别人追找的模样有趣。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的瞬移本领，让它一察觉被看见，就会眨眼消失，难觅踪迹。这样并非因为害怕，只是觉得消失后，追赶者的模样很有趣。

decisions.source: POKENAME lift their heads high, spreading their petals open to meet the midday sun. They absorb as much energy as they can to store for nighttime, using their innate powers to intensify the sun's rays if they feel it is too dark.
decisions.target: POKENAME高抬头、展花瓣，迎正午太阳，尽量储能供夜用。若觉得太暗，还会用天生力量，增强日光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME高高抬头，展开花瓣，迎向正午太阳。它们尽量吸取能量，留待夜用；若觉得太暗，还会以天生的力量，增强阳光。

decisions.source: In the Johto region, people are known to collect POKENAME's slightly toxic feathers and dry them so they can be crumbled into a powder. Smoking this causes the user to see vivid dreams, with some saying that they can see the future.
decisions.target: 城都人会收集POKENAME微毒的羽毛，晒干碾粉，吸食后能看见鲜明梦境，有人声称见到了未来。
decisions.revised: 城都一带，人们会收集POKENAME微毒的羽毛，干燥后碾成粉，再拿来当烟吸食。这会让吸食者看见鲜活的梦境，有人声称，甚至能看见未来。

decisions.source: POKENAME produce a strong static charge that they use to attach themselves to trees. If they do not discharge regularly they can end up attaching to one another in clumps, or even get drawn to and stick to clothing of people passing by.
decisions.target: POKENAME产强静电，把自己黏在树上。若不常放电，可能彼此黏成团，甚至被路人衣物吸去黏住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME产生强静电，将自己黏在树上。若不定期放电，它们可能彼此黏成团，甚至被吸向路人的衣料，黏在上面。

decisions.source: Despite POKENAME's short and bulky stature, it can hop and skip around at unexpectedly fast speeds if it detects anything bad with its surprisingly sharp senses. The pink egg it carries is said to bring everlasting happiness to anyone who eats it.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽矮胖，敏锐感官一觉不对，就能出奇快地蹦走。据说所带的粉蛋，能给吃者永恒幸福。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽矮胖，只要敏锐的感官察觉不对，就能以出人意料的速度蹦跳。据说，吃下它带着的粉色蛋，就能得到永恒幸福。

decisions.source: POKENAME are able to control the levels of moisture in an environment, either packing together bundles of moisture to form into rain clouds or gathering energy to ignite themselves. If one of their clouds burns, it will burst into a field of steam.
decisions.target: POKENAME控制环境湿度，可把水气聚成雨云，也能聚能点燃自身。云若烧起，就炸散成大片蒸汽。
decisions.revised: POKENAME控制环境湿度，能将水分聚成团，化作雨云，也能聚集能量，点燃自己。它的云一烧起，就会迸散成大片蒸汽。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is covered in poisonous thorns that protect the bud growing on its back. The fragrance of its still-closed petals can soothe anyone who breathes it in, which is why it is often used in the preparation of certain tranquilizers.
decisions.target: POKENAME遍身毒刺，保护背上花苞。未开的花瓣香气能安抚吸入者，因此常被用于某些镇静剂。
decisions.revised: POKENAME满身的毒刺，保护背上生长的花苞。闭合花瓣的香气，能安抚吸入者，因此常被用于配制某些镇静剂。

decisions.source: Although the shell of POKENAME makes it hard for it to swim efficiently, its shell is effective at stopping waves from doing major damage. Smaller Pokémon that reside on the beach hide behind POKENAME's shell when the waves start to get intense.
decisions.target: POKENAME外壳让游泳不顺，却能有效挡住海浪，免遭重伤。浪大时，海滩小宝可梦会躲到它壳后。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的壳虽让它游泳不够灵便，却能有效抵挡海浪的严重伤害。浪势增强时，住在海滩的较小宝可梦，就会躲到壳后。

decisions.source: POKENAME wraps its long tongue around its body, allowing it to lick up sweet nectar as it dances through the flower fields. However, it is just as content to slurp up small Bug Pokémon if they get too close to its flowers.
decisions.target: POKENAME长舌绕身，舞过花田时舔食甜蜜。可小型虫宝可梦若靠花太近，也一样乐意吸进嘴里。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将长舌绕在身上，在花田舞动时，舔取甘甜的花蜜。不过，小型虫类宝可梦若靠它的花太近，它也一样乐意吸来吃。

decisions.source: Clusters of POKENAME make their home high in the treetops, avoiding the forest floor in order to keep themselves safe from predators. They can be seen by the light of their shells at night, creating the illusion that the trees bear glowing fruit.
decisions.target: 成群POKENAME以高树顶为家，避开林地，远离捕食者。夜间壳光亮起，让树木仿佛结满发光果实。
decisions.revised: 成群的POKENAME栖居在高高的树梢，避开森林地面，以免遭到捕食者袭击。夜里，它们的壳亮起光芒，远远望去，仿佛树上结满了发光的果实。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their powerful forelimbs to dig burrows into the muddy banks of rivers, raising their young in the safety of their nests. They are quick to grow agitated as even passing a curious glance into their burrow provokes them into a rage.
decisions.target: POKENAME用强前肢在泥泞河岸挖洞，安全育幼。它易烦躁，连好奇瞥进洞里一眼，也能激起怒火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用强壮的前肢，在泥泞的河岸挖洞，在安全的巢中养育幼崽。它们很容易烦躁，哪怕只是好奇地往洞里瞥一眼，也会惹得它们勃然大怒。

decisions.source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through their pink horns and utilize this ability to avoid trouble. The saliva of their large jaws has a soothing effect on the mind, which helps them to elude predators and is very useful in medicine.
decisions.target: POKENAME以粉角感知情绪，借此避险。巨颚唾液能舒缓心神，帮助逃开捕食者，医药上也很有用。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通过粉红色的角感知他人的情绪，借此避开麻烦。巨大双颚中的唾液能舒缓心神，不仅帮助它们逃脱捕食者，在医药方面也大有用处。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME are chivalrous Pokémon that will leap to defend the weak and frail alike with blades of psychic energy they form upon their elbows. They are a common inspiration for stories of knights that ride upon white steeds to protect others.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME富骑士精神，以肘上精神能量刃，挺身保护弱小。常启发骑白马救人的骑士故事。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME富有骑士精神，会用肘部凝聚出的精神能量之刃，挺身保护弱小。那些骑着白马、守护他人的骑士故事，常以它们为灵感。

decisions.source: A legend states that POKENAME has the wisdom of a king, the fortitude of a knight, and the power to rule over others. It is a courteous Pokémon that makes sure to greet and bow to opponents before attacking gracefully and overwhelmingly.
decisions.target: 传说POKENAME有君王智慧、骑士坚毅与统御之力。它有礼，先问候、鞠躬，再优雅而压倒性地进攻。
decisions.revised: 传说，POKENAME拥有君王的智慧、骑士的坚毅，以及统御他人的力量。它彬彬有礼，出招前总会先向对手问候、鞠躬，随后发起优雅而势不可挡的攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME study different forms of dances and styles, changing the color of their feathers as they perform different routines. They often get so caught up in their dances that they forget to change their colors back to hide again once they're done.
decisions.target: POKENAME研究各式舞蹈，表演不同动作，也换羽色。常沉迷过头，跳完忘了变回保护色，再度隐藏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME钻研各种舞蹈与风格，表演不同的舞步时，羽毛也随之变色。它们常跳得太过入迷，结束后竟忘了变回原来的颜色，再次将自己藏起来。

decisions.source: POKENAME flowers absorb sunlight to convert it into energy to fuel their constant wanderlust. The eye at the centre of their flower can detach and float on its own should they absorb enough energy, allowing them to seek out new places to explore.
decisions.target: POKENAME花朵吸日光供能，满足不断远游的欲望。能量足，花心眼能脱离飘出，寻找新的探索地。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的花朵吸收阳光，转化为能量，支持它们不停远游。能量足够时，花心的眼睛便能脱离身体，自行漂浮，寻找新的地方探索。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be seen swimming deep within lakes at night, the gigantic eye at their centre roving around in the dark in search of prey. Their eye shines with an eerie red light, causing the lakes they swim in to glow at night.
decisions.target: 夜里，能见POKENAME在深湖游泳。中央巨眼在暗中转动，搜寻猎物，诡异红光使湖也在夜间发亮。
decisions.revised: 夜里，能看见POKENAME在湖水深处游动，身体中央的巨眼在黑暗中转动，搜寻猎物。那只眼睛发出诡异的红光，使它们游过的湖水也亮了起来。

decisions.source: The flame at the tip of an POKENAME's tail shines like a miniature sun, although it is only slightly hotter than a candle's flame. Young Trainers often favor having one of these Pokémon around to help them navigate dark tunnels.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾火亮如小太阳，热度却只略高于烛火。年轻训练家常喜欢带一只，帮助穿过黑隧道。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾尖的火焰亮如一轮小太阳，温度却只比烛火稍高。年轻训练家常喜欢带上一只，帮助自己穿过黑暗的隧道。

decisions.source: POKENAME spend most of the day resting beneath the desert sand to remain cool. They emerge from the sand to stretch their wings and glide through the sky. Their main source of food comes from leftovers after carnivorous Pokémon eat their fill.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天大多歇在沙下避暑，出来时才伸翼滑翔。主食是肉食宝可梦吃饱后留下的残余。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天大多在沙漠的沙层下休息，保持凉爽。它们钻出沙子，便伸展翅膀，在空中滑翔。食物主要是肉食宝可梦吃饱后留下的残余。

decisions.source: POKENAME are found in odd shady places in steppe climates, such as in the crevices of trees or even in underground burrows. They run about during the night and are not deterred by the cold due to the natural warmth their bodies generate.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在草原气候区的隐蔽阴处，例如树缝，甚至地洞。夜里奔走，身体天生散热，不惧寒冷。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在草原气候区一些不起眼的阴凉处，例如树木的缝隙，甚至地下洞穴。它们夜间四处奔走，身体天生产生的热量，使它们不畏寒冷。

decisions.source: POKENAME inhabit cold shores and freezing waters, with seaweed, moss, and whatever berries they can find serving as their diet. They tend to live in groups of at least five or up to seven, with the largest serving as the group's leader.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在寒冷海岸与冰水，吃海藻、苔藓及找到的树果。五至七只结群，最大的一只作首领。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖息在寒冷的海岸与冰冷水域，以海藻、苔藓和能找到的各种树果为食。它们通常五到七只结成一群，由体型最大的一只担任首领。

decisions.source: POKENAME claims parts of the forest as its own and marks its territory with will-o'-wisps that mark the area's circumference. Those who enter its domain report a number of symptoms, such as hallucinations, heat stroke, and short-term memory loss.
decisions.target: POKENAME占据部分森林，用鬼火围出领地边界。进入者曾出现幻觉、中暑、短期记忆丧失等症状。
decisions.revised: POKENAME占据森林的一部分，在周围布下鬼火，标明领地的边界。据闯入者所述，他们曾出现幻觉、中暑、短期记忆丧失等多种症状。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a cunning Pokémon, nearly impossible to hit thanks to its unmatched agility. It can curl into a ball in an instant, shielding its weak points with its shell, and hurls sand bombs to hinder foes while executing swift evasive maneuvers.
decisions.target: POKENAME狡黠灵巧，几乎打不中。瞬间蜷成球，用壳护住弱点，再边迅速闪避，边掷沙弹阻碍敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分狡黠，身手敏捷得无与伦比，几乎无法击中。它能瞬间蜷缩成球，以外壳护住弱点，一边迅速闪避，一边投掷沙弹阻碍敌人。

decisions.source: This variety of POKENAME is widely believed to have been cursed once upon a time. Nobody knows why it has only one arm, but it does not seem to be held back by its lack of said appendage.
decisions.target: 人们普遍相信，这种POKENAME曾遭诅咒。为何只有一臂仍不清楚，但似乎并不受影响。
decisions.revised: 人们普遍相信，这种POKENAME曾在很久以前遭到诅咒。没人知道它为何只有一条手臂，不过，少了这条手臂，似乎并没有妨碍它的生活。

decisions.source: Its long tongue is usually used to lap up water, not to fight. After taking in enough water, it will find a wide-open field and bask in the sun. The chubbier the POKENAME, the healthier it is.
decisions.target: 长舌多用来舔水，并非战斗。喝足后就找开阔田野晒太阳。POKENAME越圆胖，就越健康。
decisions.revised: 它的长舌通常用来舔水，而非战斗。喝够水后，就会找一片开阔的田野，悠闲地晒太阳。POKENAME越是圆胖，身体就越健康。

decisions.source: POKENAME's front half resembles Zapdos's Galarian counterpart, and has a strong tendency to run about at high speeds. The back half is less equipped for running in such a manner, so it struggles to keep pace.
decisions.target: POKENAME前半像伽勒尔闪电鸟，极爱高速奔跑。后半身却没那么擅长，费力才能跟上。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的前半身酷似伽勒尔的闪电鸟，非常喜欢高速奔跑。后半身却不太适合这样跑动，常常得费上一番力气，才能跟上前半身。

decisions.source: An extremely territorial beast, the wings of POKENAME allow it to briefly take flight when jumping on its prey. It is said that its golden fur allows it to store energy when the sun is at its zenith.
decisions.target: POKENAME极护地盘，扑向猎物时，双翼能助短飞。据说，金毛能让它在太阳最高时储能。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是一种领地意识极强的猛兽。扑向猎物时，双翼能让它短暂飞起。据说，太阳升至最高处时，它那金色的毛发能储存能量。

decisions.source: Though their appearance is more cutesy, POKENAME are still incredibly fierce Pokémon. Their small claws are sharp enough to create deep cuts in even the toughest skin, though they need to be up close to use them.
decisions.target: POKENAME外表更可爱，却仍极凶。小爪锐利得能深割最坚韧的皮，但得近身才用得到。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然外表更加可爱，性情却依旧极为凶猛。小小的爪子锋利无比，连最坚韧的皮肤也能划出深深的伤口，不过必须贴近对方才能使出。

decisions.source: If POKENAME decides that a forest is too dark, it will topple trees with its powerful tail. It will then scatter seeds onto the forest floor and breathe onto them so that they quickly sprout into colorful flowers.
decisions.target: POKENAME若觉得森林太暗，就以强尾推树，再向林地撒种、吐息，让它们快速萌成彩花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME若觉得森林太暗，便用强壮的尾巴推倒树木。随后，它向林地撒下种子，朝种子吹气，使它们迅速萌发，开出五彩缤纷的花朵。

decisions.source: When its flower tail comes into contact with water, it revives dead algae, making them green and full of life again. POKENAME is a peaceful creature that spends entire days playing in the water with its little family.
decisions.target: 花尾一碰水，就能让死藻，重新碧绿、充满生机。POKENAME平和，整天与小家庭，在水里玩。
decisions.revised: 花朵般的尾巴一碰到水，就能让死去的藻类重获生机，再次变得碧绿鲜活。POKENAME性情平和，常与自己的小家庭，在水中玩上一整天。

decisions.source: POKENAME will attack with a barrage of petals, and then light them on fire to severely burn its opponents. These flames are often mistaken for some kind of supernatural phenomenon, leading to many superstitions about this Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME先发花瓣雨，再点燃，严重灼伤对手。火常被误当超自然现象，带来诸多迷信。
decisions.revised: POKENAME先以密集的花瓣攻击，再将花瓣点燃，严重灼伤对手。这些火焰常被误认为某种超自然现象，因此衍生出许多关于它的迷信传闻。

decisions.source: POKENAME lurk out of sight in swampy water, blending into the native plant life thanks to their symbiotic growths. They have powerful jaws and it is near impossible to break free of them if they bite onto you.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏沼泽水里，借共生植物，融入当地草木。颚极强，一旦咬住，几乎不可能挣脱。
decisions.revised: POKENAME潜藏在沼泽水中，借助身上的共生植物，与当地草木融为一体，难以察觉。它的双颚力量惊人，一旦被咬住，几乎不可能挣脱。

decisions.source: Whenever it gets cold, some people opt to give POKENAME a Health Feather before turning it back towards the wild. The feather helps it endure life's troubles by giving it a little extra heat to keep warm.
decisions.target: 天冷，有人会送POKENAME体力之羽，再放归野外。羽添一点热，帮助保暖，面对生活艰难。
decisions.revised: 天冷时，有些人会先送给POKENAME一根体力之羽，再将它放归野外。羽毛能添上一点暖意，帮助它御寒，度过生活中的种种艰难。

decisions.source: POKENAME swarm together to river banks during the morning, sunning themselves to warm up their bodies. Once they are sufficiently warmed up, they spend the day diving in and out of rivers searching for weeds to feed on.
decisions.target: POKENAME早晨成群到河岸晒暖身体。充分暖和后，整天在河中钻进钻出，寻找水草吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME早晨成群聚到河岸，晒太阳让身体暖和起来。充分暖身后，它们便整天在河里潜入跃出，寻找水草充饥。

decisions.source: The large feathers across POKENAME's heads are indicative of their status in the pack, with the leader having the largest. These Pokémon often fight each other for dominance, using their talons to slice at each other.
decisions.target: POKENAME头上的大羽标明群中地位，首领的最大。它们常用爪互相斩击，争夺统治权。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上的大羽毛，标志着它在群体中的地位；首领的羽毛最大。它们常用利爪相互劈砍，为争夺主导地位而战。

decisions.source: If POKENAME has a vision of a terrible future, its head will spin in circles rapidly. If it is a particularly awful vision, the head will spin faster than normal, a sign of the intensity of its foreseeing.
decisions.target: POKENAME预见可怕未来，头就飞快转圈。景象若特别糟，转得更快，表明预见有多强烈。
decisions.revised: POKENAME若预见可怕的未来，头便会飞快地转圈。若景象格外骇人，头转得还会比平时更快，显示出这次预见有多么强烈。

decisions.source: Every full rotation of POKENAME's gears causes a small burst of light and electric energy to generate from its cores. If the wool on its head is not groomed regularly, it will cause issues with its functionality.
decisions.target: POKENAME齿轮每转完整一圈，核心就迸一小阵光与电。头毛若不常打理，会妨碍功能。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的齿轮每转满一圈，核心就会迸出一小阵光与电能。头上的绒毛若不定期梳理，就会妨碍它正常运作。

decisions.source: POKENAME make their homes high up on the side of cliff faces, living above precipitous drops. They have a tendency to pester neighbouring Pokémon, raiding their nests for food before returning to the safety of their home.
decisions.target: POKENAME在崖面高处安家，下方就是险峭深渊。它爱烦邻居，袭巢抢食，再回安全家中。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在悬崖壁的高处安家，脚下便是陡峭的深渊。它们喜欢招惹邻近的宝可梦，闯进对方巢穴抢夺食物，再回到安全的家中。

decisions.source: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.
decisions.target: POKENAME每年只开一次花，总在同一夜。花开后献给最爱者；两只互换花，就相伴终生。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一年只开一次花，而且年年都在同一个夜晚。花开时，它会将花献给最钟爱的对象。两只POKENAME若这样交换了花朵，便会相伴一生。

decisions.source: POKENAME cares for the tree it lives on throughout its entire life, alongside the other members of its family. Because it is very shy, if it spots a human it freezes completely, pretending to be made of wood.
decisions.target: POKENAME终生与家人一起，照料所住的大树。十分害羞，一见人就完全僵住，装成木头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一生都与家族成员一起，照料自己栖居的大树。它非常害羞，一发现人类，便会僵在原地，一动不动，假装自己也是木头。

decisions.source: POKENAME wrap a thin layer of puffy silk across their abdomen to store webbing until it is ready to be used as a parachute. Once airborne, they release their webbing all at once to glide through the wind.
decisions.target: POKENAME腹外裹一层薄蓬丝，储存准备用作降落伞的网。一腾空便全放开，随风滑翔。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在腹部裹上一层薄薄的蓬松丝线，将蛛网收存其中，留作降落伞。一旦腾空，便会将网一下子全部放开，随风滑翔。

decisions.source: POKENAME enjoys roasted berries, spitting small fireballs at ones growing on trees to cook them before eating. Its tongue is covered with burn marks from not waiting for berries to properly cool down before trying to eat them.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱吃烤树果，会吐小火球，先在树上烤熟。可总不等凉好便吃，舌头满是烫痕。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢吃烤树果，会向树上结着的树果吐出小火球，烤熟再吃。可它总等不及树果充分冷却，便急着入口，舌头上满是烫伤的痕迹。

decisions.source: POKENAME take their training very seriously. If these Pokémon cannot accomplish a goal they have set, they will become enraged. Stomping their feet, they will begin slashing and bashing at boulders with their tails and sharp claws.
decisions.target: POKENAME对训练极认真。设定目标却达不成，就会暴怒跺脚，用尾巴与利爪劈砸巨石。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对训练极其认真。如果达不到自己定下的目标，就会勃然大怒，连连跺脚，开始用尾巴和利爪，劈砍、猛砸巨石。

decisions.source: POKENAME's ears are hard and sharp like blades for defense. Under the light of the moon, if this Pokémon is moved by a strong sense of justice, its rings will glow with a blinding golden light.
decisions.target: POKENAME耳硬如利刃，可作防御。月光下，若被强烈正义感打动，圆环便发出耀眼金光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的耳朵坚硬而锋利，如同利刃，能用来防御。在月光下，若它心中涌起强烈的正义感，身上的圆环便会绽放耀眼的金光。

decisions.source: POKENAME deftly wields its ribbons like whips, striking at those who would harm others with their pointed ends. Cuts caused by its attacks cause the wounded party to slowly be sapped of their fighting spirit until they collapse.
decisions.target: POKENAME灵巧以缎带作鞭，用尖端攻击想伤人者。伤口慢慢抽走敌人斗志，直到倒下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME灵巧地将缎带挥舞成鞭，用尖端抽击企图伤害他人的家伙。被划伤后，伤者的斗志会一点点流失，直到倒下。

decisions.source: Waiting patiently, POKENAME shift the colors of their scales to blend in with the water's surface. Once prey wanders near, their tongues shoot out to grab them, pulling them into their mouths before snapping their jaws shut.
decisions.target: POKENAME耐心等待，鳞色与水面相融。猎物走近，舌头便射出抓住，拉入口，再猛合双颚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME变换鳞片的颜色，与水面融为一体，耐心等待。猎物一靠近，它们便射出舌头，将其卷入口中，随后猛地合拢双颚。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their lower limbs to quickly move along the ground but can even walk along walls and ceilings. The feelers of their fingertips serve as conduits for their mystical energies, through which they often create defensive barriers.
decisions.target: POKENAME用下肢快速走地，也能攀墙顶。指尖触须引导神秘能量，常用来造防御屏障。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠下肢在地面快速移动，甚至能沿墙壁和天花板行走。指尖的触须可以传导神秘能量，它常借此制造防御屏障。

decisions.source: The ring above POKENAME's head adjusts its position to absorb the most sunlight possible at any given time. If in danger, the ring responds instinctively and fires off the stored energy in a blazing Solar Beam attack.
decisions.target: POKENAME头上环不断调位，随时尽量吸光。遇险会本能回应，以炽烈日光束释放储能。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头顶的圆环会不断调整位置，随时尽可能多地吸收阳光。一遇危险，圆环便会本能地作出反应，将储存的能量，化为炽烈的日光束射出。

decisions.source: POKENAME makes its home in forests with ancient, exposed rock that has been worn down flat from millennia of erosion. They are a staunch defender of their nest, using their stony head to slam opponents with ruthless attacks.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在森林里，古老露岩被千年侵蚀磨平。它坚定护巢，以石质头部无情撞敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖居的森林里，裸露着古老的岩石，历经数千年侵蚀，已被磨得平坦。它坚决守护巢穴，以石质头部，向对手发起毫不留情的撞击。

decisions.source: POKENAME hunts by using its extremely rapid wingbeat to kick up dirt and dust to obscure the area. It then swoops by and snatches up its prey with the strong jaws of the false mouth on its tail.
decisions.target: POKENAME以极快振翅扬起尘土，遮蔽周围，再飞掠过去，用尾部假嘴的强颚抓住猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME狩猎时，会飞快振翅，扬起尘土，遮蔽四周。随后，它飞掠而过，用尾部假嘴那强壮的双颚，猛然叼起猎物。

decisions.source: Proud of its appearance, POKENAME spends a good amount of time per day grooming and preening itself. The small bursts of fire it breathes out burn in a shifting rainbow of hues, making them quite the visual spectacle.
decisions.target: POKENAME对外貌自豪，每天花不少时间梳洗。吐出的小团火焰会变换虹彩，十分夺目。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对自己的外貌十分自豪，每天花不少时间梳洗、整理羽毛。它吐出的一小团团火焰，燃烧时会变换出彩虹般的色彩，格外绚丽夺目。

decisions.source: Twirling rapidly to build up energy, POKENAME defend themselves with the rings that surround their bodies. If they ever need to get out of trouble, they rapidly rotate their rings to propel themselves upwards with the magnetic force.
decisions.target: POKENAME快速旋转积能，以身边圆环自卫。需要脱困时，就急转圆环，借磁力向上推进。
decisions.revised: POKENAME快速旋转来积蓄能量，并用环绕身体的圆环自卫。需要脱困时，它会让圆环飞速转动，借磁力将自己向上推进。

decisions.source: Due to its large size, POKENAME requires an extremely large amount of coal to be able to move. The many spinning gears inside of POKENAME's body allow it to generate electricity, which it uses to attack its opponents.
decisions.target: POKENAME体形大，得吃极多煤才能移动。体内许多旋转齿轮让它发电，用来攻击对手。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体型庞大，需要消耗极多的煤炭，才能移动身体。体内众多旋转的齿轮，能使它产生电力，用来攻击对手。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a fearsome aerial hunter using its power over space to cut off its prey's escape. It opens up portals through space in front of prey while they flee, which drop them right into POKENAME's grasp.
decisions.target: POKENAME是凶猛空中猎手，用空间能力断逃路。猎物逃跑时，前方开门，正落入它手中。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是凶猛的空中猎手，能操纵空间，截断猎物的退路。猎物奔逃时，它会在前方开启空间传送门，让对方径直落入自己掌中。

decisions.source: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of which gems it has recently eaten. If it does not eat enough jewels, the fire on its tail will grow dim and weak.
decisions.target: 尾尖火焰，能看出它最近吃过什么宝石。珠宝吃得不够，尾火就会暗淡虚弱。
decisions.revised: 尾尖燃烧的火焰，能反映它最近吃过哪种宝石。如果摄入的珠宝不够充足，尾巴上的火焰，就会变得暗淡而微弱。

decisions.source: After it sheds its shell, chefs will wander to collect the shells to grind and pulverize into a thick paste. This thick paste is poured onto tropical desserts to serve a mildly sweet taste of dragon fruit.
decisions.target: 它蜕壳后，厨师四处收集，磨成浓糊，浇在热带甜点上，添一丝淡甜火龙果味。
decisions.revised: 它蜕壳后，厨师们便会四处收集这些壳，将其碾碎，磨成浓稠的糊。把糊浇在热带风味的甜点上，就能添上一抹淡甜的火龙果滋味。

decisions.source: POKENAME have incredibly rough scales that are capable of grating solid rock and damaging ship hulls if they collide against either. They typically hunt down large schools of small Pokémon, swallowing many of them whole per meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME鳞极粗，碰岩能刮坚石，撞船能伤船体。通常猎大群小宝可梦，一餐整吞许多。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的鳞片极其粗糙，碰上坚硬的岩石也能将其刮损，撞上船只则会损伤船体。它们通常捕猎成大群的小型宝可梦，每餐都会整只吞下许多。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a sturdy wooden stump atop their head and often ferry other Pokémon across bodies of water. They often release a happy whistle whenever the Pokémon they help give them a reward for their help.
decisions.target: POKENAME头顶有坚固木桩，常渡其他宝可梦过水。受助者若送谢礼，就会吹开心口哨。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头顶长着坚实的木桩，常载着其他宝可梦渡过水域。得到受助者送上的谢礼时，它往往会吹起欢快的口哨。

decisions.source: POKENAME clad themselves in protective cloaks of leaves held together with sticky bubbles; as such, they nest within tree foliage. They spit out many bubbles to put out flames and prevent forest fires, then hunt down those responsible.
decisions.target: POKENAME披叶衣，以黏泡固定，便在树叶间筑巢。吐大量泡灭火、防林火，再追捕肇事者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用黏性泡泡将树叶连成防护披风，因此会在树木的枝叶间筑巢。它们吐出大量泡泡，扑灭火焰、防止森林火灾，随后再追捕纵火者。

decisions.source: With a single wave of its wand, POKENAME causes all sounds in its immediate area to echo and amplify in volume. It often does this to unsettle its opponent, though this tends to irritate nearby allies as well.
decisions.target: POKENAME挥杖一下，身边一切声音便回响放大。常用来令敌不安，却也惹烦附近伙伴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME只需挥一下魔杖，附近的一切声音便会回响，音量随之放大。它常用这招扰乱对手，却也往往惹得附近的伙伴心烦。

decisions.source: The jungle is a dangerous place with POKENAME around. It will lie flat on the ground, and stepping on its tail will result in a sting so painful that one will be in agony for three days straight.
decisions.target: 有POKENAME的丛林很危险。它平趴地面，谁踩上尾巴，就会被蜇得接连三天痛不欲生。
decisions.revised: 有POKENAME出没的丛林，十分危险。它平趴在地上，谁若踩到它的尾巴，就会挨上一蜇，剧痛足以让人接连三天痛不欲生。

decisions.source: POKENAME enjoys playing in the sand, using its shovel and psychic powers to construct different shapes and patterns. Once it's done playing, it will let the sand rest in piles to act as blankets for a nap.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱玩沙，用铲子与超能力造出各种形状、图案。玩够，就留成沙堆，当被子小睡。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢玩沙，用铲子和超能力，堆出各种形状与图案。玩够以后，它会将沙子留成一堆堆，当作被子，舒舒服服地小睡。

decisions.source: POKENAME digs with ease using its hard mouth and sharp claws. Its favorite food is the roots of trees. If it uncovers a mushroom, it will stare at it for a moment before moving on without eating it.
decisions.target: POKENAME以硬嘴、利爪轻松掘地，最爱吃树根。若挖出蘑菇，却只盯一会儿，就绕过不吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用坚硬的嘴和锋利的爪子，便能轻松挖掘。它最爱吃树根，若挖出蘑菇，却只会盯着看一会儿，就继续前行，并不吃掉。

decisions.source: POKENAME are highly playful Pokémon, frequently sighted on beaches that children often visit. They will assist in building sand castles on the beaches where they reside, allowing children to use the tools on their heads and backs.
decisions.target: POKENAME贪玩，常在孩子爱去的海滩现身。它帮忙筑沙堡，也让孩子用头、背上的工具。
decisions.revised: POKENAME非常贪玩，常出现在孩子们爱去的海滩。它会帮忙在栖居的沙滩上堆沙堡，还会让孩子们使用自己头上和背上的工具。

decisions.source: POKENAME carries a bone with it at all times, and sharpens one end of it over time. It uses the pointed end to chisel away at large ice blocks, digging itself out a den for when night falls.
decisions.target: POKENAME始终带着骨头，慢慢磨尖一端。用尖端凿开大冰块，挖出夜幕降临后的栖所。
decisions.revised: POKENAME随时都带着一根骨头，日积月累，将其中一端磨尖。它用尖端凿削大冰块，为自己挖出一处，供夜幕降临时歇息的窝。

decisions.source: POKENAME shoots bubbles from its mouth to annoy swimmers who dive into the waters where it lives, and keeps doing so until they leave. When the battle gets tough, it takes on the appearance of its opponent to make them let their guard down.
decisions.target: POKENAME向进入家园水域的泳客吐泡，烦到对方离开。战况不利，就变成对手外表，使其放松警惕。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会向潜入自己栖居水域的游泳者吐泡泡，不停骚扰，直到对方离开。战斗艰难时，它会变成对手的模样，使对方放松警惕。

decisions.source: POKENAME's fire is both incredibly strong and superheated, yet it miraculously doesn't harm any plant it spreads over. This is because the fire is filled with the power to revitalize plants, so any damage done by the fire is ironically burned away.
decisions.target: POKENAME火势强、温度高，却奇妙地不伤所过植物。火里充满复苏之力，任何损伤，反而一并被“烧去”。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的火焰猛烈而炽热，却奇迹般地不会伤害蔓延之处的任何植物。因为火中充满让植物复苏的力量，就连火焰造成的损伤，也会反被“烧去”。

decisions.source: POKENAME school together under the full moon and will jump out of the water to try and bathe themselves in moonlight. Why they do this is unclear, but legends say that if a POKENAME can jump to the moon it will undergo an incredible transformation.
decisions.target: POKENAME满月下成群游，跃出水面，试着沐浴月光。原因不明，传说若跳到月亮，就会经历惊人变化。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在满月下成群游动，跃出水面，试着让自己沐浴月光。原因尚不清楚，不过传说，若有POKENAME能跃上月亮，便会发生惊人的变化。

decisions.source: According to legend, POKENAME watches over the dreams of humans and Pokémon alike, keeping evil spirits away with the light it can emit from its tail. It is said that anyone who touches its soft wool will fall into a deep, sweet sleep.
decisions.target: 传说POKENAME守望人和宝可梦的梦，用尾光驱邪。据说谁碰柔软羊毛，就会陷入深沉甜美的睡眠。
decisions.revised: 传说，POKENAME守护着人类与宝可梦的梦，用尾巴发出的光驱散邪灵。据说，只要触碰它柔软的羊毛，便会沉入深沉而甜美的梦乡。

decisions.source: POKENAME have floats attached to their tails that they can control the buoyancy of, enabling them to return to the surface of the water in seconds if they need to. They are a popular companion of lifeguards and are trained to rescue drowning people.
decisions.target: POKENAME能控制尾部浮具的浮力，需要时数秒就回水面。它是救生员的热门伙伴，受训救溺水者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾部连着浮具，能自行调节浮力，必要时几秒内就能回到水面。它们深受救生员喜爱，经过训练，能救助溺水的人。

decisions.source: POKENAME can live on land or in the water due to its fins and legs. However, this Pokémon struggles to run, constantly tripping over its own feet and rolling forwards. It also has problems navigating in the water because of its small fins.
decisions.target: POKENAME有鳍有腿，能水陆生活。可跑步总被自己的脚绊住，往前滚；小鳍也使水中辨向移动困难。
decisions.revised: POKENAME既有鳍又有腿，能够在水里和陆地生活。不过，它跑起步来很吃力，总被自己的脚绊倒，向前滚去；小小的鳍，也让它在水中行动不便。

decisions.source: POKENAME takes pride in caring for the chicks in the nest on its back and preparing them to leave. POKENAME monitors the chicks as they practice walking, using its heated vines to pick them up when they fall or place them back into the nest.
decisions.target: POKENAME以照料背上巢里的幼鸟、帮助离巢为傲。看着它们练走，跌倒就用热藤扶起，或放回巢中。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以照料背上巢中的幼鸟，并帮助它们为离巢作准备而自豪。幼鸟练习走路时，它会在一旁看护，跌倒了，就用温热的藤蔓扶起，或放回巢中。

decisions.source: If you're being accosted on the street at night, you can rest assured that a POKENAME will come to your aid. They aren't selfless though; if you fail to pay them for their time, you won't be as lucky next time.
decisions.target: 夜间在街头受纠缠，放心，POKENAME会来相助。可并非无私，若不付时间报酬，下次就未必如此幸运。
decisions.revised: 夜间若在街头受到纠缠，可以放心，POKENAME会前来相助。不过，它们并非毫无私心；若不为它们付出的时间支付报酬，下次可就没那么幸运了。

decisions.source: Parts of POKENAME's body tint crimson when its temper reaches its boiling point. It lets out sharp cries and swings its limbs through the air to vent this temper, each motion causing the area to tremble from the sheer energy of its raging.
decisions.target: POKENAME怒到顶点，部分身体就染猩红。它尖叫挥肢发泄，狂怒中的能量让每个动作都震动四周。
decisions.revised: POKENAME怒火冲到顶点时，身体的部分区域，会染上猩红。它发出尖锐的叫声，挥动四肢宣泄怒气；狂怒的能量，使每个动作都震动四周。

decisions.source: Ancient Johtonian texts call POKENAME 'It That Brings Rapture'. One flap of its wings is enough to create a raging flow of wind, however it's harmless and only causes others swept up in it to be hit with an inexplicable sense of jubilance.
decisions.target: 古城都文献称POKENAME为“带来狂喜的存在”。一振翅便掀狂风，却无害，只让卷入者感到莫名欢欣。
decisions.revised: 城都的古老文献称POKENAME为“带来狂喜的存在”。它只需一振翅，就能掀起汹涌的狂风，不过这风毫无伤害，只会让卷入其中者，感到莫名的欢欣。

decisions.source: POKENAME emerges from beneath the sand to hunt in the desert at night, sensing other Pokémon in the dark by detecting their body heat. After slashing at ankles to trip its prey up, POKENAME wraps its cloth around the head to drain life force.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜里从沙下现身，感应其他宝可梦体热狩猎。先割脚踝绊倒，再用布裹住头，吸取生命力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜里从沙漠的沙层下现身，靠感知体温，在黑暗中追踪其他宝可梦。它先划伤猎物的脚踝，将其绊倒，再用布裹住对方的头，吸取生命力。

decisions.source: These tiny Pokémon often use their slimy bodies to cling to other Pokémon in order to get around. They carry a ball of silk webbing atop their backs, which is filled with crushed up nuts to feed on during their journeys.
decisions.target: 它们身体很小，常用黏身攀上别的宝可梦搭便车。背上丝球里装满碎坚果，供旅途食用。
decisions.revised: 这些小小的宝可梦，常用黏滑的身体，依附在其他宝可梦身上，借此出行。背上驮着一团丝网，里面装满了压碎的坚果，留作旅途中的食物。

decisions.source: POKENAME's metal body naturally sinks, so it spends most of its time on the seabed, firing  torpedoes from the launcher on its back at prey swimming above. After hitting a target, POKENAME leaps up through the water to seize it with its steel teeth.
decisions.target: POKENAME金属身自然下沉，大多留海底，背部发射器向上方猎物射鱼雷。命中后跃水，用钢牙咬住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的金属身体会自然下沉，因此它大多待在海底，用背上的发射器，向上方游过的猎物发射鱼雷。击中目标后，它便从水中跃起，用钢牙将其咬住。

decisions.source: POKENAME will find the largest tree in a forest and make its nest there. There it enters a trance to commune with all the trees in the forest, where it watches for threats. POKENAME will protect its forest, unfazed by even the strongest of foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME在全林最大树上筑巢，出神与所有树相通，留意威胁。保护森林，再强的敌人也动摇不了。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会在森林里最大的一棵树上筑巢，进入恍惚状态，与林中所有树木沟通，留意潜在的威胁。它守护自己的森林，即使最强大的敌人，也无法使它动摇。

decisions.source: During the day, POKENAME climbs to the tops of mountains to absorb sunlight. At night, this Pokémon digs shallow burrows to rest, and while sleeping in said burrows, it appears to casual bystanders as just a simple rock.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天爬山顶吸收阳光，夜里挖浅穴休息。睡在里面时，粗看只像一块普通石头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天攀上山顶，吸收阳光；夜里则挖出浅浅的洞穴，躺下休息。睡在洞中时，旁人若不仔细看，只会把它当成一块普通的石头。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its extending vines to constrict around its prey. Once it has them fully in its grasp, it sets the vines alight with its fire breath, holding them down and roasting them until they're ready for consumption.
decisions.target: POKENAME伸出藤蔓缠住猎物。彻底抓牢后，再用吐息点燃藤条，压住猎物烘烤，直到能吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME伸长藤蔓，紧紧缠住猎物。等到完全抓牢，就用火焰吐息点燃藤蔓，将猎物牢牢按住，烘烤至可以食用为止。

decisions.source: POKENAME lights up its flame at night to try and attract prey. The act of doing so is exhausting for it, though, so by the time anything is drawn close enough to hunt, POKENAME is too tired to do so.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜里点火，想引来猎物。可这动作太累，等什么终于靠得够近，POKENAME又累得捕不动了。
decisions.revised: POKENAME夜里点起火焰，试图引来猎物。可维持火焰十分耗费体力，等到猎物终于靠得足够近，它却已经累得无力捕猎了。

decisions.source: POKENAME live inside tunnels they dig into the side of riverbanks. If other Pokémon approach their burrow, POKENAME will rush out to attack with their sharp claws and powerful tail, relying on the spikes on their back for protection.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在河岸侧挖出的隧道。谁靠近洞穴，POKENAME就冲出，以利爪、强尾攻击，再靠背刺护身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME住在河岸侧面挖出的隧道中。其他宝可梦一靠近洞穴，它便冲出，用锋利的爪子和强壮的尾巴攻击，再靠背上的尖刺保护自己。

decisions.source: After being struck by lightning, POKENAME's body becomes energized and can produce a large amount of spores in a very short period. It can generate enough to coat an entire village in a thin layer of yellow powder.
decisions.target: POKENAME挨雷后，身体充满活力，能极短时间产出大量孢子，足以给整村覆上薄薄黄粉。
decisions.revised: 遭到雷击后，POKENAME的身体便充满能量，能在极短时间内，产生大量孢子，足以让整个村庄，都覆上一层薄薄的黄色粉末。

decisions.source: POKENAME nest in alpine regions, finding hollows amongst tree roots to hide their nests from predators. Their chirps and cries can be heard echoing through the forests, turning frantic and aggressive should someone get too close to their nest.
