decisions.target: POKENAME在高山筑巢，藏于树根空洞，躲捕食者。啾叫回荡森林，谁近巢，就转成惊慌凶声。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在高山地区筑巢，寻找树根间的空洞，将巢藏好，避开捕食者。它们的啾鸣与叫声回荡林间；谁若靠巢太近，叫声便会变得慌乱而凶狠。

decisions.source: POKENAME requires all four of its wings to flap at full force in order to keep its heavy body aloft. It scrapes its sharp talons across the ground four times in a row before taking off into the air.
decisions.target: POKENAME四翼必须全力拍动，才能让沉重身体留在空中。起飞前，会用尖爪连续刮地4次。
decisions.revised: POKENAME必须全力拍动四只翅膀，才能让沉重的身体留在空中。每次起飞前，它都会用锋利的脚爪，连续刮擦地面四次。

decisions.source: POKENAME awaken at sunrise each day to find the best places to absorb sunlight and ride on gentle gusts of wind to quickly move from one spot to another. They stay put during cloudy days to avoid getting tired.
decisions.target: POKENAME每天日出醒来，找最佳晒太阳处，借微风快速换位置。阴天则待着不动，免得累。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每天日出时醒来，寻找最适合吸收阳光的地方，借轻柔的风，迅速从一处移到另一处。阴天时，它们便待着不动，免得消耗体力。

decisions.source: When this Pokémon creates a nest, it considers any area it can see from its home to be its territory. POKENAME will use its talons, beak, and fire attacks to fend off opponents who encroach on its land.
decisions.target: POKENAME筑巢后，从家里看得见的地方，都算领地。谁敢闯入，就用爪、喙与火焰攻击驱赶。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦筑巢以后，会将从家中看得见的所有区域，都视为自己的领地。谁若侵入，POKENAME便会用脚爪、喙和火焰攻击，将对方赶走。

decisions.source: POKENAME carries soil in its eggshell to help it collect water and nutrients as it journeys. However, the cracks in the shell for its feet leak soil, so it must refill often with dirt from all over the region.
decisions.target: POKENAME在蛋壳里带土，旅行时收集水和养分。可脚边裂口会漏土，只好常从各地补充。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在蛋壳里带着土，帮助自己在旅途中收集水分与养分。不过，双脚所在的壳缝会漏土，只好经常从各地取土补充。

decisions.source: POKENAME detects people who are in danger with its psychic powers, teleporting to where a person is to rescue them. When POKENAME saves someone, it will give them one of its feathers, which brings good luck to whoever touches it.
decisions.target: POKENAME用超能力感知遇险者，瞬间移动去救。救人后会送一根羽毛，谁碰到都带好运。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用超能力感知遇险的人，再瞬间移动到对方身边，展开救援。救下人后，它会送出自己的一根羽毛，给所有触碰羽毛的人带来好运。

decisions.source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly, instead it uses its powerful legs to sprint across open plains in pursuit of prey. It ambushes smaller Pokémon with sudden bursts of speed and drags them back to its hidden nest.
decisions.target: POKENAME太重不能飞，改用强腿在旷野追猎。突然爆发速度伏击小宝可梦，再拖回暗巢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME太重，无法飞翔，便靠强壮的双腿，在开阔的平原上奔跑追猎。它猛然加速，伏击体型较小的宝可梦，再将其拖回隐蔽的巢穴。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME will conceal themselves within storm clouds as they search for prey. Each strike from their pincers is not only strong enough to break rocks, but also charged with enough electricity to even stun Grass-type Pokémon.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME藏雷云找猎物。每下钳击既能碎石，又带足电，连草属性宝可梦也能震晕。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME寻找猎物时，会藏身于雷暴云中。它们的钳子每一击，不仅有碎石之力，还带着足以让草属性宝可梦也麻痹的强大电力。

decisions.source: POKENAME hunts both in rivers and in the air, aided by its water-repellent fur. It will be dry as soon as it leaves the water, enabling it to immediately take flight without being weighed down by wet fur.
decisions.target: POKENAME在河中和空中都能狩猎，毛发防水。出水立刻变干，可立即起飞，不被湿毛拖累。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在河里和空中都能捕猎，身上的毛发具有防水作用。一离开水面，毛发就会变干，使它能立刻起飞，不被湿毛拖累。

decisions.source: POKENAME encases itself in a bubble of psychic energy before descending to the bottom of lakes to sleep. The loud, croaking rumble of its snoring can be heard from above the water no matter how deep it has dived.
decisions.target: POKENAME用精神能量泡裹身，再潜湖底睡。鼾声如低沉蛙鸣，无论潜多深，水上也听得到。
decisions.revised: POKENAME先用精神能量形成的泡泡裹住全身，再沉到湖底睡觉。它的鼾声响亮，像隆隆的蛙鸣，无论潜得多深，从水面上也听得见。

decisions.source: POKENAME patrols the streams that flow through the woods and clears them of natural or man-made obstructions, thereby preserving the health of the environment. The curved antenna on its head allows it to predict rain with extreme accuracy.
decisions.target: POKENAME巡视林溪，清自然或人为障碍，维护环境健康。头上弯触角能极准确地预测雨。
decisions.revised: POKENAME巡视流经森林的溪流，清除天然或人为造成的阻塞，维护环境的健康。头顶弯曲的触角，让它能极为准确地预测降雨。

decisions.source: POKENAME are clumsy and often fall over, but their bodies are so light that this never causes them any damage. In windy weather, they hold hands with Pokémon they have befriended to prevent themselves from being blown away.
decisions.target: POKENAME笨拙常摔，身体却轻得从不因此受伤。风天会牵友好宝可梦的手，防止被吹走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME行动笨拙，常常摔倒，可身体非常轻，从不会因此受伤。有风时，它们会牵住交好宝可梦的手，以免被吹走。

decisions.source: POKENAME swim by twirling their leaves above their head like a propeller, floating up into the current and spinning happily across the surface of rivers and streams. They playfully spray Bubbles at one another as they are swept downriver.
decisions.target: POKENAME把头上叶转如螺旋桨，浮入水流，开心旋过河溪。顺流漂下时，会彼此喷泡沫玩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将头顶的叶片转得像螺旋桨一样，借此游泳，浮入水流，在河溪表面欢快地旋转。顺流而下时，它们还会互相喷出泡沫，嬉戏玩耍。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very methodical, so they grow frustrated if the large flowers on their heads are caught in the wind or left askew. They flap their flower-like wings to re-adjust themselves until all three flowers are synchronized.
decisions.target: POKENAME讲究条理，头上大花被风吹乱、歪斜，就烦躁。它拍花翼调整，直到三朵花全同步。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分讲究条理，头上的大花若被风吹乱，或歪向一边，就会感到烦躁。它会拍动花朵般的翅膀，调整姿态，直到三朵花的动作一致。

decisions.source: POKENAME will often bully other Pokémon in the area into sharing their food. If a rival encroaches on their territory, they'll try to menace each other. If neither retreats, an intense but short battle determines the victor.
decisions.target: POKENAME常欺负附近宝可梦，逼分食。对手闯领地，先互吓；谁也不退，就用短促激战决胜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常欺负附近的宝可梦，逼它们分享食物。若有对手侵入领地，双方会先互相恐吓；谁也不肯退让时，就会以一场短暂而激烈的战斗决出胜负。

decisions.source: The loose skin around the bodies of POKENAME help protect them from serious injury when they scrap with one another. They have a tendency to scratch at one another and bite with their sharp teeth when fighting for food.
decisions.target: POKENAME身上的松皮，有助于在互相打架时避免重伤。争食时，它爱抓挠彼此、用利牙咬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上松弛的皮肤，能在彼此争斗时，帮助它们避免严重的伤害。争抢食物时，它们往往会相互抓挠，再用锋利的牙齿撕咬。

decisions.source: In combat, POKENAME flap their wings to lift themselves into the air, then deliver a series of rapid-fire kicks using both legs. POKENAME always seems to anticipate where foes will flee to and makes sure to get there first.
decisions.target: POKENAME战斗时振翼腾空，再用双腿接连快踢。似乎总能预料敌人会往哪逃，抢先抵达。
decisions.revised: 战斗时，POKENAME拍动翅膀腾空，随后用双腿使出一连串迅疾的踢击。它似乎总能预料敌人会逃向哪里，并抢先赶到。

decisions.source: POKENAME stomps through swamps and marshes in search of old, rotten tree stumps that are full of dense cellulose. It tenses its legs to build up energy before ramming into these tree stumps, breaking the wood into edible chunks.
decisions.target: POKENAME踏过沼泽，寻找富含纤维素的腐旧树桩。绷腿蓄能，再撞上树桩，碎成可食木块。
decisions.revised: POKENAME踏过沼泽湿地，寻找富含纤维素的腐旧树桩。它绷紧双腿积蓄能量，再猛撞树桩，将木头撞成可以食用的小块。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is covered in hundreds of poisonous hairs, which dissuades bird Pokémon from trying to eat it. If the soil around it is lacking in nutrients, it will start to nibble on other plants for sustenance.
decisions.target: POKENAME全身数百毒毛，让鸟宝可梦不愿吃。附近土壤缺养分，就开始啃其他植物维生。
decisions.revised: POKENAME全身覆盖数百根毒毛，使鸟类宝可梦不愿尝试捕食它。如果周围的土壤缺乏养分，它就会开始啃食其他植物，维持生计。

decisions.source: POKENAME are guardians for their younger siblings and do their best to keep them in the nest. When they are angry, they breathe out hot flames to signal to their younger siblings that it is time to calm down.
decisions.target: POKENAME守护弟妹，尽力让它们留在巢里。生气时，它们喷出热焰，示意弟妹该安静下来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME守护着年幼的弟妹，尽力让它们留在巢中。生气时，它会喷出炽热的火焰，向弟妹示意，该安静下来了。

decisions.source: POKENAME will kick up dust with its wings and then manipulate it to serve as an accentuation of its dance routines. The hum created by the rapid beating of its wings serves as the musical backdrop to its dancing.
decisions.target: POKENAME以翅膀扬起尘土，操纵沙尘，衬托舞步。快速振翅产生的嗡鸣，就是舞蹈的伴奏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用翅膀扬起尘土，再操纵沙尘，衬托自己的舞步。翅膀快速拍动时发出的嗡鸣，则成了舞蹈的伴奏。

decisions.source: POKENAME's milk is said to be packed with so much power and nutrients that it would give the drinker the strength to move a planet. It has rarely, if ever, been seen sharing its milk with humans, however.
decisions.target: 据说POKENAME奶中力量与营养极盛，喝下便能搬动行星。但几乎从未被见到分享给人。
decisions.revised: 据说，POKENAME的奶富含无比强大的力量与营养，能让饮用者获得移动行星的力气。不过，人们几乎从未见过它，将自己的奶分享给人类。

decisions.source: POKENAME's gelatinous body gives it pitiful defenses, so it hides away inside tree holes for safety. It uses psychic powers to pluck leaves and berries from the tree and bring them back to its home to feast on.
decisions.target: POKENAME胶身防御差得可怜，便藏进树洞。它以超能力摘下树叶树果，搬回家，饱餐一顿。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体如同凝胶，防御力差得可怜，便藏在树洞里求得安全。它用超能力从树上摘下叶子与树果，送回家中，饱餐一顿。

decisions.source: POKENAME have no eyes and are totally reliant on their acute hearing for navigation. They will sometimes use their little wings to knock small pebbles around, listening out for the echoes to get a good sense of their surroundings.
decisions.target: POKENAME没有眼睛，全靠敏锐听觉辨路。有时用小翼敲动石粒，聆听回响，好好掌握四周。
decisions.revised: POKENAME没有眼睛，完全依靠敏锐的听觉辨别方向。有时，它会用小翅膀拨动周围的石子，仔细聆听回声，掌握四周的情况。

decisions.source: POKENAME carries with it a giant gem that works as a shield to deflect blows. If an attack manages to blemish its precious jewel, it flies into a rage and attempts to crush its foe with its bare hands.
decisions.target: POKENAME带着一颗巨宝石，作盾挡击。攻击若损伤了珍宝，它便暴怒，想用双手捏碎敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME随身带着一颗巨大的宝石，当作盾牌，挡开攻击。若有攻击损伤了心爱的宝石，它便会勃然大怒，试图徒手将敌人捏碎。

decisions.source: POKENAME are cunning, sneaky Pokémon that love shiny things and steal any that they find. They live in caves where they hide their loot and will attack anyone who tries to take even the slightest part of it.
decisions.target: POKENAME狡猾隐秘，喜爱亮物，找到什么都偷。赃物藏在洞里，谁想拿走一点，就会遭攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME狡猾又善于潜行，喜欢闪闪发亮的东西，发现了就会偷走。它们住在洞穴里，将赃物藏好；谁想拿走哪怕一丁点，也会遭到攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME love to play hockey with other Pokémon but often have a hard time handling a hockey stick. Their flippers are unable to firmly grasp the stick, leading to many accidents where the stick slams into their heads.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱与其他宝可梦打冰球，却常拿不稳球杆。鳍肢抓不牢，球杆频频砸到自己头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢与其他宝可梦打冰球，却常常拿不稳球杆。鳍肢无法牢牢抓住球杆，于是频频发生球杆砸到自己头上的意外。

decisions.source: POKENAME sit with their arms crossed and their fangs bared whenever they rest as a means to deter others. When they are awake and active, POKENAME find tough fruits and tree bark to gnaw on to keep their jaws strong.
decisions.target: POKENAME休息也双臂交叉、露出獠牙，吓退旁人。醒来活动，会啃硬水果与树皮，保持颚力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME休息时，总会交叉双臂，露出獠牙，借此吓退旁人。醒来活动后，它们会寻找坚硬的果实与树皮啃咬，让双颚保持强壮。

decisions.source: POKENAME experience a jolt of energy whenever they absorb lots of sunlight and run around wildly to burn off some of the excess energy. During winter when there is little sunlight, they conserve their energy by limiting their movement.
decisions.target: POKENAME吸足日光，就精力猛增，四处狂跑，消耗多余能量。冬日日照少，便少动保存体力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吸收大量阳光后，精力便会猛然涌起，于是四处狂奔，消耗一部分多余的能量。冬天日照较少，它们便减少活动，保存体力。

decisions.source: POKENAME are a common Pokémon to be included in aquariums, their leaves filtering out impurities in the water whilst their shell keeps them from being disturbed. They pump water past their leaves by opening and closing their shells.
decisions.target: POKENAME常被养在水族箱，叶滤水中杂质，壳则护它免打扰。开合甲壳，就让水流经叶片。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是水族箱里常见的宝可梦，叶片能过滤水中的杂质，外壳则保护自己免受打扰。它们通过开合外壳，将水抽送过叶片。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be found at festivals at night, channeling a ghostly fire that surrounds it while it dances in the moonlight. It is said that bearing witness to this mystical dance extends one's lifespan just a little longer.
decisions.target: 夜间节庆常能见POKENAME，月下跳舞时引幽火绕身。据说观赏这神秘舞蹈，能稍稍延寿。
decisions.revised: 夜晚的节庆中，常能看见POKENAME在月光下起舞，引导幽幽的火焰环绕身边。据说，亲眼观赏这场神秘舞蹈，能让寿命稍稍延长。

decisions.source: POKENAME sprays a highly toxic gas out of its tail that forms a dense cloud of poison if not dealt with. This gas is also highly flammable, a simple ember capable of turning the cloud into an intense inferno.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾喷剧毒气，不处理便聚成厚毒云。气也极易燃，小小余烬就能将云化作火海。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从尾部喷出剧毒气体，若不处理，就会聚成浓厚的毒云。这种气体还极易燃烧，小小一点余烬，便足以让毒云变成猛烈的火海。

decisions.source: Many sailors still believe that POKENAME is an ill-omened creature, since it appears just before a hurricane strikes. It tends to make its home on isolated atolls in the middle of the ocean to avoid contact with humans.
decisions.target: POKENAME总在飓风前出现，许多水手仍视它为凶兆。为了避人，常在远海偏僻环礁安家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME总在飓风来临前现身，因此许多水手，至今仍相信它是带来厄运的生灵。它通常在大洋深处的偏僻环礁安家，避免接触人类。

decisions.source: Most planes are routed to fly around POKENAME territories, but when that isn't possible, they will bring a team of flying Pokémon to defend them. A swarm of POKENAME can rip through iron in a matter of seconds.
decisions.target: 大多数飞机会绕POKENAME领地。不能绕，就带飞行宝可梦小队护航；一群几秒就能撕铁。
decisions.revised: 大多数飞机的航线，都会绕开POKENAME的领地。无法绕行时，便会带上一队飞行宝可梦护航。成群的POKENAME，只需几秒，就能将铁撕开。

decisions.source: POKENAME ears are extremely sensitive to loud noises, enabling them to hear the faintest sound from great distances away. Growing urbanisation has caused them to retreat into the wilds, trying to avoid the headache inducing noise of the city.
decisions.target: POKENAME耳朵极敏感，连远处最细微声也听到。城市化加剧，便退荒野，躲让头痛的市声。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的耳朵对响声极其敏感，连远处最细微的声音也听得见。随着城市不断扩张，它们退入荒野，试图避开城市里令人头痛的噪音。

decisions.source: POKENAME has poor eyesight, only able to naturally see its most immediate surroundings. At night, the frill around its neck can glow brighter in order to illuminate the area around it and help it see where it's going.
decisions.target: POKENAME视力差，平时只能看清身边极近处。夜里颈边褶饰会更亮，照亮四周，帮助认路。
decisions.revised: POKENAME视力很差，平时只能看见紧邻身边的事物。夜里，颈部周围的褶饰能发出更亮的光，照清四周，帮助它辨认前路。

decisions.source: POKENAME often appears in cemeteries to care for the flowers placed before the graves of the deceased. Rumor has it that its body is hollow and that it is moved solely by the bulb it carries atop its head.
decisions.target: POKENAME常到墓地，照料摆在逝者墓前的花。传闻它的身体是空的，全靠头顶种子带动。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常出现在墓地，照料摆在逝者墓前的鲜花。传闻它的身体内部空空如也，全靠头顶的种子，才能活动。

decisions.source: POKENAME compress electrical energy into spheres that they can fling at their foes. While their aim with their throwing arm tends to be poor, they are able to use their psychic powers to guide the sphere to its target.
decisions.target: POKENAME把电能压成球，掷向敌人。投掷的手往往瞄不准，却能用超能力，引球击中目标。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将电能压缩成球，投向敌人。它用来投掷的手臂，往往瞄得不准，却能借助超能力，引导电球击中目标。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their four wings to achieve great speeds, all for the sake of securing food. Trainers are oft advised to be wary of these Pokémon, for they are more than happy to steal any and all food they can sink their teeth into.
decisions.target: POKENAME用四翼高速飞行，全为弄到食物。训练家须留意，因为凡能下口的食物，它们都很乐意抢走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠四只翅膀飞出极快的速度，全是为了弄到食物。人们常提醒训练家提防它们，因为凡是能下口的食物，它们都十分乐意抢走。

decisions.source: The crystalline orb beneath its chin emits a strong enough light that it can easily see within ocean depths. It can swim against strong water currents and can even ride upon wind currents without needing to re-enter the water for quite some time.
decisions.target: 下巴的水晶珠，光强得足以照清深海。它能逆强流游动，甚至可乘气流，许久不必重入水中。
decisions.revised: 它下巴的水晶珠，能发出足够强的光，轻松照清深海。它能逆着强劲的水流游动，甚至能乘着气流而行，很长时间都不必重新入水。

decisions.source: POKENAME's red petals secrete a fragrant oil that is used to create some of the most exclusive lines of women's perfume. According to some stories, it is an extremely rare Pokémon that appears only in the presence of people with gentle hearts.
decisions.target: POKENAME红花瓣分泌香油，用于一些最高端的女士香水。有故事说，它极稀有，只向温柔之心者现身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的红色花瓣会分泌芳香油，用于制作一些最顶级的女士香水。有些故事说，它极为稀有，只有心地温柔的人在场时，才会现身。

decisions.source: POKENAME eat many sorts of berries throughout the day but keep Maranga Berries in a pile away from the other berries. On nights of the full moon, they each take a Maranga Berry and eat them to gain a slight boost to their mental acuity.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天吃各种树果，却把香罗果与其他果分开堆。满月夜，每只取一颗来吃，让思维稍更敏锐。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天吃各种树果，却会把香罗果单独堆放，不与其他树果混在一起。满月之夜，它们各取一颗香罗果吃下，让思维稍微敏锐一些。

decisions.source: Watching a POKENAME's flower blossom is said to bring good fortune to the observers due to the rarity of the event, their flowers opening just once in their lifetime. Their flowers remain in full bloom at all times of day, the sight inspiring joy.
decisions.target: POKENAME的花一生只开一次，极稀有，因此据说目睹花开就有好运。开放后昼夜盛放，景象让人喜悦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的花一生只开一次，十分罕见，因此据说，目睹花开能为观者带来好运。花开以后，无论昼夜，都保持盛放，让见者心生喜悦。

decisions.source: POKENAME often stumbles when walking due to the weight of its bulky shell. This Pokémon is still learning how to manipulate the pumps on its back, so there is a 50-50 chance it will eject fire or water. On rare occasions, they will eject both.
decisions.target: 厚重壳让POKENAME走路常绊倒。还在学控制背上泵，因此喷火或喷水各有50%的机会，罕见时两者齐发。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的外壳笨重，走起路来经常绊倒。它还在学习控制背上的泵，所以喷出火或水的机会各占一半；极少数时候，两者会一起喷出。

decisions.source: A Pokémon that loves to dig through loose soil and sand, POKENAME are often used by construction crews to clear building sites prior to work starting. They enjoy the work but have to be watched closely in case they dig too much ground out.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱挖松土与沙，建筑队常用来在开工前清场。它喜欢这工作，却得紧盯，以免挖掉太多地面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢在松软的土壤和沙子中挖掘，建筑队常请它们在开工前清理场地。它们很喜欢这份工作，不过必须密切看护，以免把地面挖掉太多。

decisions.source: Though it has a large mouth, it can only breathe out small flames; it loves to hold large foods in its mouth and roast them with these flames. It fans out its tail feathers when agitated and bites at the air to intimidate others.
decisions.target: 嘴虽大，却只能吐小火。它爱含住大食物，用小火烤。烦躁时，会展开尾羽，对空咬合，威吓旁人。
decisions.revised: 它虽然嘴巴很大，却只能吐出小小的火焰，喜欢将大块食物含在嘴里，慢慢烤熟。烦躁时，它会展开尾羽，对着空气咬合，威吓旁人。

decisions.source: Solitary creatures that make their homes deep within frigid mountain areas, just a touch from POKENAME's ribbon-like vines will chill a person to the bone. It steals body heat this way in order to keep the glacier on its back frigid and robust.
decisions.target: POKENAME独居寒山深处，缎带藤轻碰，就令人冷到骨子里。它借此偷体热，让背上冰川保持寒冷坚实。
decisions.revised: POKENAME独居在寒冷山区的深处，它缎带般的藤蔓，只需轻轻一碰，就能让人寒冷彻骨。它借此夺取体温，使背上的冰川保持冰冷而坚实。

decisions.source: A rolling cloud of freezing mist is oft a harbinger of the advance of these Pokémon within the tundra they call home. They can freeze most prey solid with a breath loosed by their maws and instantly crush them with their mighty jaws.
decisions.target: 在冻原家园，翻滚寒雾常预示它们将近。一口吐息，就能冻住多数猎物，再以巨颚瞬间压碎。
decisions.revised: 在它们栖居的冻原上，一团翻滚的寒雾，常预示着这些宝可梦正在靠近。它们张口吐息，就能将大多数猎物冻得结结实实，再用强大的双颚，瞬间压碎。

decisions.source: POKENAME are able to curl up to hide in such a way that they resemble a Poké Ball. They are also able to manipulate their innate electrical energy into extremely elaborate patterns as a means of both intimidation and communication.
decisions.target: POKENAME能蜷成精灵球模样躲藏。还能将自身电能塑成极复杂的图案，用于威吓和交流。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能够蜷缩身体，装成精灵球的模样，藏起自己。它们还能操纵与生俱来的电能，编织出极其精巧复杂的图案，用于威吓和交流。

decisions.source: The vine-like hairs that coat POKENAME are actually quite tough and are able to resist the pecks of a Pidgeotto. It will also use the vines to swing from tree to tree if it needs to escape from danger.
decisions.target: POKENAME藤蔓般的毛十分坚韧，能挡住比比鸟啄击。遇险时，也能靠藤蔓在树间荡行逃脱。
decisions.revised: POKENAME全身藤蔓般的毛发，其实非常坚韧，连比比鸟的啄击也能挡住。遇险需要逃跑时，它还会借助这些藤蔓，从一棵树荡向另一棵树。

decisions.source: POKENAME holds a Charti Berry whenever it wants to fly in the sky, as it takes little effort to knock it down from the sky. It lives deep in the forest to avoid the risk of any rocks flung around.
decisions.target: POKENAME想飞时，就拿着草蚕果，因为轻易就会被打落。它住在深林，避开四处飞掷的石块。
decisions.revised: POKENAME想在空中飞行时，总会带着草蚕果，因为它很容易就被击落。它栖居在森林深处，避免遭遇四处飞掷的石块。

decisions.source: POKENAME are strong enough that even just swinging their wings is enough to break a tree in two, yet there are also venomous stingers at the tips of their wings. They are territorial to all, even others of their species.
decisions.target: POKENAME强得只挥翼，就能折树，翼端还藏毒刺。它对任何对象都护地盘，连同类也不例外。
decisions.revised: POKENAME力量强大，光是挥动翅膀，就足以将一棵树折成两段，翼尖还长着毒刺。它对任何闯入领地的对象都不客气，连同类也不例外。

decisions.source: POKENAME lures potential prey toward it by releasing a sweet fragrance of honey and resin from its pink petals. It takes tremendous pride in its long beak, often challenging other members of its species to see whose is the mightiest.
decisions.target: POKENAME粉瓣放蜂蜜与树脂甜香，引来潜在猎物。它以长喙极自豪，常与同类比，谁的最强。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从粉红色花瓣中，散发出蜂蜜与树脂的甜香，吸引潜在的猎物靠近。它对自己的长喙极其自豪，常向同类挑战，比比谁的喙最有力量。

decisions.source: When inhabiting areas with lots of fast predators, POKENAME adapt by using their rear flames to rocket themselves away from danger. On the other hand, POKENAME in areas with large foes adapt by creating a large puff of flames for intimidation.
decisions.target: 快猎手多的地方，POKENAME会靠后焰，火箭般逃险；大敌多的地方，则会造大火团，威吓对手。
decisions.revised: 生活在敏捷捕食者众多的地方，POKENAME会用后部的火焰，像火箭般加速逃离危险。而大型敌人较多的地区，它们则会制造一大团火焰，威吓对方。

decisions.source: POKENAME perches against tree trunks, listening for the sounds of Pidgey hunting. When it catches one that is just about to eat, it swoops down with an ear-piercing shriek, scaring off the Pidgey and stealing its hard-earned meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠树干栖息，听波波狩猎。发现哪只将吃，就尖啸俯冲，吓走波波，偷辛苦得来的饭。
decisions.revised: POKENAME贴着树干栖息，聆听波波捕猎的动静。一发现有波波正要进食，它便发出刺耳的尖啸，俯冲而下，吓跑波波，抢走对方辛苦得来的食物。

decisions.source: POKENAME are gluttonous creatures that do not enjoy sharing their food. When they are fed a Jaboca Berry, they become aggressive and bite anything that comes near their mouth. They feel so much remorse afterwards that they end up crying.
decisions.target: POKENAME贪吃，不爱分享。吃嘉珍果会变得好斗，什么靠近嘴边都咬。事后又悔恨得哭起来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分贪吃，不喜欢分享食物。吃了嘉珍果以后，它们会变得好斗，凡是靠近嘴边的东西都会咬。不过事后，又会懊悔得哭起来。

decisions.source: POKENAME take great pride in their appearance and are at their happiest when they're being pampered by their trainer. They make a soft purring coo as their feathers are brushed, enjoying the act of grooming and always wanting more.
decisions.target: POKENAME极重视外貌，训练家呵护时最开心。羽毛被刷时轻声咕噜，享受梳理，总还想更多。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对自己的外貌十分自豪，得到训练家宠爱时，最为开心。梳理羽毛时，它会发出轻柔的咕噜声，享受这番照料，总还想再多梳一会儿。

decisions.source: POKENAME can eject their stomachs and fill them with air, allowing them to float in water. In certain regions, POKENAME are thrown into the ocean in a competition. After floating to shore, their tears are collected to be turned into salt.
decisions.target: POKENAME能把胃吐出充气，浮在水里。某些地区比赛把它扔进海；等漂回岸，再收眼泪制盐。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能将胃吐出，充满空气，让自己浮在水上。某些地区，会举办把POKENAME扔进海里的比赛；待它们漂回岸边，再收集眼泪制盐。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is protected by a hard black shell that allows it to camouflage perfectly in the darkness. Just before charging at an enemy, it makes the rings on its armored carapace glow, to have an advantage against them.
decisions.target: POKENAME有坚硬黑壳保护，能完美藏进黑暗。向敌人冲锋前，先让甲壳圆环发光，占得先机。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体由坚硬的黑色外壳保护，能完美融入黑暗。向敌人冲锋前，它会先让甲壳上的圆环亮起光芒，为自己占得优势。

decisions.source: POKENAME always keeps its body coiled up in a spiral to some extent. It's front head is fairly docile, but the tail's head is skittish and will attempt to jab its horn into those who get too close.
decisions.target: POKENAME始终将身体多少盘成螺旋。前头较温顺，尾上的头却胆小，谁靠太近，就想用角刺。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体，总会或多或少地盘成螺旋。前面的头相当温顺，尾部的头却容易受惊，谁靠得太近，它就会试着用角刺过去。

decisions.source: POKENAME burrow through the undergrowth in forests and are rarely seen above ground. They can dig both forward and backward thanks to their twin drills and they play an important role in mixing nutrients in the soil with their tunnels.
decisions.target: POKENAME在森林地下钻行，很少露地。双钻能前后挖，隧道也帮助拌匀土中养分，作用重要。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在森林的林下钻穴而行，很少出现在地面。它们靠两只钻头，既能向前挖，也能向后挖；挖出的隧道，对混合土中的养分十分重要。

decisions.source: POKENAME are reclusive Pokémon that make their homes in deep caves. Though seldom seen, they gather on moonlit nights to dance along the mountainside. Under a full moon, their feathers blaze with fire as the dance reaches its peak.
decisions.target: POKENAME隐居深洞，虽少见，却会在月夜聚到山侧跳舞。满月下，舞至高潮，羽毛便燃起火焰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME隐居在深深的洞穴里，平时很少现身，却会在月夜聚集，沿着山坡起舞。满月之下，舞蹈达到高潮时，羽毛便会燃起火焰。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends most of its time lounging in the sun, waiting for its flower to bloom. If disturbed, it will release a cloud of poison to ward off attackers. When further provoked, POKENAME uses its physical strength to overwhelm its opponent.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多晒太阳闲躺，等花盛开。受打扰就放毒云驱敌；再被挑衅，才用体力压倒对手。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大多时候懒懒地躺在阳光下，等待自己的花盛开。受到打扰时，它会放出毒云，赶走袭击者；若再遭挑衅，便用强健的体魄，压倒对手。

decisions.source: Sometimes referred to as "the Mage in White" in some regions, POKENAME abhors violence and refrains from fighting as much as possible. Even when it does fight, once the battle concludes, it will heal its opponent as well as itself.
decisions.target: 有些地区叫POKENAME“白衣法师”。厌恶暴力，尽量避战。即使开打，战后一并治疗敌人与自己。
decisions.revised: 有些地区称POKENAME为“白衣法师”。它厌恶暴力，尽可能避免争斗。即使不得不战，结束后，也会一并治疗对手与自己。

decisions.source: If you were to look into the hole in POKENAME's neck, you would be subjected to horrific, never-ending nightmares. It is believed that the souls of those who fall victim to this will never be able to rest.
decisions.target: 若看进POKENAME颈孔，就会陷入可怕、无尽的噩梦。人们相信，受害者的灵魂将永不得安息。
decisions.revised: 若往POKENAME颈部的洞中看，就会遭受恐怖而永无止境的噩梦。人们相信，这些受害者的灵魂，将永远无法安息。

decisions.source: One can tell how well a POKENAME is feeling just by looking: should it begin to suffer headaches, it loses control of its camouflage ability and begins to shift through all manner of colors and patterns until the pain subsides.
decisions.target: 看外表就知POKENAME状况。一头痛，就控制不住伪装，开始流转各种颜色与花纹，直到痛止。
decisions.revised: 只看外表，就能知道POKENAME身体状况如何。一旦头痛，它就会失去对伪装能力的控制，不停变换各种颜色和花纹，直到疼痛消退。

decisions.source: The red circles on the face of an POKENAME are its heat-sensing organs. As the Pokémon is not very strong, it uses its 340-degree vision and its heat sense to avoid predators and find others of its kind.
decisions.target: POKENAME脸上的红圈是热感器官。它力量不强，会借340度视野与热感，避开捕食者，寻找同类。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脸上的红色圆圈，是感知热量的器官。它并不强壮，便靠三百四十度的视野与热感能力，避开捕食者，寻找自己的同类。

decisions.source: POKENAME is in full control of the marvelous adaptability of its body, able to rewrite its DNA on the fly to adapt to its surroundings. This makes it capable of enduring even the most taxing of conditions with little issue.
decisions.target: POKENAME完全掌控身体惊人的适应力，随时改写DNA，适应周围。再严苛的环境，也能轻松忍受。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能完全掌控身体惊人的适应能力，随时改写DNA，适应周围的环境。因此，即使条件再严苛，它也能毫不费力地承受。

decisions.source: Once it finds a place to settle down, POKENAME stays still during the cold season and waits for warm temperatures and filling rain before moving about once more. It is extremely brave and will not hide even in torrential downpours.
decisions.target: POKENAME一安顿，寒季就静止，等温暖与充沛雨水到来，再度活动。它极勇敢，暴雨里也不藏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME找到落脚处后，寒冷的季节便待着不动，等气温回暖、雨水充沛，才重新开始活动。它极其勇敢，即使遇上倾盆大雨，也不会躲藏。

decisions.source: Near the end of its lifecycle, the sprout-like tail on POKENAME's rear grows into a large tree that prevents it from moving easily. This tree continues to draw nutrients from the main body long after it passes on.
decisions.target: POKENAME生命将尽时，后方芽状尾巴长成大树，妨碍移动。死后许久，树仍从主体吸取养分。
decisions.revised: 生命接近终点时，POKENAME身后嫩芽般的尾巴，会长成一棵大树，让它行动不便。即使它离世很久以后，这棵树仍会从本体中，继续汲取养分。

decisions.source: Any cotton that is picked from POKENAME's body will remain warm to the touch, even for years after being removed. POKENAME itself, however, does not like being used as a pillow, and will drastically increase its temperature if laid on.
decisions.target: 摘下POKENAME身上的棉，哪怕过数年，摸着也仍暖。但POKENAME不爱当枕头，谁躺上来，体温就会猛升。
decisions.revised: 从POKENAME身上摘下的棉花，即使过了好几年，摸上去仍然温暖。不过，POKENAME并不喜欢被当作枕头，谁躺上来，它就会让体温骤然升高。

decisions.source: To protect the mushroom on its back, POKENAME freezes moisture in the air into armor around it. The fungus remains dormant but unharmed until the weather is warm enough to melt the ice, which is when it scatters its spores.
decisions.target: POKENAME冻结空气水分，结甲保护背菇。真菌休眠却无损，直到天气暖到融冰，才撒出孢子。
decisions.revised: 为了保护背上的蘑菇，POKENAME将空气中的水分冻结，在周围结成冰甲。真菌在其中休眠，不受损伤；待天气暖到足以融冰，才会散播孢子。

decisions.source: POKENAME are coated in a thin layer of fur that traps moisture and dirt, allowing plants to grow within it. They stimulate this plant growth with periodic electrical shocks, helping to revitalise the plants if they ever begin to wilt.
decisions.target: POKENAME薄毛留住泥与水，让植物长在里面。定期电击刺激生长，植物一萎，又能帮它恢复。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上薄薄的毛发，能留住水分和泥土，使植物在其中生长。它们定期释放电击，刺激植物生长；若植物开始萎蔫，也能帮助它们恢复生机。

decisions.source: POKENAME kicks up dazzling embers as it shows off its fancy footwork and high-speed spins. Spectators of these shows must watch from far away in the event it spins too fast and becomes an intense tornado of fire instead.
decisions.target: POKENAME炫脚步、高速旋转，踢起绚丽余烬。观众得远远看，免得它转太快，反成猛烈火龙卷。
decisions.revised: POKENAME炫耀华丽的步法、飞快旋转时，会踢起绚丽的火星。观众必须站在远处，以防它转得太快，竟变成猛烈的火焰龙卷风。

decisions.source: It lazily waves its pom-poms around while standing in deep ponds, gathering water plants and small Pokémon to eat. Its pom-poms can also release an electric shock if a more active predator attempts to ambush it.
decisions.target: 它站在深池，懒懒挥绒球，捞水草与小宝可梦吃。活跃天敌想偷袭，绒球也能放电。
decisions.revised: 它站在深深的池塘里，懒洋洋地挥动绒球，收集水草和小型宝可梦充饥。若有更活跃的捕食者试图伏击，绒球也能释放电击。

decisions.source: POKENAME is found along beaches and ports where it will steal freshly caught fish from other Pokémon or humans. It is rather slow on land, but speeds up in the water by using its vines to aid in propulsion.
decisions.target: POKENAME在海滩与港口，偷人与宝可梦刚捕的鱼。陆上较慢，水里靠藤辅助推进，速度便快。
decisions.revised: POKENAME出没在海滩与港口，会从其他宝可梦或人类那里，偷走刚捕到的鱼。它在陆地上行动较慢，入水后却能靠藤蔓辅助推进，游得更快。

decisions.source: POKENAME act as a bully, pushing any other predatory Pokémon from their territory. When two POKENAME get near each other, the violence that ensues can damage parts of the reef, sometimes making it unsuitable for them to continue residing there.
decisions.target: POKENAME霸道，赶走领地其他猎手。两只太近，暴斗会毁部分珊瑚礁，有时连自己也住不下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分霸道，会把其他捕食性宝可梦赶出领地。两只POKENAME一旦靠近，就会爆发激烈争斗，破坏部分珊瑚礁，有时甚至使那里不再适合自己居住。

decisions.source: POKENAME have dyed sand in their wings thanks to a contrived effort from filmmakers to enhance shots of POKENAME. They are more likely to be spotted by predators because of their dyed wings, leading to a recent decrease in the population.
decisions.target: 电影人为拍得好看，刻意染了POKENAME翼沙。彩翼却让天敌更易察觉，近期种群因此减少。
decisions.revised: 为了让POKENAME的镜头更好看，电影制作人刻意将它们翅膀里的沙子染了色。然而，染色的翅膀让它们更容易被捕食者发现，导致近期种群数量下降。

decisions.source: POKENAME are covered in a thick coating of sensitive hairs that help them navigate in the dark. These hairs are tipped with an irritating poison to deter predators, and despite their soft appearance it is not advisable to stroke them.
decisions.target: POKENAME全身浓密触觉毛，帮助暗中认路。毛尖带刺激毒素，驱退天敌；看似柔软，也不宜摸。
decisions.revised: POKENAME全身覆着浓密而敏感的毛，帮助它在黑暗中辨别方向。毛尖带有刺激性毒素，能吓退捕食者；虽然看起来柔软，却不宜抚摸。

decisions.source: Quills across POKENAME's body lengthen in response to the emotions it senses around it. The more it feels endangered, the more quills come out to protect itself, ready to be launched from its body at a moment's notice.
decisions.target: POKENAME感知周围情绪，体表尖刺便会变长。越觉危险，越多尖刺冒出护身，随时准备射出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME感知周围的情绪时，身上的尖刺便会随之伸长。越觉得危险，就有越多的刺冒出来保护自己，随时准备从体表发射。

decisions.source: Extremely slothful, POKENAME rarely moves even in its own self-defense. It is quite attached to its club, but even if it's stolen it won't muster up the energy to take it back, simply crying loudly in response.
decisions.target: POKENAME极懒，连自卫都很少动。它虽依恋骨棒，哪怕被偷也提不起劲抢回，只会放声大哭。
decisions.revised: POKENAME懒得出奇，连自卫也很少愿意动。它虽然十分依恋自己的骨棒，可即使骨棒被偷，也提不起劲抢回来，只会放声大哭。

decisions.source: To be able to fly at fast speeds, POKENAME need to consume their weight in food every day. Their favorite food is tree sap, lapping it up in reckless abandon and not even noticing when they get stuck to the tree because of the sticky sap.
decisions.target: POKENAME每天得吃自身体重的食物，才能高速飞行。最爱树汁，常舔得忘乎所以，连黏在树上都没察觉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每天必须吃下与自身体重相当的食物，才能高速飞行。它们最爱树汁，常舔得忘乎所以，连被黏稠树汁粘在树上，也没察觉。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a chirp that sounds like a whistling blade of grass, allowing their parents to know when to come back to the nest with food. While many coexist with their kin, it is not unheard of for POKENAME to abandon a nest once they get big.
decisions.target: POKENAME的鸣声像草叶吹哨，告诉父母该带食物回巢。虽有许多与亲族同住，长大后弃巢也并不罕见。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的叫声，如同吹响草叶的哨音，让父母知道该带着食物回巢了。虽然许多会与亲族共同生活，长大后离巢而去，也并不罕见。

decisions.source: The most powerful part of POKENAME's body is its red gear, which can be swung like a weapon at any enemy approaching from behind, or interlocked with the cog on the back of its head to spin the gears around its mouth at high speed.
decisions.target: POKENAME最强的部位是红齿轮，能当武器挥向后方来敌，也能咬合脑后齿轮，带动嘴边齿轮高速旋转。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最有力的部位，是红色的齿轮。它既能像武器般挥向后方来敌，也能与脑后的齿轮啮合，带动嘴边的齿轮高速转动。

decisions.source: These desert Pokémon have evolved to be able to hide their own heads within remains, with their lower bodies submerged in the sands. When prey draws near, they grab hold of a bone and use it like a club to pummel them into submission.
decisions.target: 这些沙漠宝可梦能把头藏进遗骸，下身埋在沙里。猎物靠近，便抓起骨头当棒，打到对方屈服。
decisions.revised: 这些沙漠宝可梦演化出了将头藏进遗骸的本领，下半身则埋在沙中。猎物靠近时，它们便抓起一根骨头当作棍棒，猛击对方，直到其屈服。

decisions.source: POKENAME dances alone late at night, and some claim to hear the faint music of a lyre in the distance as it moves. Legend says that watching it for too long causes one to become entranced, and they awaken the next day near a gravestone, disoriented.
decisions.target: POKENAME深夜独舞，有人称，远处会响起淡淡里拉琴声。传说看太久，就会恍惚，翌日在墓碑旁迷惘醒来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME深夜独自起舞，有人声称，它舞动时，远处能听见隐约的里拉琴声。传说，看得太久便会着迷，次日在墓碑旁醒来，茫然不知身在何处。

decisions.source: POKENAME is highly industrious, and constantly spins yarn. If it runs out of fibers to convert into thread, it will start hunting for Pokémon that produce silk or wool, using the fibers it has already spun to trap them and its claws to shave them.
decisions.target: POKENAME勤劳无比，不停纺毛线。纤维不够，就猎捕能吐丝、长毛的宝可梦，用纺好的线困住，再以爪剃毛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME极其勤劳，不停地纺线。纤维耗尽后，它便开始寻找会吐丝或长羊毛的宝可梦，用纺好的纤维将它们困住，再用爪子剃下毛来。

decisions.source: By pretending to be asleep while soaking up sunlight and luring Pokémon in with a sweet scent, POKENAME gets bug Pokémon to gather around them. Once the bug Pokémon are close, they rely on echolocation to bite and drain blood from their meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME一边晒太阳，一边装睡，放出甜香，引虫宝可梦聚拢。等它们靠近，再靠回声定位咬住，吸血进食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一边吸收阳光，一边假装睡觉，散出甜香，吸引虫类宝可梦聚在身旁。等对方靠近，它便凭回声定位，咬住这顿美餐，吸取血液。

decisions.source: This Pokémon's body may appear light due to the feathers, but it can weigh as much as a small plane. Using its steel wings to control its flight path, POKENAME uses the cannon on its back to propel itself forward with rainbow colored energy.
decisions.target: 羽毛让POKENAME看似轻盈，实际却能重如小飞机。它用钢翼控制航向，以背炮喷出虹色能量，推动前进。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦披着羽毛，看似轻盈，体重却能堪比一架小飞机。POKENAME用钢铁翅膀控制航向，再以背上的炮，喷出虹色能量，推动自己前进。

decisions.source: POKENAME lie in wait on shores across the world. When they spot prey, they use their beaks to strike swiftly and catch them off guard. They target only smaller, weaker prey due to their limited mobility on land or in water.
decisions.target: POKENAME在各地海岸静候猎物，以喙迅速突袭。水陆行动都受限，因此只捕较小、较弱的目标。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在世界各地的海岸埋伏。发现猎物后，就用喙迅速突袭，打对方一个措手不及。由于在陆地和水中行动都受限制，它们只捕猎更小、更弱的目标。

decisions.source: It uses all four arms and even its tail to grab stones in order to pelt them at trespassers. Should this warning be ignored, it will fly into a deeper rage and roll at its target, howling all the while.
decisions.target: 它用四臂，甚至尾巴抓石，投向入侵者。警告若被无视，就愈发暴怒，边嚎边滚向目标。
decisions.revised: 它用四只手臂，甚至连尾巴也用上，抓起石头，投向擅闯者。若警告被无视，它便更加暴怒，一边嚎叫，一边翻滚着冲向目标。

decisions.source: POKENAME frequently spar with their siblings to develop their skills. Even during mealtime, they will fight with each other over who gets the biggest share. Despite not being fully grown, a Crunch from these Pokémon is able to break bones.
decisions.target: POKENAME常与手足切磋，磨练本领。连吃饭，也争谁分得最多。虽未成年，咬碎仍足以折断骨头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常与兄弟姐妹切磋，磨练本领。就连吃饭时，也会为了谁分得最多而争斗。虽然尚未长大，它们使出的咬碎，已经足以咬断骨头。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives at the top of the tallest mountains. Over winter it lets its fires be dampened by the harsh snowfall and falls into a deep slumber. Once Spring arrives, it uses Burn Up to completely clear the mountaintop of snow.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在最高山顶。冬季，大雪压弱火势，它便深睡。春来，再用燃尽，将整座山顶的雪清光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖居在最高的山顶。冬季，它任由猛烈的降雪压弱火势，陷入沉睡。等到春天来临，就使出燃尽，将山顶的积雪彻底清除。

decisions.source: The longer POKENAME runs during a charge, the more mystical power builds up within its body. After enough time, it can even gain the ability to fly temporarily, despite the weight of its body and the small size of its wings.
decisions.target: POKENAME冲锋跑得越久，体内神秘力量就越多。时间够了，哪怕身体重、翼又小，也能暂时飞起。
decisions.revised: POKENAME冲锋奔跑得越久，体内积蓄的神秘力量就越强。时间足够长时，即使身体沉重、翅膀又小，它也能暂时获得飞行的能力。

decisions.source: POKENAME is friendly and curious, with a strong aversion to any sort of combat. If things start turning violent, it kicks up wind and dust with rapid flapping of its wings to help it and its friends escape the potential fight.
decisions.target: POKENAME友善好奇，极其厌战。事情一变凶，它便急拍翼，扬风卷尘，帮助自己与朋友逃开冲突。
decisions.revised: POKENAME友善又好奇，极其厌恶任何争斗。局面一旦变得暴力，它就飞快振翅，卷起风尘，帮助自己和朋友，逃离可能发生的战斗。

decisions.source: POKENAME hovers around near where Pidgey flock, looking to steal some of the food they scrounge up. Its cry is a louder, shriller version of Pidgey's, and effective at sending a flock flying away so it can swipe a meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME悬在波波群旁，想偷它们找的食物。叫声比波波更响、更尖，足以惊飞鸟群，抢到一餐。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在波波群附近盘旋，伺机偷走它们辛苦寻来的食物。它的叫声像波波，却更响亮、更尖锐，能惊飞整个鸟群，让它趁机抢得一餐。

decisions.source: Their wings are strong and fold up tightly as they burrow through the ground, using the momentum to leap and glide. POKENAME have many sharp and rigid feathers along their backs that they can shed and launch at foes or prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME钻地时收紧强翼，借冲势跃起滑翔。背上有许多坚硬锐羽，能脱落射向敌人或猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在地下钻行时，会将强壮的翅膀紧紧收起，借势跃出，滑翔而去。背上长着许多尖锐坚硬的羽毛，可以脱落，射向敌人或猎物。

decisions.source: POKENAME have been observed flying across deserts at supersonic speeds, and are known to help those who have lost their way amongst the dunes. It is also said that it can hear whispers of the future with it's powerful ears.
decisions.target: 曾观察到POKENAME以超音速飞越沙漠，帮助迷失沙丘的人。据说，强耳也能听见未来的低语。
decisions.revised: 人们曾观察到POKENAME以超音速飞越沙漠，也知道它会帮助迷失在沙丘间的人。据说，它凭强大的听觉，还能听见来自未来的低语。

decisions.source: POKENAME are territorial and will battle any rival POKENAME that stray into the area they call home. Battles between the two can last for hours with loud squawks echoing through the mountains as they flap powerful blasts of air at one another.
decisions.target: POKENAME领地意识强，同类对手误入便战。两只交手可持续数小时，强风互拍，尖叫回荡群山。
decisions.revised: POKENAME领地意识很强，同类对手若闯入自己的家园，它便会应战。两者的战斗可持续数小时，彼此振翅，掀起强风，尖厉的叫声回荡群山。

decisions.source: With a single flap of its wings, POKENAME can take to the skies at speeds reaching 70MPH. Its take-off is so powerful that it releases a shockwave, and it always leaves a single glowing feather behind after it flies off.
decisions.target: POKENAME一扇翼就能腾空，速度最高每小时70英里。起飞强到释放冲击波，飞走总留一根亮羽。
decisions.revised: POKENAME只需振一下翅膀，就能腾空而起，速度可达每小时七十英里。起飞的力量大得会激起冲击波，飞走后，总会留下一根发光的羽毛。

decisions.source: Its muscles expand and tense the more electricity it has stored within itself. The long, white hair of an POKENAME turns as dark as a storm cloud when it exerts itself, which often occurs when it prepares to protect its nest.
decisions.target: POKENAME存电越多，肌肉就越膨胀、绷得越紧。发力时白长毛黑如雷云，常发生在准备护巢时。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体内储存的电力越多，肌肉就越膨胀、绷紧。发力时，白色的长毛会变得像雷暴云一样漆黑，这常发生在它准备保护巢穴的时候。

decisions.source: These majestic Pokémon can call forth lightning around themselves and will "catch" lightning with their marvelous horns. An enraged POKENAME's trampling will scorch the very ground they walk upon and call down bolts of lightning to split the earth.
decisions.target: 威严的POKENAME能召周身雷电，用华美的角“接”住。暴怒奔踏会烧焦脚下土地，召雷劈裂大地。
decisions.revised: 这些威严的宝可梦，能在周围召来雷电，用华美的角将落雷“接住”。POKENAME暴怒时，奔踏会烧焦脚下的土地，还会召下道道闪电，将大地劈裂。

decisions.source: POKENAME are far more buoyant than unfused Marill, and are able to trap air within their oily fur. They are so buoyant that they can sit happily on the surface of rivers if they want to, watching the world drift by.
decisions.target: POKENAME比未融合的玛力露浮力大得多，油毛能兜空气。想浮就开心坐在河面，看世界漂过。
decisions.revised: POKENAME比未融合的玛力露浮力大得多，还能将空气留在油润的毛发中。只要愿意，它们便能惬意地坐在河面上，看着四周景色缓缓流过。

decisions.source: POKENAME spend their days fluttering over running streams and rivers, occasionally pausing above the water's surface to grab at an aquatic Pokémon. They are physically frail and use their long ears to listen for danger, flying away if startled.
decisions.target: POKENAME整天扑飞河溪上，偶尔停在水面，抓水生宝可梦。身体脆弱，靠长耳听险，受惊就飞走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME整天在流动的河溪上方振翅飞舞，偶尔停在水面上方，伸手抓取水生宝可梦。它们体质脆弱，靠长耳聆听危险，一受惊就飞走。

decisions.source: Its flower bud opens halfway and the leaves along its body stand on end when it flies into a fit of rage. These fits of rage seem to boost its circulation, which results in the leaves growing even more robust.
decisions.target: 暴怒时，花苞半开，身上叶片根根竖起。怒火似乎促进循环，让叶片反而长得更强健。
decisions.revised: 勃然大怒时，它的花苞会打开一半，全身的叶片也根根竖起。这样的怒火，似乎能促进体内循环，使叶片长得更加茁壮。

decisions.source: When POKENAME fires off a spike from one of its cannons, the recoil from the blast is enough to crumble its steel shell. As long as it's in the ozone layer, it can absorb some nanoparticles to mend the shell.
decisions.target: POKENAME从炮射出尖刺，反冲甚至能震碎钢壳。只要在臭氧层，就能吸收一些纳米粒子修补。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从炮中发射尖刺时，强大的后坐力，足以震碎自己的钢铁外壳。只要身在臭氧层中，它就能吸收一些纳米粒子，修补外壳。

decisions.source: POKENAME bounce on their tails to drive the spines into the ground and carve out tunnels for them to burrow into. If this process is interrupted, POKENAME rotate their tails to bounce away on the rounded parts and find a new spot.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠尾弹跳，将刺扎地，挖出能钻的隧道。被打断，就转尾，用圆圆的部位弹走，另找地方。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用尾巴弹跳，将尖刺扎进地面，凿出能藏身的隧道。过程若被打断，它们便转过尾巴，用圆润的部分弹跳离开，另寻新地方。

decisions.source: Male POKENAME use their beaks to break off coral branches to build a suitable nest for a partner. During courtship season, female POKENAME will choose a partner based on the quality of the nest, then settle into the home with the male.
decisions.target: 雄性POKENAME用喙折珊瑚枝，为伴侣筑好巢。求偶季，雌性会按巢的品质择偶，再与雄性入住。
decisions.revised: 雄性POKENAME用喙折下珊瑚枝，为伴侣建造合适的巢穴。到了求偶季节，雌性会按巢的品质挑选伴侣，再与雄性一同入住。

decisions.source: Groups of POKENAME will spin large webs just above the water's surface. These webs serve to catch any Pokémon leaping out of the water, with a single Magikarp able to feed a group of these Pokémon for weeks.
decisions.target: POKENAME群体在水面上方织大网，捕捉跃出水面的宝可梦。一条鲤鱼王，就够一群吃上数周。
decisions.revised: 成群的POKENAME会紧贴水面上方，织起巨大的网，捕捉跃出水面的宝可梦。只需一条鲤鱼王，就够这一群宝可梦吃上好几个星期。

decisions.source: POKENAME are known to siphon light from anything they can get in their claws to fuel themselves, completely draining the target of energy. In stories, if one stared at the light POKENAME emits for too long, their life force would be drained.
decisions.target: POKENAME抓住什么，就吸光供能，榨尽目标能量。故事里，盯它放的光太久，也会被抽走生命力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会从爪中能抓住的任何东西里吸取光，为自己供能，将目标的能量彻底抽干。故事里，若盯着它发出的光看得太久，生命力也会被吸走。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its ability to change color to near-flawlessly blend into its surroundings. It will wait patiently, sometimes for hours at a time, for prey to accidentally wander within striking distance, at which point it will lunge at high speed.
decisions.target: POKENAME变色几乎完美融入周围，耐心等，有时一守数小时。猎物无意进入范围，就高速猛扑。
decisions.revised: POKENAME凭变色能力，几乎完美地融入周围环境，耐心等待，有时一等就是数小时。猎物若无意间走进攻击范围，它便会飞快扑出。

decisions.source: POKENAME race around their opponents at incredible speed, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. When they spot an opening, they charge forward with a powerful Take Down, using the full weight of their metallic bodies to try and secure victory.
decisions.target: POKENAME以惊人速度绕敌奔跑，等最佳时机。一见空隙，就用猛撞冲前，借金属全重，力争获胜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以惊人的速度，绕着对手奔跑，等待最佳攻击时机。一发现破绽，就向前使出强力的猛撞，借金属身体的全部重量，力争取胜。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their cape-like manes to daze their enemies as they perform combos of punches and kicks. If that were not enough already, they can also release bursts of flames from the soles of their feet to accelerate their kicks.
decisions.target: POKENAME打出连环拳脚时，会用披风状鬃毛使敌人晕眩。还嫌不够，就从脚底喷火，加快踢击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME打出连续的拳脚时，会用披风般的鬃毛，晃得敌人晕眩。不止如此，它们还能从脚底喷出火焰，加快踢击的速度。

decisions.source: A gentle and caring Pokémon that is capable of swimming across the sands of their desert homes like water. If they come across someone lost, they immediately heft them onto their back and take them to the nearest oasis.
decisions.target: 它温柔体贴，在沙漠家园的沙里游，如同水中。遇迷路者，便立刻背起，带到最近绿洲。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦温柔体贴，能在家乡沙漠的沙中游动，如同行于水中。一遇到迷路的人，它们就立刻将其背起，送往最近的绿洲。

decisions.source: The two sets of metal gears on either side of POKENAME's head are powerful weapons when ground against foes at close quarters. These cogs can also be fired off as spinning projectiles, although POKENAME must run after them to retrieve them.
decisions.target: POKENAME头两侧的金属齿轮组，近身磨击威力极强，也能作为旋转弹丸射出，但得跑去捡回。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头部两侧，各有一组金属齿轮，近身磨击敌人时，便是威力强大的武器。齿轮也能当作旋转的弹丸射出，不过之后，它必须跑去将其捡回。

decisions.source: When POKENAME spots a quarrel, it uses its wings to blow away the disputers far from each other. When it can't blow them away, it kicks up a Fairy Wind to surround the quarrelers and force soothing auras into them.
decisions.target: POKENAME发现争吵，就扇翅把双方远远吹开。吹不走，便掀妖精之风包围，强行注入舒缓气息。
decisions.revised: POKENAME看见争吵，就会挥动翅膀，将争执者远远吹开。若吹不动，便掀起妖精之风，围住双方，强行将舒缓的气息注入其中。

decisions.source: The feelers on POKENAME's body are extremely strong and can withstand the heat of up to 1500 degrees. It uses them to grab at burning trees during forest fires, consuming the charred wood and berries even while they are still ablaze.
decisions.target: POKENAME触须极强，耐热达1500度。森林大火中用来抓燃树，烧焦的木头和树果还在燃烧，也照吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的触须极为强韧，能承受高达一千五百度的热量。森林大火中，它会用触须抓住燃烧的树木，即使焦黑的木头与树果仍在燃烧，也照样吞食。

decisions.source: Legends say that POKENAME can circle the globe so fast that it will start to turn back time. It has almost never been seen fully; the only remnants of its presence are a trail of blue light as it flies by.
decisions.target: 传说POKENAME环绕全球快得能倒转时间。几乎无人见全貌，只有飞过时一道蓝光，证明来过。
decisions.revised: 传说，POKENAME绕着全球飞行时，速度快得能让时间倒流。人们几乎从未见过它的全貌，只有掠过时留下的一道蓝光，昭示着它曾来过。

decisions.source: POKENAME's preferred eating method is to consume an entire bush in one bite, chewing on it over the course of the whole day. When elated, it spews a short spout of pollen and seeds from a spout atop its head.
decisions.target: POKENAME最爱一口吞掉整丛灌木，嚼上一整天。开心时，头顶喷口会短促地喷出花粉与种子。
decisions.revised: POKENAME最喜欢一口吞下一整丛灌木，再用一整天慢慢咀嚼。兴高采烈时，它会从头顶的喷口，短促地喷出一股花粉和种子。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a bombastic bully of a Pokémon, swinging its tail about to push around anything smaller than it. It intimidates those who try to fight back by smacking its tail on the ground while electrified, making a mighty thunderclap.
decisions.target: POKENAME张扬跋扈，甩尾欺负一切比自己小的。谁想反抗，就带电拍尾击地，发出巨雷声威吓。
decisions.revised: POKENAME张扬又霸道，甩动尾巴，欺负一切比自己小的对象。谁若想反抗，它就用带电的尾巴猛拍地面，发出震耳的雷鸣，威吓对方。

decisions.source: In the right mindset, POKENAME can be a scourge on ships on the water. However, they often lack enough motivation to attack the ships and are more commonly kept as rowdy pets, as they are not regarded as dangerous Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME真起劲，能成为水上船只的灾星。可常懒得进攻，多被当闹腾宠物，不算危险宝可梦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME真起了兴致，便能成为水上船只的祸患。不过，它们往往提不起劲去攻击船只，也不被视为危险的宝可梦，更常被当作闹腾的宠物饲养。

decisions.source: POKENAME possess fallen logs, infusing the dead wood with new life. They seek out decaying trees within the forest and tear them down, incorporating the wood into their shell and leaving space for new growth to take the tree's place.
decisions.target: POKENAME附身倒木，为枯木注入新生命。找林中腐树拆掉，将木融入壳，也为新生植物腾空间。
decisions.revised: POKENAME附身于倒下的树干，为枯木注入新生。它们寻找森林中腐朽的树，将其拆下，融入自己的外壳，同时腾出空地，让新的植物生长。

decisions.source: POKENAME are capable of blending into their environment with their superb camouflage, but the plant bulbs on their head will always remain the same color. They cover the bulbs on their head with leaves to help make their camouflage more convincing.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体伪装再好，头上球状的植物部分，却始终不变色。便用叶片盖住，让伪装更可信。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的伪装十分出色，能与环境融为一体，但头上球状的植物部分，却始终不会变色。它们便用树叶将其盖住，使伪装更加逼真。

decisions.source: POKENAME tunnels through even the hardest substances while using its sensitive ears to detect vibrations from prey, even flying ones. Upon sensing a target, it bursts from the ground, clamps its jaws on its food, and flies away to eat undisturbed.
decisions.target: POKENAME凿穿最硬材料，敏耳探猎物震动，飞着的也察觉。锁定便破土，咬住食物，飞走安静吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME连最坚硬的物质也能钻穿，同时用敏锐的耳朵，探知猎物的震动，连飞行的猎物也不例外。一察觉目标，它便破土而出，咬住食物，飞到不受打扰的地方享用。

decisions.source: POKENAME seek out old shells on the beach, using them as shelter to withdraw into when spooked. They are able to launch their shovels as projectile weapons, spearing them into their foes if they aren't left alone after hiding away.
decisions.target: POKENAME在海滩找旧壳，受惊便缩进。若躲好后还被纠缠，就射出铲子当投射武器，刺向敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在海滩寻找旧壳，当作受惊时可以缩进去的庇护所。藏好后若仍被纠缠，它们就会将铲子当作投射武器发射，径直刺向敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends its day sleeping inside volcanos, but once the moon comes out, it wakes up and leaves its home. When hunting, it uses its vast wings and sharp claws to catch prey. Its vision and strength is strongest at night.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天睡在火山里，月亮一出，就醒来离巢。捕猎靠宽翼、利爪，夜间视力与力量，都最强。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天睡在火山里，月亮一出，就醒来离巢。捕猎靠宽翼、利爪，夜间视力与力量，都最强。

decisions.source: POKENAME use the broken remnants of egg shells to protect their bodies, trying to keep themselves safe from harm. They have poor control of their electrical powers and the shell they use often ends up charred and blackened by their shocks.
decisions.target: POKENAME用破碎的蛋壳护身，尽力避免受伤。它们控制不好电力，所用的壳往往被电得焦黑。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用破碎的蛋壳护身，尽力避免受伤。它们控制不好电力，所用的壳往往被电得焦黑。

decisions.source: POKENAME's flowers give periodic puffs of pollen that help them to sense the direction the wind is blowing in. When they see their pollen travel in the direction they want to go, they leap into the air and spread their arms wide to catch the breeze.
decisions.target: POKENAME的花定时喷出少量花粉，帮助感知风向。看见花粉飘向想去的地方，就跃上空中，张开双臂乘风。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的花定时喷出少量花粉，帮助感知风向。看见花粉飘向想去的地方，就跃上空中，张开双臂乘风。

decisions.source: POKENAME creates a rainbow in the sky as a marker for when it turns night and becomes too dark for it to easily find its way back home. There are many tiny crystals that line its body, but impurities have grown over and covered them from view.
decisions.target: POKENAME在天空造彩虹作路标，免得入夜太暗，找不到家。周身本有许多细晶，却已被杂质盖住，看不见了。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在天空造彩虹作路标，免得入夜太暗，找不到家。周身本有许多细晶，却已被杂质盖住，看不见了。

decisions.source: POKENAME lives on hot, arid islands where it slowly stalks prey while it pretends to be a non-threatening plant. The prickly fruit that grows on the ends of its arms has a sweet flavor and a juicy texture, making it sought out to top off dishes.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在炎热干岛，装成无害植物，慢慢跟踪猎物。臂端的带刺果实香甜多汁，常被人找来点缀菜肴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在炎热干旱的岛屿，装作无害的植物，慢慢跟踪猎物。手臂末端长出的带刺果实，香甜多汁，人们常寻来点缀菜肴。

decisions.source: When groups of POKENAME gather under the full moon's light, sparks fly in the vicinity. The color of each spark varies from POKENAME to POKENAME, so their displays can be just as mesmerizing as they are dangerous.
decisions.target: POKENAME在满月下聚集，周围便电花飞舞。每只火花颜色不同，场面既迷人又危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在满月下聚集，周围便电花飞舞。每只火花颜色不同，场面既迷人又危险。

decisions.source: POKENAME will tuck themselves into their shell, using the flame from their tail to stay warm as they sleep. Attempting to disturb a sleeping POKENAME will cause them to release fire from the holes in their shell.
decisions.target: POKENAME缩进壳里睡觉，靠尾焰取暖。若去打扰熟睡的POKENAME，它就会从壳上的孔洞喷火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME缩进壳里睡觉，靠尾焰取暖。若去打扰熟睡的POKENAME，它就会从壳上的孔洞喷火。

decisions.source: During battle, POKENAME shakes its body vigorously to cloud itself in the dirt or sand stuck in its fur. It takes advantage of the opponent's confusion by leaping behind them and striking with burning talons.
decisions.target: POKENAME战斗猛抖身，让毛里泥沙，遮住自己。趁敌迷乱，跳到背后，以燃烧利爪出击。
decisions.revised: 战斗时，POKENAME猛烈抖动身体，扬起毛发里沾着的泥沙，将自己遮住。趁对手迷乱，它便跃到其身后，用燃烧的脚爪攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME patrols rivers from just above the surface, ever watchful over the companions it guards. When its shell proves too heavy for sustained flight, it takes to the water, where its swimming prowess more than compensates.
decisions.target: POKENAME贴河面巡视，时刻守望伙伴。壳太重，飞不久时就入水，出色泳技足以弥补。
decisions.revised: POKENAME贴河面巡视，时刻守望伙伴。壳太重，飞不久时就入水，出色泳技足以弥补。

decisions.source: POKENAME's lightweight body makes prancing through the forest a simple task. It can inhale deeply and inflate its body to increase its size in an attempt to scare off others that might prey on it.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体轻，林中蹦跳毫不费力。它能深吸气鼓身，放大体型，试图吓退捕食者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身体轻盈，在森林里蹦跳毫不费力。它能深深吸气，将身体鼓胀起来，以更大的体型，试着吓退可能捕食自己的家伙。

decisions.source: POKENAME scuttles around the forest floors, licking at Tiny Mushrooms. Most are eaten right away, but those it particularly enjoys the taste of are attached to its back, carried to its home to be savored later.
decisions.target: POKENAME在林地爬，舔小蘑菇。多数立刻吃掉，特别喜欢的则贴背带回家，留着细品。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在森林地面爬来爬去，舔尝小蘑菇。大多会当场吃掉，遇上味道特别喜欢的，就贴在背上，带回家留待以后细细享用。

decisions.source: POKENAME protects its flock by firing electrically charged clumps of wool from its cannons at any perceived dangers. Its woolly back must be shorn often as it hardens quickly into a tough shell, trapping detritus within.
decisions.target: POKENAME从炮中射带电毛团，守群防危险。背毛很快硬成壳，把碎屑困住，必须常剪。
decisions.revised: POKENAME从炮中射带电毛团，守群防危险。背毛很快硬成壳，把碎屑困住，必须常剪。

decisions.source: POKENAME tails light up when they are agitated. They use the bright flashes as an offensive weapon to try to blind whatever caused them to grow anxious, giving them a chance to land a powerful shock.
decisions.target: POKENAME烦躁时尾巴亮起，强闪主动晃花惹它焦虑者的眼，争取机会，再来强电击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME烦躁时，尾巴便会亮起。它用明亮的闪光作武器，试着晃花令自己不安者的眼睛，趁机使出强力电击。

decisions.source: POKENAME stalks its prey from afar, camouflaging itself in the trees and bushes. However, due to its fur being an unnatural shade of green, other Pokémon often end up spotting it before it can strike.
decisions.target: POKENAME在树灌间伪装，远远跟踪猎物。可毛绿得不自然，往往还没出击，就被看穿。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏身树木与灌丛，远远跟踪猎物。不过，毛发的绿色过于不自然，常常还没出击，就被其他宝可梦发现。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves attention but often struggles to get any because it blends in with the world around it. Whenever POKENAME is noticed by a Trainer, it lets out gleeful cries as it embraces them with its feelers.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱关注，却常融入环境而得不到。训练家一注意它，就欢叫着用触须拥抱。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢受到关注，却常因与环境融为一体，而无法如愿。训练家只要注意到它，它便欢叫着伸出触须，紧紧拥抱对方。

decisions.source: POKENAME's claws constantly grow throughout its lifetime and if they grow too long, it will be unable to run properly. Its body is very aerodynamic, allowing it to run through the forest at high speeds.
decisions.target: POKENAME的爪一生不停长，太长就没法好好跑。身形有利破风，能在林中高速奔跑。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的爪子一生都在生长，若长得太长，就会妨碍奔跑。它的身形有利于减少空气阻力，使它能在森林中高速疾驰。

decisions.source: POKENAME charges down others not as a mark of aggression but as a way of playing. The impact is gentle, though it spreads out a large amount of pollen that typically aggravates the playmate's allergies.
decisions.target: POKENAME冲撞不是敌意，而为玩耍。力道温和，可散出的大量花粉，常刺激玩伴过敏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME冲撞别人，是为了玩耍，并非出于敌意。撞击的力道虽轻，却会散出大量花粉，往往使玩伴的过敏加重。

decisions.source: POKENAME have rings on their body that glow at night and shine particularly bright on nights of the new moon. They often draw the attention of other Pokémon who come to investigate the strange light.
decisions.target: POKENAME圆环夜里发光，新月之夜尤其明亮，常引来其他宝可梦，探查这奇怪的光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME圆环夜里发光，新月之夜尤其明亮，常引来其他宝可梦，探查这奇怪的光。

decisions.source: POKENAME has two mouths, one on either side of its head. They open and close at such speeds that the nearby water heats up slightly, though they are not very precise and often miss their prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME头两侧各有一张嘴，开合快得让附近水微微升温。可不太准，常咬空猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头部两侧各有一张嘴，开合速度快得能让附近的水微微升温。不过，它们瞄得不太准，常常咬不中猎物。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon that lives in social groups consisting of its own kind. Although aggressive, if it truly fears for its safety, it will sob and attempt to retreat back to its pack.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜间活动，与同类群居。虽凶，真担心自己安危时，却会啜泣，试着退回族群。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是一种夜行宝可梦，与同类结群生活。虽然性情凶猛，真觉得自身安全受到威胁时，却会一边啜泣，一边试着退回族群。

decisions.source: Despite the weight of their metal body, POKENAME are surprisingly agile in their underground environment. They use their psychic powers to lift up their long tail, enabling them to climb up and run along cave walls.
decisions.target: 金属身虽重，POKENAME地下动作却出奇灵活。念力托起长尾，就能攀上洞壁、沿壁跑。
decisions.revised: 金属身虽重，POKENAME地下动作却出奇灵活。念力托起长尾，就能攀上洞壁、沿壁跑。

decisions.source: Despite the terrifying appearance of this Pokémon, it is no predator. It uses its powerful jaw and wickedly sharp axes to cut through stones and metals like butter, which it then consumes for nutrients.
decisions.target: 它虽可怕，却不是捕食者。强颚、利斧切石和金属，如切黄油，再吃下取养分。
decisions.revised: 这种宝可梦外表可怕，却并非捕食者。它用强壮的颚和极其锋利的斧刃，轻松切开石头与金属，再将其吃下，获取养分。

decisions.source: POKENAME's rocky spines are very solid as well as very sharp. It strikes with headbutts and rolling strikes, but isn't afraid to tear a spine off and wield it as a weapon as well.
decisions.target: POKENAME岩刺既结实又锋利。靠头撞与滚撞进攻，也不怕拔下一根刺，当武器挥使。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的岩刺既坚固又锋利。它会用头撞和滚动冲撞攻击，也毫不犹豫地拔下尖刺，当作武器挥舞。

decisions.source: POKENAME finds deep mud holes to stand upon and sink into, submerging its body in mud. It gets antsy if it goes too long without a nice coating of mud and grime over its rocky complexion.
decisions.target: POKENAME找深泥坑站着沉下，全身浸泥。岩石般的外皮太久没覆好泥垢，就会焦躁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME找到深泥坑后，会站进去，慢慢沉下，让全身浸入泥中。岩石般的外皮，若太久没有好好覆上一层泥垢，它就会焦躁不安。

decisions.source: POKENAME's feathers are covered in tiny, poisonous needles that are extremely dangerous to breathe in. It builds its nest in small trees, spending more of its time looking after its eggs than hunting for food.
decisions.target: POKENAME羽毛覆着微小毒针，吸入极危险。在小树筑巢，照看蛋比找食物更费时间。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的羽毛覆着细小毒针，吸入十分危险。它在小树上筑巢，花在照看蛋上的时间，比捕猎觅食还要多。

decisions.source: POKENAME's green poisonous powder is used in pigments for painting. In small quantities, a touch causes mild itching, but in large quantities, it can blind the person, making it both a useful and dangerous substance.
decisions.target: POKENAME绿毒粉可作绘画颜料。少量接触只微痒，大量却会致盲，因此有用也危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME绿毒粉可作绘画颜料。少量接触只微痒，大量却会致盲，因此有用也危险。

decisions.source: They can build up heat within themselves by flapping their wings without moving, which causes their feathers to change color. They will change colors to blend into their surroundings or to try and intimidate others.
decisions.target: 它们原地振翼，在体内积热，使羽毛变色。换色可融入周围，也可试着威吓。
decisions.revised: 它们原地拍动翅膀，在体内积蓄热量，使羽毛变色。它们会用不同的颜色，融入周围环境，或试着威吓其他生物。

decisions.source: POKENAME grow irrationally angry at the sound of running water, seeking to stem the flow of streams and rivers in whatever way they can. This often results in them tearing down trees and creating impromptu dams.
decisions.target: POKENAME一听流水声，就莫名暴怒，想尽办法拦住溪河。常因此扯倒树木，造临时坝。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一听流水声，就莫名暴怒，想尽办法拦住溪河。常因此扯倒树木，造临时坝。

decisions.source: POKENAME is obsessed with its own hairdo. It will often show it off any chance it gets. Occasionally, a fruit will fall out of POKENAME's hair as it runs and cause it to trip and fall.
decisions.target: POKENAME痴迷自己的发型，逮机会就炫耀。偶尔跑着跑着，发里掉果，反把自己绊倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME痴迷自己的发型，一有机会就要炫耀。偶尔跑着跑着，头发里会掉出一颗果实，反倒将自己绊倒。

decisions.source: Flying high in the sky, POKENAME uses the blade on its tail to strike prey from above. It then uses its sharp fangs to break through tough hide and extract the life force from its prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞在高空，用尾刃从上方攻击猎物，再用利齿咬穿坚韧皮肤，抽取生命力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞在高空，用尾刃从上方攻击猎物，再用利齿咬穿坚韧皮肤，抽取生命力。

decisions.source: It is said that having a POKENAME as a supporter will greatly boost one's chances of victory. When several are gathered together, they wave their bladed arms in unison as a sort of battle cheer.
decisions.target: 据说有POKENAME支持，胜算会大增。几个聚在一起时，会齐挥刀臂，如同为战斗助威。
decisions.revised: 据说有POKENAME支持，胜算会大增。几个聚在一起时，会齐挥刀臂，如同为战斗助威。

decisions.source: POKENAME are covered in poisonous spikes that grow longer over time and can penetrate up to three layers of solid steel. It is unhealthy for POKENAME to go too long without having their spikes or fur trimmed.
decisions.target: POKENAME毒刺不断变长，最多能穿透三层实心钢板。刺或毛太久不修，会影响健康。
decisions.revised: POKENAME毒刺不断变长，最多能穿透三层实心钢板。刺或毛太久不修，会影响健康。

decisions.source: When awakened by external forces, the spines on POKENAME's head will change colors, signaling a forthcoming drought in the nearby areas. POKENAME will train until tired again, then return to its slumber and end the drought.
decisions.target: 外力唤醒POKENAME，头刺就变色，预示附近将旱。它练到再累，重回睡眠，旱情才结束。
decisions.revised: POKENAME被外力唤醒时，头上的尖刺就会变色，预示附近地区即将干旱。它会训练到再次疲惫，然后重回沉睡，旱情也随之结束。

decisions.source: As POKENAME dances, the shadows around it seem to move and undulate in time with its movements. It is said that those who watch its dances for too long will be consumed by the shadows themselves.
decisions.target: POKENAME跳舞，周围阴影似乎随动作移动、起伏。据说看太久，就会被阴影本身吞没。
decisions.revised: POKENAME跳舞，周围阴影似乎随动作移动、起伏。据说看太久，就会被阴影本身吞没。

decisions.source: When POKENAME spots an enemy, they flap their wings before aggressively charging forward. Unfortunately for POKENAME, they often forget why they want to fight partway through the charge. This leads to POKENAME stopping before giving a confused quack.
decisions.target: POKENAME见敌就扇翅猛冲，可惜常半路忘了为何想打架，于是停下，困惑地嘎一声。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一看见敌人，就拍动翅膀，气势汹汹地向前冲。可惜，它常在半路忘了为何要打架，于是停下脚步，困惑地嘎了一声。

decisions.source: POKENAME's stubby legs make its movement quite slow. When it needs to go faster, it can turn sideways and roll, but this type of movement is difficult to maintain for more than a few seconds.
decisions.target: POKENAME短腿让它爬得慢。急需加速，便侧身翻滚，可这种移动方式很难撑过几秒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的腿短短的，移动相当缓慢。需要加速时，它能侧过身来翻滚，不过这种移动方式，很难维持超过几秒。

decisions.source: POKENAME lures small creatures into its bag by putting sweet-scented treats at the entrance. Once they draw near, it closes the bag, which is filled with poisons, and traps them while the toxins take effect.
decisions.target: POKENAME在袋口放香甜零嘴，诱小生物入袋。靠近便合上，困在满袋毒中，等待毒发。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在袋口摆上散发甜香的零食，引诱小生物入袋。对方一靠近，它就合上装满毒物的袋子，将其困住，等待毒素生效。

decisions.source: POKENAME's strength and fighting spirit is indomitable. It absolutely refuses to give up a fight, and boxing matches between rivals in the wild can go on for days without end before a victor is decided.
decisions.target: POKENAME力量与斗志不屈，绝不肯放弃。野外对手间的拳赛，能连打数天，才分胜负。
decisions.revised: POKENAME力量强大，斗志不屈，绝不肯放弃战斗。野外对手之间的拳赛，能不间断地打上数天，才决出胜负。

decisions.source: POKENAME stamps its feet and flaps its winged arms to build up fire. This is a crucial part of the POKENAME courtship dance, but it is very loud, as they tend to group up around trash cans.
decisions.target: POKENAME跺脚、扑翼状双臂蓄火，是求偶舞的重要部分。常聚垃圾桶旁，声音却很吵。
decisions.revised: POKENAME跺动双脚，拍打翅膀般的双臂，积蓄火焰。这是求偶舞中至关重要的一环，可它们常聚在垃圾桶旁，动静实在很吵。

decisions.source: POKENAME scrape together rocks hidden beneath their feathers to create sparks while they dance, catching downy fluff from their wings on fire. These flickering lights mixed with their rapid movements create a beautiful display of dance.
decisions.target: POKENAME舞中摩擦羽下藏石，擦火点燃翼绒。闪烁火光配合快动作，舞景十分美丽。
decisions.revised: POKENAME跳舞时，摩擦羽毛下藏着的石头，擦出火星，点燃翅膀上的绒羽。闪烁的火光配上迅疾的动作，成了一场美丽的舞蹈表演。

decisions.source: These Pokémon gorge themselves upon human trash and other waste, which adds more and more mass to their bodies. They have no need to fear predators due to the horrendous stench their bodies emit.
decisions.target: 这些宝可梦暴食人类垃圾等废物，体重越积越多。恶臭太强，不需怕天敌。
decisions.revised: 这些宝可梦大口吞食人类的垃圾和其他废物，身体的分量随之不断增加。由于全身散发着可怕的恶臭，它们根本不必担心捕食者。

decisions.source: The white smoke of a POKENAME comes from burning refuse within its body. Its flames remove pollutants in the process, and the resulting smoke is surprisingly pleasant. Some humans use them to help clean up garbage.
decisions.target: POKENAME体内焚废物，冒出白烟。火也清除污染，烟竟宜人，有些人用它帮忙清垃圾。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的白烟，来自体内燃烧的废物。燃烧时，火焰会清除污染物，因此产生的烟，竟颇为宜人。有些人会请它们帮忙清理垃圾。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its psychic senses to locate those around it with the meekest demeanor to bite. It seeks them out specifically because it is itself too weak-willed to go after anything that might fight back.
decisions.target: POKENAME用超能力，寻找周围最怯弱的生物咬。自己也没胆，不敢对付可能反抗的。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用超能力感知周围，专挑性情最怯懦的对象下口。因为它自己也意志薄弱，不敢招惹任何可能反抗的家伙。

decisions.source: If a POKENAME wraps its string around the mast of a boat, it needs to be removed immediately. If allowed to stay, it will be joined by other POKENAME that will quickly tear the boat to shreds.
decisions.target: POKENAME若将细绳缠上船桅，就得立刻移走。任它留下，同类就会来，很快撕碎整船。
decisions.revised: POKENAME若把细绳缠上船桅，就必须立即移走。若任由它留下，其他POKENAME便会聚来，很快将整艘船撕得粉碎。

decisions.source: POKENAME stealthily swims through kelp forests to observe other inhabitants for weaknesses, which it exploits by bullying them to steal food. This practice allows it to preserve its vast energy to drive competitors from its territory.
decisions.target: POKENAME潜行海藻林，观察住民弱点，再欺负抢食，省下大量能量，赶走领地竞争者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在海藻林中潜游，观察其他居民的弱点，再加以欺凌，抢走食物。这样便能省下充沛的能量，用来驱赶侵入领地的竞争者。

decisions.source: Its acute sense of smell lets it track prey from 50 miles away. Its fur is soft and fluffy if you pet it front to back, but petting it any other way is coarse and rough.
decisions.target: 它嗅觉敏锐，50英里外也能追猎物。毛从前往后摸，软又蓬；换个方向，就粗硬。
decisions.revised: 它嗅觉敏锐，能追踪五十英里外的猎物。毛发从前往后抚摸，柔软蓬松；换作其他方向，却会觉得粗糙扎手。

decisions.source: This adorable creature poses little threat to anyone who stays out of arm's reach. It lives in any forest that possesses an abundant enough moss supply for it to use as its food source.
decisions.target: 这可爱生物，对伸手范围外的人几乎无害。只要森林苔藓够吃，就能生活。
decisions.revised: 这种生物十分可爱，只要待在它伸手够不着的地方，就几乎没有危险。任何森林，只要苔藓足够丰富，能供它充饥，就能成为它的家。

decisions.source: POKENAME's two heads can release ultrasonic waves to disorient others as a method of hunting and self-defense. If it is not careful, each head could also disorient the other, causing a multitude of issues.
decisions.target: POKENAME两头放超声扰乱旁人，捕猎、自卫都用。可不小心，也会互扰，惹出许多问题。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的两个头，都能放出超声波，使旁人晕头转向，借此捕猎、自卫。不过，一不小心，两头也会互相干扰，惹出许多麻烦。

decisions.source: POKENAME troupes sleep together during the day, spending the daylight huddled together high up in the tree branches. Their flowers help disguise their sleeping place, making it appear as though the branches are simply in bloom.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天结群睡觉，挤在高高树枝上。花朵掩住睡处，看起来只是枝头正开花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天结群睡觉，紧紧挤在高高的树枝上。它们的花朵，将睡处巧妙地掩饰起来，看上去只是枝头开满了花。

decisions.source: POKENAME will take over sunken ships at the bottom of the ocean, claiming them as territory and chasing off intruders. It often wields the anchor from said ship as a weapon to help enforce its rule.
decisions.target: POKENAME占据海底沉船，宣称领地，驱走入侵者。常拿那艘船的锚作武器，维护统治。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会占据海底的沉船，将其视为自己的领地，赶走入侵者。它常把那艘船的锚，当作武器挥舞，巩固自己的统治。

decisions.source: POKENAME is an extremely harsh taskmaster in regards to its leadership. It holds its troops to a high standard, with failure punished via being stung by its poisonous spines, leading to several days of excruciating pain.
decisions.target: POKENAME是极严酷的首领，对部下要求很高。失败者会挨毒刺惩罚，剧痛持续数天。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是极严酷的首领，对部下要求很高。失败者会挨毒刺惩罚，剧痛持续数天。

decisions.source: It perches atop branches and rocks in wait of worthy opponents to cross its sight. When it spots one it deems a worthy foe, it cries out and leaps at them with its club raised.
decisions.target: 它停在枝头、岩上，等值得一战的对手出现。一看中，就高呼、举棍，跃向敌人。
decisions.revised: 它停在树枝和岩石上，等待值得一战的对手进入视野。一发现中意的强敌，便高声呼喊，举起棍棒，朝对方跃去。

decisions.source: POKENAME practice developing their proficiency over boney implements by skewering fruits and vegetables with boney spikes. Once they have enough food ready, they start a fire and roast these skewers until they become a delicious meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME用骨刺串水果蔬菜，练习驾驭骨工具。食物备够，就生火，将串烧烤成美餐。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用骨刺串起水果蔬菜，练习熟练使用骨制工具。食物备够后，它们就生起火，将这些串烤成可口的美餐。

decisions.source: Since the deep sea lacks leaves for it to eat, POKENAME has turned to a diet of seaweed and moss instead. If attacked, it has the option of either jabbing the assailant with its horn or using its fin to swim away.
decisions.target: 深海没有叶片可吃，POKENAME便改吃海藻与苔藓。受攻击时，要么用角刺向敌人，要么摆鳍游走。
decisions.revised: 深海没有叶片可吃，POKENAME便改吃海藻与苔藓。受攻击时，要么用角刺向敌人，要么摆鳍游走。

decisions.source: It works in tandem with its young to search for sweet fruits and nectar in forests. Once they have found a good source of food, the child will be allowed to gorge itself first before the parent eats what is left.
decisions.target: 与幼崽合作，在森林寻找甜果和花蜜。找到好食物后，先让孩子吃饱，自己再吃剩下的。
decisions.revised: 与幼崽合作，在森林寻找甜果和花蜜。找到好食物后，先让孩子吃饱，自己再吃剩下的。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a curious sort, often following along after something passing by has caught its interest. It is rather shy as well, so should the person it follows turn to see their pursuer, it turns invisible so as not to get caught.
decisions.target: POKENAME好奇，经过的什么一惹兴趣，就常跟去。可它也害羞，被跟的人一转头，便隐形，免被捉着。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生性好奇，路过的事物只要引起兴趣，它就常会跟上去。不过，它也很害羞，被跟随的人若转身察看，它便隐去身形，以免被捉住。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its tough claws to till soil and to break open hard nuts. The flame upon its tail flicks wildly when it feels threatened. To keep foes at bay, it waves about its leaf that exudes a sharp, yet rich, scent.
decisions.target: POKENAME用坚爪翻土、破硬坚果。遇险，尾焰疯狂摇动，它再挥叶，散刺激又浓郁的气味，驱退敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用坚韧的爪子翻土，破开坚硬的果壳。感到威胁时，尾上的火焰会剧烈摇曳。它挥动叶片，散发浓郁而刺鼻的气味，阻止敌人靠近。

decisions.source: POKENAME's precognitive abilities alert it to disasters that will take a heavy emotional toll on people. Though it can do nothing to divert the disasters themselves, its leaf emits a calming scent that can help soothe the victims after the fact.
decisions.target: POKENAME能预知，让人心灵受重创的灾难。虽无法阻灾，叶片安神香气，却能在事后安抚受害者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的预知能力，能让它察觉会使人心灵遭受重创的灾难。虽然无法阻止灾难本身，叶片散发的平和香气，却能在事后安抚受害者。

decisions.source: POKENAME balance on their tails whenever they fight against other Pokémon because it gives them a greater range of movement. When they are losing a fight, they bite down on a Ganlon Berry to help them take a few more hits.
decisions.target: POKENAME战斗时靠尾巴站稳，活动范围更大。快输时就咬下一颗龙睛果，让自己多挨几下攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME与其他宝可梦交战时，总会靠尾巴保持平衡，让动作的范围更大。落于下风时，它们就咬下一颗龙睛果，让自己能再多承受几次攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME are very playful and love to play with their lure. Yet, when they hit it too hard, the lure becomes unable to produce light for a few days. POKENAME rarely learn from their errors and often damage their lure once they recover.
decisions.target: POKENAME极爱玩自己的诱饵。可打得太重，就几天不能发光。它很少长记性，刚恢复，往往又弄坏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分贪玩，最爱摆弄自己的诱饵。可是打得太重，诱饵就会好几天无法发光。它们很少吸取教训，刚恢复，往往又将诱饵弄坏了。

decisions.source: POKENAME's only method of defense is to inflate its body with air, turning a deeper red to scare off others. It cannot hold its breath for long, so it hides in taller grass to limit its need to use this technique.
decisions.target: POKENAME唯一的防御，是吸气鼓身、变得更红，吓退对方。可憋气不久，便躲高草丛，尽量少用这招。
decisions.revised: POKENAME唯一的防御手段，是将空气吸入体内，鼓起身体，变成更深的红色，吓退对方。它无法长时间憋气，便藏在高草丛里，尽量少用这招。

decisions.source: POKENAME are common companions for young children due to how docile they are and how warm their wool fleeces are. Their wool fleeces can become so thick that the smallest amount will generate enough static electricity to power a lightbulb for hours.
decisions.target: POKENAME温顺、毛暖，是幼童常见伙伴。毛能长得极厚，一点点便能产生足够点灯数小时的静电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME性情温顺，羊毛又暖和，是幼童常见的伙伴。毛层能长得非常厚，即使只取极少一点，产生的静电，也足够让灯泡亮上数小时。

decisions.source: POKENAME swing their tail into the path of any threats, relying on the broad metal plate to absorb the blows coming their way. Their tail plate can also double as portable shade, allowing POKENAME to cool off if the sun gets too hot.
decisions.target: POKENAME把尾巴挥向威胁，靠宽金属板挡攻击。尾板也能当便携遮阳伞，太阳太热便躲着降温。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将尾巴挥到威胁袭来的方向，靠宽大的金属板承受攻击。尾板还能兼作便携的遮阳伞，让它在烈日下乘凉。

decisions.source: It uses the flame on its tail to communicate with others of its kind over long distances, forming glowing messages in the night sky. The mild venom from its spines can be used as a pesticide, making POKENAME highly valued by farmers.
decisions.target: 它用尾火远距离沟通，在夜空组成亮消息。背刺的弱毒能作农药，因此POKENAME极受农夫重视。
decisions.revised: 它用尾部的火焰，与远方的同类交流，在夜空中写出发光的信息。尖刺上的轻微毒液，还能用作农药，因此POKENAME深受农民重视。

decisions.source: POKENAME loves to nap while sunbathing. This action helps POKENAME regain lost energy and support the growth of the earthy shell on its back. This Pokémon uses its taloned feet to scratch the earth and look for fertile soil to nestle into.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱边晒太阳边打盹，恢复能量，帮助背上土壳生长。它用爪足挠土，找肥沃土壤窝进去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢晒着太阳打盹，既能恢复消耗的能量，也有助于背上土质外壳的生长。它用带爪的双脚扒土，寻找肥沃的土壤，舒服地窝进去。

decisions.source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to negative emotions, growing teary-eyed at a hint of negativity. It snaps its claws at the source of the emotions, the pinch of which causes a sense of calm in the victim should POKENAME hold them long enough.
decisions.target: POKENAME对负面情绪极敏感，一点苗头就泪汪汪。它向源头挥钳，夹得够久，就能让受害者平静。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对负面情绪极其敏感，稍有一丝，就会泪眼汪汪。它朝情绪的源头伸钳夹去，若夹住足够久，受夹者就会感到平静。

decisions.source: Its thick arms glow brighter as it fights, building energy that quickly surges across its entire body. The large horn of a POKENAME can pierce through steel and serves as a conduit to release its energy after it has built up enough.
decisions.target: 战斗时，粗臂越来越亮，积能迅速涌遍全身。POKENAME大角能穿钢，也是积能足够后释放的导体。
decisions.revised: 战斗中，它粗壮的手臂越来越亮，积蓄的能量，迅速涌遍全身。POKENAME的大角能刺穿钢铁，也是能量积蓄足够后，释放出去的通道。

decisions.source: Thanks to its deep shadow body, POKENAME can transform the claws on its neck into giant hands to grasp prey. The gold armor it wears allows it to be highly aggressive, as the armor is as sharp as its claws and horns.
decisions.target: 靠深黑暗影身躯，POKENAME能将颈爪变成巨手捉猎物。金甲与爪角同样锐利，让它能凶狠进攻。
decisions.revised: POKENAME凭深沉的暗影身躯，能将颈部的爪子化作巨手，抓住猎物。它身穿的金甲，与爪和角一样锋利，使它能发起凶猛的进攻。

decisions.source: POKENAME are seen treading across large bodies of water in herds, galloping across the surface of the water at speeds rivaling a powerful jet ski. Sharpedo and Carvanha often follow them, scaring away other aquatic Pokémon from getting in their path.
decisions.target: POKENAME成群踏水，水面奔速如强劲水上摩托。巨牙鲨与利牙鱼常随行，吓走拦路水生宝可梦。
decisions.revised: 人们见过POKENAME成群踏过大片水域，在水面奔腾，速度堪比强劲的水上摩托。巨牙鲨与利牙鱼常跟在旁边，吓走其他可能挡路的水生宝可梦。

decisions.source: POKENAME forage for Tanga Berries to protect themselves against the many Bug-type Pokémon in their natural habitat. They hunt rodent Pokémon by reaching into burrows with their long snout and let out a spooky cry whenever they are full.
decisions.target: POKENAME找扁樱果吃，抵御栖地众多虫属性宝可梦。长鼻探洞猎鼠类宝可梦，每逢吃饱，就怪叫。
decisions.revised: POKENAME寻找扁樱果，保护自己，抵御栖息地众多的虫属性宝可梦。它把长鼻伸入洞穴，捕猎鼠类宝可梦，每当吃饱，就会发出阴森的叫声。

decisions.source: POKENAME's teeth are heavily coated with impurities, meaning it won't feel any pain from biting on tough items. It likes to crush objects as hard as it can to squeeze even the slightest bit of extra light energy from them.
decisions.target: POKENAME的牙厚覆杂质，所以啃硬物也不疼。它喜欢拼命咬碎物体，榨出哪怕多一点点的光能。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的牙齿厚厚地覆着杂质，咬硬物时也不会疼。它喜欢使尽力气压碎东西，哪怕只能再榨出一丁点光能，也不放过。

decisions.source: A POKENAME can grow in size by actively melting any sand it moves on and incorporating it into its body. Should anyone ever break a POKENAME's brittle shell, it will immediately viciously attack the one responsible with burning hot sand and glass.
decisions.target: POKENAME主动熔掉沿途沙粒，纳入身体，长大。谁打破脆壳，就会立刻被灼热沙与玻璃凶狠袭击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会主动熔化沿途的沙子，将其融入身体，令体型增长。谁若打破它脆弱的外壳，就会立刻遭到凶猛反击，被灼热的沙子与玻璃袭击。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in polar regions, their thick layers of fat and coating of fuzzy fur helping to protect them from the cold. They hibernate through the summer months and emerge in the polar night, roaming the ice fields in the constant darkness.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在极地，厚脂肪和毛绒皮肤御寒。夏季休眠，极夜才出现，在不变的黑暗中漫游冰原。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在极地，靠厚厚的脂肪和蓬松的毛发抵御寒冷。它们整个夏季都在休眠，直到极夜才现身，在无尽的黑暗中，漫游冰原。

decisions.source: POKENAME flutter their wings rapidly when they get into Pokémon battles, lifting off the ground as they launch their flurry of kicks. The flutter of their wings dislodges paralytic wing scales that harm their foe when they get into open injuries.
decisions.target: 对战时，POKENAME快速振翅，离地连踢。翼动抖落带麻痹性的鳞粉，进入开放伤口，还会伤害敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME参加宝可梦对战时，会快速振翅，腾空使出接连的踢击。振翅还会抖落带麻痹性的鳞粉，若进入未愈合的伤口，就会伤害敌人。

decisions.source: It is a swift jungle-dwelling Pokémon known to cut down trees and steal objects from others, but only on rare occasions. The explanation for these behaviors is not known. The leaf on its head is sharp enough to cut through wood in a single strike.
decisions.target: 它是迅捷的丛林宝可梦，偶尔会砍树、偷别人的东西，缘由不明。头顶叶片锋利，一击就能切开木头。
decisions.revised: 它是迅捷的丛林宝可梦，偶尔会砍树、偷别人的东西，缘由不明。头顶叶片锋利，一击就能切开木头。

decisions.source: POKENAME has sharp, poison-soaked scythes that it uses to finish off its prey. When it rolls at high speeds it gathers its blades, and it only draws them out when hunting or battling other Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME用锋利的毒镰了结猎物。高速滚动时会收起刀刃，只在狩猎或战斗时展开。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用锋利的毒镰了结猎物。高速滚动时会收起刀刃，只在狩猎或战斗时展开。

decisions.source: It can usually be found floating around in tall grass, singing to injured Pokémon in an effort to help them. It is said that traveling with this Pokémon can bring the Trainer good luck.
decisions.target: 常在高草中飘浮，为受伤宝可梦歌唱施助。据说与它同行，训练家会有好运。
decisions.revised: 常能在高草丛中，看见它飘浮的身影。它为受伤的宝可梦歌唱，试着帮助它们。据说，与这种宝可梦同行，能为训练家带来好运。

decisions.source: POKENAME hides itself at the bottom of ponds during the day. At night, it will raise the eyes atop its rocky head above the surface to watch for prey approaching the water to drink, then leap out to seize it in its arms.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天藏在池底。夜里，把石头头顶的眼睛升出水面，等猎物近水喝水，再跳出用手臂抓住。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天藏在池塘底部。夜里，它将石质头顶的眼睛探出水面，守候前来饮水的猎物，再突然跃出，用双臂将其抓住。

decisions.source: POKENAME are a rare sight, as they are only seen gliding across the sky on nights of a full moon. They are friendly toward lost travelers, guiding them home with the pale light radiating from their wings.
decisions.target: POKENAME罕见，只在满月之夜，才滑过天空。它友善对待迷途旅人，用翼上淡光，领回家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分罕见，只有满月之夜，才会被看见在天空滑翔。它们善待迷途的旅人，用翅膀散发的淡淡光芒，指引对方归家。

decisions.source: POKENAME has nearly boundless amounts of energy, able to fly around for over a week without tiring out. It loves to play with young children, but it can get a bit too energetic every now and then.
decisions.target: POKENAME能量几乎无尽，飞一周多，也不会累。它爱与小孩子玩，只是偶尔会兴奋过头。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能量几乎无尽，飞一周多，也不会累。它爱与小孩子玩，只是偶尔会兴奋过头。

decisions.source: POKENAME are fiercely territorial over the frozen caves where they nest. If an intruder gets too close to their domain, they will attack in coordinated swarms, darting from the shadows to strike trespassers with their venomous stingers.
decisions.target: POKENAME凶猛保护冰洞巢穴。入侵者太近，它们就协同群攻，从阴影疾出，用毒刺打击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME对筑巢的冰洞，有极强的领地意识。入侵者若太靠近，它们便会成群配合，从阴影中疾速冲出，用毒刺发动袭击。

decisions.source: POKENAME can sense people's dispositions and will only let itself be visible to those with a genuine desire to see it and pure intentions in their hearts. It remains invisible in the presence of anybody else.
decisions.target: POKENAME能感知人的心性，只向真心想见、意图纯洁者显形。其余对象在场，它都隐形。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能感知人的心性，只会向真心想见自己、心中意图纯洁的人显形。其他任何人在场时，它都会保持隐形。

decisions.source: To keep their claws sharp, POKENAME regularly scrape them against each other. The flakes that come off of POKENAME's claws are sought after by practitioners of folk medicine, who believe that the flakes will cure any sickness.
decisions.target: POKENAME定期互刮爪子，保持锋利。刮落的碎屑，深受民间医者追捧，相信能治任何病。
decisions.revised: 为了让爪子保持锋利，POKENAME会定期将爪子互相磨刮。刮落的碎屑，深受民间医者追捧，他们相信，这些碎屑能治愈任何疾病。

decisions.source: The tendrils on POKENAME's head give it extrasensory perception. It can wave them in the air to detect foes who try to sneak up on it, then use psychic blasts to sap their will to fight.
decisions.target: POKENAME头须有超感知力，空中一挥，就能发现潜近的敌人，再用精神冲击，削去战意。
