decisions.revised: POKENAME头上的须蔓，赋予它超常的感知能力。在空中挥动须蔓，便能探知企图偷偷接近的敌人，再发出精神冲击，削弱对方的斗志。

decisions.source: Even when POKENAME's flames are at rest, segments of its hide still glow red-hot from the heat it emanates. It ignites its fire just before rolling at opponents, turning itself into a burning, whirling fireball.
decisions.target: POKENAME火焰平息，一些皮仍灼红发亮。滚撞对手前，它才点火，化成燃烧旋转的火球。
decisions.revised: 即使POKENAME的火焰平息，散发的热量，仍会使部分皮肤灼红发亮。滚向对手之前，它才点燃火焰，化成一团燃烧着旋转的火球。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be found in swamps, building its dens out of wooden logs and tree roots. While it needs to repair its dens every few days, POKENAME prefers to spend most of the day gnawing on large logs.
decisions.target: POKENAME住沼泽，用原木与树根筑巢。虽每隔几天，就需修屋，它却宁愿整天，啃大原木。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在沼泽，用原木和树根建造巢穴。虽然每隔几天，就需要修缮一次，它却更喜欢把一天中的大部分时间，用来啃咬大块原木。

decisions.source: POKENAME clamp their jaws around anything that interests them and pull it back into their shell for safekeeping. If they're caught biting onto a person or larger Pokémon in their excitement, they will hide in their shells to avoid being scolded.
decisions.target: POKENAME把感兴趣的东西咬住，拉进壳妥存。若被发现兴奋咬着人，或大宝可梦，就缩壳，免遭责骂。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会咬住任何感兴趣的东西，拉进壳里妥善收藏。若被发现兴奋地咬着人，或较大的宝可梦，它们便缩进壳中，逃避责骂。

decisions.source: Its four bulbs store electricity and glow the more they have stored. The bulbs on a POKENAME's cheeks are how it will primarily release electricity, which it will often do when it has generated too much.
decisions.target: POKENAME四个灯球储电，存得越多就越亮。主要靠颊球放电，产电过多时经常这样做。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的四个灯球能够储电，存得越多，光就越亮。它主要通过脸颊的灯球释放电力，产电过多时，经常会这样做。

decisions.source: POKENAME are usually seen with their parents, as this Pokémon has a hard time being independent. When left or alone or can't find its parents, POKENAME will cry out loudly and throw a kicking temper tantrum.
decisions.target: POKENAME难以独立，通常跟父母一起。被独自留下或找不到父母，就大哭乱踢，闹脾气。
decisions.revised: POKENAME很难独立，通常都与父母待在一起。一旦被独自留下，或找不到父母，就会大声哭喊，乱踢乱蹬地闹起脾气。

decisions.source: It is said that POKENAME has the power to create songs that reflect the true heart of any person it has met. If anyone disturbs its song, it will open its eyes and release a deafening screech.
decisions.target: 据说POKENAME能创作反映所遇之人真实内心的歌曲。谁打断，就睁眼发出震耳尖啸。
decisions.revised: 据说POKENAME能创作反映所遇之人真实内心的歌曲。谁打断，就睁眼发出震耳尖啸。

decisions.source: POKENAME use the friction of flight to generate electricity within their wool fleeces, which is then stored in the orbs on their tail tips. They grow more excitable the more power they have stored and seek battles to let loose their excess power.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠飞行摩擦，在羊毛里产电，再存进尾尖光球。存得越多越兴奋，会找战斗，放掉过剩电力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠飞行时的摩擦，在羊毛中产生电力，再储存到尾尖的光球里。电力存得越多，它们就越兴奋，会寻找战斗，释放过剩的电力。

decisions.source: POKENAME is easily blown away by strong winds, so it uses its large ears to check the wind's speed. It uses its toxic barbs to attach itself to objects to prevent itself from being blown away.
decisions.target: POKENAME容易被大风吹走，用大耳检查风速。毒刺能把自己固定在物件上，免得飞走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME容易被大风吹走，用大耳检查风速。毒刺能把自己固定在物件上，免得飞走。

decisions.source: This elusive nocturnal Pokémon is incredibly tough to spot, catch, and thus, research. Because of this, scientists are divided into two camps: some believe POKENAME's wings are made of moon rock, while the others think they can be made of cheese.
decisions.target: POKENAME夜行难寻，难见难捉，更难研究。科学家因此分两派：有人信翼是月岩，有人想可能是奶酪。
decisions.revised: 这种神出鬼没的夜行宝可梦，既难发现，又难捕捉，因此更难研究。科学家也分成两派：有些认为POKENAME的翅膀由月岩构成，另一些则觉得，可能是奶酪。

decisions.source: POKENAME walks on its two front paws to train its upper body strength, leaving its third paw free to attack with. To catch opposing Pokémon off guard, it falls back onto its stomach and rapidly spins, clenching anything that may come close.
decisions.target: POKENAME以前两爪走，练上身，留第三爪攻击。为出奇制胜，会趴回肚子快速旋转，抓住靠近的一切。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用两只前爪行走，锻炼上半身的力量，将第三只爪留作攻击。为使对手措手不及，它会俯身趴下，飞快旋转，抓紧一切靠近的东西。

decisions.source: When threatened, POKENAME withdraws into its shell. Its gills are too large to fit in with the rest of it, so they have developed a poisonous film that they excrete onto their gills, causing nerve damage to anything that tries to attack it.
decisions.target: 遇到威胁，POKENAME就缩进壳里。鳃太大，收不进去，于是它会分泌毒膜覆住鳃，损伤攻击者的神经。
decisions.revised: 遇到威胁，POKENAME就缩进壳里。鳃太大，收不进去，于是它会分泌毒膜覆住鳃，损伤攻击者的神经。

decisions.source: POKENAME flattens itself out as much as possible and waits until something comes along and treads upon it. Once something does, it lets out a joyful cry, as it treats being stepped on like winning a game.
decisions.target: POKENAME尽量摊平身体，等东西路过踩上来。一被踩中，它就开心地叫，仿佛赢了游戏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尽可能摊平身体，等待有东西经过，踩到自己。一旦被踩中，它便欢快地叫起来，仿佛这样就赢了一场游戏。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their bulbs to hide among flower bushes, eating away at the leaves within. Once they have finished their meal, they will plant sprouts along the base of the bush to help it grow back sooner.
decisions.target: POKENAME借球茎藏在花丛，吃里面的叶子。吃完会沿灌木根部种芽，帮助更快长回来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME借花苞掩护，藏在开花的灌木丛中，啃食里面的叶子。饱餐之后，它们会沿灌木基部种下嫩芽，帮助灌木更快长回来。

decisions.source: The flower on POKENAME's back gives off an intense fragrance that can relieve the pain caused by migraines. It is an extremely rare Pokémon that lives a solitary life in the heart of the jungle.
decisions.target: POKENAME背上的花香气浓烈，能减轻偏头痛造成的疼痛。它极其罕见，独居丛林深处。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背上的花香气浓烈，能减轻偏头痛造成的疼痛。它极其罕见，独居丛林深处。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends its entire day searching for food to nourish the flower blooming on its back, making it grow even more beautiful. When it is happy, it naturally releases a strong fragrance that can lift the spirits of anyone who breathes it in.
decisions.target: POKENAME整天找食物，滋养背上盛开的花，让它更美。开心时自然散出浓香，吸入者都会心情振奋。
decisions.revised: POKENAME整天找食物，滋养背上盛开的花，让它更美。开心时自然散出浓香，吸入者都会心情振奋。

decisions.source: POKENAME fakes a kind gesture by gifting eggs with a foul taste to people. Once it sees their startled reaction to the egg's taste, it runs away extremely quickly before the person can enact their revenge.
decisions.target: POKENAME假装好意，送给人难吃的蛋。一看对方被味道吓到，就飞快逃走，免得遭报复。
decisions.revised: POKENAME假装好意，送给人难吃的蛋。一看对方被味道吓到，就飞快逃走，免得遭报复。

decisions.source: POKENAME are known to be relentless attackers and rarely show any mercy to their foes. They attack their enemies by swinging their tails like maces. If their tail stays in contact with the ground for too long, they will become drained of energy.
decisions.target: POKENAME攻势凶狠，极少怜悯敌人，会像挥重锤一样甩尾攻击。但尾巴若触地太久，就会耗尽能量。
decisions.revised: POKENAME攻势凶狠，极少怜悯敌人，会像挥重锤一样甩尾攻击。但尾巴若触地太久，就会耗尽能量。

decisions.source: Known for being a lone hunter, POKENAME will stalk its prey until they tire out, quickly getting the jump on them once they do. It creates scythes made of electricity, using them to hack and slash its quarry until they're perfectly cooked.
decisions.target: POKENAME独自狩猎，跟踪猎物直到疲惫，再迅速扑上。造出雷电镰刀，劈砍目标，直到烹得恰到好处。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是出了名的独行猎手，会一路跟踪猎物，直到对方疲惫，再迅速发起突袭。它造出雷电凝成的镰刀，劈砍猎物，直到将其烹得恰到好处。

decisions.source: The Z-pattern on POKENAME's belly is caused by a severe overdevelopment of muscles, causing its belly pattern to unnaturally change. Although it knows most styles of swimming, it seemingly can only flail its arms and feet around while in the water.
decisions.target: POKENAME腹肌过度发达，让腹纹不自然地变成Z形。虽懂大多数泳姿，进水后似乎仍只能乱挥手脚。
decisions.revised: POKENAME腹肌过度发达，让腹纹不自然地变成Z形。虽懂大多数泳姿，进水后似乎仍只能乱挥手脚。

decisions.source: POKENAME have thick plumages that help to contain the heat of their inner flames, which makes them quite warm to the touch. They deliver powerful kicks to anyone or anything that may try to pluck their feathers.
decisions.target: POKENAME羽衣厚，留住内火热量，摸着十分温暖。谁或什么东西想拔毛，就会挨上强踢。
decisions.revised: POKENAME浓厚的羽毛，能留住体内火焰的热量，摸起来十分温暖。任何人或东西，只要试图拔它们的羽毛，就会挨上强力的一脚。

decisions.source: POKENAME are innocent little creatures that enjoy silly games and lots of fun. They can sense when their Trainer is upset and will do their best to cheer them up so that they can keep playing games.
decisions.target: POKENAME天真小巧，爱傻游戏与各种乐趣。能察觉训练家难过，尽力逗开心，好继续玩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是天真的小生灵，喜欢各种傻乎乎的游戏，尽情寻乐。它能察觉训练家的难过，便尽力将对方逗开心，好继续一起玩耍。

decisions.source: A protector of nature, POKENAME strives to keep the flora and fauna safe from harm. If it senses that its surroundings are in danger, it will remove its belt and strike with precision at whoever is responsible.
decisions.target: POKENAME守护自然，努力保护动植物。若察觉周围遇险，就解下腰带，精准打击肇事者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME守护自然，努力保护动植物。若察觉周围遇险，就解下腰带，精准打击肇事者。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is completely hollow, with nothing inside its hard dry shell except for white spores. These spores float out to leech life from any living thing they touch, then return back to POKENAME's dark interior.
decisions.target: POKENAME全身中空，干硬壳里只有白孢子。飘出吸取所碰活物的生命，再回黑暗体内。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体完全中空，干燥坚硬的外壳里，除了白色孢子，什么也没有。孢子会飘出去，吸取接触到的活物的生命，再返回它黑暗的体内。

decisions.source: The muscles that allow POKENAME to fire stones from its palms are actually connected to its tongue, so if POKENAME is about to fire, it sucks in its tongue. This also means POKENAME cannot fire stones and stretch out its tongue at the same time.
decisions.target: POKENAME掌心发石的肌肉，实际连着舌头。因此准备开火，就先吸回舌，也无法一边射石、一边伸舌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME掌心发石的肌肉，实际连着舌头。因此准备开火，就先吸回舌，也无法一边射石、一边伸舌。

decisions.source: POKENAME cover their eyes with flower necklaces to better sense the emotions and passions of the people around them. Once they're in tune with a Trainer's wavelength, they will change color and sway their hips to match the person's aura.
decisions.target: POKENAME用花项链遮眼，更好感知旁人情绪与热情。一与训练家同频，就变色摆胯，配合对方气场。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用花朵项链遮住眼睛，以便更好地感知周围人的情绪与热情。一旦与训练家心意相通，它们便会变换颜色，摇摆腰胯，配合对方的气场。

decisions.source: POKENAME attempts to blend into its surroundings to try and secretly agitate the many noisy beach-goers it deals with, but fails each time, as it can oddly never seem to properly match the color of sand.
decisions.target: POKENAME想融入周围，暗中烦扰吵闹的海滩客，却次次失败，不知为何总配不好沙色。
decisions.revised: POKENAME想融入周围，暗中烦扰吵闹的海滩客，却次次失败，不知为何总配不好沙色。

decisions.source: POKENAME is often used as an assistant during dental extractions thanks to its millimetric precision with its steel pincers. When in a good mood, it blows bubbles from its mouth and playfully pops them with its chelae.
decisions.target: POKENAME钢钳精确到毫米，常在拔牙时当助手。心情好，就从嘴吹泡，再用钳顽皮戳破。
decisions.revised: POKENAME操纵钢钳的精度，可达毫米，常被请去协助拔牙。心情好时，它会从嘴里吹出泡泡，再用钳子顽皮地将其戳破。

decisions.source: POKENAME is slow and lazy, but also rather cunning. Instead of chasing after prey, it climbs up to a high place and gathers a pile of rocks, then hunts for food by flinging them with great force.
decisions.target: POKENAME缓慢懒散，却颇为狡猾。不追猎物，反而爬到高处，堆起石头，奋力投掷来觅食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME缓慢懒散，却颇为狡猾。不追猎物，反而爬到高处，堆起石头，奋力投掷来觅食。

decisions.source: POKENAME is typically only seen at night, flying through the air while illuminated by the full moon. Sometimes it can be seen casting a small beam of light towards the moon itself, though it is not known for what reason it does this.
decisions.target: POKENAME通常只在夜里出现，迎着满月照明飞行。有时会向月亮投出小光束，为何这样做，仍未知。
decisions.revised: POKENAME通常只在夜里现身，在满月的照耀下飞行。有时，能看见它向月亮投出一小道光束，不过为何这样做，仍不得而知。

decisions.source: POKENAME hang from cave ceilings and tree branches as they wait for prey to fall upon. They can spin their bodies so fast that the ring around their bodies can cut through trees like sawblades, though they will quickly tire and become dizzy.
decisions.target: POKENAME挂在洞顶、树枝，等着落下扑猎物。身体转得极快，周身环能如锯刃切树，却很快会累、头晕。
decisions.revised: POKENAME悬挂在洞顶或树枝上，等待时机，落下扑向猎物。它们能飞快旋转身体，让身周的圆环如锯刃般切开树木，不过很快就会疲倦、头晕。

decisions.source: POKENAME sleeps for many hours each day, and the first thing it does when it wakes up is pad damp mud or soil upon its head around its sprout. It has strong jaws that allow it to eat very tough foods, so it never struggles to find a meal.
decisions.target: POKENAME每天睡许多小时，醒来第一件事，就是把湿泥土拍在头芽周围。强颚能吃极韧食物，从不愁找不到饭。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每天睡许多小时，醒来第一件事，就是把湿泥土拍在头芽周围。强颚能吃极韧食物，从不愁找不到饭。

decisions.source: The sprout on POKENAME's head grows into a bush capable of producing berries said to have healing properties. It takes great care to make sure the plant doesn't get too much or too little sunlight.
decisions.target: POKENAME头芽长成灌木，结出据说有疗效的树果。它悉心照料，不让阳光过多或过少。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头芽长成灌木，结出据说有疗效的树果。它悉心照料，不让阳光过多或过少。

decisions.source: POKENAME in the wild will climb to the top of the largest boulder it can find and proclaim itself king of its territory. Rival POKENAME will battle each other atop the rocks to see who is truly worthy enough to sit on the throne.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME爬上能找到的最大巨石，自称领地之王。对手就在石顶决斗，看谁真有资格坐王座。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME爬上能找到的最大巨石，自称领地之王。对手就在石顶决斗，看谁真有资格坐王座。

decisions.source: POKENAME bear resemblance to an ancient artifact from the Hoenn region. When threatened, they surround themselves with a bubble made of electrified water. By using a small explosion, they make this bubble burst and paralyze the foe.
decisions.target: POKENAME像丰缘古文物。受威胁时，用带电水泡包裹自己，再以小爆炸引破，麻痹敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的模样，酷似丰缘地区的一件古老文物。受到威胁时，它们会用带电的水泡包住自己，再引发小小的爆炸，使水泡破裂，麻痹敌人。

decisions.source: Within its belly is a potent flame sac that allows it to breathe flames and keep it warm within its ocean home. The fur on its neck flickers like glowing flames and the jets of water it releases are always scalding hot.
decisions.target: 腹内强大的火囊让它能喷火，也在海中家园保温。颈毛像光焰闪动，喷出的水始终滚烫。
decisions.revised: 腹内强大的火囊让它能喷火，也在海中家园保温。颈毛像光焰闪动，喷出的水始终滚烫。

decisions.source: Those who peer into this Pokémon's flames will supposedly see their entire life as the flame flick about. The core upon POKENAME's chest contains immense energy that it can emit as a searing-hot ray of light to defend itself.
decisions.target: 据说凝望火焰，会随火光跳动，看见自己一生。POKENAME胸前核心含巨量能量，可放灼热光线自卫。
decisions.revised: 据说凝望火焰，会随火光跳动，看见自己一生。POKENAME胸前核心含巨量能量，可放灼热光线自卫。

decisions.source: Despite its diminutive stature, POKENAME is known to pick fights with Pokémon many times its size. Ironically, it wins most of these fights, as it can create rifts in space and will often send its opponent onto the surface of nearby comets.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽小，爱找体形数倍的对手，反而大多能赢。它能撕开空间，常将敌人送到附近彗星表面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽小，爱找体形数倍的对手，反而大多能赢。它能撕开空间，常将敌人送到附近彗星表面。

decisions.source: POKENAME cannot generate its own electricity and mostly relies on the poisonous spines beneath its fur to discourage attacks. If it finds a source of electricity such as a power line or transformer, it will plunge its horn in to charge itself up.
decisions.target: POKENAME不能自己发电，主要靠毛下毒刺威慑来敌。找到电线、变压器等电源，就把角扎进去充电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不能自己发电，主要靠毛下毒刺威慑来敌。找到电线、变压器等电源，就把角扎进去充电。

decisions.source: POKENAME rolls around in mud puddles to keep its body coated and moist. If it feels threatened, it shakes its body to shed clumps of mud charged with its own electricity, jolting those the mud splatters against.
decisions.target: POKENAME在泥洼打滚，让身体裹泥保湿。受威胁就抖落带电泥团，溅到谁，谁便会被电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在泥洼打滚，让身体裹泥保湿。受威胁就抖落带电泥团，溅到谁，谁便会被电。

decisions.source: Supposedly, the face within a core of a POKENAME is the true form of this Pokémon and everything else is just a shell. Only the rear star can spin, which creates a force of air that spreads the cold air breathed out from the face within the core.
decisions.target: 据说POKENAME核里的脸才是真身，其余都只是壳。只有后面的星能旋转，鼓起气流，将核中脸吐出的冷气吹散。
decisions.revised: 据说POKENAME核里的脸才是真身，其余都只是壳。只有后面的星能旋转，鼓起气流，将核中脸吐出的冷气吹散。

decisions.source: During a rainstorm, POKENAME will wait in high up places for lighting to strike. While it waits, POKENAME will freeze the raindrops using its icy breath, then unfreeze them using radio waves to practice its temperature altering powers.
decisions.target: 暴雨时，POKENAME在高处等雷击。等待中，用冰息冻雨滴，再以无线电波解冻，练习控温。
decisions.revised: 暴雨时，POKENAME在高处等雷击。等待中，用冰息冻雨滴，再以无线电波解冻，练习控温。

decisions.source: To fascinate and lure its prey, POKENAME blows bubbles that freeze the moment they hit the cold air. Once the target is distracted, it blasts them with a freezing stream of water, using the water it stores inside the ice on its back.
decisions.target: POKENAME吹泡迷住、诱来猎物，泡一碰冷空气就冻住。目标分心，再用背冰里储的水，射出冰冻水流。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吹出泡泡，迷惑并引来猎物，泡泡一碰冷空气，便会冻结。等目标分心，它再用背上冰层里储存的水，喷出冰冷的水流攻击。

decisions.source: Whenever POKENAME are struck by another Pokémon they release a toxic pollen that clings to their assailant. The pollen saps moisture and nutrients away from their assailant until they find an opportunity to launch a counterattack.
decisions.target: 被其他宝可梦击中，POKENAME就放毒花粉，黏住袭击者，吸走水与养分，争取反击机会。
decisions.revised: POKENAME每当被其他宝可梦击中，就会释放毒花粉，黏在袭击者身上。花粉持续抽取对方的水分与养分，直到它找到反击的机会。

decisions.source: POKENAME's lower body is clad in many small feathers densely packed together. It performs a careful dance when it is happy, and with people or Pokémon it trusts, but the friction of its feathers can easily spark fires if near kindling.
decisions.target: POKENAME下身密布小羽。开心或与信任者相处，会仔细跳舞；可羽毛摩擦，靠近引火物就容易起火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的下半身，密密地覆着许多小羽毛。开心时，或与信任的人类、宝可梦相处时，它会小心翼翼地起舞。不过，羽毛摩擦产生的火星，很容易点燃附近的引火物。

decisions.source: POKENAME waves its pom-poms in the air while chasing down prey, making a terrifying scream. It primarily inhabits dark forests, its glowing yellow poms illuminating the darkness as it moves swiftly in pursuit of its target.
decisions.target: POKENAME追猎，边挥绒球边恐怖尖叫。主要住暗林，发光黄球照亮黑暗，快速追逐目标。
decisions.revised: POKENAME追赶猎物时，会在空中挥舞绒球，发出可怕的尖叫。它主要生活在阴暗的森林，黄色的发光绒球照破黑暗，让它迅速追上目标。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is made up of decomposing plant life, so it wraps itself in a plastic bag to aid in holding itself together. Having hope that a person will still see potential in its abilities, it keeps a smile on its face.
decisions.target: POKENAME由腐烂植物构成，便裹塑料袋，帮助身体不散。仍盼有人看见本领的潜力，所以总带着笑。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体由腐烂的植物构成，便裹上塑料袋，帮助身体维持完整。它仍希望有人能看见自己的潜力，因此脸上总带着微笑。

decisions.source: POKENAME are a nightmare for plumbers throughout the world because they often get stuck in drainage pipes. Not only do plumbers have to drain clogged water but they may also have to face against POKENAME's powerful stings.
decisions.target: POKENAME常卡排水管，是各地水管工的噩梦。不仅要排堵水，还可能面对它强力刺击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常卡在排水管中，是世界各地水管工的噩梦。他们不仅得排出堵住的积水，还可能要面对POKENAME强有力的刺击。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a formidable predator that hunts along the shores in the company of its pack. It uses its powerful jaws to deliver lethal blows, often finishing off its prey with ease. The largest specimen is recognized as the leader of the group.
decisions.target: POKENAME是强悍猎手，与群体沿岸捕猎。强颚打出致命重击，常轻松解决猎物，最大的被认作首领。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是强悍的捕食者，会与族群一同沿岸捕猎。它用强大的双颚发出致命一击，往往轻松就能解决猎物。体型最大的一只，被公认为首领。

decisions.source: Despite their size, POKENAME can swim through thick mud as easily as they can swim in water. Their head fins are a common sight within marshes and swamps as they encircle their targets and prepare to pounce.
decisions.target: POKENAME体形虽大，浓泥里也能像水中般轻游。沼泽中常见头鳍围绕目标，准备扑击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然体型庞大，却能在浓稠的泥浆中，像在水里一样轻松游动。沼泽湿地中，常能见到它们的头鳍，正围住目标，准备扑击。

decisions.source: Though they can ride upon gentle winds, POKENAME are deathly afraid of strong winds, as those will scatter most of their leaves. Their leaves wilt in minutes when detached, yet they have great medicinal properties as well.
decisions.target: POKENAME能乘微风，却极怕强风，叶会被吹散大半。叶一离身，几分钟便枯，药用却很好。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然能乘微风而行，却极其害怕强风，因为大半叶片都会被吹散。叶子离身几分钟后便会枯萎，却仍有极佳的药用价值。

decisions.source: POKENAME resides high up in the sky, patrolling over its chosen forest domain. Causing harm to its territory will make it descend from above and blast the perpetrator with a cursed energy beam fired from its mouth.
decisions.target: POKENAME住高空，巡视选定森林。谁伤领地，就从上降下，嘴射诅咒能量束，轰击肇事者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME栖居在高空，巡视自己选定的森林领地。谁若伤害领地，它便从天而降，从口中射出带诅咒的能量束，轰击肇事者。

decisions.source: If POKENAME is spotted by a predator, it will run into the bushes. Once in the bushes, it will thrash around wildly, attempting to scare the predator off with the illusion of its more powerful evolved forms.
decisions.target: POKENAME被天敌发现，就跑进灌丛，疯狂翻动，以更强进化形态的幻象，试着吓退对方。
decisions.revised: POKENAME被天敌发现，就跑进灌丛，疯狂翻动，以更强进化形态的幻象，试着吓退对方。

decisions.source: POKENAME's strong hearing as well as its ability to faintly sense another's aura gives it excellent tracking abilities. Once it has targeted a foe, it will relentlessly pursue them until it bests them in battle.
decisions.target: POKENAME听觉强，又能隐约感知别人的波导，追踪极佳。锁定敌人，就不断追，直到战胜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME听觉敏锐，还能隐约感知他者的波导，因此极善追踪。一旦锁定敌人，就会锲而不舍地追赶，直到在战斗中将其击败。

decisions.source: Although it is a fire-type Pokémon, POKENAME is adapted to living at the bottom of the sea. It has no eyes and orients itself to its prey by its heat sense, attacking the prey by shooting small fireballs of ghost fire through the bars of its mouth.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽是火属性，却适应海底生活。它没有眼睛，用热感知定位猎物，再从口中栅栏间，射出小团幽火袭击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽是火属性，却适应海底生活。它没有眼睛，用热感知定位猎物，再从口中栅栏间，射出小团幽火袭击。

decisions.source: POKENAME sings in such a quiet whisper due to its sensitive ears that its melodies can only be heard when listening right in front of its mouth. To those who can hear it, its songs bring up feelings of homesickness and being faraway.
decisions.target: POKENAME耳朵敏感，唱得低如耳语，只有正对嘴边才能听见。听者会思念家乡，仿佛身在遥远之地。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的耳朵十分敏感，因此歌声轻如耳语，只有贴近嘴巴正前方，才能听见旋律。听到歌声的人，会涌起身在远方、思念故乡的情绪。

decisions.source: POKENAME fur is coated in a fine dust that has paralytic effects when breathed in. They flutter their wings to unleash this dust at their foes and can electrically charge it to make a dazzling light display.
decisions.target: POKENAME毛上细粉，吸入能麻痹。它振翅向敌人释放，也能给粉尘充电，造出灿烂光景。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的毛发覆着细粉，吸入后会产生麻痹效果。它们振翅，将粉尘撒向敌人，还能给粉尘充电，呈现出绚丽夺目的光景。

decisions.source: POKENAME travels alongside flocks of Mareep in the wild. It generates little electricity on its own, so it rubs against other members of the group to absorb some of their energy and store it within its wool.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME伴着咩利羊群旅行。自身发电很少，就蹭同伴，吸取部分能量，存进羊毛。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME伴着咩利羊群旅行。自身发电很少，就蹭同伴，吸取部分能量，存进羊毛。

decisions.source: POKENAME produce a sticky silk that they use to make nests and protect their eggs. The stickiness of the egg comes from the mild electrical charge it carries, the static attaching it to anything that gets close.
decisions.target: POKENAME产生黏丝，筑巢、护蛋。蛋的黏性，来自微弱电荷，静电会让它，黏住靠近的一切。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吐出黏丝，用来筑巢，保护自己的蛋。蛋的黏性，来自本身携带的微弱电荷；静电会让蛋，黏到靠近的任何东西上。

decisions.source: POKENAME stores any built-up electricity inside the shell on its back and channels the electricity through the twin cannons connected to its shell. A POKENAME's cannons can overheat if they are used too frequently without breaks.
decisions.target: POKENAME将电储在背壳里，再导向连接壳的双炮。若频繁使用、不停歇，炮便可能过热。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将电储在背壳里，再导向连接壳的双炮。若频繁使用、不停歇，炮便可能过热。

decisions.source: It runs across the land at high speeds during the day, keeping its heads in the sunlight for as long as possible. Only when the sun is hidden does it finally stop moving and rest, until it detects the next ray of sunshine.
decisions.target: 白天高速奔跑，尽可能让几个头晒着太阳。只有阳光消失，才会停下休息，等待下一缕阳光。
decisions.revised: 白天高速奔跑，尽可能让几个头晒着太阳。只有阳光消失，才会停下休息，等待下一缕阳光。

decisions.source: While it can roll across the ground, POKENAME will move much faster if it gets onto a set of railway tracks. This is incredibly dangerous to regular trains, as POKENAME will ignore signals and collide with anything that doesn't get out of its way.
decisions.target: POKENAME能滚过地面，可一上铁路，就快得多。它不理信号，挡路什么都撞，让正常列车面临极大危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然能在地面滚动，可一上铁轨，速度就会大幅提升。它无视信号，凡是不让路的东西都会撞上去，令正常行驶的列车十分危险。

decisions.source: POKENAME's mood is tied directly to its exposure to sunlight. It is calm and serene while under the sun's rays, but the moment it has no source of light and warmth, it stomps around in a tantrum, roaring at anything that approaches.
decisions.target: POKENAME心情直接受日照影响。阳光下平静安宁，可一失去光与暖，就闹着踩踏，向所有靠近者怒吼。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的心情，与日照直接相连。沐浴阳光时，它平静安宁；一失去光与热的来源，便会暴躁跺脚，向一切靠近的对象怒吼。

decisions.source: POKENAME are sometimes filled with manic bursts of energy, racing through the air to chase after other Pokémon. They have poor visibility due to their shell and are prone to accidentally crashing into the Pokémon they're playing with at high speed.
decisions.target: POKENAME有时突然活力爆发，飞着追逐其他宝可梦。壳挡视线，让它常高速撞上正在一起玩的对象。
decisions.revised: POKENAME有时突然活力爆发，飞着追逐其他宝可梦。壳挡视线，让它常高速撞上正在一起玩的对象。

decisions.source: The tips of POKENAME's fingers allow them to touch their own silk without it getting stuck to them, which allows them to weave their strands into many different shapes. They often love to create portraits of others made purely of their own silk.
decisions.target: POKENAME的指尖碰自己的丝不会黏住，因此能编织各种形状。它常爱全用自己的丝，为别人织肖像。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的指尖触碰自己的丝，不会被黏住，因此能将丝织成各种形状。它们常喜欢完全用自己的丝，为别人编织肖像。

decisions.source: POKENAME have lures on the back of their head that draw curious Pokémon to investigate. They are difficult for other Pokémon to keep up with, especially when they are capable of swimming up to 60 miles an hour, or nearly 100 kilometers an hour.
decisions.target: POKENAME后脑的诱饵，引好奇宝可梦前来察看。它游泳时速可达60英里、近100千米，其他宝可梦很难跟上。
decisions.revised: POKENAME后脑的诱饵，引好奇宝可梦前来察看。它游泳时速可达60英里、近100千米，其他宝可梦很难跟上。

decisions.source: POKENAME has a penchant for sniffing out tasty mushrooms to eat. It will often begin cultivating its own garden of fungi over time, and some have attempted to decipher if there is meaning behind the odd patterns in which it tends to grow them.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱嗅找美味蘑菇。久而久之，常种起自己的菌园，有人试着解读奇怪种植图案是否有含义。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢嗅寻美味的蘑菇来吃。久而久之，它常会栽种自己的菌菇园。有人试着解读，它种下的奇怪图案，究竟是否含有什么意义。

decisions.source: POKENAME produce green, rock-hard fruits from the hole in their chest after they've eaten their fill for an entire week. They use their left tendrils to throw these fruits at threats, or break them with their right hands for other Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME整整一周吃足，胸洞就产硬如岩石的绿果。左卷须用来投敌，右手则砸开，分给其他宝可梦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME整整一周吃得饱足后，胸口的洞便会结出坚硬如石的绿色果实。它们用左侧卷须，将果实投向威胁，或用右手砸开，分给其他宝可梦。

decisions.source: POKENAME enjoy hiding in lumberyards, burying themselves up to their neck in piles of logs. They leap out in an effort to surprise those who pass by, seemingly unaware that their giant grins make them easy to pick out amongst the piled-up wood.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱藏木场，把自己埋进原木堆到脖子，再跳出吓人。似乎不懂大笑脸早让它很容易被找出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢藏在木材场，将自己埋进原木堆，只露出脖子以上，再跳出来，试着吓路人一跳。它们似乎没发觉，巨大的笑脸，早已让自己在木堆中格外显眼。

decisions.source: POKENAME does not seem to mind how warm or cold it is and will go outside to sing and dance whenever it is sunny. When combined with the fragrance of POKENAME's flowers, these performances appear to compel other Pokémon to approach and watch.
decisions.target: POKENAME似乎不怕冷热，只要晴天就外出歌舞。配上花香，表演仿佛让其他宝可梦忍不住靠近观看。
decisions.revised: POKENAME似乎不怕冷热，只要晴天就外出歌舞。配上花香，表演仿佛让其他宝可梦忍不住靠近观看。

decisions.source: When POKENAME folds back its wings, it suddenly becomes extremely slow in flight when it expects to become faster. This is due to it becoming very twitchy and off-balance when it tucks its wings in, also causing it to take more air resistance.
decisions.target: POKENAME收翼本想飞快些，却突然变得极慢。因为收翼会使它剧烈抽动、失衡，还承受更多空气阻力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME收翼本想飞快些，却突然变得极慢。因为收翼会使它剧烈抽动、失衡，还承受更多空气阻力。

decisions.source: POKENAME is confident, yet polite, and enjoys sparring with those of stronger than itself. This Pokémon uses its beak and the talons on its wings to attack. In a pinch, POKENAME can remove the feather on its head and throw it like a dagger.
decisions.target: POKENAME自信有礼，爱与比自己强的对象切磋。以喙与翼爪进攻，危急时还能拔下头羽，当匕首掷出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME自信有礼，爱与比自己强的对象切磋。以喙与翼爪进攻，危急时还能拔下头羽，当匕首掷出。

decisions.source: POKENAME's carapace and shell are quite heavy, making it rather sluggish in movement. To compensate, it can extend beams of energy from the pincers on its head to give it a great deal more reach for snagging prey than first glance would suggest.
decisions.target: POKENAME甲壳很重，行动迟缓。作为弥补，它能从头钳伸出能量束，远远攫住猎物，范围比乍看大得多。
decisions.revised: POKENAME甲壳很重，行动迟缓。作为弥补，它能从头钳伸出能量束，远远攫住猎物，范围比乍看大得多。

decisions.source: POKENAME prefers to live in frigid areas in solitude, and in the absence of such will create one. With a wave of its arm, it can freeze a mile of its surroundings and all who dwell in the area to make its new home.
decisions.target: POKENAME偏爱在冰冷地区独居，若没有就自造。一挥臂，周围一英里与所有居民便能冻结，成为新家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME喜欢在寒冷地区独居，找不到这样的地方，就自行创造。它一挥手臂，便能冻结周围一英里内的环境，以及其中所有生灵，作为新家。

decisions.source: The flame at the tip of their tail has grown hotter upon evolving, though the light it provides has stayed the same. Their claws have developed to be strong enough to dig through rock due to them so often accompanying Trainers through tunnels.
decisions.target: 进化后，它们尾火更热，亮度却不变。由于常陪训练家穿隧道，爪也练得足够强，能钻过岩石。
decisions.revised: 进化后，它们尾火更热，亮度却不变。由于常陪训练家穿隧道，爪也练得足够强，能钻过岩石。

decisions.source: POKENAME's ribbons can cut through the air to summon portals across space. It is said that it will toss those who don't show positivity near it into these portals, banishing them elsewhere so it does not have to deal with their negativity.
decisions.target: POKENAME缎带能切开空气，召空间门。据说附近谁不显积极，就会被抛去别处，免得再应付负面情绪。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能用缎带划开空气，召出跨越空间的传送门。据说，身边若有人不表现得积极乐观，它就会将其丢进门，放逐到别处，免得面对对方的负面情绪。

decisions.source: POKENAME are found often in deep waters, though they are easily drawn to polluted waters as well. They primarily feed on waste, resulting in them being clad in pieces of waste and having toxic scales. They are violent enough to attack ships for food.
decisions.target: POKENAME常在深水，也易受污水吸引。主要吃废物，因此满身垃圾碎片，鳞也有毒；凶得能为食物袭船。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常出没于深水，也很容易被污染的水域吸引。它主要以废物为食，因此身披垃圾碎片，鳞片也有毒。性情凶暴到会为觅食而攻击船只。

decisions.source: POKENAME allows any Pokémon that lives in the forest to make its home inside of its gigantic mouth. To any forest threat, this mouth instead becomes their downfall and their soul is taken. The soul is then used as fertilizer for its forest.
decisions.target: POKENAME允许任何林中宝可梦，在巨嘴里安家。可威胁森林者，嘴就是末日：灵魂被取走，当森林肥料。
decisions.revised: POKENAME允许森林里任何宝可梦，在自己的巨嘴中安家。不过，对威胁森林的家伙，这张嘴却意味着覆灭：灵魂会被夺走，化作森林的肥料。

decisions.source: POKENAME can focus its ultrasonic waves into blades of sound that cause ear-piercing pain to anyone struck by them. It repeatedly bashes foes with the sharp ends of its wings and scales so that they never try to challenge it for resources again.
decisions.target: POKENAME将超声聚成声刃，令命中者耳痛欲裂。翼尖与锐鳞反复痛打敌人，让它们不敢再来争资源。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能将超声波凝聚成声刃，让被击中者感到刺耳的剧痛。它反复用翼与鳞片的锋锐末端，痛击敌人，使对方再也不敢争夺资源。

decisions.source: The tochukaso mushrooms that grow from POKENAME's body grow to enormous sizes because of the Fairy-type energy that is so abundant in this species. You can tell if a POKENAME has passed through your house because of the mold spots it leaves behind.
decisions.target: POKENAME充满妖精属性能量，让身上的冬虫夏草长得巨大。若曾经过家里，便能从留下的霉斑辨出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME充满妖精属性能量，让身上的冬虫夏草长得巨大。若曾经过家里，便能从留下的霉斑辨出。

decisions.source: A relentless undersea hunter, POKENAME is extremely difficult for sea creatures to escape. It can shift the currents with a swing of its claws, and said claws easily tear through sand and stone to tear up any dens that prey thinks to hide within.
decisions.target: POKENAME是穷追不舍的海中猎手。挥爪能改洋流，利爪也轻易撕开沙石，把猎物想藏的洞一并掀毁。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是穷追不舍的海中猎手，海洋生灵极难逃脱。它挥爪便能改变水流，利爪还能轻易撕开沙石，摧毁猎物打算藏身的洞穴。

decisions.source: POKENAME's face and fists are both covered by a thick layer of bone. It can deliver punches with devastating force, and any foe that tries to strike it in the head is likely to do more damage to its own fist than to POKENAME.
decisions.target: POKENAME脸和双拳都覆着厚骨，拳力惊人。敌人若打它的头，多半自己的拳受伤更重，POKENAME反而没那么痛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脸和双拳都覆着厚骨，拳力惊人。敌人若打它的头，多半自己的拳受伤更重，POKENAME反而没那么痛。

decisions.source: POKENAME generate a powerful static charge that they use to hover above the land and travel using the winds. Several Trainers have been electrocuted after making contact with a POKENAME that was blown off-course by a sudden gust.
decisions.target: POKENAME靠强静电悬浮，随风旅行。曾有数名训练家碰到被阵风吹偏的个体，遭到电击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME靠强静电悬浮，随风旅行。曾有数名训练家碰到被阵风吹偏的个体，遭到电击。

decisions.source: The sweet and mellow flavor of POKENAME's nectar is not only incredibly tasty, but it also seems to have a calming effect on those who drink it. Even a furious Primeape will relax after a single sip.
decisions.target: POKENAME的花蜜甘甜醇厚，美味又似乎能安抚心绪。连暴怒的火暴猴喝一口，也会放松。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的花蜜甘甜醇厚，美味又似乎能安抚心绪。连暴怒的火暴猴喝一口，也会放松。

decisions.source: POKENAME makes its burrows amongst tree roots, using the extra structure of the roots to reinforce its underground home. At night, they often come to the mouth of their burrows and sing out to one another to communicate.
decisions.target: POKENAME在树根间打洞，借根系加固地下的家。夜里，它们常来到洞口，以歌声彼此交流。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在树根间打洞，借根系加固地下的家。夜里，它们常来到洞口，以歌声彼此交流。

decisions.source: POKENAME are covered in a protective shell that easily conducts electricity and will discharge it into anyone who attempts to hold or touch them. They use their long tails to hang from trees while waiting for their evolution.
decisions.target: POKENAME覆有易导电的保护壳，谁想抱或碰，就会被电。它们用长尾挂在树上，等待进化。
decisions.revised: POKENAME覆有易导电的保护壳，谁想抱或碰，就会被电。它们用长尾挂在树上，等待进化。

decisions.source: POKENAME is believed to have the power to change the weather by waving the orbs on its forelimbs in the air. Drizzle always seems to fall on forests in which they live, preventing POKENAME's skin from drying out.
decisions.target: 人们认为，POKENAME挥动前肢珠体，就能改天气。栖居的森林，似乎总下细雨，让皮肤不干。
decisions.revised: 人们相信，POKENAME在空中挥动前肢的珠体，便能改变天气。它们栖居的森林，似乎总有细雨飘落，使皮肤免于干燥。

decisions.source: As POKENAME speed through the skies, their pink-tinted feathers often fall off due to the blistering speeds. Before anyone can collect these feathers, they're contained in small bubbles and brought back to POKENAME once they've perched.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞得太快，粉羽常会脱落。还没被人捡走，就先被小泡收起，等它栖下，再送回来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在空中疾驰时，速度过快，常会掉落粉色的羽毛。还不等人捡起，羽毛就被小泡泡收好，待它停栖下来，再送回身边。

decisions.source: POKENAME constantly have a grumpy expression, though are often seen playing with Poliwhirl. Due to their small arms, they use their bubbles as fists, putting the force of a punch into one and blowing it towards the opponent.
decisions.target: POKENAME总一脸不高兴，却常与蚊香君玩。小臂不便，它便把泡当拳，注入拳力，吹向对手。
decisions.revised: POKENAME总是一脸不高兴，却常被看见与蚊香君玩耍。它们的手臂短小，便用泡泡充当拳头，将拳击的力量注入其中，吹向对手。

decisions.source: POKENAME channels fire from within its body to be fired off from its cannon. As it burns hotter and harder, the cannon alone cannot contain its fire and flames begin to erupt from other parts of POKENAME's body.
decisions.target: POKENAME把体内火，导向炮口。烧得越热、越猛，一炮便装不下，其他身体部位，也开始喷火。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将体内的火焰引导到炮中，发射出去。燃烧得越热、越猛烈，光靠炮便无法容纳，火焰开始从身体其他部位喷涌而出。

decisions.source: POKENAME needs to be regularly sheared so that its wool does not grow excessively. If allowed to grow out, the wool will surge with excessive electricity and create ribbon-like whips of lightning that can injure those nearby.
decisions.target: POKENAME需常剪毛，避免过长。放任生长，毛中电力过盛，形成缎带状电鞭，伤到附近生物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME必须定期剪毛，以免羊毛长得过盛。若任其生长，毛中便会涌出过量电力，形成缎带般的雷电长鞭，伤及附近的生灵。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a love for shiny objects, obsessively hunting out coins and polished gemstones. When they find something to their liking their tail lights up like a beacon, drawing other POKENAME to come and see what they've found.
decisions.target: POKENAME痴迷闪物，四处寻硬币与抛光宝石。找到喜欢的，尾灯像信标亮起，招同类来看。
decisions.revised: POKENAME酷爱闪亮的东西，痴迷地寻找硬币和抛光的宝石。找到心仪之物时，尾巴便亮得像信标，招来其他POKENAME，一同看看发现了什么。

decisions.source: If POKENAME is threatened, it will curl up its limbs and pretend to be a patch of colorful mushrooms. Even if this isn't convincing, the rocky puffballs on its back are hard enough to resist most attackers.
decisions.target: POKENAME遇险，就蜷肢装彩蘑菇丛。就算骗不过，背上石质绒球也够硬，能抵御多数敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME遇到威胁，就会蜷起四肢，假装成一丛五彩蘑菇。即使骗不过对方，背上石质的马勃菌，也足够坚硬，能抵御大多数袭击者。

decisions.source: POKENAME's long leaves catch the wind, and on days with a gentle breeze, POKENAME will use them to float during graceful leaps as it dances. On windy days, POKENAME will shelter inside to prevent it from being blown away.
decisions.target: POKENAME用长叶兜风，在微风天轻盈跃起，飘浮着跳舞。风大时会躲进室内，以免被吹走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用长叶兜风，在微风天轻盈跃起，飘浮着跳舞。风大时会躲进室内，以免被吹走。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends its time meditating in undersea caves during the day, but will emerge at night. During nights with a full moon, however, it will come ashore to bask in the moonlight, which seems to increase its power.
decisions.target: POKENAME白天在海底洞穴冥想，夜里出来。满月之夜则会上岸晒月亮，似乎能增强力量。
decisions.revised: POKENAME白天在海底洞穴冥想，夜里出来。满月之夜则会上岸晒月亮，似乎能增强力量。

decisions.source: POKENAME have rough, coarse fur that helps to protect them from the worst impacts of status effects. Their tails have no fur at all and can be moved rapidly, letting POKENAME use it as a whip to attack with.
decisions.target: POKENAME毛粗硬，帮助抵御异常状态最严重的影响。尾巴全无毛，动作迅速，能当鞭攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME粗硬的毛发，能帮助它抵御异常状态最严重的影响。尾巴上没有一点毛，却能迅速挥动，当作鞭子攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its ribbons to brush against others to drain bits of joy from them. The absorbed emotions serve as energy for it to use to cast hexes on others, as it delights in causing misfortune and distress.
decisions.target: POKENAME用丝带轻蹭其他生命，吸走一点喜悦，转成施咒能量。它乐于制造不幸和困扰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用丝带轻蹭其他生命，吸走一点喜悦，转成施咒能量。它乐于制造不幸和困扰。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is rather sensitive, so it rarely pokes its heads up very far above ground. Their craniums are protected by a sturdy shell, and they can fire sharp stone projectiles from the growths on their necks.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体敏感，头很少探出地面太远。脑壳有坚壳保护，颈上突起能射出锐利石弹。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体相当敏感，很少将头探出地面太高。头颅由坚固的外壳保护，颈部的突起，还能发射锋利的石弹。

decisions.source: A large amount of liquid magma is stored within the shell on POKENAME's back. These stores connect directly to its hands, allowing it to spray magma from its arms to fend off any dangers that it faces.
decisions.target: POKENAME背壳中储存大量液态岩浆，与双手直接相通，能从手臂喷出，抵御面前的危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME背壳中储存大量液态岩浆，与双手直接相通，能从手臂喷出，抵御面前的危险。

decisions.source: POKENAME seems to be competitive by nature, opting to fight over fleeing. However, if this Pokémon knows it cannot win in a fight, POKENAME will deal as much damage as it can before finding a chance to retreat.
decisions.target: POKENAME似乎天性好胜，宁战不逃。但若知道赢不了，也会尽量重创敌人，再找机会撤退。
decisions.revised: POKENAME似乎天性好胜，宁战不逃。但若知道赢不了，也会尽量重创敌人，再找机会撤退。

decisions.source: When its fighting spirit flares to its max in battle, POKENAME's metallic body glows from the sheer heat it's producing inside. Once the battle's over, steam rises from its joints as the body cools down.
decisions.target: POKENAME战斗中斗志最旺时，内部高热会让金属身体发亮。战后冷却，关节便冒出蒸汽。
decisions.revised: POKENAME战斗中斗志最旺时，内部高热会让金属身体发亮。战后冷却，关节便冒出蒸汽。

decisions.source: POKENAME waits patiently at the base of trees, then punches the trunk as soon as the fruit above is ripe. This attack leaves a fist-shaped scorch mark on the bark and makes all the fruit immediately drop.
decisions.target: POKENAME耐心守在树下，果实一熟就出拳击干。树皮留下拳形焦痕，所有果实立刻落下。
decisions.revised: POKENAME耐心等在树下，树上的果实一成熟，就立刻挥拳打向树干。这一拳会在树皮留下拳形的焦痕，使所有果实立即掉落。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their sharp incisors to bite through the bark of a tree's trunk and feed on the sap within. They prefer to feed on toxic species, incorporating the poisons into their own bodies to deter predators.
decisions.target: POKENAME以锋利门牙咬穿树皮，吃内部树液。偏爱有毒树种，将毒纳入身体，吓退捕食者。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用锋利的门牙咬穿树干的外皮，吸食其中的树汁。它们偏爱有毒树种，将毒素融入自身，借此吓退捕食者。

decisions.source: Despite its adorable appearance, it is a mischievous Pokémon that plays terrifying pranks to frighten humans. The more fear it manages to absorb into its red pearls, the more potent the venom inside its body becomes.
decisions.target: 它虽可爱，却爱玩恐怖恶作剧，吓唬人类。红珠吸到的恐惧越多，体内毒便越强。
decisions.revised: 它虽可爱，却爱玩恐怖恶作剧，吓唬人类。红珠吸到的恐惧越多，体内毒便越强。

decisions.source: POKENAME spends much of its time playing in the mud, using camouflage to hide itself away from potential dangers. This ability is slightly hampered by the mud still sticking to its body and sometimes giving away its position.
decisions.target: POKENAME大多玩泥，用伪装躲潜在危险。可身上仍黏着的泥，会稍微妨碍，有时暴露位置。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大多时候都在玩泥巴，借伪装藏好自己，避开潜在危险。不过，黏在身上的泥巴，稍稍妨碍了这种能力，有时还会暴露位置。

decisions.source: POKENAME has four sharp steel blades on its head. Although these blades are short, POKENAME can use its spiked metal feet to pin foes in place, then lean down to slash by spinning its head around at high speed.
decisions.target: POKENAME头有四把锐钢刃，虽短，却能先用带刺金属脚定敌，再低头高速旋转，进行劈斩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME头上有四把锋利的钢刃，虽然短小，却能先用带刺的金属脚，将敌人钉在原地，再俯下身，高速旋转头部，发起劈斩。

decisions.source: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME can manifest two extra hands to grapple its opponent. If the opponent is held by these hands for too long, they will begin to feel tired as their life is being sapped away.
decisions.target: POKENAME用超能力显出两只额外的手，擒住对手。被握太久，生命力便被抽走，开始疲惫。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能用超能力，凝聚出额外的两只手，擒住对手。被这些手抓得太久，生命力便会逐渐流失，开始感到疲倦。

decisions.source: POKENAME live in areas with rich soil, clean water, and strong trees. The vibrancy of their tails is a sign of how healthy they are; a rich, bright, and verdant green indicates when a POKENAME is in perfect health.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在沃土、净水与壮树之地。尾色鲜艳程度反映健康，浓亮翠绿，说明状态完好。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在土壤肥沃、水源洁净、树木强健的地区。尾巴的色泽，反映身体是否健康；浓艳明亮的翠绿色，意味着它状态完好。

decisions.source: POKENAME sharpens its beak with its blade between battles. This way, even if a skilled foe were able to disarm the sword it wields, it would never be caught without a sharp weapon to deal with its opponent.
decisions.target: POKENAME在战斗间隙用刀磨喙。这样，即使剑被高手缴走，也始终有锋利武器应对敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在战斗间隙用刀磨喙。这样，即使剑被高手缴走，也始终有锋利武器应对敌人。

decisions.source: It is said that the magma flowing through POKENAME's body would burn hotter than the sun if not for the ice on its body cooling it constantly. No one is quite sure how the ice never melts.
decisions.target: 据说若非体上冰不断冷却，POKENAME内部岩浆能热过太阳。但没人确定，冰为何从不融。
decisions.revised: 据说，若非身上的冰不断冷却，POKENAME体内流动的岩浆，会比太阳还炽热。不过，谁也说不清，冰为何始终不会融化。

decisions.source: In winter, POKENAME's white back enables it to blend in with snow-covered landscapes. On nights with a new moon it will emerge, and disturb the sleep of any Pokémon or people it walks near to.
decisions.target: 冬季，POKENAME白色背部能融入雪景。新月之夜现身，走近的人或宝可梦，睡眠都会受扰。
decisions.revised: 冬季，POKENAME白色的背部，让它融入白雪覆盖的风景。新月之夜，它会现身，扰乱沿途附近宝可梦和人类的睡眠。

decisions.source: The fluff on POKENAME's ears is sticky and difficult to clean off once stuck to clothing. It can generate small flames at the tips of its ears to ward off attackers, but only for a short time.
decisions.target: POKENAME耳上的绒毛很黏，一沾衣服就难清掉。耳尖能生出小火驱敌，但维持不了多久。
decisions.revised: POKENAME耳上的绒毛很黏，一沾衣服就难清掉。耳尖能生出小火驱敌，但维持不了多久。

decisions.source: POKENAME hang from tree branches, leeching off of some of the tree's nutrients. Once they are full, they will fall to the ground and release all of their spores, which can be a hazard to passing Trainers.
decisions.target: POKENAME吊在枝上，分食树的养分。吃饱便落地，撒尽孢子，对路过的训练家可能很危险。
decisions.revised: POKENAME悬挂在树枝上，吸取树木的部分养分。吃饱以后，它们便落到地面，释放全部孢子，可能危及路过的训练家。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses the mask it carries with its tail as a paddle to swim faster in the water. The spirals on its stomach will change direction based on whether the eyes on the mask are open or closed.
decisions.target: POKENAME用尾巴持着的面具当桨，游得更快。腹部螺旋转向，取决于面具的眼是睁是闭。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用尾巴拿着的面具当桨，让自己游得更快。面具上的眼睛睁开或闭上时，腹部螺旋的方向，也会随之改变。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a fierce protector of its land and the Pokémon in it, brutally mauling any trespassers. However, due to its short and stubby legs, it often ends up falling over and struggles to get back up.
decisions.target: POKENAME凶猛保护土地及其中宝可梦，残忍撕咬闯入者。可腿短粗，常跌倒，还很难起身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME凶猛保护土地及其中宝可梦，残忍撕咬闯入者。可腿短粗，常跌倒，还很难起身。

decisions.source: Touching a POKENAME is unwise, as the sugary foods they eat from garbage make them sticky and create a sweet malodor that becomes hard to wash off, often inducing sickness and appetite loss that can last for days.
decisions.target: 碰POKENAME很不明智。垃圾甜食令它黏糊，甜臭难洗，还常令人恶心、没胃口，好几天不退。
decisions.revised: 最好别碰POKENAME。它吃下垃圾中的甜食，身体变得黏糊，还带着难以洗掉的甜腻臭味，常让人恶心、食欲不振，持续好几天。

decisions.source: POKENAME despise people who litter or throw away perfectly good items. They gather any piece of trash they find and use it to build up their fists, determined to get vengeance on the one that discarded the item.
decisions.target: POKENAME恨乱丢垃圾、扔完好物品的人。捡到什么，都拿来增大拳头，决心向弃物者报仇。
decisions.revised: POKENAME厌恶乱扔垃圾，或丢弃完好物品的人。它们收集找到的每一件垃圾，用来壮大拳头，决心向丢弃者报仇。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its tusks to carve markings into the bark of trees in its home. These markings are indicators of its territory, and POKENAME will turn aggressive if these markers are ignored and trespassers delve further into the forest.
decisions.target: POKENAME用獠牙在住处树皮刻痕，标示领地。闯入者若无视，还往深林走，就会凶猛起来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用獠牙，在住处的树皮上刻下标记，标示自己的领地。闯入者若无视警告，继续深入森林，它便会变得凶猛好斗。

decisions.source: POKENAME stretches its roots through the ground, tapping into nearby trees to feel what they feel. It uses this ability to sense the movement of other Pokémon through the trees, pouncing on anything that gets too close.
decisions.target: POKENAME根伸地下，连附近树，感受其所感。借树察觉其他宝可梦动静，什么太近，就扑去。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将根伸入地下，连上附近的树木，感受它们的所感。它借树木探知其他宝可梦的动静，凡是靠得太近的东西，都会扑过去。

decisions.source: This Pokémon is typically found stalking the depths of the seafloor for prey using its echolocation. However, it has been seen flying out of the sea in order to attack large Pokémon or human ships.
decisions.target: 它通常靠回声定位，在深海底潜猎。也曾飞出海面，攻击大宝可梦与人类船只。
decisions.revised: 它通常靠回声定位，在深海底潜猎。也曾飞出海面，攻击大宝可梦与人类船只。

decisions.source: Its fur can store a tremendous amount of static electricity, as well as concealing the sharp thorns that cover its head and back. It curls up into a ball when it sleeps, keeping its soft belly protected.
decisions.target: 毛皮既能储存庞大静电，也藏住头、背上的利刺。睡觉时蜷成球，护住柔软腹部。
decisions.revised: 毛皮既能储存庞大静电，也藏住头、背上的利刺。睡觉时蜷成球，护住柔软腹部。

decisions.source: POKENAME attempts to teach itself discipline and fight more tactically in combat. To that end, it covers its mouth with its long tongue, to help prevent itself from falling to its instincts and resorting to simply biting opponents.
decisions.target: POKENAME努力自学纪律，让战斗更讲策略。它用长舌盖住嘴，免得屈从本能，只会咬对手。
decisions.revised: POKENAME努力培养自制力，让战斗更讲策略。为此，它用长舌盖住嘴巴，帮助自己克制本能，免得又只顾着咬对手。

decisions.source: POKENAME thrives in the open ocean where it can burst out of the water to snag bird Pokémon as a meal. When it leaps over boats, people recoil in fear of its appearance, but it is only a danger if the Carvanha hitching a ride falls off onto the deck.
decisions.target: POKENAME在远海生活，能跃出水捕鸟宝可梦。跳过船，人常被外表吓退，可真正危险的，是搭便车的利牙鱼掉上甲板。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在开阔海域生活得很好，能跃出水面，捕捉鸟类宝可梦。它跃过船只时，外貌常吓得人退缩；不过，只有搭便车的利牙鱼掉上甲板，才会真的带来危险。

decisions.source: If POKENAME gets angry enough, it will expel poisonous gas. Most of the time, in battles, it will try to fill the air with a gas similar to the one used in metal inert gas welding, so its electric attacks become more accurate and powerful.
decisions.target: POKENAME怒极会喷毒气。平时作战，则常放出类似惰性气体保护焊所用的气体，让电击变得更准、更强。
decisions.revised: POKENAME怒极会喷毒气。平时作战，则常放出类似惰性气体保护焊所用的气体，让电击变得更准、更强。

decisions.source: Thanks to its developed psychic powers, it is able to use its staff as a flying broomstick, carrying POKENAME wherever it wishes to go. It is an infinitely kind and gentle creature that does everything in its power to aid anyone it sees in need.
decisions.target: POKENAME精神力发达，能用杖当飞天扫帚，去任何想去的地方。它极其善良温柔，见谁需要，都竭力帮助。
decisions.revised: POKENAME超能力发达，能把杖当作飞天扫帚，载着自己前往任何想去的地方。它极其善良温柔，看见谁需要帮助，都会竭尽所能。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their wings to row through the water, filling their shell with bubbles to aid in their buoyancy. They are not very fast swimmers, their shell too bulky to be streamlined, but they can use their cannons to provide a brief burst of speed.
decisions.target: POKENAME用翅膀划水，把壳充满气泡增加浮力。壳太庞大，不够流线，游得不快，却能用炮短暂爆发加速。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用翅膀划水，把壳充满气泡增加浮力。壳太庞大，不够流线，游得不快，却能用炮短暂爆发加速。

decisions.source: POKENAME's blue coloration enables it to hide in clear water but is highly visible on land, so it rarely ventures onto shore. POKENAME is quick to flee from larger and stronger Pokémon, but attacks weaker Pokémon if it can catch them by surprise.
decisions.target: POKENAME蓝色能藏清水，陆上却极显眼，因此少登岸。遇更大更强者立逃，却会趁弱小宝可梦不备攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME蓝色的身体，能藏在清澈的水中，在陆地却十分显眼，因此很少冒险上岸。遇到更大、更强的宝可梦，它会迅速逃走，却会趁弱者不备，发起攻击。

decisions.source: The curled hair on POKENAME's face can extend and grab things up to 2 metres away. The tips are coated in a sticky gel that ensures that anything they touch doesn't get away. POKENAME uses this on their children when they argue with each other.
decisions.target: POKENAME脸上卷毛能伸长，抓2米外的物件。尖端黏胶让碰到的东西逃不掉，孩子互吵时，就会用这本领。
decisions.revised: POKENAME脸上的卷毛能伸长，抓取最远两米处的物件。毛尖覆着黏胶，碰到的东西就逃不掉。孩子们相互争吵时，它便会用这项本领。

decisions.source: As POKENAME scurries around in the dead of night in search of food, it uses its bushy tail to cover its tracks. It is particularly wary of Cacturne, so as soon as it spots one, it blends into the shadows and quickly makes its escape.
decisions.target: POKENAME深夜奔走觅食，用蓬松尾巴盖住脚印。它格外警惕梦歌仙人掌，一见到就融入阴影，迅速逃走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME深夜奔走觅食，用蓬松尾巴盖住脚印。它格外警惕梦歌仙人掌，一见到就融入阴影，迅速逃走。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be seen prowling around without a care, even allowing small Pokémon to climb on its body. However, it does not tolerate being attacked or stolen from: in these cases, it will fire drills from its palms and retreats to a dark cavern.
decisions.target: POKENAME无忧游走，甚至让小宝可梦爬上身体。但若被攻击、被偷东西，就从掌心射出钻头，再退入暗洞。
decisions.revised: POKENAME无忧游走，甚至让小宝可梦爬上身体。但若被攻击、被偷东西，就从掌心射出钻头，再退入暗洞。

decisions.source: A POKENAME's diet consists mostly of raw ores and various minerals, which in turn allow for its body to grow ever tougher. They fire Iron Balls from the holes in their hands to finish off their opponents and then eat the Iron Balls afterwards.
decisions.target: POKENAME主食原矿、多种矿物，让身体不断更坚。从手上孔洞射出黑色铁球，解决对手后，再把铁球吃回。
decisions.revised: POKENAME主要吃原矿和各种矿物，使身体日益坚韧。它们从手上的孔洞发射黑色铁球，了结对手，之后再把铁球吃掉。

decisions.source: Not only are its magnet-hands strong enough to be used like hammers, but they allow it to project and control a magnetic force. They will use this magnetism to either repel foes or to drag them in and deliver a steel-hard punch.
decisions.target: 磁铁双手强得能当重锤，也能施放并操控磁力。或斥开敌人，或吸近后打出坚如钢铁的重拳。
decisions.revised: 磁铁双手强得能当重锤，也能施放并操控磁力。或斥开敌人，或吸近后打出坚如钢铁的重拳。

decisions.source: POKENAME's many rows of extremely hard teeth all rotate rapidly, allowing it to tunnel through solid rock. This also allows it to eat anything it can fit in its maw, as heavily armored prey are hardly a struggle to consume with its serrated teeth.
decisions.target: POKENAME多排极硬牙齿全都高速旋转，能钻穿坚岩。巨口容得下的东西都吃，重甲猎物也难不倒锯齿。
decisions.revised: POKENAME多排极其坚硬的牙齿，都会高速旋转，能钻穿坚实的岩石。只要塞得进嘴，它都能吃下；锯齿之下，连重甲猎物也不难吞食。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a very clingy little Pokémon. It grabs onto others in order to nip them and siphon static electricity with its fangs for sustenance, but it immensely enjoys the hugs as well, so prying all four of its arms off can require effort.
decisions.target: POKENAME小巧黏人，攀住别人轻咬，用牙吸静电充饥。可也实在享受拥抱，想掰开四条手臂，常得费些劲。
decisions.revised: POKENAME小巧黏人，攀住别人轻咬，用牙吸静电充饥。可也实在享受拥抱，想掰开四条手臂，常得费些劲。

decisions.source: POKENAME swiftly attacks its prey, blowing its icy breath to fan the sub-zero flame-like mist on its tail, instantly engulfing its target. Once the victim is frozen solid, it quietly drags them back to its lair to then shatter them with its claws.
decisions.target: POKENAME迅速袭猎，吐冰息，扇起尾上零下的火焰状雾，瞬间吞没目标。冻透后，静静拖回巢，再用爪敲碎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME迅速袭向猎物，吐出冰息，鼓动尾巴上零度以下、火焰般的雾气，瞬间将目标吞没。猎物冻得结实后，它便悄悄拖回巢穴，再用爪子敲碎。

decisions.source: A slimy substance is pumped around inside POKENAME's metal armor and can be fired out of the cannon on its back as sticky goo. Different Drives may be slotted in to energize this substance with electricity, or make it scorching hot or freezing cold.
decisions.target: POKENAME金属铠甲内循环着黏稠物，可由背炮射出。插入不同卡带，还能让物质带电，或变得灼热、冰寒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME金属铠甲内循环着黏稠物，可由背炮射出。插入不同卡带，还能让物质带电，或变得灼热、冰寒。

decisions.source: To use the water stored inside its tail, POKENAME must stand on top of it, using its own weight to squeeze the liquid out. Because the tail is so bouncy and slippery, the Pokémon is perpetually terrified of losing its footing and tumbling off.
decisions.target: 要用尾巴里储的水，POKENAME必须站上去，借体重挤出。可尾巴又弹又滑，让它始终害怕失足，翻滚摔下。
decisions.revised: 要使用尾巴中储存的水，POKENAME必须站到尾巴上，用自己的体重将水挤出。可尾巴又弹又滑，使它总害怕脚下不稳，翻滚着摔下来。

decisions.source: Historically, POKENAME has been noted for its swift ability to learn and its reliability in all kinds of situations. To give its attacks an extra punch of power, POKENAME rubs its hands together and allows static charge to build up.
decisions.target: POKENAME自古便以学得快、遇事可靠而闻名。为了让攻击更有威力，POKENAME会摩擦双手，积蓄静电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME自古便以学得快、遇事可靠而闻名。为了让攻击更有威力，POKENAME会摩擦双手，积蓄静电。

decisions.source: POKENAME puts up the guise of being a grand and powerful Pokémon, able to summon and create anything it wants. In reality, it is extremely weak and powerless, its attacks being even punier than a droplet of water.
decisions.target: POKENAME装成伟大强盛、能召造一切的宝可梦。其实弱得毫无力量，攻击连一滴水都不如。
decisions.revised: POKENAME装出威风强大的模样，仿佛想要什么，都能召来、创造。其实它极其虚弱，毫无力量，攻击的威力，连一滴水都不如。

decisions.source: Rampaging POKENAME are known to attack small towns and villages near bodies of water. While POKENAME is not weak to Fire-type moves, they are effective in raising POKENAME's body temperature and forcing them back into the water to cool.
decisions.target: 狂暴POKENAME常袭击水边小镇与村庄。火属性招式虽不克制POKENAME，却能升高体温，逼POKENAME回水降温。
decisions.revised: 狂暴POKENAME常袭击水边小镇与村庄。火属性招式虽不克制POKENAME，却能升高体温，逼POKENAME回水降温。

decisions.source: POKENAME weave psychically charged webs deep within dark caves. They rely on the psychic charge on these webs to sense their prey, the strands picking up on the panic of those caught within them and transmitting them back to POKENAME.
decisions.target: POKENAME在黑洞穴深处，织带精神能量的网。网感知被困者恐慌，传回给它，帮助察知猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在昏暗的洞穴深处，织起带有精神能量的网。它们靠网上的精神能量感知猎物：丝线捕捉被困者的恐慌，再将其传回。

decisions.source: POKENAME, despite their apparent size and shape, can reach rather high speeds when they fly. Although not as fast, they are still fairly quick runners as well. They have considerable psychic power, which they are always utilizing while awake.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽这般体形，飞速却相当高。跑虽不如飞，也依然快。精神力量可观，醒时始终在用。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然有着这样的体型和外形，飞行速度却相当快。奔跑虽不如飞行，也依旧迅捷。它们的超能力十分可观，清醒时始终都在运用。

decisions.source: Each petal on POKENAME's body can be pressed into an oil that heals scrapes and cuts. They enjoy taking care of other Pokémon in the wild and are often spotted with a Chikorita in their front pouch.
decisions.target: POKENAME每片花瓣，都能压出治疗擦伤、割伤的油。它爱照顾野生同伴，前袋常装着菊草叶。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上的每片花瓣，都能压榨出治疗擦伤、割伤的油。它喜欢照料其他野生宝可梦，常能看见前面的袋子里，装着一只菊草叶。

decisions.source: POKENAME are solitary Pokémon and will often fight with each other over territory. If it is disturbed during the day, it will quickly bite its attacker before swiftly flying away, leaving them to deal with its venomous bite.
decisions.target: POKENAME独居，常为领地互斗。白天受扰，会迅速咬袭击者一口便飞走，留下对方承受毒咬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME独居，常为领地互斗。白天受扰，会迅速咬袭击者一口便飞走，留下对方承受毒咬。

decisions.source: POKENAME often stare into the distance unblinkingly for hours, which some claim to be because they are peering into the future. Their wings are like large axe blades that allow them to glide through the sky at great speeds.
decisions.target: POKENAME常数小时不眨眼地望远，有人说它在窥未来。双翼如大斧刃，让它高速滑翔天空。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常几个小时不眨眼，凝望远方，有人说，这是在窥探未来。它们的翅膀如同巨大的斧刃，能让它们高速滑过天空。

decisions.source: The wool of a POKENAME can grow so large that many children think of them as walking clouds. The electricity that surges within their wool can grow so intense that their wool can look like it is a thundercloud.
decisions.target: POKENAME羊毛能长得极大，许多孩子觉得像行走的云。毛中电流强烈时，甚至看着像雷云。
decisions.revised: POKENAME羊毛能长得极大，许多孩子觉得像行走的云。毛中电流强烈时，甚至看着像雷云。

decisions.source: With its shell glowing brightly like a beacon, this kind Pokémon guides ships during dark nights, helping them maneuver between sea rocks and moor to the shore. Underwater, small Pokémon gather around POKENAME's light for protection.
decisions.target: 善良的POKENAME亮壳如信标，黑夜引船绕海礁、靠岸。水下，小宝可梦也聚在光旁寻求保护。
decisions.revised: 这种善良的宝可梦，外壳亮得像信标，在漆黑的夜晚为船只引路，帮助穿过海礁，停靠岸边。水下，小型宝可梦也会聚在POKENAME的光芒周围，寻求保护。

decisions.source: POKENAME's golden body glows brightly, but the light flashes on and off every few seconds. While this can be useful for lighthouses, POKENAME tends to doze off late at night, causing the light to go out until it wakes.
decisions.target: POKENAME金身明亮，却每隔几秒闪灭一次。虽适合灯塔，深夜却爱打盹，灯熄到醒来才重亮。
decisions.revised: POKENAME金色的身体，明亮耀眼，每隔几秒，光就会闪灭一次。虽然适合为灯塔照明，它却常在深夜打盹，让光芒熄灭，直到醒来。

decisions.source: POKENAME flap their wings to add air to the fire burning along their tails, creating enough heat to boil any water around them. They hide within steam and reflect the light of their fires along bubbles to disorient prey.
decisions.target: POKENAME拍翼给尾火添空气，热到能煮沸周围水。它藏蒸汽里，让火光经泡反射，扰乱猎物。
decisions.revised: POKENAME拍动翅膀，为尾部燃烧的火焰送入空气，产生的热量，足以煮沸周围的水。它们藏进蒸汽，让泡泡反射火光，扰乱猎物。

decisions.source: POKENAME have little to no flight power on their own, instead outstretching their wings to glide with the wind. The mildly toxic pollen their leaves produce easily gets carried off by the wind, causing irritation and itching upon contact.
decisions.target: POKENAME几乎不能自行飞，只能展翼乘风滑。叶片的微毒花粉容易飘散，接触便刺激、发痒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME几乎没有自行飞行的能力，而是伸展翅膀，借风滑翔。叶片产生的微毒花粉，很容易随风飘散，接触后，会产生刺激与瘙痒。

decisions.source: POKENAME's massive spores like to clump together. They're soft to the touch while still retaining their mass. Some entrepreneurs tried to use POKENAME's spores to make pillows, only to discover they invoke a deep sleep if inhaled.
decisions.target: POKENAME巨大孢子爱结团，摸着虽软，分量不减。有商人试制枕头，却发现吸入会让人深睡。
decisions.revised: POKENAME巨大的孢子，很容易聚成一团，摸起来柔软，分量却不减。有些商人尝试用这些孢子制成枕头，却发现，一旦吸入，就会使人陷入沉睡。

decisions.source: POKENAME cheese has a distinct, earthy flavour to it thanks to the Pokémon's steady diet of mineral-rich soil. Their cheese is considered a delicacy in some parts of the world, though it's an acquired taste.
decisions.target: POKENAME常吃富矿土，奶酪便有独特泥土风味。有些地区视为佳肴，不过得吃惯才懂欣赏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常吃富矿土，奶酪便有独特泥土风味。有些地区视为佳肴，不过得吃惯才懂欣赏。

decisions.source: POKENAME lies in wait, hidden among the branches, ready to drop onto the heads of unsuspecting passersby who get too close to its tree. Once it falls, it coats its body in electricity to prevent anyone from touching it.
decisions.target: POKENAME藏枝间伏等，准备落到靠树太近、无防备的路人头上。落下后，全身带电，阻止触碰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME藏在枝叶间埋伏，准备落到太靠近树木、毫无防备的路人头上。落下后，它会让电流覆盖全身，阻止任何人触碰。

decisions.source: Although many assume that POKENAME are combat-prone, given the large drill arms they have, they are actually very docile Pokémon. They typically only use their drills to dig new homes or to break open extremely tough nuts.
decisions.target: 大钻臂让许多人以为POKENAME好战，其实很温顺。通常只用钻头挖新家，或打开极硬坚果。
decisions.revised: 大钻臂让许多人以为POKENAME好战，其实很温顺。通常只用钻头挖新家，或打开极硬坚果。

decisions.source: POKENAME climbs mountains by digging its claws into rocks, scaling to high altitudes to reach nests of other Pokémon. It patiently waits for the right opportunity to steal eggs, before making the long descent back to the ground.
decisions.target: POKENAME用爪嵌岩爬山，高高攀到其他宝可梦的巢。耐心等机会偷蛋，再花很久回到地面。
decisions.revised: POKENAME将爪子嵌进岩石，攀上高山，抵达其他宝可梦的巢。它耐心等待偷蛋的良机，得手后，再沿漫长的路途，回到地面。

decisions.source: POKENAME can often be found meditating in branches of tall trees. While they appear to be in a deep trance, they are hyper aware of their surroundings, and are always on guard in case lumberjacks chop down too much.
decisions.target: POKENAME常在高树枝间冥想。看似深陷恍惚，其实极留意周围，始终防着伐木工砍得太多。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常在高树枝间冥想。看似深陷恍惚，其实极留意周围，始终防着伐木工砍得太多。

decisions.source: POKENAME are often seen thriving inside of sandstorms, using a way of moving that resembles swimming. When they're in danger, they use their claws to bury themselves in the ground, only leaving their rough scales above the sand.
decisions.target: POKENAME常在沙暴里活跃，以游泳般的方式移动。遇险就用爪埋进地下，只留粗鳞在沙上。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常在沙暴里活跃，以游泳般的方式移动。遇险就用爪埋进地下，只留粗鳞在沙上。

decisions.source: POKENAME are experts at controlling their body temperature. They are primarily seen in a dormant state to preserve their energy, but never confuse their dormancy for laziness; these Pokémon take pride in their training to reach that state.
decisions.target: POKENAME精通体温控制，多以休眠节能。不过别误以为它懒惰，它为练成这状态十分自豪。
decisions.revised: POKENAME非常善于控制体温，平时多以休眠状态保存能量。不过，千万别把休眠误认成懒惰；它们为训练到这样的境界，而深感自豪。

decisions.source: Recently, some martial artists have taken to using POKENAME as their coach. They are perfect sparring partners, able to anticipate any move that will be used against them, allowing the athlete to put their full force into the move.
decisions.target: 近来有武术家请POKENAME当教练。它能预判任何来招，是理想陪练，让武者尽情全力出招。
decisions.revised: 近来有武术家请POKENAME当教练。它能预判任何来招，是理想陪练，让武者尽情全力出招。

decisions.source: POKENAME can be found climbing mangrove trees or jumping across marshes using the exposed mangrove roots. Trainers passing through these areas occasionally fall victim to the shenanigans of these Pokémon and have balls of mud thrown at them.
decisions.target: POKENAME会攀红树，或借露出的根跳过沼泽。路过训练家偶尔会遭它恶作剧，被扔来泥球。
decisions.revised: POKENAME会攀红树，或借露出的根跳过沼泽。路过训练家偶尔会遭它恶作剧，被扔来泥球。

decisions.source: Timid by nature and with poor eyesight, POKENAME rarely pokes itself out of its home high up in trees. It waits until its psychic senses detect no others in the vicinity before it deigns to go out to forage.
decisions.target: POKENAME天性胆怯、视力差，很少探出高树上的家。精神感知确认附近无人，才肯出去觅食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME天性胆怯，视力又差，很少从高树上的家中探出身子。只有用超能力确认附近没有其他生灵，它才肯出去觅食。

decisions.source: POKENAME is a subject of great scientific interest due to being hollow, not breathing, and floating above the ground. Its jaw has the strength to break a tree in half, yet POKENAME only opens its mouth to bite an enemy.
decisions.target: POKENAME中空、不呼吸，又悬在地上，让科学家极感兴趣。颚能咬断树，却只在咬敌时才张嘴。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的身体中空，不需呼吸，又飘浮于地面之上，引起科学家极大的兴趣。它的颚有将树咬成两段的力量，却只在咬敌人时，才会张嘴。

decisions.source: POKENAME's camouflage ability does not extend to its drill once it begins rotating. It uses its tongue to grab and hold onto berries, drilling holes into them with its horn to more easily reach the sweet pulpy insides.
decisions.target: POKENAME钻头一转，就无法一起伪装。用舌抓稳树果，再拿角钻孔，轻易够到里面的甜果肉。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的钻头一旦转起来，就无法再随身体一起伪装。它用舌头抓牢树果，再以角钻出洞，方便吃到里面甜美的果肉。

decisions.source: A stealthy fighter, POKENAME camouflages with it's environment to avoid detection from its foes. Once it's within striking distance, it leaps towards its prey and dishes out a flurry of swift blows until they're out cold.
decisions.target: POKENAME是隐秘斗士，融入环境，不让敌人察觉。一进范围，便扑向猎物，接连快击，直到打昏。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是隐秘斗士，融入环境，不让敌人察觉。一进范围，便扑向猎物，接连快击，直到打昏。

decisions.source: Some students use POKENAME as a study aid, as gazing into the light on its head stimulates the brain and temporarily increases intellect. It comes with the caveat of reducing one's energy and tiring them out quicker, however.
decisions.target: 有学生拿POKENAME助学，因为凝视头灯能刺激脑，暂时增智。可代价是精力下降，更快疲惫。
decisions.revised: 有些学生请POKENAME帮助学习，因为凝视它头上的光，能刺激大脑，暂时提高智力。不过，这也有代价：精力会下降，更容易疲倦。

decisions.source: POKENAME breathes out a burning white flame said to purify the evil in one's soul. The more evil the soul of the victim, the hotter and more painful the fire is said to burn as it cleanses them.
decisions.target: POKENAME吐出灼白火焰，据说能净化灵魂邪恶。受害者魂越恶，净化的火就烧得越热、越痛。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吐出炽热的白色火焰，据说，能净化灵魂中的邪恶。受害者的灵魂越邪恶，净化时，火焰就会烧得越热，带来越强的痛楚。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at the ground inside its cave to chip into it. It will keep doing this until it hits a geothermal vent and heat pours into its home.
decisions.target: POKENAME用布高举刀刃，向洞窟地面反复刺下、凿开，直到碰到地热喷口，让热气涌入家中。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用布高举刀刃，向洞窟地面反复刺下、凿开，直到碰到地热喷口，让热气涌入家中。

decisions.source: POKENAME can repeatedly fire off the gear on its tail, letting it fire off powerful, relentless blows from afar. If the foe gets near, it repeatedly jabs with the toxin-coated spikes around its waist to knock them out.
decisions.target: POKENAME能反复发射尾齿轮，远处强攻不休。敌人靠近，就用腰边覆毒尖刺连戳，将其击倒。
decisions.revised: POKENAME能反复射出尾巴的齿轮，从远处发动猛烈而不间断的攻击。敌人一靠近，它就用腰间覆着毒素的尖刺，连续戳刺，将其击倒。

decisions.source: It uses its anchor to catch large prey, then ensnares them in its feelers and seaweed to drain them of their vitality. If its body is ever damaged, it will scavenge the remains of ships to repair itself.
decisions.target: 它用锚捉大猎物，再以触须与海草缠住，吸取活力。身体受损，就捡沉船残件修补。
decisions.revised: 它用锚抓住大型猎物，再以触须和海藻缠住，吸取对方的生命力。身体一旦受损，它便搜集船只的残骸，修补自己。

decisions.source: During the day, POKENAME motionlessly watch travelers that pass through the desert. At night, they find the wayfarers and stick them with pins while they sleep. These pins cause a stress-relieving effect via acupuncture, helping the wanderer rest.
decisions.target: 白天，POKENAME不动地看沙漠旅人路过。夜里找到他们，趁睡着扎针，借针灸舒压，帮助休息。
decisions.revised: 白天，POKENAME一动不动地注视穿越沙漠的旅人。到了夜里，它会找到这些人，趁他们熟睡，扎上细针，以针灸缓解压力，帮助休息。

decisions.source: POKENAME prefer to live on beaches with pink or white sand. Though the reason for this isn't certain, some researchers suggest that POKENAME can use sand that is similarly colored to their bodies to repair small amounts of damage.
decisions.target: POKENAME偏爱粉沙或白沙海滩。原因不明，有研究者认为，近似体色的沙可修补少量损伤。
decisions.revised: POKENAME偏爱粉沙或白沙海滩。原因不明，有研究者认为，近似体色的沙可修补少量损伤。

decisions.source: Some people believe that the crystal that forms at the end of a POKENAME's wand can mystically transmit joy. Because of that, poachers have started targeting this species to steal their wands and profit off of selling them.
decisions.target: 有人相信，POKENAME杖尖水晶能神秘地传递喜悦。因此偷猎者开始盯上它，偷杖贩卖牟利。
decisions.revised: 有人相信，POKENAME杖尖形成的水晶，能以神秘力量传递喜悦。因此，偷猎者开始盯上这种宝可梦，盗走它们的杖，靠贩卖牟利。

decisions.source: POKENAME live within the calderas of active volcanoes, competing with one another for the warmest spots. The fumes they release when they are riled up are noxious, and it is advised to avoid breathing them in at all costs.
decisions.target: POKENAME住在活火山破火山口，争抢最暖的位置。激动时放出的烟气有毒，务必避免吸入。
decisions.revised: POKENAME生活在活火山的破火山口内，互相争抢最温暖的位置。它们激动时，释放的烟气有毒，因此务必避免吸入。

decisions.source: POKENAME's song possesses a powerful energy that revitalizes and reshapes the land around it. It's thought that if it sang for long enough, it would turn the land into something resembling how it looked in prehistoric times.
decisions.target: POKENAME歌声的强能量，能恢复、重塑附近土地。人们认为唱得够久，便会变得像史前那样。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的歌声蕴含强大能量，能恢复并重塑周围的土地。人们认为，只要唱得足够久，大地便会变得如同史前时代。

decisions.source: It traps its prey in a ball of sticky gel that is almost impossible to escape from. During the rainy season, it will coat its web in this gel to keep it resistant to the wind and rain.
decisions.target: 它将猎物困在黏胶球里，几乎无法脱身。雨季，又会将这种胶涂在网上，抵御风雨。
decisions.revised: 它将猎物困在黏胶球里，几乎无法脱身。雨季，又会将这种胶涂在网上，抵御风雨。

decisions.source: Many fans of hockey know that POKENAME are popular players of the sport because of their superior speed and agility. POKENAME fly low to the ground to maintain control of the puck before swinging their tail to score a goal.
decisions.target: 许多冰球迷都知道，POKENAME因速度与敏捷出众而很受欢迎。贴地低飞控球，再挥尾射门。
decisions.revised: 许多冰球迷都知道，POKENAME凭出众的速度与敏捷身手，成为深受欢迎的球员。它们贴近地面低飞，稳稳控住冰球，再挥尾射门得分。

decisions.source: The blue flames of a POKENAME are so cold that anyone who tries to ride them without befriending them first will be frozen solid. The vent-like ports along their torsos exude hot steam as they gallop across snowfields.
decisions.target: POKENAME蓝火极冷，未先结交就想骑，会被彻底冻住。奔过雪原时，躯干排气口喷出热蒸汽。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的蓝色火焰极冷，若未先与它交好，就想骑上去，便会被冻得结结实实。它们在雪原奔驰时，躯干上的通风口，会喷出热蒸汽。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is covered with stinging leaves that serve as a defense mechanism against predators. It often falls asleep under the sun to absorb its warmth and energy, storing it within its bulb as it prepares for evolution.
decisions.target: POKENAME全身带刺叶，防御天敌。常在日下睡着，吸收暖意与能量，存进背上种子，准备进化。
decisions.revised: POKENAME全身覆着会蜇人的叶片，抵御捕食者。它常在阳光下睡觉，吸收热量与能量，存进背上的种子，为进化作准备。

decisions.source: POKENAME fashions a helmet from a dried gourd and seeks out a mentor to teach it to fight in defense of baby Pokémon. It is an excellent partner for new Trainers due to its obedient and agreeable attitude.
decisions.target: POKENAME用干葫芦做头盔，找导师教它战斗，保护幼年宝可梦。顺从随和，很适合新训练家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用干葫芦做头盔，找导师教它战斗，保护幼年宝可梦。顺从随和，很适合新训练家。

decisions.source: Extremely exciteable by nature, POKENAME wave their tails around to build up static while they dance. To show their support for their friends and teammates, they will hold their tails above their heads with a dazzling display of sparks.
decisions.target: POKENAME天性易兴奋，边舞边甩尾积静电。支持朋友与队友时，会举尾过头，炫目火花四射。
decisions.revised: POKENAME天性极易兴奋，跳舞时会挥动尾巴，积蓄静电。为了支持朋友和队友，它们会将尾巴高举过头，让炫目的火花四处绽放。

decisions.source: POKENAME reach up to the sky whenever the aurora glitters overhead, entranced by the majestic display above. Frost crystals glitter in the dark around their arms when they do so, making it appear as though they are hugging starlight.
decisions.target: 极光在上方闪耀，POKENAME就着迷地向天伸手。臂边霜晶在暗中发亮，看着像在拥抱星光。
decisions.revised: 极光在上方闪耀，POKENAME就着迷地向天伸手。臂边霜晶在暗中发亮，看着像在拥抱星光。

decisions.source: POKENAME always strive to be stronger, leading to them clashing with each other whenever they meet; this also serves to test the mettle of each other. The spikes along their bodies are harder than steel and are shed monthly.
decisions.target: POKENAME总想变强，一见同类就交锋，检验彼此意志。体表尖刺比钢铁还硬，每月脱落一次。
decisions.revised: POKENAME始终追求更强的力量，同类一见面就会交锋，考验彼此的气魄。身上的尖刺，比钢铁还硬，每月会脱落一次。

decisions.source: POKENAME is notably difficult for Trainers to catch due to its defense mechanisms; between hypnosis with its antlers and a variety of toxins emitted from its wings, it has a multitude of ways to make capturing it a challenge.
decisions.target: POKENAME很难捕捉，鹿角能催眠，翅膀能释放多种毒素，防御手段繁多，让训练家难以下手。
decisions.revised: POKENAME很难捕捉，鹿角能催眠，翅膀能释放多种毒素，防御手段繁多，让训练家难以下手。

decisions.source: POKENAME tend to seclude themselves in barren areas where they churn the ground and make it ripe for plant life to grow as they feed off the hard rocks and minerals. Once the area is completely green though, they move on to the next barren land.
decisions.target: POKENAME常独居荒地，吃硬石与矿物时翻动土地，使其适合草木生长。等大地全绿，又会迁往下一片荒地。
decisions.revised: POKENAME常独居荒地，吃硬石与矿物时翻动土地，使其适合草木生长。等大地全绿，又会迁往下一片荒地。

decisions.source: This Pokémon waits underground for victims to walk underneath it, at which point it leaps from the ground and slices prey apart using its scissors. They are also known to mimic plant life when the soil is too hard for them to dig into.
decisions.target: 它伏在地下，等猎物经过便跃出地面，以巨剪切碎对方。若泥土太硬，挖不进去，也会改装成植物。
decisions.revised: 它伏在地下，等猎物经过便跃出地面，以巨剪切碎对方。若泥土太硬，挖不进去，也会改装成植物。

decisions.source: The flames of POKENAME shine as bright and as hot as the sun itself. Legends claim that if POKENAME were ever to perish, then its egg will open and it will rise anew from it clad in flames with a brand-new egg already in its clutches.
decisions.target: POKENAME的火焰，亮度与热度都如太阳。传说它若死去，蛋便开启，它会披火重生，爪中已有一颗全新的蛋。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的火焰，亮度与热度都如太阳。传说它若死去，蛋便开启，它会披火重生，爪中已有一颗全新的蛋。

decisions.source: POKENAME is an incredibly powerful being, but also very gentle and shy. It stays near the bottom of the sea, but if it senses ships sailing above it while it swims, it keeps the ocean waves gentle to ensure safe travel for those on the surface.
decisions.target: POKENAME力量极强，却温柔害羞，待在海底附近。游时若察觉上方有船，便让海浪温和，确保水面平安通行。
decisions.revised: POKENAME力量无比强大，却又温柔害羞，常待在海底附近。游动时，若察觉上方有船，它便让海浪保持和缓，确保水面的旅人平安通行。

decisions.source: POKENAME's many crystalline orbs are as cold as solid ice and serve as conduits for the electricity stored within its tail fur. Some use its shed orbs to cool foods. It can freeze its fur to make it stand on end to better defend itself.
decisions.target: POKENAME众多晶球冷如坚冰，传导尾毛存的电。有人用落球冷藏食物。它还能冻硬毛，使其竖起，加强防御。
decisions.revised: POKENAME身上众多的水晶珠，冷如坚冰，能传导尾毛储存的电力。有人用它脱落的珠子冷却食物。它还能将毛发冻结，使其竖起，更好地保护自己。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses the horn on its forehead to move large boulders that block its path as it swims at high speed in rivers. It has a habit of stockpiling as much fruit as possible in its hiding place and then eating it once it is ripe.
decisions.target: POKENAME在河里高速游泳时，会用额头的角移开挡路巨石。它习惯在藏身处尽量囤积水果，等熟透再吃。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在河里高速游泳时，会用额头的角移开挡路巨石。它习惯在藏身处尽量囤积水果，等熟透再吃。

decisions.source: When outmatched in battle, POKENAME uses its powerful legs to kick up clouds of sand to disorient its foe. It then curls into a ball and rolls away at high speed. The heat from its body can leave shards of glass scattered along its escape route.
decisions.target: POKENAME战斗中不敌，就用强腿踢起沙云，扰乱对方，再蜷成球高速滚走。体热会让逃跑沿途散落玻璃片。
decisions.revised: POKENAME战斗不敌时，会用强壮的双腿，踢起沙尘云，扰乱敌人，再蜷成球，高速滚走。身体的热量，还可能让逃跑的沿途，散落玻璃碎片。

decisions.source: The lower half of its body is a large opening lined with small, metal blades that can hold onto prey as they are dragged in and swallowed whole. Its species can communicate with one another using their metal antennae on the sides of their heads.
decisions.target: 下半身是大开口，内衬小金属刃，扣住被拖入的猎物，再整只吞下。它们用头两侧金属触角交流。
decisions.revised: 下半身是大开口，内衬小金属刃，扣住被拖入的猎物，再整只吞下。它们用头两侧金属触角交流。

decisions.source: A common tale above the polar circle says that right as the sun sets to usher in the polar night, POKENAME can be seen leading the spirits of those who have passed. Despite the extreme conditions, many people come annually to try and catch a glimpse.
decisions.target: 极圈地区流传：太阳落下、极夜将至之际，能见POKENAME引领亡魂。环境虽极端，仍年年有人来，想一睹身影。
decisions.revised: 极圈地区流传：太阳落下、极夜将至之际，能见POKENAME引领亡魂。环境虽极端，仍年年有人来，想一睹身影。

decisions.source: Many consider it to be a juggernaut in a class of its own when it comes to combat. With a single swing of either of its arms, it can shatter large boulders. Its sizable tree indicates its health; if the leaves wilt, its strength wanes.
decisions.target: 许多人认为，它战力独一档，势不可挡。任一臂一挥，就能碎大石。巨树反映健康，叶若枯，力量也减。
decisions.revised: 许多人认为，它在战斗中自成一格，势不可挡。任一手臂挥动一下，就能击碎巨石。身上的大树，反映它的健康；叶片若萎蔫，力量也会减弱。

decisions.source: The toxic gas released by a POKENAME is so thick and horrid that it is visibly an eerie purple color. They can easily subdue most opponents through the smell of this gas alone, but it is also so toxic that it may quickly end their torment.
decisions.target: POKENAME毒气浓烈可怕，肉眼可见诡紫色。光味道便制服多数敌人，毒性却也可能很快让对方彻底“解脱”。
decisions.revised: POKENAME释放的毒气，浓烈而可怕，肉眼可见一片诡异的紫色。光是气味，就能轻易制服多数对手；而猛烈的毒性，也可能很快结束它们的痛苦。

decisions.source: It is rumored that these Pokémon were born of the spirits left behind by forest fires, now possessing the burnt remains of trees. They are incredibly docile and shy, though when happy their flames noticeably grow and they cannot help but dance a bit.
decisions.target: 据传它们是林火留下的灵魂，附烧焦树骸。温顺又害羞，可一开心，火焰明显长大，还忍不住跳舞。
decisions.revised: 据传，这些宝可梦诞生自森林火灾遗下的灵魂，如今附在烧焦的树木残骸上。它们十分温顺害羞，开心时，火焰却会明显增大，还忍不住跳上几步。

decisions.source: The appendage around its neck is a long root that allows it to connect with and control nearby plants through their roots. From the shadows, it monitors those in its forest and attacks them with precise Water Shuriken if they harm the forest at all.
decisions.target: 颈边长肢是根，能连周围植物的根，进而控制。暗中监视，谁稍伤森林，就以精准飞水手里剑攻击。
decisions.revised: 它颈边环绕的附属物，是一条长根，能连上附近植物的根，进而控制植物。它在暗处监视林中生灵，谁若对森林稍有伤害，就以精准的飞水手里剑攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME's fur becomes densely matted with soil and dirt as they dig through the ground in search of plant roots to feed on. Their fur is packed with enough soil that it can support plant life of its own, large flowers growing from their back.
decisions.target: POKENAME挖地寻找植物根吃，毛中便积满土与污物，纠结成块。泥土多得能养活植物，背上因此长出大花。
decisions.revised: POKENAME挖地寻找植物根吃，毛中便积满土与污物，纠结成块。泥土多得能养活植物，背上因此长出大花。

decisions.source: Though it resembles a Noivern, this Pokémon cannot make high-pitched noises to orient itself in the dark. Instead, it has a thick bone plating on its throat that, when struck with POKENAME's club, creates a loud sound that it then uses to echolocate.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽像音波龙，却无法用高频叫声在黑暗辨路。它改拿骨棒敲喉部厚骨板，以响声进行回声定位。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽像音波龙，却无法用高频叫声在黑暗辨路。它改拿骨棒敲喉部厚骨板，以响声进行回声定位。

decisions.source: POKENAME is considered a relatively easy pet to care for, with a simple diet and disposition. In addition, the flame on its tail changes color based on its mood, making it easy to tell when it is content or not.
decisions.target: POKENAME饮食简单，性情单纯，是颇容易照料的宠物。尾焰会随心情变色，开不开心，一眼便知。
decisions.revised: POKENAME饮食简单，性情单纯，是颇容易照料的宠物。尾焰会随心情变色，开不开心，一眼便知。

decisions.source: In battles between rival POKENAME, the victor will take the loser's bone club and wield it in tandem with its own. Be wary if one sees a POKENAME with four clubs; it is sure to be a powerful foe indeed.
decisions.target: POKENAME相争，胜者会夺走败者骨棒，与自己的并用。遇上持四根棒的POKENAME，可得当心，那必是强敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME相争，胜者会夺走败者骨棒，与自己的并用。遇上持四根棒的POKENAME，可得当心，那必是强敌。

decisions.source: POKENAME uses its sharp wings to slice and weaken foes before finishing them off with its sharp horns. If it can't tear an enemy with its horns, it flies up and crashes down with them to smash them apart.
decisions.target: POKENAME先用锐翼切伤、削弱敌人，再以尖角了结。若角撕不开对方，便飞高后撞下，将其砸碎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME先用锐翼切伤、削弱敌人，再以尖角了结。若角撕不开对方，便飞高后撞下，将其砸碎。

decisions.source: Although its body is large, POKENAME's mouth is only big enough to eat bird eggs and leaves. As a result, it must eat massive amounts of food each day to maintain its size, making it a devastating invasive species.
decisions.target: POKENAME身体大，嘴却只够吃鸟蛋与叶片。为维持体型，每天得吃惊人的量，入侵时破坏极强。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然体型庞大，嘴却只够吃鸟蛋与树叶。为维持体型，它每天必须吃下大量食物，因此是一种破坏力惊人的入侵物种。

decisions.source: At night, POKENAME shakes its head back and forth which causes the leaves on its face to release a sweet fragrance that helps it sleep. These leaves grow throughout its life and help generate enough oxygen to help POKENAME breathe underwater.
decisions.target: 夜里，POKENAME来回摇头，让脸叶散甜香，帮助入睡。叶终生长，产出足够氧气，也让它水下呼吸。
decisions.revised: 夜里，POKENAME来回摇头，让脸上的叶子散出甜香，帮助自己入睡。叶片一生都在生长，能产生充足的氧气，使它在水下也能呼吸。

decisions.source: POKENAME eat Enigma Berries to help them survive in the wild because they are fragile creatures that get exposed to many threats. They sprout vines from their back to push predators away before sliding away on a sheet of ice.
decisions.target: POKENAME体弱，野外威胁多，便吃谜芝果帮助生存。它从背部长藤，推开捕食者，再沿冰片滑走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME体弱，野外威胁多，便吃谜芝果帮助生存。它从背部长藤，推开捕食者，再沿冰片滑走。

decisions.source: After POKENAME eats all the berries from a tree, it will breathe on the plant to rejuvenate it. This causes it to produce new berries sooner, which POKENAME will immediately eat, so it never needs to move far to find food.
decisions.target: POKENAME吃光一树果，就朝树吐息，使其恢复，尽快结新果。新果立刻又吃，因此不用远走找食。
decisions.revised: POKENAME吃光树上的树果后，会朝树吐息，让它恢复生机，更早结出新果。新果一长成，它又立刻吃掉，因此不用走远，就能一直找到食物。

decisions.source: POKENAME generate heat from their shells to keep them warm even in the dark depths of the ocean. The process causes any water within their shells to boil, leading to the shells glowing slightly and leaking bubbles through the cracks.
decisions.target: POKENAME从壳中产热，连黑暗深海也能保暖。过程让壳内水沸腾，壳便微亮，气泡从裂缝漏出。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的外壳会产生热量，使它在黑暗的深海，也能保持温暖。壳中的水因此沸腾，外壳微微发光，气泡从裂缝中逸出。

decisions.source: POKENAME have a thick layer of woolly feathers that keeps them warm at night. As they sleep they generate static electricity that clings to their body. When they awaken at dawn they have built enough electricity to power cellular devices.
decisions.target: POKENAME厚厚的羊毛羽让夜里温暖。睡时不断积静电，黎明醒来，已够给移动通信设备供电。
decisions.revised: POKENAME厚厚的羊毛般羽毛，能在夜里保暖。睡觉时，它们不断产生附着于身体的静电；黎明醒来，积蓄的电力，已足够为移动通信设备供电。

decisions.source: POKENAME's body is covered in a massive coat of wool so thick it can't walk, forcing it to roll to move around. Despite its cute appearance, it is a tough Pokémon, capable of unleashing devastating electric attacks.
decisions.target: POKENAME覆着巨大羊毛外套，厚到无法走，只能滚。外表虽可爱，却很强悍，能放毁灭性的电击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME全身覆着厚厚的羊毛，厚到无法走路，只能靠翻滚移动。虽然外表可爱，它却十分强悍，能释放威力惊人的电击。
