decisions.source: POKENAME flock towards volcanic vents and areas where magma bubbles up. The spots on its shell shine brightly when it is absorbing heat, making it also useful in factories to warn of areas that may be too hot to touch.
decisions.target: POKENAME群聚火山喷口和岩浆冒出之地。吸热时壳斑明亮，工厂也用它警告哪些地方太烫。
decisions.revised: POKENAME成群聚向火山喷口，以及岩浆翻涌的地方。吸热时，外壳上的斑点会明亮发光，因此工厂也会用它们，警示哪些地方可能太烫，不宜触碰。

decisions.source: POKENAME cheerfully dance amongst one another around forest streams, performing complex moves to communicate with one another. Their gatherings are meant to be secret and, in an effort to hide, they will freeze up if someone happens to see them.
decisions.target: POKENAME在林溪边欢舞，用复杂动作沟通。聚会想保密，若碰巧被看，就僵住不动，试图藏起来。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在森林溪流边，彼此欢快起舞，用复杂的动作交流。它们想让聚会保持秘密，若碰巧被人看见，就会僵住不动，试图藏好自己。

decisions.source: POKENAME are commonly used in the food industry to help with the ageing and fermentation of certain cheeses. Their back is coated in a fungus that gives dairy products a strong flavour if left in place for a long time.
decisions.target: 食品业常请POKENAME，帮助某些奶酪陈化发酵。背上真菌长期作用，会给奶制品添浓烈风味。
decisions.revised: 食品业常请POKENAME，帮助某些奶酪陈化发酵。背上真菌长期作用，会给奶制品添浓烈风味。

decisions.source: POKENAME are less adept at swimming than Omanyte because the inside of its shell is full of soil and greenery instead of air. When the greenery becomes so abundant that it splits the shell open, POKENAME will be close to evolving.
decisions.target: POKENAME壳里全是土和植物，而非空气，游泳不如菊石兽。植物多到撑裂壳时，就接近进化了。
decisions.revised: POKENAME壳里全是土和植物，而非空气，游泳不如菊石兽。植物多到撑裂壳时，就接近进化了。

decisions.source: POKENAME leaves its mouth open until prey wanders into range, at which point it moves at great speed and devours it. It then tightly closes and slowly digests its food; a single meal can keep it satisfied for several months.
decisions.target: POKENAME张着嘴，等猎物进入范围，就迅速吞下。随后紧紧合起，慢慢消化，一顿就够满足数月。
decisions.revised: POKENAME张着嘴，等猎物进入范围，就迅速吞下。随后紧紧合起，慢慢消化，一顿就够满足数月。

decisions.source: The many eyes along the leaves of a POKENAME's tail watch in all directions, constantly on guard for threats. If an opponent threatens the main body, the leaves all bristle as the body counterattacks on a moment's notice.
decisions.target: POKENAME尾叶上许多眼看向各处，时刻警戒。对手若威胁本体，所有叶片立起，身体瞬间反击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME尾部叶片上的许多眼睛，望向四面八方，时刻警惕威胁。对手若威胁本体，所有叶片便会竖起，身体立即反击。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their strong jaws to dig through mountains, eating any soil or ores that fall into their mouths. They battle by using sheer force, knocking their tails into opponents, slamming their bodies into foes, or simply biting onto them.
decisions.target: POKENAME用强颚钻山，落进嘴的土、矿都吃。战斗凭蛮力，或甩尾、或身体猛撞，或直接咬住敌人。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用强颚钻山，落进嘴的土、矿都吃。战斗凭蛮力，或甩尾、或身体猛撞，或直接咬住敌人。

decisions.source: When POKENAME's is angry, its mane generates an electric field that it can project as a powerful electric discharge. Its twin tails are burning hot and can act like flamethrowers, either for hunting prey or for fighting its enemies.
decisions.target: POKENAME愤怒时，鬃毛产生电场，可投放为强劲电击。双尾炽热如喷火器，既能猎食，也能迎敌。
decisions.revised: POKENAME愤怒时，鬃毛会产生电场，释放出强劲的电击。它炽热的双尾，还能充当火焰喷射器，既能捕猎，也能迎战敌人。

decisions.source: POKENAME plant their stout legs into riverbeds and let the rushing currents hydrate them and clean off their shells of any debris. If they ever get swept away, their large tail fins are strong enough to fight against the current.
decisions.target: POKENAME以粗腿扎稳河床，让急流补水、冲去壳上碎屑。若被冲走，大尾鳍也强到能抵抗水流。
decisions.revised: POKENAME以粗腿扎稳河床，让急流补水、冲去壳上碎屑。若被冲走，大尾鳍也强到能抵抗水流。

decisions.source: POKENAME is highly protective of other avian Pokémon and works to defend them wherever possible. It puffs its chest up to seem larger and intimidate others in the hopes that it can protect others without resorting directly to violence.
decisions.target: POKENAME极护其他鸟宝可梦，尽可能施援。挺胸显大，威吓旁人，盼能不直接动武，就保护大家。
decisions.revised: POKENAME十分爱护其他鸟类宝可梦，总会尽可能保护它们。它鼓起胸膛，让自己显得更大，威吓旁人，希望不必直接动武，也能守护同伴。

decisions.source: POKENAME have incisors that grow at a prodigious rate. They try to gnaw through wood as quickly as possible in order to keep them under control. Unfused Bidoof will try and help POKENAME, bringing them plenty of logs to chew on.
decisions.target: POKENAME门牙长得惊人，尽量快啃木，防止失控。未融合大牙狸也想帮忙，送来大量原木啃咬。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的门牙长得极快，便尽可能迅速地啃咬木头，控制牙齿的长度。未融合的大牙狸也会试着帮忙，送来许多原木，让它们啃咬。

decisions.source: Legends say that POKENAME's knowledge is infinite, that it knows of everything that was or will be. Those considered geniuses across history are rumored to have been visited by POKENAME in their dreams, and granted a fraction of its intellect.
decisions.target: 传说，POKENAME知识无限，过去未来全知。历代天才，据说都曾在梦里受访，被赐一小部分智慧。
decisions.revised: 传说，POKENAME的知识无穷无尽，过去与未来的一切，它都知晓。历代被视为天才的人，据说都曾在梦中得到它的造访，被赐予它的一小部分智慧。

decisions.source: As a POKENAME flies through the sky, it casts a frosty veil of many colors as a trail from its wings and tail. POKENAME have been labeled a protected species due to how hunted they were for their vibrantly colored feathers.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞过天空，翼尾拖出多彩寒霜薄幕。鲜艳羽毛招来大量捕猎，因此被列为保护物种。
decisions.revised: POKENAME飞过天空时，翅膀与尾巴，会拖出一条多彩的寒霜薄幕。它们曾因羽毛色彩鲜艳而遭到大量捕猎，因此被列为受保护的物种。

decisions.source: POKENAME rarely has the energy to use its limbs for anything, so it instead uses its ribbons to move itself or grab things. Others touched by the ribbons will feel extremely sluggish and lethargic for the remainder of the day.
decisions.target: POKENAME很少有精力动四肢，改用缎带移动、抓物。被碰到者当天剩余时间都会极迟缓、无力。
decisions.revised: POKENAME很少有精力用四肢做事，便改用缎带移动身体，抓取物件。被缎带碰到的对象，在当天剩下的时间里，都会十分迟缓、无精打采。

decisions.source: POKENAME's large horns exude a calming aura, which is most potent when they touch another living being. Unfortunately, its entire body is covered in a germ-laden mucous membrane; it is strongly advised never to touch this Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME大角散出舒缓气息，碰到生灵时最强。但全身覆有满带病菌的黏膜，最好绝不触碰。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大角散出舒缓气息，碰到生灵时最强。但全身覆有满带病菌的黏膜，最好绝不触碰。

decisions.source: POKENAME scream out infrasonic shrieks that are too high-pitched for the human ear to hear. They use these shrieks to navigate and locate other Pokémon, listening for echoes and then diving at Pokémon with their venomous horns.
decisions.target: POKENAME发出人耳听不见的尖叫，聆听回声，用来导航、寻找其他宝可梦，再以毒角俯冲攻击。
decisions.revised: POKENAME发出人耳听不见的尖叫，聆听回声，用来导航、寻找其他宝可梦，再以毒角俯冲攻击。

decisions.source: During long summers, POKENAME is said to awaken and roam the lands in search of food. During these periods, no rain falls, and plants wither. Once full, POKENAME will return to its home underground, sleep, and allow rain to fall again.
decisions.target: 据说长夏，POKENAME醒来四处觅食。期间无雨，植物凋萎。吃饱回地下家园睡去，雨才重新落下。
decisions.revised: 据说，漫长的夏季里，POKENAME会苏醒，四处游荡觅食。这段时间，不会有雨落下，植物也会凋萎。吃饱后，它返回地下的家，重新睡去，雨水才再度降临。

decisions.source: According to ancient mythology, POKENAME is said to live deep within the mantle layer of the planet. With the full power of the land and magma, POKENAME could cover the entire world in a landmass, leaving no traces of water left.
decisions.target: 古神话称POKENAME住在地幔深处，凭大地与岩浆的全力，能让陆地覆盖整个世界，不留水迹。
decisions.revised: 据古老神话所述，POKENAME栖居在行星地幔的深处。凭借大地与岩浆的全部力量，它能让陆地覆盖整个世界，不留一丝水的踪迹。

decisions.source: Most of POKENAME's toxins are stored in a sac within its tail. It delivers the toxin to its spines so it can create clouds of toxic spores from its many spikes, its tail sac shrinking as it does so.
decisions.target: POKENAME的毒素多存于尾内的囊，再送进各根尖刺，放出团团毒孢子。释放时，尾囊也会缩小。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的毒素多存于尾内的囊，再送进各根尖刺，放出团团毒孢子。释放时，尾囊也会缩小。

decisions.source: Although POKENAME is blind, it navigates its cave lair perfectly by sensing vibrations in the ground beneath its feet. It has a pair of wings that allow short flights, which it uses to reach crevices where it hides its food.
decisions.target: POKENAME虽盲，脚下地面的震动，却让它在洞中辨路自如。双翼能短飞，用来到达藏食的岩隙。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽盲，脚下地面的震动，却让它在洞中辨路自如。双翼能短飞，用来到达藏食的岩隙。

decisions.source: POKENAME spend most of their time gliding through the air and only come down to the ground for water and minerals from the mud. Most of their energy comes from sunlight that they get from being high above the clouds.
decisions.target: POKENAME大部分时间空中滑翔，只为吸泥中水与矿物落地。主要能量，来自高于云层的日光。
decisions.revised: POKENAME大多时间都在空中滑翔，只有需要汲取泥中的水分与矿物，才会落地。它们在高高的云层上方，沐浴阳光，获得大部分能量。

decisions.source: POKENAME enjoy playing with an assortment of broken toys that end up in landfills, such as a discolored ball of yarn or a broken laser pointer. After eating lots of garbage, they cough up a hairball before resuming their play.
decisions.target: POKENAME爱玩垃圾场的坏玩具，如褪色毛线球、坏激光笔。吃下大量垃圾，咳个毛球，又继续玩。
decisions.revised: POKENAME爱玩垃圾场的坏玩具，如褪色毛线球、坏激光笔。吃下大量垃圾，咳个毛球，又继续玩。

decisions.source: It races along the coastline with its pack, hunting anything that moves by relying on its powerful hound-like sense of smell. Once it clamps down with jaws as strong as a hydraulic press, it refuses to let go.
decisions.target: 它与群体沿岸疾跑，靠猎犬般强嗅觉，猎一切会动的。双颚如液压机，夹住就绝不松。
decisions.revised: 它与族群沿海岸疾驰，凭猎犬般敏锐的嗅觉，追猎一切会动的东西。双颚强如液压机，一旦咬住，就绝不松口。

decisions.source: POKENAME is highly territorial and will fly into a rage if it ever discovers that its forest has been damaged. So long as it is shown respect, though food offerings help as well, it will allow others to pass through.
decisions.target: POKENAME极护领地，发现森林受损就暴怒。可只要给足尊重，食物供奉也有帮助，便允许通过。
decisions.revised: POKENAME领地意识极强，一发现森林遭到破坏，就会勃然大怒。不过，只要给予尊重，它便会让人通过；献上食物，也很有帮助。

decisions.source: POKENAME use their small trees on their trunks to mop up loose water and puddles, which is absorbed and filtered within them. They are playful Pokémon who love letting others trim their trees, which helps keep them from overgrowing.
decisions.target: POKENAME用象鼻上的小树，拖抹散水与水洼，吸进体内过滤。爱玩，也喜欢被修树，免得长太旺。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用象鼻上的小树，抹去零散的积水与水洼，将水吸入体内过滤。它们性情贪玩，也喜欢别人修剪小树，免得长得过盛。

decisions.source: POKENAME flowers produce a slightly acrid scent, reminiscent of the first wisps of smoke from a fire. Their many-petalled tails waft this scent through the forests they live in, allowing them to find one another through the dense undergrowth.
decisions.target: POKENAME花有微呛味，像火刚燃起的淡烟。多瓣尾将气味扇过森林，方便彼此在密灌里寻找。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的花，散发着略微呛鼻的气味，像火焰初起时的几缕轻烟。多瓣的尾巴，将气味扇遍栖居的森林，让它们在浓密的林下，也能找到彼此。

decisions.source: POKENAME are an uncommon sight, though anytime they have been spotted has been within a field of flowers. If they are ever stepped on, they emit a shrill cry and scatter toxic pollen from their flowers before quickly flying away.
decisions.target: POKENAME不常见，不过至今的目击地点，全在花田。若被踩到，就尖叫、散出毒花粉，再迅速飞走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME不常见，不过至今的目击地点，全在花田。若被踩到，就尖叫、散出毒花粉，再迅速飞走。

decisions.source: The poison from a POKENAME causes a temporary paralysis lasting up to 3 days. It can make the affected area feel as though it's made of stone, and it can spread throughout the entire body if not treated quickly enough.
decisions.target: POKENAME的毒会造成最长3天的暂时麻痹。患处感觉像石头，若没及时处理，还可能蔓延全身。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的毒会造成最长3天的暂时麻痹。患处感觉像石头，若没及时处理，还可能蔓延全身。

decisions.source: Despite its expert combat skills, POKENAME is actually quite cowardly. If it's locked in a fight, it thinks it can't win, it will bite its opponent with its powerful jaws and quickly fly off while they're distracted.
decisions.target: POKENAME战技虽精，其实胆小。陷入自认赢不了的战斗，就用强颚咬敌，趁对方分心，赶紧飞走。
decisions.revised: POKENAME虽然战技高超，实际却相当胆小。若陷入自认无法获胜的战斗，它就用强壮的双颚咬住对手，趁对方分心，迅速飞走。

decisions.source: The intense heat from its flames creates a thick layer of glass to form on its back. It has to be careful with its shovel because if it gets too close to its flames, the shovel will completely melt.
decisions.target: 火焰的高热，让它背上形成厚玻璃层。它得小心铲子，一靠火焰太近，就会彻底熔掉。
decisions.revised: 火焰的高热，让它背上形成厚玻璃层。它得小心铲子，一靠火焰太近，就会彻底熔掉。

decisions.source: POKENAME often live in packs that include Torggy, with the one POKENAME that has the largest and most vibrant crest acting as the leader. They collectively mine for coal to eat, with the pack leader always being given the largest piece.
decisions.target: POKENAME群体常有煤小子，头冠最大、最鲜亮的POKENAME当首领。它们一起挖煤吃，首领总分到最大块。
decisions.revised: POKENAME群体常有煤小子，头冠最大、最鲜亮的POKENAME当首领。它们一起挖煤吃，首领总分到最大块。

decisions.source: If there's a blackout after a rainy day, there's a good chance that a group of POKENAME have eaten all of the electricity at the nearby power plant. They use the energy gained from the electricity to dance in celebration of the sun's return.
decisions.target: 雨后若停电，多半是一群POKENAME把附近发电厂的电吃光了。它们用吸来的能量跳舞，庆祝太阳重新出现。
decisions.revised: 雨后若停电，多半是一群POKENAME把附近发电厂的电吃光了。它们用吸来的能量跳舞，庆祝太阳重新出现。

decisions.source: POKENAME's eyes are covered in a special film that protects them as it digs through sand, dirt, or rock. It can curl up to defend itself, its tensed hide being tough enough to repel some attacks, and uses its tail stinger to strongly jab at foes.
decisions.target: POKENAME眼覆特殊薄膜，钻过沙、土与岩石时，保护双眼。它能卷身，以绷紧硬皮挡开某些攻击，再用尾刺狠扎。
decisions.revised: POKENAME的眼睛覆着特殊薄膜，钻过沙子、泥土和岩石时，能保护双眼。它会蜷起身体，用绷紧的坚韧皮肤挡开部分攻击，再以尾刺，狠狠戳向敌人。

decisions.source: When POKENAME hangs on a tree, it uses flower buds as a counterweight. If it eats too much at once, it may be forced to spend the night on the ground because the weight of its body and flower buds becomes too great for its muscular tentacles.
decisions.target: POKENAME挂在树上时，用花苞配重。一次吃太多，身体和花苞重得强壮触手也撑不住，可能只好在地上过夜。
decisions.revised: POKENAME挂在树上时，用花苞配重。一次吃太多，身体和花苞重得强壮触手也撑不住，可能只好在地上过夜。

decisions.source: Its long antennae can sense the arrival of sea storms ahead of time, so it always tries to alert humans who may be in danger. To defend itself from other Pokémon, it coats its body in bubbles so they can absorb part of incoming attacks.
decisions.target: 长触角能预先察觉海上风暴，因此总试着提醒可能遇险的人。自卫时会覆满泡泡，吸收部分攻击。
decisions.revised: 长触角能预先察觉海上风暴，因此总试着提醒可能遇险的人。自卫时会覆满泡泡，吸收部分攻击。

decisions.source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that were created with the hopes that they could be used to safely study the behaviours of more dangerous wild Pokémon. They have a strong desire to be loved and use discarded fabrics to try and look like real Pokémon.
decisions.target: POKENAME是人造宝可梦，原盼能安全研究危险野生宝可梦。渴望被爱，用废布装扮，想显得像真正的宝可梦。
decisions.revised: POKENAME是人造宝可梦，创造它们，是希望能安全地研究危险野生宝可梦的行为。它们十分渴望被爱，便用废弃布料装扮自己，试着显得像真正的宝可梦。

decisions.source: The smaller heads resemble Beldum and act as scouts for the center head by emerging from the soil first in order to check if the coast is clear. In battle, the smaller heads also serve as turrets, being able to fire psychic blasts from their eyes.
decisions.target: 小头形似铁哑铃，先探出土，为中央头侦察周围是否安全。战斗也如炮塔，能从眼中轰出精神能量。
decisions.revised: 小头形似铁哑铃，先探出土，为中央头侦察周围是否安全。战斗也如炮塔，能从眼中轰出精神能量。

decisions.source: When POKENAME want to get an idea of where to find water, they will poke their heads out of the ground and unfold the leaves they usually keep safe. Their leaves are sensitive to moisture in the air, letting them figure out where to get a drink.
decisions.target: POKENAME想知道哪里有水时，会把头探出地面，展开平时保护着的叶。叶片对空气湿度敏感，能帮它找水喝。
decisions.revised: POKENAME想知道哪里有水时，会把头探出地面，展开平时保护着的叶。叶片对空气湿度敏感，能帮它找水喝。

decisions.source: POKENAME seeks out worthy opponents in the ocean to train up its skills, but it will go ashore to fight a Groutortle if it spots the rival Pokémon. Once it is satisfied with its battle prowess, it dives to deep ocean trenches to evolve and sleep.
decisions.target: POKENAME在海中寻找强敌练技，但看见宿敌固咪龟，也会上岸交战。满足于实力后，便潜入深海沟进化、沉睡。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在海中寻找值得一战的对手，磨练本领。不过，一发现宿敌固咪龟，就会上岸与之交战。等对自己的战斗实力满意后，它便潜入深深的海沟，进化、沉睡。

decisions.source: Wild POKENAME roll around in trash and other debris, which is all eventually absorbed into their bodies if they do not fall off. Once a year, they must shed some of their garbage-like bodies so that they do not grow so large that they cannot move.
decisions.target: 野生POKENAME在垃圾与杂物里滚，没掉下的，最终全被吸收。每年必须蜕一部分垃圾身体，免得大到动不了。
decisions.revised: 野生POKENAME在垃圾与杂物中打滚，只要没有掉落，这些东西最终都会被吸入体内。每年，它们都必须蜕去一部分垃圾般的身体，免得长得太大，无法移动。

decisions.source: POKENAME flies about the forest in search of a tree that is unprotected and bonds with it. It will work closely with an arborist or other Pokémon that it trusts to tend to the tree, leaving in search of a new tree to protect once satisfied.
decisions.target: POKENAME飞林寻找无人保护的树，与之结伴。会与信任的树艺师或宝可梦合作照料，满意后，再找新树守护。
decisions.revised: POKENAME在森林里飞行，寻找没有守护者的树，与其结下羁绊。它会与信任的树艺师，或其他宝可梦密切合作，照料这棵树；待到满意，再去寻找新的树木守护。

decisions.source: Once POKENAME claims a light source for itself, it defends it with its life to prevent anyone else from getting near it. To drain objects of their light energy, it uses its whole body to wrap around the object while latching on with all of its claws.
decisions.target: POKENAME一占有光源，就拼死守护，不许任何生物靠近。它用全身裹住物体，所有爪都紧紧扣住，将光能吸干。
decisions.revised: POKENAME一占有光源，就拼死守护，不许任何生物靠近。它用全身裹住物体，所有爪都紧紧扣住，将光能吸干。

decisions.source: While POKENAME uses its guitar to play its music, it has no problem bashing it against foes and letting it crumble into pieces to gain an easy victory. It dances in such a way that it always agitates those who watch and makes them want to brawl.
decisions.target: POKENAME用吉他演奏，也毫不介意拿它砸敌，哪怕碎掉，轻松赢就好。舞姿总能激怒观众，让他们也想打一场。
decisions.revised: POKENAME用吉他演奏，也毫不介意拿它砸向敌人，即使吉他碎成片，也要轻松取胜。它跳舞的方式，总能激怒观看者，让他们也想大打一场。

rows.source: Researchers have uncovered earlier signs of this Pokémon's existence. The latest report dated its chemical signature to a meteor that landed over 10 million years ago.
rows.translation: 研究者发现了这种宝可梦更早存在的迹象。最新报告指出，其化学特征可追溯到一颗1000多万年前落地的陨石。

rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME渴望有一天，能披上坚不可摧的金属鳞片。为增强耐久，它在火山中烘烤自己，还会将身体撞向崖壁，反复锤炼。

rows.source: Its feelers become rigid during battle or when it feels agitated, which turns them into sharp weapons as well. It can cut out, or off, pieces of ore and gemstones, which are also what it eats; many quarries are privy to having at least one POKENAME.
rows.translation: 战斗或烦躁时，它的触须会变硬，也就成了锋利的武器。它能切下矿石和宝石，这些也是它的食物；许多采石场，都至少有一只POKENAME。
rows.reason: at least one→至少一只，采石场数量下限保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 战斗或烦躁时，它的触须会变硬，也就成了锋利的武器。它能切下矿石和宝石，这些也是它的食物；许多采石场，都至少有一只POKENAME。

rows.source: Its steel whiskers serve as radars for even the smallest of vibrations around them. When it meets another of its kind, the two of them will clash with Headbutt and Iron Tail attacks, the sounds of which that can ring out for miles.
rows.translation: 它的钢铁胡须，如雷达般，连周围最细微的震动也能探知。遇上同类，双方会用头锤和铁尾交锋，声音能传出几英里。
rows.reason: the two为相遇双方，miles为不定距离；译双方与几英里，没有新增精确距离。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 它的钢铁胡须，如雷达般，连周围最细微的震动也能探知。遇上同类，双方会用头锤和铁尾交锋，声音能传出几英里。

rows.source: The three heads work in tandem to quickly dig out tunnels with their jaws. Because these jaws are so powerful, POKENAME can dig through solid stone walls other cave-diggers cannot.
rows.translation: 三个头配合双颚，迅速挖出隧道。颚的力量极大，让POKENAME连其他穴居者无法钻穿的坚实石壁，也能挖开。
rows.reason: three heads→三个头；双颚是上下颚的身体称谓，并未将头的数量改成二。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 三个头配合双颚，迅速挖出隧道。颚的力量极大，让POKENAME连其他穴居者无法钻穿的坚实石壁，也能挖开。

rows.source: POKENAME spend all day digging pitfalls around the oases they call home. They are prone to forgetting where they've dug them, often causing POKENAME to fall into one and spend their evening climbing back out.
rows.translation: POKENAME整天在绿洲家园周围，挖掘陷坑。可它们总忘记挖在哪里，常常自己掉进去，整个晚上，都忙着往外爬。
rows.reason: all day与evening分别为整天挖坑、晚上爬出；无精确小时数，译文未造数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME整天在绿洲家园周围，挖掘陷坑。可它们总忘记挖在哪里，常常自己掉进去，整个晚上，都忙着往外爬。

rows.source: POKENAME commonly sit upon the bottom of large bodies of water. They sleep for up to seventeen hours at a time before coming up for a breath of air.
rows.translation: POKENAME常坐在大片水域的底部，一次最多睡十七小时，才浮上来，换一口气。
rows.reason: up to seventeen hours→一次最多十七小时，上限、连续睡眠与换气先后正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME常坐在大片水域的底部，一次最多睡十七小时，才浮上来，换一口气。

rows.source: POKENAME dream of one day soaring through the sky. They hang upside down from tree branches using their silk, feeling the breeze and moving their arms as if they were actually in flight.
rows.translation: POKENAME梦想有一天，能翱翔天空。它们用丝倒挂树枝，感受微风，挥动手臂，仿佛真的在飞行。
rows.reason: one day为将来梦想，译有一天，非24小时量。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME梦想有一天，能翱翔天空。它们用丝倒挂树枝，感受微风，挥动手臂，仿佛真的在飞行。

rows.source: Despite being strong and muscular, POKENAME struggles to fly due to its heavy weight and relatively small wings. It never stops trying though, as it dreams of reaching the top of a rainbow one day.
rows.translation: POKENAME虽然强壮、肌肉发达，身体却重，翅膀又偏小，飞行十分吃力。不过，它从不停止尝试，梦想有一天，能到达彩虹的顶端。
rows.reason: one day为将来梦想，译有一天，未造飞行期限。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME虽然强壮、肌肉发达，身体却重，翅膀又偏小，飞行十分吃力。不过，它从不停止尝试，梦想有一天，能到达彩虹的顶端。

rows.source: POKENAME throws itself off cliffs several times a day in hopes of one day achieving flight. This results in its armored top half becoming harder than steel over time.
rows.translation: POKENAME每天好几次，从悬崖跃下，希望终有一天能飞。日积月累，让上半身的护甲，变得比钢铁还硬。
rows.reason: several times a day→每天好几次；one day→终有一天，两种时间含义没有混淆。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME每天好几次，从悬崖跃下，希望终有一天能飞。日积月累，让上半身的护甲，变得比钢铁还硬。

rows.source: POKENAME dreams constantly of the day it will one day evolve and be able to soar across the sky. At times, the frustration of being stuck on the ground will leave it crying.
rows.translation: POKENAME始终梦想着，终有一天，自己会进化，翱翔天空。有时，困在地面的挫败感，会让它哭起来。
rows.reason: one day为终有一天进化的愿望，无实际一天进化时限。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME始终梦想着，终有一天，自己会进化，翱翔天空。有时，困在地面的挫败感，会让它哭起来。

rows.source: POKENAME in the wild duel each other by ramming their heads together until one gives up. Whenever they achieve victory, they release a triumphant roar that can be heard from a mile away.
rows.translation: 野生POKENAME用头互相猛撞，展开决斗，直到一方认输。每当取胜，它就会发出得意的吼声，一英里外，也听得见。
rows.reason: a mile away→一英里外，距离单位英里保留，未误为一公里。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 野生POKENAME用头互相猛撞，展开决斗，直到一方认输。每当取胜，它就会发出得意的吼声，一英里外，也听得见。

rows.source: POKENAME are slow moving Pokémon that lumber through mountain ravines in the certainty that very few things can truly threaten them. Their shells are nearly five inches thick, protecting them from most physical threats.
rows.translation: POKENAME行动缓慢，笃定几乎没什么能真正威胁自己，沉重地穿过山间峡谷。近五英寸厚的外壳，能挡住大多数物理威胁。
rows.reason: nearly five inches→近五英寸；厚度与接近值保留，没有写成五厘米或至少五英寸。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME行动缓慢，笃定几乎没什么能真正威胁自己，沉重地穿过山间峡谷。近五英寸厚的外壳，能挡住大多数物理威胁。

rows.source: POKENAME are known to inhabit mountainous regions. If approached, they retract into their shells to flee by rolling down slopes. In hopes of one day taking flight, they spend years journeying to become strong enough to scale even the highest peaks.
rows.translation: POKENAME栖居山区，有东西靠近，就缩进壳里，滚下山坡逃走。为了有一天能飞，它们花上数年旅行，锻炼到足以攀上，连最高的山峰。
rows.reason: spend years→花上数年，未指定不存在的年数；one day仍为将来愿望。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME栖居山区，有东西靠近，就缩进壳里，滚下山坡逃走。为了有一天能飞，它们花上数年旅行，锻炼到足以攀上，连最高的山峰。

rows.source: POKENAME sleeps curled in a ball deep within icy caves. Its frilled plating wards off ambushes, and the surrounding air drops by ten degrees as it slumbers.
rows.translation: POKENAME蜷成球，睡在冰洞深处。褶边般的甲片，能抵御伏击；沉睡时，周围气温，还会下降十度。
rows.reason: air drops by ten degrees→气温下降十度，保温差而非绝对温度；原未给温标，现译也未加摄氏/华氏。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME蜷成球，睡在冰洞深处。褶边般的甲片，能抵御伏击；沉睡时，周围气温，还会下降十度。

rows.source: In tight-knit packs, POKENAME scuttles through caverns in search of silver ore. A single group can consume over 50 tons in just one week.
rows.translation: POKENAME结成关系紧密的群体，爬过洞穴，寻找银矿。一群只需一周，就能吃掉五十多吨。
rows.reason: over 50 tons in one week→一周五十多吨，超过、吨及每周统计口径均正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME结成关系紧密的群体，爬过洞穴，寻找银矿。一群只需一周，就能吃掉五十多吨。

rows.source: These Pokémon were found to be extremely useful as high-output capacitors when linked to machinery through the gear on their backs. While it is unknown how much energy they can store, they are able to output at 100,000 MWh for extended durations.
rows.translation: 人们发现，用背部齿轮连接机器后，这些宝可梦能充当极其有用的高输出电容器。储能上限虽然不明，却能长时间持续输出，高达十万兆瓦时的能量。
rows.reason: 100,000 MWh→十万兆瓦时。MWh为能量单位，译文仍写能量，未擅换MW功率或另添每小时。源文output at...for extended durations量纲措辞不严谨是原文问题。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 人们发现，用背部齿轮连接机器后，这些宝可梦能充当极其有用的高输出电容器。储能上限虽然不明，却能长时间持续输出，高达十万兆瓦时的能量。

rows.source: This Pokémon seems unaccustomed to having a third gear, so it sometimes falls out of sync, resulting in all three gears locking and grinding. However, when the gears are perfectly in sync, POKENAME's power is noticeably boosted.
rows.translation: 这种宝可梦，似乎不习惯第三枚齿轮，偶尔不同步，就会让三枚齿轮一起卡住、磨响。不过，完全同步时，POKENAME的力量，会明显增强。
rows.reason: third gear、all three→第三枚、三枚，齿轮总数与序数都保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 这种宝可梦，似乎不习惯第三枚齿轮，偶尔不同步，就会让三枚齿轮一起卡住、磨响。不过，完全同步时，POKENAME的力量，会明显增强。

rows.source: POKENAME releases clouds of yellow grease-scented powder when happy. Machines nearby operate at twice their normal speed when exposed to this powder.
rows.translation: POKENAME开心时，会放出带润滑油气味的黄色粉云。附近的机器，一接触粉末，就会以正常的两倍速度运转。
rows.reason: twice normal speed→正常的两倍速度，未误作增加两倍至三倍。

rows.source: POKENAME's body is covered in metal scales that spark when it leaps from the water. It can leap up to 10 feet above the surface to bite prey such as Wingull.
rows.translation: POKENAME全身覆着金属鳞片，跃出水面时，会闪出火花。它最高能跃到水面上方十英尺，咬住长翅鸥一类的猎物。
rows.reason: up to 10 feet above water→最高水面上方十英尺，上限与高度基准水面均正确。

rows.source: POKENAME are often found inside factory machines, fitting their pad in between in order to spin and generate energy. In the wild, POKENAME generate energy by spinning with one another.
rows.translation: POKENAME常钻进工厂机器，将莲叶嵌在其中，旋转发电。野外，它们则互相配合旋转，产生能量。
rows.reason: one another为彼此配合，不是只一只的计量；译互相配合正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME常钻进工厂机器，将莲叶嵌在其中，旋转发电。野外，它们则互相配合旋转，产生能量。

rows.source: The oddly-arranged machine Pokémon occasionally separates itself before rearranging the three units' positions. It's thought that the differing arrangements help POKENAME focus on specific functions like battling or computing.
rows.translation: 这种构造奇特的机械宝可梦，偶尔会先分离，再重排三个单元的位置。人们认为，不同排列，能帮助POKENAME专注战斗、计算等特定功能。
rows.reason: three units→三个单元，重排的位置数量保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 这种构造奇特的机械宝可梦，偶尔会先分离，再重排三个单元的位置。人们认为，不同排列，能帮助POKENAME专注战斗、计算等特定功能。

rows.source: POKENAME have strong arms and claws, though they rarely like to use their strength for fighting. They can change their appearance while resting to avoid fights, and they are only active for around 2 hours each day.
rows.translation: POKENAME的手臂与爪子强壮，却很少喜欢用力量争斗。休息时，它变换模样，避免冲突，每天只活动两小时左右。
rows.reason: only active around 2 hours each day→每天只活动两小时左右，约数、每日与只的限制都保留。

rows.source: With a simple wave of the twig it carries, POKENAME can cast an illusion on itself to mimic anyone within 20 feet. This illusion can move exactly like its subject.
rows.translation: POKENAME只需轻挥手中细枝，就能施展幻象，模仿二十英尺内的任何人。幻象的动作，也能与本尊完全一致。
rows.reason: within 20 feet→二十英尺内，范围上界与单位正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME只需轻挥手中细枝，就能施展幻象，模仿二十英尺内的任何人。幻象的动作，也能与本尊完全一致。

rows.source: The flame on POKENAME's tail flares up or dims in accordance to its mood. When overjoyed, it crackles and burns brightly casting off occasional 1s and 0s while it burns.
rows.translation: POKENAME的尾火，随心情明灭。欣喜若狂时，火焰噼啪燃得明亮，还会偶尔迸出，数字1和0。
rows.reason: 1s and 0s是二进制符号，译数字1和0；不是时间或单位换算。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的尾火，随心情明灭。欣喜若狂时，火焰噼啪燃得明亮，还会偶尔迸出，数字1和0。

rows.source: POKENAME turns its head following the sun out of admiration rather than necessity. On cloudy days, they gather together, one using the light of their flames to pretend they are the sun, the rest turning their heads as they normally would.
rows.translation: POKENAME追随太阳转头，是出于喜爱，并非出于需要。阴天时，它们会聚在一起，由一只用火光假扮太阳，其余照常，跟着转头。
rows.reason: one假扮太阳、the rest转头→一只与其余，角色数量没有颠倒；未添固定总群数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME追随太阳转头，是出于喜爱，并非出于需要。阴天时，它们会聚在一起，由一只用火光假扮太阳，其余照常，跟着转头。

rows.source: POKENAME built themselves a disguise out of old traditional theater costumes. Sometimes a POKENAME will join the New Year's celebration as one of the legendary-Pokémon dancers, just to see the happy faces of everyone watching the event.
rows.translation: POKENAME用旧的传统戏服，搭起伪装。有时，它会加入新年庆典的传说宝可梦舞队，只为看看，观众欢乐的笑脸。
rows.reason: one of the dancers为舞队成员身份，非一个新年/一年量；译加入舞队无数值遗漏。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME用旧的传统戏服，搭起伪装。有时，它会加入新年庆典的传说宝可梦舞队，只为看看，观众欢乐的笑脸。

rows.source: POKENAME hides in its keystone, waiting to pop out and scare any who walk by it. Only after scaring 108 people or Pokémon, POKENAME retreats back into its keystone to sleep.
rows.translation: POKENAME藏在楔石中，等路人经过，就跳出吓唬。只有吓满一百零八个人或宝可梦，它才会缩回楔石，睡觉。
rows.reason: only after 108→只有吓满一百零八个才退回，阈值和顺序正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME藏在楔石中，等路人经过，就跳出吓唬。只有吓满一百零八个人或宝可梦，它才会缩回楔石，睡觉。

rows.source: It throws punches from its two fists in the front or the open hole in the back of its costume. In the dark, its punches stretch further, sometimes enough to put more holes in POKENAME's rags.
rows.translation: 它能用前方双拳，或从装束背后的开口，挥出拳头。黑暗中，拳能伸得更远，有时甚至把POKENAME的破布，撑出更多洞。
rows.reason: two front fists→前方双拳；后方另有开口，未把拳数改成三。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 它能用前方双拳，或从装束背后的开口，挥出拳头。黑暗中，拳能伸得更远，有时甚至把POKENAME的破布，撑出更多洞。

rows.source: POKENAME trots about as fast as it can, its disguise flopping around as it does. It dreams of one day being able to run as fast as Rapidash, and race alongside it.
rows.translation: POKENAME尽力小跑，装束随之晃来晃去。它梦想有一天，能跑得像烈焰马一样快，与它并肩竞速。
rows.reason: one day表示将来梦想，有一天对应；无一天内赶上烈焰马的保证。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME尽力小跑，装束随之晃来晃去。它梦想有一天，能跑得像烈焰马一样快，与它并肩竞速。

rows.source: Despite the costume getting soaked, POKENAME likes to fish exactly like a real Slowpoke. Most Slowpoke don't even notice that POKENAME isn't one of them, and if they do notice, they usually forget a minute later anyway.
rows.translation: POKENAME即使装束湿透，也喜欢像真正的呆呆兽一样钓鱼。多数呆呆兽，根本没发现它不是同类；即使发现，通常过一分钟，也就忘了。
rows.reason: a minute later→过一分钟，单位与时长正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME即使装束湿透，也喜欢像真正的呆呆兽一样钓鱼。多数呆呆兽，根本没发现它不是同类；即使发现，通常过一分钟，也就忘了。

rows.source: POKENAME's incredibly hot body distorts clouds as it flies through them. When a flock gathers in a forest, the surrounding temperature rises by 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
rows.translation: POKENAME的身体异常炽热，飞过云层，连云也会变形。一群聚在森林，周围温度，就会上升华氏十度。
rows.reason: temperature rises by 10 degrees Fahrenheit→温度上升华氏十度。明确是+10°F温差，未改成10°C，也未当成绝对10°F。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的身体异常炽热，飞过云层，连云也会变形。一群聚在森林，周围温度，就会上升华氏十度。

rows.source: At the dawn of every month, POKENAME will have an airborne dance celebrating the sunrise using the two whips within its arms. The whip on the right arm is drenched in venom, while the whip in the left is engulfed in flames.
rows.translation: 每月之初的黎明，POKENAME会在空中起舞，用臂内两条长鞭，庆祝日出。右臂的鞭浸满毒液，左臂的鞭，则裹着火焰。
rows.reason: every month at dawn→每月之初黎明；two whips→两鞭，右毒左火的分配也未交换。

rows.source: POKENAME were recently discovered after a group bit through an autonomous submarine exploring the depths of the ocean, likely thinking it was food. They navigate their territories by taste, leading many to exhibit scarring from biting one another.
rows.translation: 一群POKENAME咬穿探索深海的自主潜艇，大概以为是食物，才在最近被发现。它们靠味觉，探索领地，因此许多个体，都留下互咬的伤痕。
rows.reason: a group仅指一群，不给具体数量；译一群，没有造数或单位。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 一群POKENAME咬穿探索深海的自主潜艇，大概以为是食物，才在最近被发现。它们靠味觉，探索领地，因此许多个体，都留下互咬的伤痕。

rows.source: POKENAME lacks a normal pair of eyes, causing it to float around aimlessly for much of its life. An eye on its stomach is said to open once every 5 years, and supposedly POKENAME will grant a wish to the first person it sees with said eye.
rows.translation: POKENAME没有正常的双眼，一生大多时间，都在漫无目的地漂浮。据说，腹眼每五年才睁开一次，能为这只眼看见的第一个人，实现一个愿望。
rows.reason: once every 5 years→每五年一次；first person→第一个人，周期与序数正确，传闻限定保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME没有正常的双眼，一生大多时间，都在漫无目的地漂浮。据说，腹眼每五年才睁开一次，能为这只眼看见的第一个人，实现一个愿望。

rows.source: While one of POKENAME's heads is completely blind, the other has nearly perfect vision and can see for miles away. This has led to a situation where one head constantly grooms their body while the other keeps them moving through the world.
rows.translation: POKENAME一头全盲，另一头视力却近乎完美，能看出几英里远。因此，一个头不停梳理身体，另一个，负责带着它们前行。
rows.reason: one blind/other视力良好及miles away→一头/另一头、几英里；未增加具体公里数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME一头全盲，另一头视力却近乎完美，能看出几英里远。因此，一个头不停梳理身体，另一个，负责带着它们前行。

rows.source: POKENAME enjoys playing games with others, but its two heads squabble over what games to play. Oftentimes, its prospective playmate has left by the time the two heads have finished fighting amongst themselves.
rows.translation: POKENAME喜欢与别人玩游戏，两个头，却总争论玩什么。往往等争吵结束，原本要陪它的玩伴，早已走了。
rows.reason: two heads→两个头，先争吵后玩伴离开的先后保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME喜欢与别人玩游戏，两个头，却总争论玩什么。往往等争吵结束，原本要陪它的玩伴，早已走了。

rows.source: POKENAME spend hours bickering amongst their heads. When one gets fed up, they will zip the other head shut.
rows.translation: POKENAME的两个头，会争吵好几个小时。一头受够了，就把另一头的拉链拉上，封住对方。
rows.reason: hours→好几个小时，无固定小时值；一头/另一头的双头叙述无数字遗漏。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的两个头，会争吵好几个小时。一头受够了，就把另一头的拉链拉上，封住对方。

rows.source: The heads on the ends of its two tails are used by the central head to look in multiple directions at the same time. When both of them bite down on the same foe, it completes an electrical circuit and delivers a high-voltage shock.
rows.translation: 中央头，利用两条尾巴末端的头，同时看向多个方向。两头一咬住同一个敌人，就会接成电路，发出高压电击。
rows.reason: two tail heads及both咬同一敌人→两条尾巴末端的头、两头同时咬同一敌人，电路成立条件没有丢失。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 中央头，利用两条尾巴末端的头，同时看向多个方向。两头一咬住同一个敌人，就会接成电路，发出高压电击。

rows.source: When enraged, POKENAME has been reported to manifest up to 1,000 additional heads. These apparitions strike in perfect unison before vanishing without trace.
rows.translation: 据报告，POKENAME暴怒时，能额外幻出最多一千个头。这些虚影，完美同步地攻击，再消失得无影无踪。
rows.reason: up to 1,000 additional heads→额外幻出最多一千个头，保额外与上限，而非总共一千。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 据报告，POKENAME暴怒时，能额外幻出最多一千个头。这些虚影，完美同步地攻击，再消失得无影无踪。

rows.source: The three heads of these Pokémon are often seen arguing with each other because, strangely, they each seem to be more active during different times of the day. All three heads are fully alert during battle, which is when they display a fierce power.
rows.translation: 这些宝可梦的三个头，常争吵不休，奇怪的是，各自在一天的不同时段，更加活跃。战斗时，三头全都清醒，才显出凶悍力量。
rows.reason: three heads/all three→三个头/三头；一天不同时段活跃不被改成三个固定时刻。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 这些宝可梦的三个头，常争吵不休，奇怪的是，各自在一天的不同时段，更加活跃。战斗时，三头全都清醒，才显出凶悍力量。

rows.source: POKENAME's claws and shell all bear markings that make it appear to be a group, making predators think twice about attacking. Sometimes, when lonely, it will talk to its own claws, and then pretend they are responding back.
rows.translation: POKENAME钳子与壳都有花纹，看着像一群，让天敌下手前多想一想。有时寂寞，会与自己的钳子说话，再假装得到回应。
rows.reason: think twice是三思的惯用语，非必须思考两次；译多想一想正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME钳子与壳都有花纹，看着像一群，让天敌下手前多想一想。有时寂寞，会与自己的钳子说话，再假装得到回应。

rows.source: POKENAME have an insatiable appetite because of their powerful stomach acid. They can eat twice their weight in leaves and still feel hungry enough for more.
rows.translation: POKENAME胃酸强，食欲永不满足。能吃下体重两倍的叶子，却仍饿得还想再吃。
rows.reason: twice its weight→体重两倍的叶子，比例2:1正确，未误成增重两倍或三倍。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME胃酸强，食欲永不满足。能吃下体重两倍的叶子，却仍饿得还想再吃。

rows.source: POKENAME lets loose a Kebia Berry scent to attract Bug Pokémon, then bites them. The scent is so strong it can be smelled over a hundred feet away, drawing prey in from large distances.
rows.translation: POKENAME放出通通果香，吸引虫宝可梦，再咬住。香味百余英尺外都能闻到，能引来远处猎物。
rows.reason: over a hundred feet→百余英尺外，严格超过关系与英尺单位正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME放出通通果香，吸引虫宝可梦，再咬住。香味百余英尺外都能闻到，能引来远处猎物。

rows.source: POKENAME's tongue can extend up to 10 feet from its body. The pollen it releases mimics the taste of whatever food it has last consumed, luring Pokémon based on the familiar scent.
rows.translation: POKENAME舌头最远能伸出体外10英尺。释放的花粉模仿最后吃下的食物味道，靠熟悉的气味引来宝可梦。
rows.reason: up to 10 feet→最远10英尺，上限与相对身体伸出距离正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME舌头最远能伸出体外10英尺。释放的花粉模仿最后吃下的食物味道，靠熟悉的气味引来宝可梦。

rows.source: POKENAME use their legs as their main tool for surviving. They can let loose 10 kicks per second and are able to hang themselves upside down on branches to hide.
rows.translation: POKENAME主要靠双腿生存。每秒能踢出10脚，还能倒挂树枝，藏住自己。
rows.reason: 10 kicks per second→每秒10脚，频率口径没有倒成10秒一脚。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME主要靠双腿生存。每秒能踢出10脚，还能倒挂树枝，藏住自己。

rows.source: POKENAME sleeps all day, with an aromatic drool dripping from its mouth and enticing insects inside, which it instinctively eats. When disturbed, it unleashes all of its stored power for one devastating attack before falling back asleep.
rows.translation: POKENAME整天睡觉，芳香口水从嘴里滴下，引来昆虫，本能地吃掉。受扰后，用全部积蓄力量打出威猛一击，再回去睡。
rows.reason: one devastating attack→威猛一击，全部积蓄能量仅供一次的数量正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME整天睡觉，芳香口水从嘴里滴下，引来昆虫，本能地吃掉。受扰后，用全部积蓄力量打出威猛一击，再回去睡。

rows.source: These Pokémon have a total of six eyes and three mouths that somehow manage to connect to the same stomach while also connecting to each other. The confusing biology of POKENAME has puzzled researchers for many years.
rows.translation: POKENAME共有六只眼、三张嘴，不知为何，嘴既相互连通，又连着同一个胃。这套混乱生理结构，困扰研究者多年。

rows.source: POKENAME typically lives in shady parts of dense forests. It swings the vine connected to its mouth to lure Bug-type Pokémon for food. Researchers discovered that after POKENAME consumes 108 Bug-types it travels to another forest.
rows.translation: POKENAME通常生活在密林的阴暗处，摆动连接嘴部的藤蔓，引诱虫属性宝可梦进食。研究人员发现，它吃下108只虫属性宝可梦后，就会前往另一片森林。
rows.reason: after 108 Bug-types→吃108只后迁移，触发数和之后关系正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME通常生活在密林的阴暗处，摆动连接嘴部的藤蔓，引诱虫属性宝可梦进食。研究人员发现，它吃下108只虫属性宝可梦后，就会前往另一片森林。

rows.source: POKENAME grabs prey with its leaf and eats it in one piece. Its aggressive stomach acid decomposes everything it devours within a few minutes, and it can speed up the process by rapidly rotating its body.
rows.translation: POKENAME用叶片抓住猎物，整个吃掉。强酸性的胃液几分钟内就能分解吞下的一切，它还会快速旋转身体，加速这一过程。

rows.source: POKENAME are often seen during full moon night, flying swiftly and silently, searching for a corpse. When they find one, they roost close to it and swallow the corpse in a single bite, before letting it dissolve for days in their stomachs.
rows.translation: 满月之夜，常能见到POKENAME迅速而无声地飞行，寻找尸体。找到后，它便落在附近，一口吞下尸体，再花几天时间在胃里溶解。

rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 满月之夜，常能见到POKENAME迅速而无声地飞行，寻找尸体。找到后，它便落在附近，一口吞下尸体，再花几天时间在胃里溶解。

rows.source: A ruthless apex predator on land and water, POKENAME uses its toxic, razor-sharp leaves to attack and defend. It can overpower and digest prey ten times its size.
rows.translation: POKENAME是水陆两栖的无情顶级捕食者，用有毒、锋利如剃刀的叶片攻防。它能制服并消化体形十倍于自己的猎物。

rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME是水陆两栖的无情顶级捕食者，用有毒、锋利如剃刀的叶片攻防。它能制服并消化体形十倍于自己的猎物。

rows.source: POKENAME have three separate stomachs that connect to one intestinal system, which make them quite ravenous creatures. They eat a high protein diet of Bug-type Pokémon to keep themselves full as long as possible.
rows.translation: POKENAME有三个独立的胃，连接着同一套肠道，因此食欲相当惊人。它会吃高蛋白的虫属性宝可梦，尽量让饱腹感维持得更久。
rows.reason: three separate stomachs to one intestinal system→三独立胃、同一套肠道，数量和独立/共享关系正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME有三个独立的胃，连接着同一套肠道，因此食欲相当惊人。它会吃高蛋白的虫属性宝可梦，尽量让饱腹感维持得更久。

rows.source: The red on POKENAME's gem signifies danger, as one touch causes agonising pain for up to 12 hours. It is possible to become immune to its poison by diluting it and building up the dosage. Anyone who keeps one is recommended to do this.
rows.translation: POKENAME宝石上的红色象征危险，只要碰一下，就会引发最长持续12小时的剧痛。将毒液稀释，再逐渐增加用量，可以获得对其毒素的免疫力。饲养它的人也被建议采取这种做法。
rows.reason: up to 12 hours→最长12小时疼痛，保上限及小时，不改为至少12小时。仅审虚构毒素叙述，不追加现实用量建议。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME宝石上的红色象征危险，只要碰一下，就会引发最长持续12小时的剧痛。将毒液稀释，再逐渐增加用量，可以获得对其毒素的免疫力。饲养它的人也被建议采取这种做法。

rows.source: POKENAME launches the gemlike spikes on its venomous tentacles as missiles. It shows a marked preference for hunting Corsola and can hit one from over 30 meters away.
rows.translation: POKENAME把有毒触手上宝石般的尖刺当作飞弹发射。它特别偏爱捕猎太阳珊瑚，能从超过30米外命中目标。
rows.reason: over 30 meters→超过30米外，严格超过与单位米正确。

rows.source: POKENAME nests on small deserted islands, with up to 20 individuals burying beneath the sand. They emerge at night to hunt prey such as Goldeen.
rows.translation: POKENAME在小型荒岛上筑巢，最多20只一同埋在沙下。它们夜间才会出现，捕猎角金鱼等猎物。
rows.reason: up to 20 individuals→最多20只，群体上限保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME在小型荒岛上筑巢，最多20只一同埋在沙下。它们夜间才会出现，捕猎角金鱼等猎物。

rows.source: POKENAME acts as a sort of big sibling to young Aron or Phanpy in the wild. Quick on its feet and with a sturdy iron coating, it can easily take on Pokémon that would otherwise trouble the others.
rows.translation: 野外的POKENAME，就像幼小可可多拉与小小象的兄长。它动作敏捷，披着坚固的铁甲，能轻松应对那些会给小家伙们带来麻烦的宝可梦。

rows.source: POKENAME are able to swim through sand as if it were water, leaping out to swallow their prey whole. Occasionally, these Pokémon will mistakenly swallow Cacnea, leaving them ill for a couple of days.
rows.translation: POKENAME能像游水一样，游过沙子，再跃出，将猎物整个吞下。偶尔，它们会误吞刺球仙人掌，难受上几天。

rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME能像游水一样，游过沙子，再跃出，将猎物整个吞下。偶尔，它们会误吞刺球仙人掌，难受上几天。

rows.source: When POKENAME rolls across the desert, it leaves behind tracks resembling the tire of an off-road vehicle. It is mainly active during the day, resting at night in its den dug beneath the sand.
rows.translation: POKENAME滚过沙漠，留下的痕迹，像越野车的轮胎印。它主要白天活动，夜里则在沙下挖出的巢穴休息。
rows.reason: during day/at night→白天/夜里，非计量数字；没有时段反转。

rows.source: When POKENAME were first discovered in ancient times, they were thought of as a peculiar and belligerent desert tribespeople. Social, territorial, and highly intelligent, they occupy essentially the same role today.
rows.translation: 古时初次发现POKENAME，人们将它们视为奇特而好斗的沙漠部族。直到今天，这些群居、领地意识强、极其聪明的宝可梦，仍像一支沙漠部族。
rows.reason: ancient times/today是时代词，非次数计量；古时/直到今天正确。

rows.source: POKENAME buries itself in the desert, eating its weight in sand over the course of a month. It can open its jaws far wider than a first glance would suggest, consuming huge chunks of the desert ground in a single bite.
rows.translation: POKENAME埋在沙漠里，一个月会吃下与自身体重相当的沙子。双颚张开的幅度，远比乍看大得多，一口，就能吞下大块沙漠地面。

rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME埋在沙漠里，一个月会吃下与自身体重相当的沙子。双颚张开的幅度，远比乍看大得多，一口，就能吞下大块沙漠地面。

rows.source: POKENAME bury themselves within sand dunes during the day and wait for other Pokémon to pass by so they can ambush them. At night, they shake themselves free with their large wings, flying through the dark to find a new hiding spot for the morning.
rows.translation: POKENAME白天埋在沙丘里，等待其他宝可梦经过，发动伏击。夜里，它用大翅膀抖开沙子，飞过黑暗，为清晨寻找新的藏身处。
rows.reason: 白天伏击、夜里换藏身处、清晨准备的时间段关系正确，无明确数值。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME白天埋在沙丘里，等待其他宝可梦经过，发动伏击。夜里，它用大翅膀抖开沙子，飞过黑暗，为清晨寻找新的藏身处。

rows.source: POKENAME stalk through deserts in search of prey, prowling across sand dunes and feeling minute vibrations in the sand through their whiskers. When they sense prey approaching, they pounce mouth-first, delivering a nasty Bite.
rows.translation: POKENAME越过沙丘，在沙漠潜行觅食，用胡须感知沙中细微的震动。猎物一靠近，它们便大嘴朝前，猛扑过去，使出凶狠的咬住。

rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME越过沙丘，在沙漠潜行觅食，用胡须感知沙中细微的震动。猎物一靠近，它们便大嘴朝前，猛扑过去，使出凶狠的咬住。

rows.source: POKENAME live most of their time hiding in the sand of a desert. They rarely return to the surface, as they can live on minimal food for weeks at a time. If spotted, they will rapidly flap their wings to kick up sand to obscure others' vision.
rows.translation: POKENAME大多时间，都藏在沙漠的沙里。只需极少食物，就能维生数周，因此很少回到地面。若被发现，它们就会快速振翅，扬沙，遮住旁人的视线。
rows.reason: minimal food for weeks at a time→极少食物维生数周，未换成数月或给出精确周数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME大多时间，都藏在沙漠的沙里。只需极少食物，就能维生数周，因此很少回到地面。若被发现，它们就会快速振翅，扬沙，遮住旁人的视线。

rows.source: POKENAME's heavy tail leaves it unable to move well either on land or in the water. It feebly bounces on its tail during times of stress in an attempt to calm itself.
rows.translation: POKENAME的尾巴沉重，使它在陆地与水里，都行动不便。紧张时，它会无力地用尾巴弹跳，试着让自己平静。
rows.reason: times of stress是紧张之时，不是次数倍率；译紧张时，无数值问题。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的尾巴沉重，使它在陆地与水里，都行动不便。紧张时，它会无力地用尾巴弹跳，试着让自己平静。

rows.source: When it is mocked by other Pokémon for its appearance, POKENAME digs a hole at the bottom of its lake and stays there for days, crying. It combs the beaches in search of objects that might make it look prettier and more elegant.
rows.translation: POKENAME若因外貌，被其他宝可梦嘲笑，就会在湖底挖个洞，躲进去，哭上好几天。它也会四处搜索海滩，寻找能让自己更加漂亮、优雅的物件。
rows.reason: for days→哭上好几天，持续日单位保留，无指定天数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME若因外貌，被其他宝可梦嘲笑，就会在湖底挖个洞，躲进去，哭上好几天。它也会四处搜索海滩，寻找能让自己更加漂亮、优雅的物件。

rows.source: POKENAME whiles away its days with constant eating and sleeping. Dream analysis shows that a majority of its dreams involve it being able to fly through the skies.
rows.translation: POKENAME整天吃吃睡睡，打发时光。梦境分析显示，它大多数梦里，都在天空飞翔。
rows.reason: whiles away its days为打发时光，译整天吃睡；非固定数天限制。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME整天吃吃睡睡，打发时光。梦境分析显示，它大多数梦里，都在天空飞翔。

rows.source: POKENAME swoop at one another headfirst, using their hardened skulls to bash into their rivals at high speed. The sound of the clash between them is loud enough to be heard from hundreds of meters away.
rows.translation: POKENAME头朝前，互相俯冲，用坚硬的头骨，高速撞击对手。交锋的声音，响得从数百米外，都能听见。
rows.reason: hundreds of meters→数百米，复数数量级和米单位正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME头朝前，互相俯冲，用坚硬的头骨，高速撞击对手。交锋的声音，响得从数百米外，都能听见。

rows.source: POKENAME practice using telekinesis to fulfill their dream of flight. However, their powers are still developing, allowing them to hover only a few inches high for a couple of seconds at a time.
rows.translation: POKENAME练习用念动力，实现飞行的梦想。不过，力量仍在成长，每次只能离地几英寸，悬浮两秒左右。
rows.reason: only a few inches→只能离地几英寸；a couple of seconds→两秒左右，两个近似尺度及每次时长正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME练习用念动力，实现飞行的梦想。不过，力量仍在成长，每次只能离地几英寸，悬浮两秒左右。

rows.source: POKENAME casts itself from the highest peaks to practice for the day it will finally fly. Its massive size and strength mean the impact tremor it creates hitting the ground can be felt from hundreds of yards away.
rows.translation: POKENAME从最高的山峰跃下，为终于会飞的那一天练习。庞大的体型与力量，使落地的震荡，从数百码外，也能感觉到。
rows.reason: hundreds of yards away→数百码外，未把码换为米或英里。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME从最高的山峰跃下，为终于会飞的那一天练习。庞大的体型与力量，使落地的震荡，从数百码外，也能感觉到。

rows.source: POKENAME's exterior shell is almost impenetrable, but the heavy weight and huge size means it swims at an incredibly slow pace. It filter-feeds at the ocean bottom, awaiting the day it sheds its shell and can swim more freely.
rows.translation: POKENAME的外壳几乎无法穿透，可重量与体积庞大，游泳极其缓慢。它在海底滤食，等待蜕壳的那一天，好能更自由地游动。
rows.reason: the day it sheds是蜕壳之日的将来时点，不是一日期限；无数值遗漏。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的外壳几乎无法穿透，可重量与体积庞大，游泳极其缓慢。它在海底滤食，等待蜕壳的那一天，好能更自由地游动。

rows.source: POKENAME have never been observed outside of their shells, the true structure of their head remaining unknown to researchers. Their shells are several inches thick and are reinforced with crystalline growths, forming an incredibly tough defence.
rows.translation: 从未有人见过POKENAME离开外壳，头部的真实构造，对研究者仍是谜。数英寸厚的外壳，长有水晶加固，形成异常坚韧的防御。
rows.reason: several inches thick→数英寸厚，单位英寸与不定数正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 从未有人见过POKENAME离开外壳，头部的真实构造，对研究者仍是谜。数英寸厚的外壳，长有水晶加固，形成异常坚韧的防御。

rows.source: POKENAME makes its nest near hydroelectric power plants, latching onto them to siphon power at night. During the day, it has an odd ability to increase the plant's productivity.
rows.translation: POKENAME在水力发电厂附近筑巢，夜里附在厂上，吸取电力。到了白天，它却有一种奇特本领，能提高电厂的产能。
rows.reason: 夜间吸电、白天提高产能的时段相反效应保留，无明示输出数量。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME在水力发电厂附近筑巢，夜里附在厂上，吸取电力。到了白天，它却有一种奇特本领，能提高电厂的产能。

rows.source: Turning the key on POKENAME's head a few times boosts its energy, hastening its speed and increasing its strength. Turning too much will cause it to act haywire or even collapse completely, however.
rows.translation: 将POKENAME头上的钥匙，转动几圈，就能补充能量，提高速度与力量。不过，转得太多，它就会失控，甚至彻底瘫倒。
rows.reason: a few times→几圈；转太多会失控的条件保留，未指定圈数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 将POKENAME头上的钥匙，转动几圈，就能补充能量，提高速度与力量。不过，转得太多，它就会失控，甚至彻底瘫倒。

rows.source: POKENAME rotates itself rapidly at all times, seemingly as a way to keep itself energized and aloft. If it stops, its eye dims quickly and it would presumably perish in an incredibly short amount of time.
rows.translation: POKENAME随时都在飞快旋转，似乎为了维持能量与悬浮。一旦停下，眼睛便迅速黯淡，人们推测，极短时间内，它就会死去。
rows.reason: at all times及short amount of time→随时、极短时间，未造秒数；死亡仍为推测。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME随时都在飞快旋转，似乎为了维持能量与悬浮。一旦停下，眼睛便迅速黯淡，人们推测，极短时间内，它就会死去。

rows.source: POKENAME's head rotates continuously in a clockwise direction. The springs on its legs enable it to jump over ten meters into the air.
rows.translation: POKENAME的头，不停顺时针旋转。腿上的弹簧，让它能跃到超过十米的空中。
rows.reason: over ten meters→超过十米，严格超过与米单位正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的头，不停顺时针旋转。腿上的弹簧，让它能跃到超过十米的空中。

rows.source: POKENAME can sing beautiful melodies for hours at a time. However, they are often too timid to do so, changing their appearances to avoid even showing their faces.
rows.translation: POKENAME能连续好几个小时，唱出美丽的旋律。不过，它们往往害羞得不敢唱，甚至改变模样，连脸都不愿露出。
rows.reason: for hours at a time→连续好几个小时，未换成分钟。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME能连续好几个小时，唱出美丽的旋律。不过，它们往往害羞得不敢唱，甚至改变模样，连脸都不愿露出。

rows.source: POKENAME can soar through the skies for hours at a time, changing their appearance while flying to stay undetected. Their feathers are as beautiful as they are rare, fetching a high price for collectors.
rows.translation: POKENAME一次能在空中，翱翔数小时，飞行时变换模样，避免被察觉。羽毛既美丽又稀有，在收藏者眼中，价值极高。
rows.reason: for hours at a time→一次翱翔数小时，持续小时口径正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME一次能在空中，翱翔数小时，飞行时变换模样，避免被察觉。羽毛既美丽又稀有，在收藏者眼中，价值极高。

rows.source: POKENAME can go weeks undetected while mimicking other Pokémon. It maintains a calming aura throughout this time, fleeing the moment it lapses even briefly.
rows.translation: POKENAME模仿其他宝可梦，数周也不被发现。期间，它始终维持平和的气息；哪怕短暂中断，也会立刻逃走。
rows.reason: weeks undetected→数周不被发现，持续周单位正确；短暂中断即逃也保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME模仿其他宝可梦，数周也不被发现。期间，它始终维持平和的气息；哪怕短暂中断，也会立刻逃走。

rows.source: POKENAME uses its flaming bone as a torch to light its way through caves and avoid fear of the dark. If the skull it wears is damaged, it cries all day.
rows.translation: POKENAME把燃烧的骨头当火把，照亮洞中道路，免得害怕黑暗。戴着的头骨若受损，它就会哭上一整天。
rows.reason: all day→一整天哭泣，不是给出24小时持续生理指标；无遗漏。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME把燃烧的骨头当火把，照亮洞中道路，免得害怕黑暗。戴着的头骨若受损，它就会哭上一整天。

rows.source: Supposedly, the seen body of this Pokémon is the shed shell of a bug Pokémon being inhabited by its true body. Its shadowy arms can serve as wings that can carry it for miles without needing to rest.
rows.translation: 据说，这种宝可梦可见的身体，是由真身寄居其中的虫宝可梦蜕壳。影子手臂，也能当翅膀，载着它飞出数英里，不必休息。
rows.reason: for miles without rest→飞出数英里不休息，距离单位与不休息条件正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 据说，这种宝可梦可见的身体，是由真身寄居其中的虫宝可梦蜕壳。影子手臂，也能当翅膀，载着它飞出数英里，不必休息。

rows.source: POKENAME goes around dark alleyways and offers passersby its custom-made keys...for a price. The price is to be its friend and play with it for an hour per key.
rows.translation: POKENAME在暗巷游走，向路人提供定制钥匙，不过有代价：成为它的朋友，每拿一把钥匙，就陪它玩一小时。
rows.reason: an hour per key→每一把钥匙陪玩一小时，计费比例与时长正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME在暗巷游走，向路人提供定制钥匙，不过有代价：成为它的朋友，每拿一把钥匙，就陪它玩一小时。

rows.source: Although the sound is slightly muffled by the disguise it wears, POKENAME has a beautiful singing voice. POKENAME usually sings songs it knows are popular, but will perform its own original compositions if the audience demands it enough times.
rows.translation: POKENAME的歌声美妙，虽然隔着伪装，略显闷弱。它通常唱流行曲，不过，观众若反复请求，也会演唱自己的原创作品。
rows.reason: enough times为反复请求，无固定次数；译反复请求不失数值。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的歌声美妙，虽然隔着伪装，略显闷弱。它通常唱流行曲，不过，观众若反复请求，也会演唱自己的原创作品。

rows.source: POKENAME lies completely still during the day and only flies around at night. While its body is moved around by strings, these all disappear into a patch of darkness directly above it.
rows.translation: POKENAME白天完全不动，只在夜里飞行。身体被丝线带动，而这些线，全部消失在正上方的一团黑暗中。
rows.reason: 白天完全不动、只在夜里飞行，昼夜与only限制保留，无显式数量。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME白天完全不动，只在夜里飞行。身体被丝线带动，而这些线，全部消失在正上方的一团黑暗中。

rows.source: POKENAME spends months creating a disguise to mimic a meteor shower. It often performs its own display during meteor showers, though many consider it a nuisance during these events.
rows.translation: POKENAME花上几个月，做出模仿流星雨的伪装。真正流星雨出现时，它也常来表演，可许多人，只觉得它碍事。
rows.reason: months creating disguise→花几个月，单位月与复数数量级正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME花上几个月，做出模仿流星雨的伪装。真正流星雨出现时，它也常来表演，可许多人，只觉得它碍事。

rows.source: POKENAME wear a tire with a large pipe on their backs to hose down foes. The stream of water from their back has enough force to knock down a person from several feet away.
rows.translation: POKENAME背着轮胎，上面装有大管子，用来冲击敌人。背部水流的力量，足以从几英尺外，将一个人击倒。
rows.reason: several feet away→几英尺外，未误作数米。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME背着轮胎，上面装有大管子，用来冲击敌人。背部水流的力量，足以从几英尺外，将一个人击倒。

rows.source: POKENAME fashions a disguise complete with a pendulum from whatever materials it can gather. Its hypnotic powers are mild, but effective enough that it can temporarily hypnotize victims into being its friend for a few hours.
rows.translation: POKENAME用收集到的各种材料，做出带钟摆的伪装。催眠能力虽然微弱，却足以让受害者，暂时做几小时的朋友。
rows.reason: a few hours→几小时暂做朋友，小时单位与暂时性正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME用收集到的各种材料，做出带钟摆的伪装。催眠能力虽然微弱，却足以让受害者，暂时做几小时的朋友。

rows.source: This Pokémon is said to be that which heralds the dawn of a new day, rising from over the horizon as the sun takes to the sky. Each of its red-hot scales that it scatters about will burst into fireballs when it cries out.
rows.translation: 据说，这种宝可梦，是新一天黎明的先兆，太阳升起时，它便从地平线外现身。撒下的每片炽热鳞片，都会在它鸣叫时，爆成火球。
rows.reason: new day/dawn是一天黎明的时点，非数值单位；译新一天黎明保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 据说，这种宝可梦，是新一天黎明的先兆，太阳升起时，它便从地平线外现身。撒下的每片炽热鳞片，都会在它鸣叫时，爆成火球。

rows.source: POKENAME can sleep for several months within the magma inside a volcano, protected by a fiery shield its wings generate. If it springs awake suddenly and flies off, it's an indicator the volcano will erupt within the next day.
rows.translation: POKENAME能在火山岩浆里，睡上数月，靠翅膀产生的火盾保护。若突然醒来飞走，就表示火山，将在接下来的一天内喷发。
rows.reason: 睡several months→数月；火山within next day→接下来一天内，持续期与未来上限没有混淆。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME能在火山岩浆里，睡上数月，靠翅膀产生的火盾保护。若突然醒来飞走，就表示火山，将在接下来的一天内喷发。

rows.source: Because POKENAME seem to appear out of thin air after unusually cold summers, some people believe them to be the gift of a sun deity, promising that warm days will eventually return.
rows.translation: 异常寒冷的夏天过后，POKENAME似乎总凭空出现。因此，有人相信，它们是太阳神的礼物，预示温暖日子，终会回来。
rows.reason: warm days为温暖日子将返的预兆，无明确天数，未造日期。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 异常寒冷的夏天过后，POKENAME似乎总凭空出现。因此，有人相信，它们是太阳神的礼物，预示温暖日子，终会回来。

rows.source: POKENAME uses its ear-like arms to reach and grab low-hanging fruits. The limbs constantly generate heat, so holding its food for a few minutes will cook it thoroughly, making it even more delectable.
rows.translation: POKENAME用耳朵般的手臂，摘取低垂的果实。四肢不断发热，食物只需握上几分钟，就会彻底熟透，更加可口。
rows.reason: holding a few minutes cooks food→握几分钟熟透，分钟单位与少量时长保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME用耳朵般的手臂，摘取低垂的果实。四肢不断发热，食物只需握上几分钟，就会彻底熟透，更加可口。

rows.source: POKENAME can't fly and instead uses its wings to scatter spores whenever it senses danger. These spores cause a severe allergic reaction upon contact, making the damaged area look like a high-degree burn.
rows.translation: POKENAME不会飞，一感到危险，就用翅膀撒出孢子。接触会引发严重过敏，伤处看起来，如同重度烧伤。
rows.reason: high-degree burn为重度烧伤程度，非摄氏/华氏温度数值；译重度烧伤正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME不会飞，一感到危险，就用翅膀撒出孢子。接触会引发严重过敏，伤处看起来，如同重度烧伤。

rows.source: POKENAME roosts atop jungle canopies or volcanic peaks during the day, absorbing sunlight with its wings. It echolocates prey at night, expending the solar energy in a blinding flash when it catches its prey for an easy meal.
rows.translation: POKENAME白天栖在丛林树冠或火山峰顶，用翅膀吸收阳光。夜里靠回声定位捕猎，抓获时，消耗太阳能，放出刺眼闪光，轻松取得一餐。
rows.reason: 白天吸阳光、夜里回声捕猎的时段保留；无具体小时数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME白天栖在丛林树冠或火山峰顶，用翅膀吸收阳光。夜里靠回声定位捕猎，抓获时，消耗太阳能，放出刺眼闪光，轻松取得一餐。

rows.source: In ancient times, POKENAME was a sign of disaster. When it appeared on a city's shores, it signified that it was going to sink the city or protect it from the wrath of a legendary Pokémon.
rows.translation: 古时，POKENAME是灾难的征兆。出现在城市岸边，便意味着，它将使城市沉没，或保护城市，抵御传说宝可梦的怒火。
rows.reason: ancient times为古代，非次数；源未给具体年代，译未增年代。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 古时，POKENAME是灾难的征兆。出现在城市岸边，便意味着，它将使城市沉没，或保护城市，抵御传说宝可梦的怒火。

rows.source: POKENAME is almost entirely blind, but it can sense the world around it based on the tiny hairs around its neck vibrating from sounds. Should it get cornered, it will unleash a Dragon Breath from its second head.
rows.translation: POKENAME几乎全盲，却能靠声音震动颈边的细毛，感知世界。若被逼入绝境，它就从第二个头，放出龙息。
rows.reason: second head→第二个头，序数保留；无距离或时间单位。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME几乎全盲，却能靠声音震动颈边的细毛，感知世界。若被逼入绝境，它就从第二个头，放出龙息。

rows.source: POKENAME are consumed by a relentless rage to turn everything to mud. They use Muddy Water to cover lush landscapes in gallons of water, raising the water table until it resembles a marshland.
rows.translation: POKENAME被无尽怒火吞噬，想将一切化成泥。它用浊流，倾泻成加仑的水，覆盖葱郁大地，抬高地下水位，直到宛如沼泽。
rows.reason: gallons是不定加仑量，译成加仑的水，未擅给具体升数或强定美制/英制换算。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME被无尽怒火吞噬，想将一切化成泥。它用浊流，倾泻成加仑的水，覆盖葱郁大地，抬高地下水位，直到宛如沼泽。

rows.source: POKENAME is remarkably accurate when hurling objects, capable of pinpoint precision from hundreds of feet away. It fills its body with hot gas while flying high above, raining items down on foes below.
rows.translation: POKENAME投物精准，几百英尺外也能准确命中。高飞时，体内充满热气，把物件如雨般扔向下方敌人。
rows.reason: hundreds of feet→几百英尺，保数量级与英尺，未写成几百米。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME投物精准，几百英尺外也能准确命中。高飞时，体内充满热气，把物件如雨般扔向下方敌人。

rows.source: There was once a case where a wild POKENAME suddenly came out of nowhere and snatched up a child, only to return them an hour later. According to the child, POKENAME showed them their palace in the clouds. No such habitat for POKENAME has been found.
rows.translation: 曾有一只野生POKENAME不知从何处突然出现，抓走孩子，一小时后又送回。据孩子说，它展示了云中宫殿，却从未有人找到这样的栖息地。
rows.reason: an hour later→一小时后，时长单位正确，无额外约数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 曾有一只野生POKENAME不知从何处突然出现，抓走孩子，一小时后又送回。据孩子说，它展示了云中宫殿，却从未有人找到这样的栖息地。

rows.source: POKENAME's shell is surprisingly squishy, and they can often be seen playfully bouncing into each other in the wild. Whoever loses their footing first tends to be in a bitter mood for the remainder of the day.
rows.translation: POKENAME的壳出奇软，野外常见彼此弹跳碰撞着玩。谁先站不稳，当天剩下的时间往往都会闷闷不乐。
rows.reason: remainder of the day→当天剩余时间，未扩成整整一天或数日。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的壳出奇软，野外常见彼此弹跳碰撞着玩。谁先站不稳，当天剩下的时间往往都会闷闷不乐。

rows.source: POKENAME spends most of its time exercising. As long as it has water, it can go a week without eating even during intense workouts.
rows.translation: POKENAME大部分时间都在锻炼。只要有水，即使高强度运动，也能一周不吃东西。
rows.reason: a week without eating as long as water→有水可一周不吃，周时长与必要条件均保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME大部分时间都在锻炼。只要有水，即使高强度运动，也能一周不吃东西。

rows.source: Because of its lack of teeth, POKENAME spews out an acidic liquid to dissolve its food. It struggles to move around, so it spends most of the day lying on its belly and absorbing sunlight with its leaves.
rows.translation: POKENAME没有牙，只好喷酸液溶解食物。行动困难，一天大半时间都趴着，用叶子吸收阳光。
rows.reason: most of the day→一天大半时间，非精确小时数；没有编造比例。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME没有牙，只好喷酸液溶解食物。行动困难，一天大半时间都趴着，用叶子吸收阳光。

rows.source: While in flight, POKENAME spits a lemon-scented acid at remarkable distances. Its accuracy remains flawless even at a hundred meters.
rows.translation: POKENAME飞行时，能将柠檬香酸液吐得很远。即使相隔一百米，也百发百中。
rows.reason: 原快照“百米之外”可能扩大at 100m距离边界；现译已为“即使相隔一百米，也百发百中”，相隔100米的位置与原文一致，主审修正已核实。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME飞行时，能将柠檬香酸液吐得很远。即使相隔一百米，也百发百中。
rows.suggestion: 即使相隔一百米，也百发百中。
rows.resolution: 主审已按精确原文键应用；只读终检未改译文。

historical_issue.translation: POKENAME飞行时，能将柠檬香酸液吐得很远。即使百米之外，也百发百中。
historical_issue.resolution: 主审已应用相隔一百米，本终检不改译文。

rows.source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite, often consuming prey almost as large as it is, but because of its weak stomach acids, it will spend weeks digesting its meal before it has to hunt again.
rows.translation: POKENAME食欲贪婪，常吞下几乎与自己一样大的猎物。胃酸却弱，得花数周消化，才需要再次捕猎。
rows.reason: weeks digesting→数周消化，单位周与先消化再捕猎的顺序正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME食欲贪婪，常吞下几乎与自己一样大的猎物。胃酸却弱，得花数周消化，才需要再次捕猎。

rows.source: It's said that when POKENAME is in a bad mood, its kicks become deadly due to the acid coating its feet. People remain cautious around POKENAME because of this.
rows.translation: 据说，POKENAME心情不好时，脚上覆着酸液，踢击会变得致命。因此，人们在它身边总格外谨慎。
rows.reason: feet为脚，not英尺，bad mood无数值；属选择器误命中。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 据说，POKENAME心情不好时，脚上覆着酸液，踢击会变得致命。因此，人们在它身边总格外谨慎。

rows.source: POKENAME belch magma from their upturned mouth at their foes, launching the fiery projectiles dozens of meters through the air. Their attacks are often linked to forest fires, large areas burning away and leaving fertile ash for new plant growth.
rows.translation: POKENAME从朝上的嘴里喷出岩浆，将炽热弹丸发射到数十米外。它的攻击常与森林火灾相伴，大地被烧过后留下肥沃的灰烬，供新植物生长。
rows.reason: dozens of meters→数十米，距离数量级与米单位正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME从朝上的嘴里喷出岩浆，将炽热弹丸发射到数十米外。它的攻击常与森林火灾相伴，大地被烧过后留下肥沃的灰烬，供新植物生长。

rows.source: When POKENAME eat too much, their digestive system create a very potent acid that burns their stomach. Then, POKENAME need to stop eating for a few days and drink water in order to dilute the acid.
rows.translation: POKENAME吃得太多时，消化系统就会产生极强的酸，灼伤自己的胃。这时，它必须停食几天，并喝水稀释酸液。
rows.reason: a few days stop eating→停食几天，时间单位天正确，未给具体剂量。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME吃得太多时，消化系统就会产生极强的酸，灼伤自己的胃。这时，它必须停食几天，并喝水稀释酸液。

rows.source: Many a swimmer's day was ruined thanks to POKENAME's extremely painful sting. Each sting will result in an unsightly rash that requires first aid in order to properly heal. They are easier to see at night, thanks to the way their body glows.
rows.translation: POKENAME刺人极痛，毁掉了许多游泳者一天的好心情。每次被刺都会长出难看的疹子，需要急救处理才能妥善恢复。它的身体会发光，因此夜里更容易被看见。
rows.reason: first aid为急救，非数值第一；day也为一天好心情的叙述，无计量错误。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME刺人极痛，毁掉了许多游泳者一天的好心情。每次被刺都会长出难看的疹子，需要急救处理才能妥善恢复。它的身体会发光，因此夜里更容易被看见。

rows.source: POKENAME's tentacles are coated in a powerful neurotoxin that can paralyze its prey within seconds. Its red spines give off a dull red glow that gets brighter the deeper POKENAME swims.
rows.translation: POKENAME的触手覆有强效神经毒素，几秒内就能麻痹猎物。红色尖刺散发暗红微光，游得越深，光就越亮。
rows.reason: within seconds→几秒内麻痹，秒单位和短时上界正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的触手覆有强效神经毒素，几秒内就能麻痹猎物。红色尖刺散发暗红微光，游得越深，光就越亮。

rows.source: Each of POKENAME's head and tail tentacles is tipped with a venomous stinger. The venom causes an extreme burning sensation that remains painful for days. The orbs on its back glow during the night and are used to lure in unsuspecting prey.
rows.translation: POKENAME头部和尾部的每条触手末端，都有一根毒刺。毒液会引发强烈的灼烧感，疼痛持续数日。夜里，背上的球体会发光，引诱毫无戒心的猎物。
rows.reason: remains painful for days→疼痛持续数日，持续时间单位正确，未变成延迟发作。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME头部和尾部的每条触手末端，都有一根毒刺。毒液会引发强烈的灼烧感，疼痛持续数日。夜里，背上的球体会发光，引诱毫无戒心的猎物。

rows.source: Its limbs are actually tentacles that can stretch over a meter long, making its martial strikes extremely unpredictable. When POKENAME senses an aura it finds pleasing, the gems on its head emit a faint glow.
rows.translation: POKENAME的四肢其实是能伸长至一米多的触手，使格斗攻击变幻莫测。感知到喜欢的波导时，它头上的宝石便会发出微光。
rows.reason: over a meter long→一米多的触手，超过与米单位正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的四肢其实是能伸长至一米多的触手，使格斗攻击变幻莫测。感知到喜欢的波导时，它头上的宝石便会发出微光。

rows.source: POKENAME's enlarged cranium houses a brain brimming with psychic potential. Those hit by its tentacles will be inflicted with the stinging pain of constant headaches for up to a week.
rows.translation: POKENAME膨大的头骨中，有一颗蕴藏丰富精神潜能的大脑。被触手击中后，会头痛不止，刺痛感最长可持续一周。
rows.reason: up to a week→最长持续一周，时长上限保留，不改至少一周。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME膨大的头骨中，有一颗蕴藏丰富精神潜能的大脑。被触手击中后，会头痛不止，刺痛感最长可持续一周。

rows.source: POKENAME often stumbles when walking due to the weight of its bulky shell. This Pokémon is still learning how to manipulate the pumps on its back, so there is a 50-50 chance it will eject fire or water. On rare occasions, they will eject both.
rows.translation: POKENAME的外壳笨重，走起路来经常绊倒。它还在学习控制背上的泵，所以喷出火或水的机会各占一半；极少数时候，两者会一起喷出。
rows.reason: 50-50 chance→喷火或喷水的机会各占一半，是50%/50%的正确等值释义；脚本只找裸数字50，不识别“一半”。极少数同时喷两者也照原文保留，不为修正作者概率措辞而改成其他百分比。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME的外壳笨重，走起路来经常绊倒。它还在学习控制背上的泵，所以喷出火或水的机会各占一半；极少数时候，两者会一起喷出。

rows.source: POKENAME's soft petals take two years to wilt, so some pillow companies use them as an extra-soft stuffing. The petals have a zesty, vibrant smell.
rows.translation: POKENAME柔软花瓣两年才枯，有些枕头公司拿来作极软填料。花瓣的气味清爽而鲜明。
rows.reason: two years to wilt→两年才枯，花瓣枯萎时长与年单位正确，不混宝可梦寿命。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME柔软花瓣两年才枯，有些枕头公司拿来作极软填料。花瓣的气味清爽而鲜明。

rows.source: POKENAME uses the three flowers of its body to spread pollen around lakefronts to help flower growth. It uses thorny vines extended from the same flowers to catch fish Pokémon to eat.
rows.translation: POKENAME用身上3朵花，在湖岸散播花粉，帮助花生长。它还会从这些花里伸出带刺藤蔓，捕食鱼类宝可梦。
rows.reason: three flowers→3朵花，数量正确，数字与英文拼写等值。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME用身上3朵花，在湖岸散播花粉，帮助花生长。它还会从这些花里伸出带刺藤蔓，捕食鱼类宝可梦。

rows.source: POKENAME spread a fragrant scent as they leisurely glide on air currents. On rainy days, they drift back to the ground to rest.
rows.translation: POKENAME悠闲随气流滑翔，飘散芳香。雨天便降回地面休息。
rows.reason: rainy days为雨天条件，非固定数日，译雨天未造具体天数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME悠闲随气流滑翔，飘散芳香。雨天便降回地面休息。

rows.source: In the early morning, the flowers on POKENAME's tail emit a strong sweet scent. Some believe that inhaling this aroma enough times in life will awaken psychic powers in one's mind.
rows.translation: 清晨，POKENAME尾上的花散浓甜香。有人相信，一生闻够次数，便会唤醒心中超能力。
rows.reason: enough times in life→一生闻够次数，源未给次数阈值，译文未擅造数字。

rows.source: This Pokémon practices graceful darts and twirls, all in an effort to improve its abilities to dodge and ambush. It longs for the day it evolves.
rows.translation: 它练习优雅地突进、旋转，想提升闪避和伏击能力，盼着进化的那天。
rows.reason: the day it evolves为进化的将来时点，不是一天内进化，译进化那天正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 它练习优雅地突进、旋转，想提升闪避和伏击能力，盼着进化的那天。

rows.source: POKENAME is a bit haughty and will harshly smack any that come too close with the heavy flowers on its tail. As a consolation, being struck will leave the victim smelling pleasantly floral for a few hours.
rows.translation: POKENAME有点傲，谁太靠近，就用尾上重花猛拍。勉强算安慰的是，挨打后，身上会留几小时宜人花香。
rows.reason: for a few hours→几小时花香，少量时长与小时单位保留。

rows.source: Known as protectors of flower fields, POKENAME gracefully wander through their area, monitoring the growth of each flower. If something is threatening the flowers, one kick from an angry POKENAME will send that threat flying.
rows.translation: POKENAME是花田保护者，优雅巡视领域，照看每朵花的生长。若花受威胁，愤怒的一脚，就能踢飞对方。
rows.reason: one kick→一脚踢飞，无新增击打次数。

rows.source: The flowers on POKENAME's hands bloom beautifully when it is surrounded by positive emotions. It spends its day relaxing in sunny meadows.
rows.translation: POKENAME被积极情绪包围，手上花朵就会美丽绽放。它整天在阳光草地放松。
rows.reason: spends its day→整天休息，非精确24小时生理时长，无数值错误。

rows.source: From its two flowers, it scatters an aromatic pollen that can cause the colors of nearby vegetation to gradually change; the color change is never permanent. It can change its bodily colors at will, though its flowers never change color.
rows.translation: 它从两朵花散出芳香花粉，使附近植物逐渐变色，但变化不会永久持续。身体能随意变色，自己的花却永不变色。
rows.reason: two flowers→两朵花；永不永久变色/自身花不变色的限制也保留，未造持续年数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 它从两朵花散出芳香花粉，使附近植物逐渐变色，但变化不会永久持续。身体能随意变色，自己的花却永不变色。

rows.source: POKENAME lure in their prey of Bug-type Pokémon by waving their six beautiful flowers. They drink clean springwater to give these flowers their enticing aroma.
rows.translation: POKENAME挥动6朵美丽花朵，诱来虫属性宝可梦作猎物。它喝干净泉水，让花散出诱人香气。
rows.reason: six flowers→6朵花，数量正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME挥动6朵美丽花朵，诱来虫属性宝可梦作猎物。它喝干净泉水，让花散出诱人香气。

rows.source: The roses on POKENAME's body require a high degree of care to thrive properly. Only consuming the highest quality soil and freshest water will keep the plants from wilting and losing color.
rows.translation: POKENAME身上玫瑰，要精心照料才能茁壮。只有吃最优质的土壤、喝最新鲜的水，植物才不枯萎褪色。
rows.reason: high degree of care是精心照料，degree非温度单位；译精心照料正确。

rows.source: The thorns that cover POKENAME have the remarkable ability to both harm and heal depending on how pure-hearted the one being pricked is. This has earned it the nickname "The Tender Thorn Pokémon".
rows.translation: POKENAME全身的刺能伤人，也能治愈，取决于被刺者内心有多纯洁。因此得了“温柔之刺宝可梦”的绰号。
rows.reason: the one being pricked是被刺者指代，不是只许刺一个人的数量限制。

rows.source: POKENAME regularly scatters special seeds throughout dumps to encourage plant growth. Many landfills become overgrown with flowers in a short period after one pays a visit.
rows.translation: POKENAME定期在垃圾堆散特殊种子，促进植物生长。来过不久，许多填埋场就会长满花。
rows.reason: after one pays a visit指一只宝可梦来访后，译来过不久；无固定分钟或天数。

rows.source: The flowers on POKENAME's head produce pleasant whistling music on breezy days. If it feels like people are not listening, it amplifies the sound to a piercing level to force their attention.
rows.translation: 微风天，POKENAME头上的花会奏悦耳口哨乐。觉得没人听，就提高到刺耳音量，强迫注意。
rows.reason: breezy days为微风天条件，非明确数量，译微风天正确。

rows.source: The flowers on POKENAME's tail shift in color depending on the time of day. From sunset 'til midnight, the blue flower turns red and vice versa; from sunrise 'til noon, the colors return to their original shades.
rows.translation: POKENAME尾上花随时辰变色。日落至午夜，蓝色花变红、红色花变蓝；日出至正午，颜色再恢复如初。
rows.reason: sunset to midnight及sunrise to noon→日落至午夜、日出至正午，变色/复原时段没有交换，未擅给固定小时值。

rows.source: Petals that naturally fall off POKENAME have been used as a sleep aid for centuries. A cup of tea made with these petals makes the consumer sleep for a whole 8 hours straight.
rows.translation: POKENAME自然掉落的花瓣，数百年来都被用作助眠品。一杯花瓣茶，便能让饮用者连续睡足8小时。
rows.reason: whole 8 hours straight→连续睡足8小时；centuries→数百年来，连续睡眠时长与助眠传统的时间尺度分别保留。

rows.source: Petals that naturally fall off POKENAME have been used as a sleep aid for centuries. A cup of tea made with these petals makes the consumer sleep for a whole eight hours straight.
rows.translation: POKENAME自然掉落的花瓣，数百年来都被用作助眠品。一杯花瓣茶，便能让饮用者连续睡足8小时。
rows.reason: whole eight hours straight→连续睡足8小时，拼写数字与阿拉伯数字等值；centuries保数百年来。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME自然掉落的花瓣，数百年来都被用作助眠品。一杯花瓣茶，便能让饮用者连续睡足8小时。

rows.source: Wild POKENAME never remain in one place for long. It is said that their bodies each contain multiple spirits, and that these spirits squabble amongst themselves to decide what POKENAME should evolve into.
rows.translation: 野生POKENAME从不在一处久留。据说每只体内都有多个灵魂，为了决定该进化成什么，彼此争吵不休。
rows.reason: one place/multiple spirits→一处/多个灵魂，未凭复数追加固定灵魂总数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 野生POKENAME从不在一处久留。据说每只体内都有多个灵魂，为了决定该进化成什么，彼此争吵不休。

rows.source: The sac on the end of its tail is inflatable and can expand to several times the size of its body.  Even in serious situations, it loves using its sac to bounce everywhere.
rows.translation: 尾端的囊可以充气，胀到身体的好几倍。即使事态严重，它还是爱用这个囊四处弹跳。
rows.reason: several times the size of its body→身体好几倍，比例基准为体积/体形而非重量，未造确切倍数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 尾端的囊可以充气，胀到身体的好几倍。即使事态严重，它还是爱用这个囊四处弹跳。

rows.source: POKENAME floats lazily above rivers, scanning for prey like Caterpie. Once it spots one, it wraps its thread-like limbs around it and drags it away to its nest.
rows.translation: POKENAME懒懒浮在河流上方，寻找绿毛虫等猎物。一发现，就用细线般的肢体缠住，拖回巢。
rows.reason: one为看到的某只猎物，中文一发现对应，不是必须只捕食一只的上限。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME懒懒浮在河流上方，寻找绿毛虫等猎物。一发现，就用细线般的肢体缠住，拖回巢。

rows.source: Whenever a life is lost near POKENAME, its head expands, absorbing the energy. This seems to greatly upset it, and it emits a sorrowful wail, jumping up high into the air, and does not come down for days.
rows.translation: 附近有生命逝去，POKENAME的头就会胀大，吸收能量。这似乎使它十分难过，悲伤哀号着跃上高空，数日不落。
rows.reason: for days→数日不落，持续单位天保留，未改几小时。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 附近有生命逝去，POKENAME的头就会胀大，吸收能量。这似乎使它十分难过，悲伤哀号着跃上高空，数日不落。

rows.source: Whenever a life is lost near POKENAME, the Drifloon expands, absorbing the energy, and the Wooper shrinks. This seems to greatly upset it, and it emits a sorrowful wail, jumping up high into the air, and does not come down for days.
rows.translation: 附近有生命逝去，POKENAME的飘飘球部分就会胀大，吸收能量，乌波部分却缩小。它似乎十分难过，悲伤哀号着跃上高空，数日不落。
rows.reason: for days→数日不落，持续天数与前一版本一致，未因双个体描写改变时长。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 附近有生命逝去，POKENAME的飘飘球部分就会胀大，吸收能量，乌波部分却缩小。它似乎十分难过，悲伤哀号着跃上高空，数日不落。

rows.source: At night, POKENAME tries to get people to follow it by having them take hold of one of its tails. However, its body is so light that a child can easily pull it around.
rows.translation: 夜里，POKENAME想让人抓住其中一条尾巴，跟随自己。可身体太轻，连孩子也能轻易拉着它走。
rows.reason: one of its tails→其中一条尾巴，未误成只有一条尾巴。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 夜里，POKENAME想让人抓住其中一条尾巴，跟随自己。可身体太轻，连孩子也能轻易拉着它走。

rows.source: Like Drifloon, it's in POKENAME's nature to lure and abduct children. However, given it can only float a few feet off the ground, almost all children escape its grasp.
rows.translation: 像飘飘球一样，诱骗、绑走孩子是POKENAME的本性。但它只能离地飘几英尺，几乎所有孩子都逃得掉。
rows.reason: only a few feet off ground→只能离地几英尺，单位英尺、高度基准地面与只能限制均保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 像飘飘球一样，诱骗、绑走孩子是POKENAME的本性。但它只能离地飘几英尺，几乎所有孩子都逃得掉。

rows.source: The fluffiness of the clouds on POKENAME's back is dependent on how much sunlight it has absorbed during the day. It uses string-like vines to lift up small children to play with and sing to them.
rows.translation: POKENAME背上云朵的蓬松程度，取决于白天吸收了多少日光。它用细线般的藤蔓举起小孩，一起玩，唱歌给他们听。
rows.reason: during the day为白天吸光的时段，没有明示小时数，译未造时长。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME背上云朵的蓬松程度，取决于白天吸收了多少日光。它用细线般的藤蔓举起小孩，一起玩，唱歌给他们听。

rows.source: This Pokémon's ambushing power is limited by the alarming noise of its squeaky slither. It is said to appear coiled in the shape of the number two.
rows.translation: 它蛇行时吱吱作响，声音惹人警觉，限制了伏击能力。据说现身时，会盘成数字2的形状。
rows.reason: number two→数字2，保持形状符号而非身体个体数。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 它蛇行时吱吱作响，声音惹人警觉，限制了伏击能力。据说现身时，会盘成数字2的形状。

rows.source: POKENAME sprouts balloon-like objects from its back to float over cliffs. These balloons are insulated from its electric discharges, and it can generate up to four at a time, adjusting their number based on how far it needs to travel.
rows.translation: POKENAME背上长出气球般的物体，帮它浮过峭壁。这些气球能隔绝自身放电，最多同时长4个，按路程远近调整数量。
rows.reason: up to four at a time→最多同时4个，数量上限与同时发生条件都保留。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME背上长出气球般的物体，帮它浮过峭壁。这些气球能隔绝自身放电，最多同时长4个，按路程远近调整数量。

rows.source: POKENAME's two gas-filled tails serve to lighten its weight, aiding its agility. There is a downside to this trait, however — a strong wind may blow POKENAME away.
rows.translation: POKENAME两条充气的尾巴能减轻重量，帮助灵活移动。但也有缺点：一阵强风，就可能把它吹走。
rows.reason: two gas-filled tails→两条充气尾巴，数量正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME两条充气的尾巴能减轻重量，帮助灵活移动。但也有缺点：一阵强风，就可能把它吹走。

rows.source: If POKENAME senses a fight beneath it as it flies, it swoops down and uses its feelers to ensnare and carry one of the combatants far away, believing that separating them will solve whatever problem caused the strife.
rows.translation: POKENAME飞行时，若察觉下方打架，就俯冲，用触须缠住一方，带到远处。它相信，无论为何争执，把双方分开就能解决。
rows.reason: one of the combatants→一方，不误成把双方一起带走；无额外精确距离。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME飞行时，若察觉下方打架，就俯冲，用触须缠住一方，带到远处。它相信，无论为何争执，把双方分开就能解决。

rows.source: It utilizes its own internal flames and its inherently light body to drift through the air, though it takes shelter on windy days. Its body can expand a decent bit, to the point that it sometimes has been mistaken for a balloon by small children.
rows.translation: 它靠体内火焰和天生轻盈的身体，在空中漂游，有风天却会找掩蔽。身体能膨胀不少，有时被小孩误认成气球。
rows.reason: windy days为有风天气条件，非数日时长，译有风天正确。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: 它靠体内火焰和天生轻盈的身体，在空中漂游，有风天却会找掩蔽。身体能膨胀不少，有时被小孩误认成气球。

rows.source: POKENAME seems to have a vendetta against flying objects, balloons in particular. If it spots one, it cannot resist the impulse to pop it with its claws.
rows.translation: POKENAME似乎与飞行物有仇，尤其是气球。只要看见，就忍不住想用爪子戳破。
rows.reason: one为发现一个飞行物的泛指，译只要看见，未增加计量或次数条件。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME似乎与飞行物有仇，尤其是气球。只要看见，就忍不住想用爪子戳破。

rows.source: POKENAME's powerful legs combined with its light body allow it to leap up to 60 feet in the air. It can use the flames it produces to stay aloft for longer, but it is then in danger of being blown about by even gentle winds.
rows.translation: POKENAME双腿强，身体轻，最高能跳60英尺。借自生火焰，还能留空更久，但此时连微风，也可能把它吹来吹去。
rows.reason: up to 60 feet→最高60英尺，跳跃高度上限及英尺单位正确，未误作60米。
rows.current_translation_when_report_written: POKENAME双腿强，身体轻，最高能跳60英尺。借自生火焰，还能留空更久，但此时连微风，也可能把它吹来吹去。

community_proposals.purpose: 从已完成B/C/root终审笔记提取当前主术语表缺项，仅供主审统一名称；不修改译文、术语表或其他分片。
application_rules: 仅供主审应用候选，当前文件不执行任何替换。
优先按完整英文专名与实体类别匹配；只借名称，不用百科对战机制或生态覆盖社区原创。
non_official=true表示笔记或百科明确为非官方通行译名；false表示已有任天堂/官方或明确简中名依据；null表示已有中文用名但本次未证明官方等级，不能据此声称大陆官方。
不得把普通词、语境绰号、未定代词或原文笔误修复无条件注册为正式专名。
不得把同一融合英文名无条件映射到多个身份中的第一个；本文件不新增任何融合名键。
aliases仅收本轮B/C/root原文中确见的形式；上下文受限变体另记，不因拼写相似泛替换。
稳定species/moves分类词表不为填满主terms整库复制，重点收新核地名、场所、树果、邮件、料理及易误译道具。
本次只另行复查Shadow Mail、Azalea Town、Mount Lanakila的网页；其他链接为终审笔记已有证据，不冒称全部本次重访。
